VT:0000000.name: mammary gland secreted fluid morphology trait

VT:0000001.name: vertebrate trait
VT:0000001.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of a vertebrate organism.

VT:0000002.name: head size trait
VT:0000002.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the portion of the body containing the brain and organs of sight, hearing, taste, and smell.

VT:0000003.name: adipose morphology trait
VT:0000003.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the fat-storing cells/tissue.

VT:0000004.name: forelimb conformation trait
VT:0000004.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the assessment of the overall structure and proportions of the anterior or superior jointed appendages of an animal, used for locomotion or grasping.

VT:0000005.name: heart right atrium size trait
VT:0000005.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the right upper chamber of the heart.

VT:0000006.name: esophagus size trait
VT:0000006.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the part of the digestive canal through which food passes from the pharynx to the stomach.

VT:0000007.name: mammary gland growth trait
VT:0000007.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the increase in size of the milk-producing glands in female mammals, consisting of lobes containing clusters of alveoli with a system of ducts to convey the milk to an external nipple or teat.

VT:0000008.name: heart atrium appendage configuration trait
VT:0000008.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement of the small trabeculated chamber projecting from the atrium proper.

VT:0000009.name: obsolete red blood cell quantity
VT:0000009.def: OBSOLETE. Replace with VT:00001586, erythrocyte quantity.

VT:0000010.name: abdominal fat pad morphology trait
VT:0000010.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the encapsulated adipose tissue in the cavity bounded by the abdominal walls, the diaphragm, and the pelvis.

VT:0000011.name: cloaca septation extent
VT:0000011.def: The degree to which the separation of the single opening of the digestive, urinary, and reproductive tracts (cloaca) into multiple isolated openings during development has reached its end point.

VT:0000012.name: heart left atrium size trait
VT:0000012.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the left upper chamber of the heart.

VT:0000013.name: adipose distribution trait
VT:0000013.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the placement of fat-storing cells/tissue on the body.

VT:0000014.name: tracheal-esophageal septation extent
VT:0000014.def: The degree to which the separation of the trachea and esophagus during development has reached its end point.

VT:0000016.name: hindlimb conformation trait
VT:0000016.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the assessment of the overall structure and proportions of the posterior or inferior jointed appendages of an animal, used for locomotion or grasping.

VT:0000017.name: outer ear size trait
VT:0000017.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of any of the components of the auricles or external acoustic meatus.

VT:0000018.name: heart ventricle membranous septum morphology trait
VT:0000018.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the membranous portion of the wall between the lower chambers of the heart.
synonyms: interventricular septum membranous part morphology trait

VT:0000019.name: heart right atrium morphology trait
VT:0000019.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the right upper chamber of the heart.

VT:0000020.name: heart left atrium morphology trait
VT:0000020.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the left upper chamber of the heart.

VT:0000021.name: outer ear prominence
VT:0000021.def: The physical distance from the outer edge of the outer ear to the head.

VT:0000022.name: outer ear shape trait
VT:0000022.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical form or contours of any of the components of the auricles or external acoustic meatus.

VT:0000023.name: obsolete ear orientation trait
VT:0000023.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the location or placement of the outer ears in relation to each other or to the skull.\nreplace with VT:0010274

VT:0000024.name: heart atrium appendage morphology trait
VT:0000024.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the small trabeculated chamber projecting from the atrium proper.

VT:0000025.name: atrioventricular valve morphology trait
VT:0000025.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the valves that gate the flow of blood from the atria into the ventricles.

VT:0000026.name: inner ear morphology trait
VT:0000026.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the labyrinth, including the semicircular canals, vestibule and cochlea.

VT:0000027.name: head width
VT:0000027.def: The distance from side to side across the portion of the body containing the brain and organs of sight, hearing, taste, and smell.

VT:0000028.name: pars superior vestibularis morphology trait
VT:0000028.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the part of the vestibular ganglion that receives fibers from the maculae of the utricle and the sacculae and the ampullae of the anterior and lateral semicircular ducts.

VT:0000029.name: malleus morphology trait
VT:0000029.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the largest of the three auditory ossicles, which resembles a club.

VT:0000030.name: tympanic ring morphology trait
VT:0000030.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bony ring at the ear canal to which the tympanic membrane is attached.

VT:0000031.name: cochlea morphology trait
VT:0000031.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the spiral-shaped bony canal in the inner ear containing the hair cells that transduce sound.

VT:0000032.name: urine total protein amount
VT:0000032.def: The total proportion, quantity, or volume in urine of macromolecules consisting of long chains of amino acids in peptide linkage.

VT:0000033.name: mitral valve morphology trait
VT:0000033.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the valve between the left atrium and the left ventricle of the heart.

VT:0000034.name: vestibule morphology trait
VT:0000034.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the cavity between the semicircular canals and the cochlea of the inner ear.

VT:0000035.name: membranous labyrinth morphology trait
VT:0000035.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the complex arrangement of communicating canaliculi and sacs suspended within the cavity of the bony labyrinth of the inner ear.

VT:0000036.name: tricuspid valve morphology trait
VT:0000036.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the valve between the right atrium and the right ventricle of the heart.

VT:0000037.name: lateral semicircular canal morphology trait
VT:0000037.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the lateral long bony tube of the labyrinth that is involved in the sense of balance.

VT:0000038.name: head length
VT:0000038.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the portion of the body containing the brain and organs of sight, hearing, taste, and smell.

VT:0000039.name: otic capsule morphology trait
VT:0000039.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the cartilage or bony capsule surrounding the inner ear mechanism.

VT:0000040.name: aortic valve morphology trait
VT:0000040.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the valve between the left ventricle and the ascending aorta.

VT:0000041.name: endolymphatic duct size trait
VT:0000041.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the small membranous canal, connecting with both saccule and utricle of the membranous labyrinth, passing through the aqueduct of vestibule, and terminating in the endolymphatic sac.

VT:0000042.name: organ of Corti morphology trait
VT:0000042.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the highly specialized epithelium in the floor of the ductus cochlearis; also referred to a spiral organ (organum spirale), or acoustic papilla.

VT:0000044.name: pulmonary valve morphology trait
VT:0000044.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the valve between the right ventricle and the pulmonary trunk.

VT:0000045.name: hair cell morphology trait
VT:0000045.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the sensory epithelial cells of the inner ear.

VT:0000046.name: sulcus ampullaris morphology trait
VT:0000046.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the transverse groove on the membranous ampulla of each semicircular duct, where the nerve enters the ampullary crest.

VT:0000047.name: head circumference
VT:0000047.def: The distance around the widest part of the portion of the body containing the brain and organs of sight, hearing, taste, and smell.

VT:0000048.name: stria vascularis morphology trait
VT:0000048.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the stratified, secretory epithelium which lines the upper part of the cochlear spiral ligament and maintains K+ homeostasis in the endolymph; stria vascularis normally consists of marginal, intermediate, and basal cells: basal and marginal cell tight junctions preclude paracellular diffusion into and out of the intrastrial space while basal and intermediate cells secrete into this space K+ derived from fibrocytes through gap junctions.
synonyms: stria vascularis ductus cochlearis morphology trait

VT:0000049.name: middle ear morphology trait
VT:0000049.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of any of the components of the tympanic cavity or its ossicles.

VT:0000050.name: pancreas/salivary gland morphology trait
VT:0000050.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the pancreas or salivary glands.

VT:0000051.name: testis physiology trait
VT:0000051.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the male reproductive glands where sperm production occurs.

VT:0000052.name: ear unfolding initiation trait
VT:0000052.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the start of opening and spreading out of the outer ear.

VT:0000053.name: milk total casein amount
VT:0000053.def: The total proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of all fractions of casein, which is the predominant phosphoprotein in milk.

VT:0000054.name: ear emergence initiation trait
VT:0000054.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the start of the growth of the outer ear.

VT:0000055.name: milk total mineral amount
VT:0000055.def: The total proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of all inorganic elements or compounds that have importance in body functions.

VT:0000056.name: urine trait
VT:0000056.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the fluid and dissolved substances excreted by the kidneys.

VT:0000057.name: ossification trait
VT:0000057.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of bone formation or conversion of fibrous tissue or cartilage into bone.

VT:0000058.name: heart muscle compact layer morphology trait
VT:0000058.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the outer, dense layer of the myocardium.

VT:0000059.name: osteoclast development trait
VT:0000059.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of this multinucleated cell, which normally functions in the absorption and removal of osseous tissue.

VT:0000060.name: ossification initiation trait
VT:0000060.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the start of the formation of bone or conversion of fibrous tissue or cartilage into bone.

VT:0000061.name: cardiomyocyte morphology trait
VT:0000061.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the striated muscle cells comprising the myocardium; depending on the species, cells may be mono-, bi-, or multinucleated.

VT:0000062.name: heart muscle trabeculae morphology trait
VT:0000062.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the supporting bundles of muscular fibers lining the walls of the heart.

VT:0000063.name: heart ventricle papillary muscle morphology trait
VT:0000063.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the group of myocardial bundles which terminate in the chordae tendineae that attach to the cusps of the atrioventricular valves; each ventricle has an anterior and a posterior papillary muscle; the right ventricle sometimes has a septal papillary muscle.

VT:0000064.name: secondary bone resorption trait
VT:0000064.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of osteoclasts to degrade the organic and inorganic phases of bone by absorption.

VT:0000065.name: medullary cavity morphology trait
VT:0000065.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the marrow cavity in the shaft of a long bone.

VT:0000066.name: pancreas/salivary gland physiology trait
VT:0000066.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the pancreas or salivary glands.

VT:0000067.name: obsolete blood morphology trait
VT:0000067.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the fluid that circulates through the heart, arteries, veins, and capillaries, carrying oxygen and nutritive materials and removing waste products and carbon dioxide.

VT:0000068.name: blood mineral amount
VT:0000068.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of any inorganic element or compound that has importance in body functions.

VT:0000069.name: embryo trait
VT:0000069.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the anatomical entity that comprises the organism in the early stages of growth and differentiation that are characterized by cleavage, the laying down of fundamental tissues, and the formation of primitive organs and organ systems.

VT:0000070.name: bone physiology trait
VT:0000070.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in a portion of osseous tissue forming a part of the skeleton; consists of a dense outer layer surrounded by the periosteum, and an inner spongy substance.

VT:0000071.name: axial skeleton cell quantity
VT:0000071.def: The proportion or number of cells in the craniofacial, vertebral, rib, or sternal bones.

VT:0000072.name: bone elasticity trait
VT:0000072.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of bone to recover size and shape after deformation in any way.

VT:0000073.name: lifetime offspring quantity
VT:0000073.def: The proportion or number of offspring born over the reproductive life of a female organism.

VT:0000074.name: neurocranium morphology trait
VT:0000074.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bones of the skull enclosing the brain.

VT:0000075.name: blood-brain barrier morphology trait
VT:0000075.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the group of barriers and transport systems in the brain capillary endothelium that controls the entrance of substances into the brain extracellular space from the blood.

VT:0000076.name: calvaria morphology trait
VT:0000076.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the upper dome-like portion of the skull.

VT:0000077.name: interparietal bone morphology trait
VT:0000077.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bone of the cranium that lies above and anterior to the occipital bone in some mammals.

VT:0000078.name: supraoccipital bone morphology trait
VT:0000078.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bone on the dorsal side of the great foramen of the skull, usually forming a part of the occipital in the adult, but distinct in the young.

VT:0000079.name: basilar bone morphology trait
VT:0000079.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the basilar process of the occipital bone in the base of the cranium, frequently forming a direct part of the occipital in the adult, but usually distinct in the young.

VT:0000080.name: exoccipital bone morphology trait
VT:0000080.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bone or region on the lateral sides of the great foramen of the skull, which often forms a part of the occipital in the adult, but is usually distinct in the young.

VT:0000081.name: cranial suture closure initiation trait
VT:0000081.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the start of fusion of the bones of the skull.

VT:0000084.name: fontanelle morphology trait
VT:0000084.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the membranous interval at the margins of cranial bones in neonates.

VT:0000085.name: blood-cerebrospinal fluid barrier morphology trait
VT:0000085.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the group of barriers and transport systems in the choroid plexus located in the lateral, third, and fourth brain ventricles that controls the entrance of substances into the cerebrospinal fluid from the blood.

VT:0000087.name: capillary morphology trait
VT:0000087.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the small branching blood vessels that connect arterioles and venules.

VT:0000098.name: vomer bone morphology trait
VT:0000098.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the triangular flat bone of the nasal septum.

VT:0000100.name: ethmoid bone morphology trait
VT:0000100.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bone lying between the orbital plates of the frontal bone and anterior to the sphenoid bone; it enters into the formation of the anterior cranial fossa, the orbits, and the nasal cavity.

VT:0000102.name: nasal bone morphology trait
VT:0000102.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of either of two rectangular bone plates forming the bridge of the nose.

VT:0000104.name: sphenoid bone morphology trait
VT:0000104.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the most irregularly shaped bone of the base of the skull.

VT:0000106.name: basisphenoid morphology trait
VT:0000106.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the part of the base of the cranium between the basioccipital and the presphenoid, which usually ossifies separately in the embryo or in the young, and becomes a part of the sphenoid in the adult; in many animals it persists as a separate bone between the basioccipital bone and the presphenoid bone.

VT:0000107.name: frontal bone morphology trait
VT:0000107.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bone forming the forehead and roof of the eye orbit.

VT:0000109.name: parietal bone morphology trait
VT:0000109.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the curved bone forming part of the vault of the cranium.

VT:0000116.name: tooth development trait
VT:0000116.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the bone-like structures embedded in the jaw.

VT:0000117.name: tooth primordium development trait
VT:0000117.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the cells that give rise to the teeth.

VT:0000119.name: tooth eruption trait
VT:0000119.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the passage of a tooth through the alveolar process and perforation of the gums.

VT:0000120.name: bite alignment trait
VT:0000120.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the patterned arrangement of the upper and lower teeth with respect to each other or arrangement of the upper and lower jaws with respect to each other.

VT:0000121.name: cardiovascular system development trait
VT:0000121.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the heart or blood vessels during their formation and differentiation.

VT:0000122.name: blood vessel development trait
VT:0000122.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the tubular channels through which the blood circulates.

VT:0000124.name: tooth quantity
VT:0000124.def: The proportion or number of the hard structures of the upper and lower jaws used in mastication.

VT:0000125.name: heart tube morphology trait
VT:0000125.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the primitive epithelial cardiac tube before the division into the chambers of the mature heart.

VT:0000126.name: tooth strength trait
VT:0000126.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of teeth to withstand the application of force without yielding or breaking.

VT:0000128.name: molar growth trait
VT:0000128.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the increase in size of the most posterior teeth, located on either side of the jaw and characterized by a large crown and broad chewing surface.

VT:0000130.name: cancellous bone morphology trait
VT:0000130.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of bone that has a lattice-like or spongy structure.

VT:0000131.name: long bone epiphysis morphology trait
VT:0000131.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the head of a long bone which, during development and growth, is separated from the shaft by the epiphyseal plate.

VT:0000132.name: epiphysis width
VT:0000132.def: The distance from side to side of the part of the head of a long bone which, during development and growth, is separated from the shaft by the epiphyseal plate.

VT:0000133.name: long bone metaphysis morphology trait
VT:0000133.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the conical section of bone between the epiphysis and diaphysis of the long bones.

VT:0000134.name: compact bone thickness
VT:0000134.def: The distance between the surfaces of the superficial layer of solid, hard bone that covers spongy bone.

VT:0000135.name: outflow tract morphology trait
VT:0000135.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the path through which blood exits the heart.

VT:0000136.name: microglial cell morphology trait
VT:0000136.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the small, migratory, phagocytic, interstitial cells derived from myeloid progenitor cells and found in the parenchyma of the central nervous system; microglia are scavengers, engulfing dead cells and other debris, and in Alzheimer's disease, microglia are found associated with dying nerve cells and amyloid plaques.

VT:0000137.name: vertebra morphology trait
VT:0000137.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the bony segments of the spinal column.

VT:0000138.name: vertebra quantity
VT:0000138.def: The proportion or number of bony segments of the spinal column.

VT:0000139.name: transverse process morphology trait
VT:0000139.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the bony protrusion on either side of the arch of a thoracic vertebrae.

VT:0000140.name: pedicle morphology trait
VT:0000140.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of part of the posteriorlateral vertebral arch of a thoracic vertebra.

VT:0000141.name: vertebral body morphology trait
VT:0000141.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the main portion of the vertebra, anterior to the vertebral canal.

VT:0000142.name: outer ear thickness
VT:0000142.def: The distance between the exterior surface and the interior surface of the auricle.

VT:0000149.name: scapula morphology trait
VT:0000149.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of either or both of the large, flat bones of the shoulder girdle.

VT:0000150.name: rib morphology trait
VT:0000150.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the elongated, curved bones forming the bony wall of the chest.

VT:0000151.name: atrioventricular canal partitioning trait
VT:0000151.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which the right and left sides of the heart become separated.

VT:0000152.name: proximal rib morphology trait
VT:0000152.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the rib structures near the spine; ribs do not contact vertebrae.

VT:0000153.name: obsolete blood circulatory physiology trait
VT:0000153.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable functional characteristic related to the function of or processes in the blood or vasculature.

VT:0000154.name: obsolete lymph circulatory physiology trait
VT:0000154.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable functional characteristic related to the function of or processes in the flow of lymph through its vasculature or of the lymph or vasculature itself.

VT:0000155.name: rib attachment trait
VT:0000155.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the attachment of ribs to the vertebral column or to the sternum.

VT:0000157.name: sternum morphology trait
VT:0000157.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the long, flat bone of the chest.

VT:0000159.name: xiphoid process morphology trait
VT:0000159.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the posterior/inferior tip of the sternum.

VT:0000163.name: cartilage morphology trait
VT:0000163.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the nonvascular, resilient, flexible connective tissue found primarily in joints, walls of the thorax, and tubular structures, but which also comprises most of the skeleton in early fetal life; some species have skeletons that are completely composed of cartilage which is never ossified.

VT:0000164.name: cartilage development trait
VT:0000164.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the nonvascular, resilient, flexible connective tissue found primarily in joints, walls of the thorax, and tubular structures, but which also comprises most of the skeleton in early fetal life. Some aquatic vertebrates have skeletons comprised entirely of cartilage.

VT:0000165.name: hypertrophic chondrocyte zone morphology trait
VT:0000165.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the layer of the epiphyseal plate where no cell division occurs and chondrocytes begin to terminally differentiate.

VT:0000166.name: chondrocyte morphology trait
VT:0000166.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of non-dividing cartilage cells.

VT:0000167.name: chondrocyte quantity
VT:0000167.def: The proportion or number of non-dividing cartilage cells.

VT:0000170.name: blood vessel physiology trait
VT:0000170.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the tubular channels through which the blood circulates.

VT:0000171.name: blood physiology trait
VT:0000171.def: Any measurable functional characteristic related to the function of or processes in the fluid that circulates through the heart, arteries, veins, and capillaries, carrying oxygen and nutritive materials and removing waste products and carbon dioxide.

VT:0000172.name: bone marrow cell quantity
VT:0000172.def: The proportion or number of cells that make up the core cavities of bones.

VT:0000173.name: lymph vessel physiology trait
VT:0000173.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the lymph vessels.

VT:0000174.name: lymph physiology trait
VT:0000174.def: Any measurable functional characteristic related to the function of or processes in the fluid which is collected from the tissues throughout the body, flows in the lymphatic vessels, and is eventually added to the venous blood circulation.

VT:0000175.name: hemodynamics trait
VT:0000175.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the circulation of blood throughout the body, including both the movement and the forces created by the movement.

VT:0000179.name: obsolete blood molecular composition trait
VT:0000179.def:
OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the blood.
consider: VT:0015078

Reinstated 6/29/21, VT:0010931

VT:0000180.name: blood cholesterol amount
VT:0000180.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the most abundant steroid in animal tissues, and precursor to steroid hormones and bile salts; also component of plasma membranes.

VT:0000181.name: blood LDL cholesterol amount
VT:0000181.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the lipoprotein: cholesterol complex that transports cholesterol out of the arteries and around the body, for use by various tissues in normal bodily functions.
synonyms: blood low density lipoprotein cholesterol amount

VT:0000182.name: blood flow trait
VT:0000182.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the movement of blood within a vessel or tissue.

VT:0000183.name: blood pressure trait
VT:0000183.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the hydrostatic force exerted by the blood perpendicular to the blood-tissue surface.

VT:0000184.name: blood HDL cholesterol amount
VT:0000184.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the small lipoprotein:cholesterol complex that transports cholesterol out of the arteries and to the liver for reprocessing or excretion.
synonyms: blood high density lipoprotein cholesterol amount

VT:0000185.name: obsolete blood flow velocity
VT:0000185.def: OBSOLETE. The speed at which blood moves through the vessels.

VT:0000186.name: blood shear trait
VT:0000186.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the mechanical force exerted by the blood parallel to the blood-tissue surface.

VT:0000187.name: triglyceride amount
VT:0000187.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in a body tissue or fluid of this molecule, glycerol esterified at each of its three hydroxyl groups by a fatty acid; triglyceride is an important molecule for storage of fatty acids in adipose tissue.

VT:0000188.name: blood glucose amount
VT:0000188.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the monosaccharide that is the end product of carbohydrate digestion; D-glucose serves as a primary energy source for living organisms.

VT:0000189.name: blood vessel distensibility trait
VT:0000189.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the blood vessels (tubular channels through which the blood circulates) to stretch.

VT:0000190.name: blood vessel permeability trait
VT:0000190.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of gases, liquids, or solutes to pass through the blood vessel wall.

VT:0000192.name: mineral amount
VT:0000192.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in a body tissue or fluid of any inorganic element or compound that has importance in body functions.

VT:0000194.name: obsolete blood vessel proliferation trait
VT:0000194.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of increasing the number of blood vessels within a given area or volume of tissue.\nconsider: VT:0010299, VT:0010300

VT:0000195.name: blood vessel reactivity trait
VT:0000195.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the ability of a blood vessel to change diameter in response to a chemical or mechanical signal.

VT:0000197.name: vasodilation trait
VT:0000197.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of a blood vessel to increase its diameter in response to a chemical or mechanical signal.

VT:0000198.name: vasoconstriction trait
VT:0000198.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of a blood vessel to reduce its diameter in response to a chemical or mechanical signal.

VT:0000199.name: blood albumin amount
VT:0000199.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the major blood protein that is important in maintenance of the colloidal osmotic pressure, fatty acid transport, and transport of large organic molecules.

VT:0000202.name: blood alkaline phosphatase amount
VT:0000202.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this enzyme, which hydrolyzes orthophosphoric monoesters.

VT:0000203.name: blood aspartate transaminase amount
VT:0000203.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this enzyme, which catalyzes the reversible transfer of an amine group from l-glutamic acid to oxaloacetic acid, forming alpha-ketoglutaric acid and l-aspartic acid; aids in diagnosis of viral hepatitis and myocardial infarction.

VT:0000217.name: leukocyte quantity
VT:0000217.def: The proportion or number of nucleated cells of the myeloid or lymphoid lineages, found in blood or other tissue.

VT:0000222.name: neutrophil quantity
VT:0000222.def: The proportion or number of the granular leukocytes that have a three- to five-lobed nucleus and a cytoplasm containing inconspicuous granules.

VT:0000223.name: monocyte quantity
VT:0000223.def: The proportion or number of large, phagocytic mononuclear leukocytes produced in the vertebrate bone marrow and released into the blood.

VT:0000228.name: thrombopoiesis trait
VT:0000228.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to development of the non-nucleated cells of the blood (platelets, thrombocytes) involved in blood coagulation.

VT:0000229.name: megakaryocyte development trait
VT:0000229.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of these very large bone marrow cells which release mature platelets.

VT:0000231.name: heart excitatory physiology trait
VT:0000231.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes involved in generation and conduction of electrical impulses in the heart.

VT:0000237.name: blood cell quantity
VT:0000237.def: The proportion or numbers of the various types of blood cells.

VT:0000239.name: common myeloid progenitor cell quantity
VT:0000239.def: The proportion or number of the hematopoietic stem cells that are capable of forming any of the myeloid lineage cells.

VT:0000240.name: hematopoiesis location trait
VT:0000240.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical site where formation and development of blood cells occurs.

VT:0000242.name: heart electrical impulse generation trait
VT:0000242.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the generation of action potentials in cardiac muscle.

VT:0000244.name: obsolete cardiac output amount
VT:0000244.def: OBSOLETE. The proportion, quantity, or volume of blood that is ejected from the heart into the aorta.

VT:0000245.name: erythropoiesis trait
VT:0000245.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the formation of red blood cells.

VT:0000248.name: erythrocyte size trait
VT:0000248.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the cells in the blood that carry oxygen, red blood cells

VT:0000254.name: cerebrospinal fluid amount
VT:0000254.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the serum-like fluid that circulates through the ventricles of the brain, the cavity of the spinal cord, and the subarachnoid space, functioning in shock absorption.

VT:0000255.name: regional blood flow trait
VT:0000255.def: Any measurable functional characteristic related to blood flow in a specific region of the body, tissue, or organ.

VT:0000259.name: capillary permeability trait
VT:0000259.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of gases, liquids, or solutes to pass through the capillary wall.

VT:0000260.name: hemostasis trait
VT:0000260.def: Any measurable functional characteristic related to the process of prevention of blood loss.

VT:0000261.name: arterial blood flow trait
VT:0000261.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to blood flow in the arteries.

VT:0000262.name: venous blood flow trait
VT:0000262.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to blood flow in the veins.

VT:0000263.name: capillary blood flow trait
VT:0000263.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to blood flow in the capillaries.

VT:0000266.name: heart morphology trait
VT:0000266.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the organ that pumps blood through the body.

VT:0000267.name: heart development trait
VT:0000267.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the organ that pumps blood through the body.

VT:0000268.name: vibrissa quantity
VT:0000268.def: The proportion or number of stiff hairs projecting from the face, which act as touch receptors.

VT:0000269.name: heart tube looping morphogenesis trait
VT:0000269.def: Any measurable or observable characteristics pertaining to the process by which the embryonic heart tube bends to transform from a straight tube into the final folded configuration of the adult heart.

VT:0000272.name: aorta morphology trait
VT:0000272.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the main trunk of the systemic arteries.

VT:0000276.name: heart right ventricle cell size trait
VT:0000276.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the cells in the right lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0000277.name: heart shape trait
VT:0000277.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical form or contours of the organ that pumps blood through the body.

VT:0000285.name: heart valve morphology trait
VT:0000285.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the membranous folds of the heart that prevent reflux of fluid.

VT:0000288.name: pericardium morphology trait
VT:0000288.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the fibroserous membrane covering the heart and beginning of the great vessels.

VT:0000307.name: blood-inner ear barrier physiology trait
VT:0000307.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the group of barriers and transport systems which regulate the transport of various substances from blood to inner ear tissue and maintain the microhomeostasis and functional integrity of the inner ear; the endothelial cells of the inner ear blood capillaries, linked to each other by tight junctions, represent the main component of the blood-inner ear barrier.

VT:0000315.name: urine hemoglobin amount
VT:0000315.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of the oxygen-carrying protein of erythrocytes.

VT:0000319.name: endolymph physiology trait
VT:0000319.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes involved in the production (volume) or ionic homeostasis of the fluid contained within the membranous labyrinth of the inner ear.

VT:0000330.name: endolymph production trait
VT:0000330.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the secretion of the fluid that is normally contained within the membranous labyrinth of the inner ear.

VT:0000334.name: granulocyte quantity
VT:0000334.def: The proportion or number of leukocytes that have abundant granules in the cytoplasm, including basophils, neutrophils, and eosinophils.

VT:0000336.name: mast cell quantity
VT:0000336.def: The proportion or number of the cells that are found in almost all tissues, containing numerous basophilic granules and capable of releasing large amounts of histamine and heparin upon activation.

VT:0000340.name: perilymph physiology trait
VT:0000340.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the fluid contained within the osseous labyrinth, surrounding and protecting the membranous labyrinth.

VT:0000341.name: bile color
VT:0000341.def: The visually perceived hue of the fluid secreted by the liver through the bile duct, determined by relative levels of bile pigments.

VT:0000344.name: Cajal-Retzius cell morphology trait
VT:0000344.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the distinct population of large, bipolar cells, distributed in a continuous band along the marginal zone of the cortex extending to the molecular layer of the dentate gyrus.

VT:0000348.name: aerobic fitness trait
VT:0000348.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the metabolic ability to do physical work.

VT:0000353.name: vestibular system physiology trait
VT:0000353.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the sensory system responsible for the sense of head position and movement of the body through space.

VT:0000357.name: limb quantity
VT:0000357.def: The proportion or number of the projecting, paired, jointed appendages of the body used for locomotion or grasping.

VT:0000359.name: mast cell morphology trait
VT:0000359.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a cell that is found in almost all tissues, containing numerous basophilic granules and capable of releasing large amounts of histamine and heparin upon activation.

VT:0000361.name: mast cell protease storage trait
VT:0000361.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the amounts of proteolytic enzymes stored in mast cells.

VT:0000362.name: mast cell histamine storage trait
VT:0000362.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the amounts of histamine stored in mast cells.

VT:0000363.name: cochlear microphonics trait
VT:0000363.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the bioelectric potentials produced by the hair cells of the organ of Corti in response to sound; the cochlear microphonic (CM) is an electric response dominated by OHC receptor potentials from the basal turn of the cochlea and provides a measure of transducer function in OHCs; in an active ear, CM waveforms show post-stimulus ringing (i.e. a cochlear echo) whereas in a passive ear system, CM decays at the cessation of the tone burst.

VT:0000365.name: hearing electrophysiology trait
VT:0000365.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes involved in auditory function as it relates to electrical phenomena.

VT:0000366.name: brainstem auditory evoked potential
VT:0000366.def: The electrical activity generated in response to short tone bursts; may be used to evaluate sensorineural hearing function.

VT:0000367.name: coat/hair morphology trait
VT:0000367.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the fine, keratinized filamentous growths arising from the epidermis of mammals.

VT:0000374.name: cochlear frequency tuning trait
VT:0000374.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the frequency resolution of the cochlea, normally determined by the passive mechanical properties of the basilar membrane and active feedback from the outer hair cells which detect and amplify sound-induced basilar membrane motions.

VT:0000379.name: hair follicle quantity
VT:0000379.def: The proportion or number of the tubular invaginations of the epidermis from which the hair shaft develops.

VT:0000383.name: hair follicle orientation trait
VT:0000383.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the location or arrangement in relation to each other or the body of the tubular invaginations of the epidermis from which the hair shafts develop.

VT:0000384.name: hair follicle organization trait
VT:0000384.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of the tubular invaginations of the epidermis from which the hair shaft develops.

VT:0000385.name: hair follicle size trait
VT:0000385.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the tubular invaginations of the epidermis from which the hair shaft develops.

VT:0000386.name: hair follicle root sheath morphology trait
VT:0000386.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the epidermally derived layer surrounding the hair follicle.

VT:0000413.name: phalanx quantity
VT:0000413.def: The proportion or number of the long bones in any of the digits.

VT:0000414.name: hair retention trait
VT:0000414.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to maintain the fine, keratinized filamentous growths arising from the epidermis of mammals without noticeable loss.

VT:0000416.name: hair amount
VT:0000416.def: The proportion or number of the fine, keratinized filamentous growths arising from the epidermis of mammals.

VT:0000417.name: hair length
VT:0000417.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the fine, keratinized filamentous growths arising from the epidermis of mammals.

VT:0000424.name: hair growth trait
VT:0000424.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the increase in length of the fine, keratinized filamentous growths arising from the epidermis of mammals.

VT:0000425.name: eyelash retention trait
VT:0000425.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to maintain the stiff hairs projecting from the margin of the eyelid without noticeable loss.

VT:0000427.name: hair cycle trait
VT:0000427.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the cyclical phases of growth (anagen), regression (catagen), and quiescence (telogen) in the life of a hair.

VT:0000428.name: craniofacial morphology trait
VT:0000428.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the region of the body that includes the front part of the head from the chin to the top of the forehead, where the mouth, eyes, nose, and other features are located, and the part of the skull enclosing the brain.

VT:0000430.name: palatine process morphology trait
VT:0000430.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the medially directed shelves of the maxillae that, with the horizontal plate of the palatine bone, form the bony palate.

VT:0000431.name: palatine shelf morphology trait
VT:0000431.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the outgrowth of the palatine bone; normally fuses with maxillary shelf to form secondary palate.

VT:0000432.name: head morphology trait
VT:0000432.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the portion of the body containing the brain and organs of sight, hearing, taste, and smell.

VT:0000438.name: skull morphology trait
VT:0000438.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bones surrounding the brain and bones of the lower face and jaws.

VT:0000443.name: snout morphology trait
VT:0000443.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the flesh covered anterior facial part that contains the nose, jaws, teeth, and mouth that projects from the head.

VT:0000444.name: snout shape trait
VT:0000444.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical form or contours of the flesh covered anterior facial part that contains the nose, jaws, teeth and mouth that projects from the head.

VT:0000446.name: snout length
VT:0000446.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the anterior facial part of the muzzle.

VT:0000449.name: nasal bridge width
VT:0000449.def: The distance from side to side across the upper part of the ridge of the nose.

VT:0000452.name: mouth morphology trait
VT:0000452.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the oral cavity.

VT:0000454.name: jaw morphology trait
VT:0000454.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bony framework of the mouth where the teeth are held.

VT:0000455.name: maxilla morphology trait
VT:0000455.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the upper bony framework of the mouth where the superior teeth are held.

VT:0000458.name: mandible morphology trait
VT:0000458.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the lower bony framework of the mouth where the inferior teeth are held.

VT:0000461.name: presacral vertebra quantity
VT:0000461.def: The proportion or number of bony segments of the spinal column anterior/superior to the sacrum/sacral vertebrae.

VT:0000462.name: gastrointestinal system morphology trait
VT:0000462.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the components of the system that converts ingested food to nutrients and energy.

VT:0000466.name: esophageal epithelium cell quantity
VT:0000466.def: The proportion or number of cells in the epithelial layer of the esophagus.

VT:0000467.name: esophagus morphology trait
VT:0000467.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the part of the digestive canal through which food passes from the pharynx to the stomach.

VT:0000468.name: esophageal epithelium morphology trait
VT:0000468.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the epithelial layer that lines the esophagus, the part of the digestive canal through which food passes from the pharynx to the stomach.

VT:0000469.name: esophageal squamous epithelium morphology trait
VT:0000469.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the scaly epithelial layer of the part of the digestive canal through which food passes from the pharynx to the stomach.

VT:0000470.name: stomach morphology trait
VT:0000470.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the sac-like structure of the digestive canal between the esophagus and the small intestine.

VT:0000471.name: stomach epithelium morphology trait
VT:0000471.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the epithelial layer of the stomach.

VT:0000472.name: stomach squamous epithelium morphology trait
VT:0000472.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the scaly epithelial layer of the stomach.

VT:0000473.name: stomach glandular epithelium morphology trait
VT:0000473.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the gland-containing epithelial layer of the stomach.

VT:0000474.name: foregut morphology trait
VT:0000474.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the cephalic portion of the primitive digestive tube of the embryo.

VT:0000476.name: cochlear nerve fiber response trait
VT:0000476.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity to change, adjust, or alter the electrophysiological recordings from the elongated processes of auditory neurons over time or as a result of internal or external influences.

VT:0000477.name: intestine morphology trait
VT:0000477.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the digestive tube passing from the stomach to the anus.

VT:0000478.name: intestine development trait
VT:0000478.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the digestive tube passing from the stomach to the anus.

VT:0000479.name: intestinal cell morphology trait
VT:0000479.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the cells comprising the digestive tube passing from the stomach to the anus.

VT:0000481.name: intestinal cell quantity
VT:0000481.def: The proportion or number of cells comprising the digestive tube passing from the stomach to the anus.

VT:0000482.name: fibula length
VT:0000482.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the lateral and smaller bone of the lower/hind limb.

VT:0000483.name: sensorineural hearing physiology trait
VT:0000483.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes involved in the form of hearing due to processes occurring in the auditory division of cranial nerve VIII or the inner ear.

VT:0000484.name: pulmonary artery morphology trait
VT:0000484.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the artery that conveys unaerated blood to the lungs.

VT:0000485.name: otoacoustic response trait
VT:0000485.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity to change, adjust, or alter the acoustic energy produced by the cochlea in the presence or absence of sound stimulation.

VT:0000488.name: intestinal epithelium morphology trait
VT:0000488.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the cellular avascular layer of the digestive tube passing from the stomach to the anus.

VT:0000489.name: large intestine morphology trait
VT:0000489.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the distal portion of the digestive tube that extends from the ileocecal valve to the anus.

VT:0000490.name: crypt of Lieberkuhn morphology trait
VT:0000490.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of any of the tubular intestinal glands found in the mucosal membranes.

VT:0000492.name: rectum morphology trait
VT:0000492.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the terminal portion of the intestinal tube adjacent to the anus.

VT:0000494.name: cecum morphology trait
VT:0000494.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the large sac at the ileum and large intestine junction.

VT:0000495.name: colon morphology trait
VT:0000495.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the portion of the large intestine between the cecum and the rectum.

VT:0000496.name: small intestine morphology trait
VT:0000496.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the upper portion of the digestive tract, between the stomach and the large intestine.

VT:0000497.name: small intestine orientation trait
VT:0000497.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the location or arrangement of the small intestinal tract in relation to other organs or to the body.

VT:0000501.name: digestive secretion trait
VT:0000501.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a physiologically active substance (usually but not exclusively in liquid form) from a cell or a gland of the digestive system.

VT:0000509.name: digestive mucosecretion trait
VT:0000509.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a physiologically active substance (usually but not exclusively in liquid form) from the mucous membrane of the digestive system.

VT:0000511.name: intestinal mucosa morphology trait
VT:0000511.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the mucous lining of the intestine; this consists of epithelium, lamina propria, and a layer of smooth muscle cells.

VT:0000516.name: urinary system morphology trait
VT:0000516.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the organs involved in the production or excretion of urine.

VT:0000521.name: kidney cortex morphology trait
VT:0000521.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the outer area of the kidney, which contains the glomeruli and the capsules that enclose them, as well as the proximal and distal convoluted tubules.

VT:0000524.name: kidney tubule quantity
VT:0000524.def: The proportion or number of loops of Henle, proximal and distal convoluted tubules, and collecting ducts in the kidney.

VT:0000526.name: kidney pyramid size trait
VT:0000526.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the pyramidal masses; contain part of the secreting tubules and collecting tubules.

VT:0000527.name: kidney development trait
VT:0000527.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the paired organs responsible for urine excretion and regulation of ion concentrations.

VT:0000528.name: kidney development initiation trait
VT:0000528.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the start of the induction and/or differentiation of the paired organs responsible for urine excretion and regulation of ion concentrations.

VT:0000530.name: kidney blood vessel morphology trait
VT:0000530.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the network of vessels that convey blood in the paired organs responsible for urine excretion and regulation of ion concentrations.

VT:0000534.name: ureter morphology trait
VT:0000534.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the tube that conducts the urine from the renal pelvis to the bladder.

VT:0000535.name: ureter luminal epithelial cell quantity
VT:0000535.def: The proportion or number of cells in the luminal epithelium of the tube that conducts the urine from the renal pelvis to the bladder.

VT:0000537.name: urethra morphology trait
VT:0000537.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the canal leading from the bladder, discharging the urine externally.

VT:0000538.name: urinary bladder morphology trait
VT:0000538.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the distensible musculomembranous bag for holding urine.

VT:0000539.name: urinary bladder size trait
VT:0000539.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the distensible musculomembranous bag for holding urine.

VT:0000540.name: urinary bladder epithelium morphology trait
VT:0000540.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cellular avascular layer of the distensible musculomembranous bag for holding urine.

VT:0000541.name: urinary bladder transitional epithelium morphology trait
VT:0000541.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the transitional epithelial layer (stratified epithelium with large, polyploid superfical cells that are dome-shaped when relaxed, but broad and flattened when distended) of the distensible musculomembranous bag for holding urine.

VT:0000544.name: urinary bladder transitional epithelium thickness
VT:0000544.def: The distance between the surfaces of the transitional epithelial layer (stratified epithelium with large, polyploid superfical cells that are dome-shaped when relaxed, but broad and flattened when distended) of the distensible musculomembranous bag for holding urine.

VT:0000548.name: limb length
VT:0000548.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the projecting, paired, jointed appendages of the body used for movement and grasping.

VT:0000550.name: forelimb morphology trait
VT:0000550.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the anterior/superior jointed appendages used for locomotion or grasping.

VT:0000552.name: radius morphology trait
VT:0000552.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the bone situated on the lateral side of the ulna in the forelimb.

VT:0000554.name: carpus morphology trait
VT:0000554.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the nodular bones of the joint between the radius and ulna of the forelimb and the metacarpal bones.

VT:0000556.name: hindlimb morphology trait
VT:0000556.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the posterior/inferior jointed appendages used for locomotion or grasping.

VT:0000558.name: tibia morphology trait
VT:0000558.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the medial and larger of the two bones of the lower leg, which articulates with the femur, fibula, and talus.

VT:0000559.name: femur morphology trait
VT:0000559.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the long bone of the thigh.

VT:0000571.name: obsolete interdigital webbing trait
VT:0000571.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the presence of a fold of skin, or web, between the fingers or toes.

VT:0000572.name: autopod morphology trait
VT:0000572.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the distal elements of the developing limb of vertebrates that will give rise to the pedal or prehensile appendages (e.g. hand, foot, paw, phalanges and/or digits).

VT:0000573.name: hind paw size trait
VT:0000573.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical dimensions of the rear feet.

VT:0000574.name: foot pad morphology trait
VT:0000574.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the body of fat on the foot.

VT:0000579.name: nail morphology trait
VT:0000579.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the thin, horny, translucent plates covering the dorsal surface of the distal end of each terminal phalanx of the digits.

VT:0000580.name: nail shape trait
VT:0000580.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical form or contours of any of the thin, horny, translucent plates covering the dorsal surface of the distal end of each terminal phalanx of the digits.

VT:0000583.name: nail length
VT:0000583.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of any of the thin, horny, translucent plates covering the dorsal surface of the distal end of each terminal phalanx of the digits.

VT:0000588.name: tail diameter
VT:0000588.def: The distance across the appendage at the caudal end of the vertebral column.

VT:0000596.name: liver development trait
VT:0000596.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the bile-secreting exocrine gland, which is important for detoxification; for fat, carbohydrate, and protein metabolism; and for glycogen storage.

VT:0000598.name: liver morphology trait
VT:0000598.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bile-secreting exocrine gland, which is important for detoxification; for fat, carbohydrate, and protein metabolism; and for glycogen storage.

VT:0000599.name: liver size trait
VT:0000599.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the bile-secreting exocrine gland, which is important for detoxification; for fat, carbohydrate, and protein metabolism; and for glycogen storage.

VT:0000602.name: sinusoidal space size trait
VT:0000602.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the cavities in the liver.

VT:0000603.name: liver pigmentation trait
VT:0000603.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the deposition or aggregation of coloring matter in the bile-secreting exocrine gland, which is important for detoxification; for fat, carbohydrate, and protein metabolism; and for glycogen storage.

VT:0000606.name: hepatocyte quantity
VT:0000606.def: The proportion or number of the main structural components of the liver; these are specialized epithelial cells normally organized into interconnected plates called lobules.

VT:0000607.name: hepatocyte morphology trait
VT:0000607.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the main structural component of the liver; these are specialized epithelial cells normally organized into interconnected plates called lobules.

VT:0000608.name: hepatocyte organization trait
VT:0000608.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of the main structural component of the liver; these are specialized epithelial cells normally organized into interconnected plates called lobules.

VT:0000609.name: liver physiology trait
VT:0000609.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in this bile-secreting exocrine gland, which is important for detoxification; for fat, carbohydrate, and protein metabolism; and for glycogen storage.

VT:0000613.name: salivary gland morphology trait
VT:0000613.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the saliva-secreting glands of the oral cavity.

VT:0000615.name: palatine gland morphology trait
VT:0000615.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the salivary gland of the hard palate.

VT:0000616.name: palatine gland ductal branching morphology trait
VT:0000616.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the branches and distal tips of the vesicles of the palatine gland.

VT:0000617.name: salivary gland mucosal cell quantity
VT:0000617.def: The proportion or number of cells that form mucus in the salivary glands.

VT:0000619.name: salivary gland epithelial cell quantity
VT:0000619.def: The proportion or number of cells in the epithelium of the salivary gland.

VT:0000620.name: salivary duct morphology trait
VT:0000620.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the tubular canals that carry saliva.

VT:0000623.name: salivation trait
VT:0000623.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the flow, secretion, or amount of saliva.

VT:0000627.name: mammary gland morphology trait
VT:0000627.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the milk-producing glands in female mammals, consisting of lobes containing clusters of alveoli with a system of ducts to convey the milk to an external nipple or teat.

VT:0000628.name: mammary gland development trait
VT:0000628.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation or differentiation of the milk-secreting gland in female mammals during early embryogenesis or during sexual maturity or reproduction.

VT:0000631.name: neuroendocrine gland morphology trait
VT:0000631.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the organized aggregations of cells that function as secretory or excretory organs and that release hormones in response to neural stimuli.

VT:0000632.name: pineal gland morphology trait
VT:0000632.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the pineal gland, a midline, cone-like structure located in the dorso-caudal roof of the third ventricle, attached by peduncles to the habenular and posterior commissures,  which produces melatonin.

VT:0000633.name: pituitary gland morphology trait
VT:0000633.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the compound gland suspended from the base of the hypothalamus, which secretes somatotropins, prolactin, TSH (thyroid-stimulating hormone), gonadotropins, adrenal corticotropin, and other related peptides.

VT:0000638.name: cochlear hair cell development trait
VT:0000638.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the sensory epithelial cells of the cochlea during their formation and differentiation.

VT:0000639.name: adrenal gland morphology trait
VT:0000639.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the endocrine glands located above the kidney responsible for hormone and epinephrine secretion.

VT:0000643.name: adrenal central medulla morphology trait
VT:0000643.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the inner portion of the adrenal gland, consisting mainly of chromaffin cells which are responsible for secretion of epinephrine.

VT:0000646.name: adrenocortical cell morphology trait
VT:0000646.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells of the adrenal gland.

VT:0000647.name: sebaceous gland morphology trait
VT:0000647.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the holocrine glands of the dermis that secrete sebum.

VT:0000652.name: sebaceous gland size trait
VT:0000652.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the holocrine glands of the dermis that secrete sebum.

VT:0000653.name: sex gland morphology trait
VT:0000653.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the organized aggregations of cells that function as secretory or excretory organs and are associated with reproduction.

VT:0000655.name: sex gland size trait
VT:0000655.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of any of the organized aggregations of cells that function as secretory or excretory organs and are associated with reproduction.

VT:0000659.name: prostate size trait
VT:0000659.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the gland surrounding the beginning of the urethra in males that secretes part of the seminal fluid.

VT:0000660.name: lateral prostate size trait
VT:0000660.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the lateral lobe of the prostate.

VT:0000661.name: ventral prostate size trait
VT:0000661.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the ventral lobe of the prostate.

VT:0000662.name: mammary ductal tree branching trait
VT:0000662.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the development of the channels that secrete milk and direct milk to the nipple.

VT:0000665.name: coagulating gland ductal branching trait
VT:0000665.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the branches and distal tips of the vesicles of the coagulating gland.

VT:0000666.name: prostate duct quantity
VT:0000666.def: The proportion or number of minute canals that pass the prostatic secretions to the urethra.

VT:0000674.name: sweat gland morphology trait
VT:0000674.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the coiled glands of the skin that secrete sweat.

VT:0000675.name: palmar eccrine gland morphology trait
VT:0000675.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, or pattern of the sweat glands of the palm.

VT:0000678.name: parathyroid gland morphology trait
VT:0000678.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of one of the two small, paired endocrine glands, usually found embedded in the connective tissue capsule on the posterior surface of the thyroid gland; they secrete parathyroid hormone (PTH) that regulates calcium and phosphorus metabolism.

VT:0000681.name: thyroid gland morphology trait
VT:0000681.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the two-lobed endocrine gland found in all vertebrates, located in front of and on either side of the trachea in humans, that produces various hormones, such as triiodothyronine and calcitonin.

VT:0000685.name: immune system morphology trait
VT:0000685.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the organs or cells associated with the body's defense against foreign organisms or substances and aberrant native cells.

VT:0000689.name: spleen morphology trait
VT:0000689.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the organ that functions to filter blood and to store red corpuscles and platelets.

VT:0000696.name: Peyer's patch morphology trait
VT:0000696.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the protruding lymphoid tissue located on the mucosa of the small intestine that is composed of densely packed B cell follicles.

VT:0000700.name: lymph node quantity
VT:0000700.def: The proportion or number of the oval or bean shaped bodies located along the lymphatic system that consist of densely packed lymphocytes, lymph fluid and connective tissue; the sites where acquired immune responses are launched.

VT:0000701.name: lymph node size trait
VT:0000701.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the oval or bean shaped bodies located along the lymphatic system that consist of densely packed lymphocytes, lymph fluid and connective tissue; the sites where acquired immune responses are launched.

VT:0000703.name: thymus morphology trait
VT:0000703.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the primary lymphoid organ that is required for maturation of T cells.

VT:0000704.name: thymus development trait
VT:0000704.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation or differentiation of the primary lymphoid organ that is required for maturation of T cells.

VT:0000712.name: vestibular hair cell development trait
VT:0000712.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the hair cells in the sensory epithelium of the maculae and cristae of the membranous labyrinth of the inner ear.

VT:0000713.name: Reichert's cartilage development trait
VT:0000713.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the cartilage found in the mesenchyme of the second pharyngeal arch in the embryo from which develop the stapes, styloid process, lesser horn and upper part of the body of the hyoid bone; its proximal end gives rise to the stylohyoid ligament.

VT:0000715.name: thymocyte quantity
VT:0000715.def: The proportion or number of immature T cells located in the thymus.

VT:0000716.name: immune system cell morphology trait
