VT:0000716.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells associated with the body's defense against foreign organisms or substances and aberrant native cells.

VT:0000717.name: lymphocyte quantity
VT:0000717.def: The proportion or number of the cells involved in adaptive immune reactions of the body, including B cells, T cells, and natural killer cells.

VT:0000729.name: skeletal myogenesis trait
VT:0000729.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to embryonic formation or differentiation of skeletal muscle cells or fibers.

VT:0000733.name: muscular system development trait
VT:0000733.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement of an organ or part of the body.

VT:0000736.name: skeletal myogenesis initiation trait
VT:0000736.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the start of formation and/or differentiation of skeletal muscle.

VT:0000737.name: myotome development trait
VT:0000737.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation or differentiation of the part of the somite that develops into the skeletal musculature.

VT:0000740.name: smooth muscle contractility trait
VT:0000740.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the unstriated, involuntary muscle tissue of the internal organs, blood vessels, hair follicles, etc. to shorten or to develop increased tension.

VT:0000741.name: detrusor smooth muscle contractility trait
VT:0000741.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the non-striated, involuntary muscle tissue surrounding the urinary bladder to shorten or to develop increased tension.

VT:0000742.name: ileal smooth muscle contractility trait
VT:0000742.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the non-striated, involuntary muscle tissue of the portion of the small intestine that extends from the jejunum to the colon to shorten or to develop increased tension.

VT:0000759.name: skeletal muscle morphology trait
VT:0000759.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the striated muscles connected at either or both extremities with the bony framework of the body.

VT:0000761.name: diaphragm thickness
VT:0000761.def: The distance between the surfaces of the thin musculomebranous barrier that separates the abdominal and thoracic cavities.

VT:0000762.name: tongue morphology trait
VT:0000762.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the mobile mass of muscular tissue and surrounding epithelial tissue occupying the cavity of the mouth and forming part of the floor.

VT:0000763.name: filiform papillae morphology trait
VT:0000763.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the keratinized projections on the dorsal surface of the tongue.

VT:0000764.name: tongue epithelium morphology trait
VT:0000764.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the epithelial layer of the tongue.

VT:0000765.name: tongue squamous epithelium morphology trait
VT:0000765.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the scaly epithelial layer of the tongue.

VT:0000767.name: smooth muscle morphology trait
VT:0000767.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the unstriated, involuntary muscle tissue of the internal organs, blood vessels, and other body structures not under willful control.

VT:0000768.name: common crus morphology trait
VT:0000768.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the united, nonampullary ends of the superior and posterior semicircular ducts of the inner ear.

VT:0000771.name: brain size trait
VT:0000771.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the brain, one of the two components of the central nervous system and the center of thought and emotion; controls coordination, bodily activities and the interpretation of information from the senses (sight, hearing, smell, etc.).

VT:0000776.name: inferior colliculus morphology trait
VT:0000776.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the paired inferior eminence of the mesencephalic tectum that is involved in preliminary visual processing, and control of eye movements.

VT:0000777.name: inferior colliculus size trait
VT:0000777.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the paired inferior eminence of the mesencephalic tectum that is involved in preliminary visual processing, and control of eye movements.

VT:0000778.name: nervous system tract morphology trait
VT:0000778.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the bundles of myelinated nerve fibers following a defined path through the brain and/or spinal cord.

VT:0000779.name: cochlea basement membrane morphology trait
VT:0000779.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the continuous basement membrane found within the membranous labyrinth of the cochlea, known to extend from the limbus, down to the inner sulcus, across the basilar membrane, up to the external sulcus to the spiral prominence and radiating into the spiral ligament ensheathing the root cell processes.

VT:0000780.name: corpus callosum morphology trait
VT:0000780.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the thick bundle of nerve fibers comprising a commissural plate connecting the two cerebral hemispheres; it consists of contralateral axon projections that provides communications between the right and left cerebral hemispheres.

VT:0000781.name: corpus callosum size trait
VT:0000781.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the commissural plate interconnecting the cortical hemispheres of the brain.

VT:0000783.name: forebrain morphology trait
VT:0000783.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the part of the brain developed from the most rostral of the three primary vesicles of the embryonic neural tube from which the diencephalon and telencephalon are derived.

VT:0000784.name: forebrain cell quantity
VT:0000784.def: The proportion or numbers of cells in the anterior primitive cerebral vesicle; most rostral of three primary vesicles of the embryonic neural tube.

VT:0000785.name: telencephalon cell quantity
VT:0000785.def: The proportion or number of cells in cerebral cortex and basal ganglia.

VT:0000786.name: neuroepithelial layer differentiation trait
VT:0000786.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which relatively unspecialized cells acquire the specialized features of the epithelial cell layer that lines the neural tube and develops into the nervous system and neural crest cells.

VT:0000787.name: telencephalon morphology trait
VT:0000787.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the paired anteriolateral division of the prosencephalon plus the lamina terminalis from which the olfactory lobes, cerebral cortex, and subcortical nuclei are derived.

VT:0000788.name: cerebral cortex morphology trait
VT:0000788.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the grey matter on the surface of the cerebral hemisphere that develops from the telencephalon and folds into gyri; it is responsible for intellectual faculties and higher mental functions.

VT:0000789.name: cerebral cortex thickness
VT:0000789.def: The distance between the surfaces of the mantle covering the surface of the cerebral hemispheres.

VT:0000791.name: cerebral cortex layer morphology trait
VT:0000791.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the layers of the gray cellular mantle covering the surface of the brain.

VT:0000792.name: cortical marginal zone morphology trait
VT:0000792.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the developing superficial cortical layer located just under the pia matter.

VT:0000794.name: parietal lobe morphology trait
VT:0000794.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the upper central part of the cerebral hemisphere.

VT:0000795.name: postcentral gyrus morphology trait
VT:0000795.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the area of the parietal lobe that receives general sensation from the body.

VT:0000796.name: sensory dissociation area morphology trait
VT:0000796.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the area of the parietal lobe that integrates tactile and visual stimuli.

VT:0000797.name: supramarginal gyrus morphology trait
VT:0000797.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the area of the frontal lobe that is involved in perception based on sensory stimuli.

VT:0000798.name: frontal lobe morphology trait
VT:0000798.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the anterior part of the cerebral hemisphere.

VT:0000799.name: precentral gyrus morphology trait
VT:0000799.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the area of the frontal lobe that contains the cell bodies of the primary motor pathways.

VT:0000800.name: prefrontal gyrus morphology trait
VT:0000800.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the area of the frontal lobe that is involved with integration of voluntary movements and with speech.

VT:0000801.name: temporal lobe morphology trait
VT:0000801.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lower lateral part of the cerebral hemisphere.

VT:0000802.name: superior temporal gyrus morphology trait
VT:0000802.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the longitudinal ridge on the lateral surface of the temporal lobe.

VT:0000803.name: transverse gyrus of Heschl morphology trait
VT:0000803.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the area of the temporal lobe concerned with hearing.

VT:0000804.name: occipital lobe morphology trait
VT:0000804.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the posterior part of the cerebral hemisphere.

VT:0000805.name: visual cortex morphology trait
VT:0000805.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the area of the occipital cortex concerned with vision.

VT:0000807.name: hippocampus morphology trait
VT:0000807.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the deep lying structure of the cerebrum involved with memory storage and spatial navigation.

VT:0000808.name: hippocampus development trait
VT:0000808.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the deep lying structure of the cerebrum involved with memory storage and spatial navigation.

VT:0000812.name: dentate gyrus morphology trait
VT:0000812.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of one of two interlocking gyri of the hippocampus that contains granule cells, which project to the pyramidal cells and interneurons of the CA3 region of the ammon gyrus.

VT:0000813.name: hippocampus layer morphology trait
VT:0000813.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the layers of the laminar structure of the hippocampus, the deep-lying structure of the cerebrum involved with memory storage and spatial navigation.

VT:0000815.name: Ammon gyrus morphology trait
VT:0000815.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of one or both of the two interlocking gyri of the hippocampus; a circonvolution of rhinencephalon, the grey substance of which is rich in big pyramidal neuronal cells.

VT:0000816.name: cochlear hair cell stereociliary bundle morphology trait
VT:0000816.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the mechanosensitive hair bundles which are composed of thick long microvilli (stereocilia) and are located at the apical end of cochlear inner and outer hair cells.

VT:0000818.name: amygdala morphology trait
VT:0000818.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the almond-shaped body of basal nuclei anterior to the inferior horn of the lateral ventricle of the brain, within the temporal lobe; this area is involved in aggression and fear responses.

VT:0000819.name: olfactory bulb morphology trait
VT:0000819.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the forebrain region that coordinates neuronal signaling involved in the perception of smell; it receives input from the sensory neurons and outputs to the olfactory cortex.

VT:0000820.name: choroid plexus morphology trait
VT:0000820.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the network formed by blood vessels and the tela choroidea which secretes CSF into the ventricular spaces.

VT:0000821.name: choroid plexus cell quantity
VT:0000821.def: The proportion or number of cells in the tela choroidea of the cerebral ventricles.

VT:0000822.name: brain ventricle morphology trait
VT:0000822.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cavities of the brain filled with cerebrospinal fluid.

VT:0000823.name: lateral ventricle morphology trait
VT:0000823.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cavity in each of the cerebral hemispheres derived from the cavity of the embryonic neural tube; they are separated from each other by the septum pellucidum, and each communicates with the third ventricle by the foramen of Monro, through which also the choroid plexuses of the lateral ventricles become continuous with that of the third ventricle.

VT:0000825.name: lateral ventricle size trait
VT:0000825.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the horseshoe-shaped cavities of the cerebrum.
synonyms: temporal horn of lateral ventricle volume
ventricle of cerebral hemisphere size trait

VT:0000826.name: third ventricle morphology trait
VT:0000826.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the narrow cleft inferior to the corpus callosum, within the diencephalon, between the paired thalami; its floor is formed by the hypothalamus, its anterior wall by the lamina terminalis, and its roof by ependyma; it communicates with the fourth ventricle by the cerebral aqueduct, and with the lateral ventricles by the interventricular foramina.

VT:0000827.name: third ventricle size trait
VT:0000827.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the narrow cleft inferior to the corpus callosum, within the diencephalon, between the paired thalami; its floor is formed by the hypothalamus, its anterior wall by the lamina terminalis, and its roof by ependyma; it communicates with the fourth ventricle by the cerebral aqueduct, and with the lateral ventricles by the interventricular foramina.

VT:0000828.name: fourth ventricle morphology trait
VT:0000828.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the irregularly shaped cavity in the rhombencephalon, between the medulla oblongata, the pons, and the isthmus in front, and the cerebellum behind; it is continuous with the central canal of the cord below and with the cerebral aqueduct above, and through its lateral and median apertures it communicates with the subarachnoid space.

VT:0000829.name: fourth ventricle size trait
VT:0000829.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the irregularly shaped cavity in the rhombencephalon, between the medulla oblongata, the pons, and the isthmus in front, and the cerebellum behind; it is continuous with the central canal of the cord below and with the cerebral aqueduct above, and through its lateral and median apertures it communicates with the subarachnoid space.

VT:0000830.name: diencephalon morphology trait
VT:0000830.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the paired caudal parts of the prosencephalon from which the thalamus, hypothalamus, epithalamus and subthalamus are derived; these regions regulate autonomic, visceral and endocrine function, and process information directed to the cerebral cortex.

VT:0000831.name: diencephalon cell quantity
VT:0000831.def: The proportion or number of cells in the paired caudal parts of the prosencephalon from which the thalamus, hypothalamus, epithalamus and subthalamus are derived.

VT:0000832.name: thalamus morphology trait
VT:0000832.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the large ovoid mass of paired bodies containing mostly gray matter and forming part of the lateral wall of the third ventricle of the brain.

VT:0000833.name: thalamus cell quantity
VT:0000833.def: The proportion or number of cells in the large ovoid mass of paired bodies containing mostly grey matter and forming part of the lateral wall of the third ventricle of the brain.

VT:0000834.name: subthalamus morphology trait
VT:0000834.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the anterior part of the diencephalon that lies between the thalamus, hypothalamus, and tegmentum of the mesencephalon, including subthalamic nucleus, zona incerta, the fields of Forel, and the nucleus of ansa lenticularis.

VT:0000835.name: subthalamic nucleus morphology trait
VT:0000835.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lens-shaped nucleus located in the ventral part of the subthalamus on the inner aspect of the internal capsule that is concerned with the integration of somatic motor function.

VT:0000836.name: substantia nigra morphology trait
VT:0000836.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the layer of grey substance that separates the posterior parts of the cerebral peduncles (tegmentum mesencephali) from the anterior parts; it normally includes a posterior compact part with many pigmented cells (pars compacta) and an anterior reticular part whose cells contain little pigment (pars reticularis).

VT:0000837.name: hypothalamus morphology trait
VT:0000837.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the ventral part of the diencephalon extending from the region of the optic chiasm to the caudal border of the mammillary bodies and forming the inferior and lateral walls of the third ventricle; this region regulates the autonomic nervous system via hormone production and release.

VT:0000838.name: cochlear hair cell inter-stereocilial links trait
VT:0000838.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, or pattern of the morphologically and biochemically distinct link types that extend between the stereocilia of cochlear hair bundles; link types can be distinguished by their relative sensitivities to treatment with calcium chelators and the protease subtilisin.

VT:0000839.name: hypothalamus cell quantity
VT:0000839.def: The proportion or number of cells in the ventral part of the diencephalon extending from the region of the optic chiasm to the caudal border of the mammillary bodies and forming the inferior and lateral walls of the third ventricle; this region regulates the autonomic nervous system via hormone production and release.

VT:0000840.name: epithalamus morphology trait
VT:0000840.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the small dorsomedial area of the thalamus including the habenular nuclei and associated fiber bundles, the pineal body, and the epithelial roof of the third ventricle.

VT:0000841.name: hindbrain morphology trait
VT:0000841.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the caudal region of the brain; includes cerebellum, pons and medulla oblongata.

VT:0000842.name: superior olivary complex morphology trait
VT:0000842.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the nucleus of neurons on the dorsal part of the lateral surface of the pons; it normally receives projection fibers from the cochlear nuclei and is prominently involved in spatial localization of sound.

VT:0000843.name: facial nuclei cell quantity
VT:0000843.def: The proportion or number of neurons in the group of motor neurons in the hindbrain; receives fibers from the facial muscles, stapedus muscle and stylohyoid muscle.

VT:0000844.name: pontine flexure morphology trait
VT:0000844.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the bend in the developing neural tube that produces a thinning of the roof of the pons and medulla oblongata and defines the boundary between the metencephalon and medulla oblongata in the embryo.

VT:0000846.name: medulla oblongata morphology trait
VT:0000846.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the most caudal region of the brainstem that lies directly rostral to the spinal cord; includes regions responsible for autonomic functions such as digestion, breathing and control of heart rate.

VT:0000847.name: metencephalon morphology trait
VT:0000847.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the anterior part of the rhombencephalon.

VT:0000848.name: pons morphology trait
VT:0000848.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the band of nerve fibers in the brain connecting the medulla oblongata and the mesencephalon; this region conveys information about movement from the cerebral hemisphere to the cerebellum.

VT:0000849.name: cerebellum morphology trait
VT:0000849.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the part of the metencephalon that lies in the posterior cranial fossa dorsal to the pons and medulla that is concerned with the coordination of movement and learning of motor skills.

VT:0000851.name: cerebellum cell quantity
VT:0000851.def: The proportion or number of cells in the part of the metencephalon that lies in the posterior cranial fossa dorsal to the pons and medulla that is concerned with the coordination of movement and learning of motor skills.

VT:0000852.name: cerebellum size trait
VT:0000852.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the part of the metencephalon that lies in the posterior cranial fossa dorsal to the pons and medulla that is concerned with the coordination of movement and learning of motor skills.

VT:0000854.name: cerebellum development trait
VT:0000854.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the part of the metencephalon that lies dorsal to the pons and medulla behind the brain stem and controls balance for walking and standing, modulates the force and range of movement and is involved in the learning of motor skills.

VT:0000855.name: interlobular fissure development trait
VT:0000855.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the major fissures of the cerebellum.

VT:0000856.name: cerebellum plate morphology trait
VT:0000856.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the embryonic pseudostratified epithelium of the fourth cerebellar ventricle that eventually forms the vermis and ventral neuroepithelium.

VT:0000857.name: cerebellum foliation trait
VT:0000857.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the formation of small offshoots of the cerebellar lobules.

VT:0000859.name: somatosensory cortex morphology trait
VT:0000859.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the area of the parietal lobe that lies posterior to the central sulcus and is concerned with receiving and processing general sensations from the body surface.

VT:0000860.name: primary somatosensory cortex morphology trait
VT:0000860.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the area of the postcentral gyrus and central sulcus that is involved in somatic sensation.

VT:0000861.name: barrel cortex organization trait
VT:0000861.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of the discrete functional units of the somatosensory cortex that processes tactile information derived from the vibrissae.

VT:0000863.name: secondary somatosensory cortex morphology trait
VT:0000863.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the area of the upper bank of the lateral sulcus that is involved in somatic sensation.

VT:0000864.name: cerebellum vermis morphology trait
VT:0000864.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the narrow medial zone between the two hemispheres of the cerebellum that is delimited by two longitudinal furrows; it may be continuous with the cerebellar hemispheres in some areas of the cerebellum, e.g., dorsally, or separated by deeper fissures in others (e.g., ventrally); it receives inputs from the spinocerebellar tracts which carry to the vermis information on the position and balance of the torso, and it sends projections to the fastigial nucleus of the cerebellum, which then sends output to the vestibular nuclei.

VT:0000865.name: cerebellum vermis size trait
VT:0000865.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the narrow middle zone between the two hemispheres of the cerebellum.

VT:0000866.name: cerebellum vermis cell quantity
VT:0000866.def: The proportion or number of cells in the narrow medial zone between the two hemispheres of the cerebellum that is delimited by two longitudinal furrows; it may be continuous with the cerebellar hemispheres in some areas of the cerebellum, e.g., dorsally, or separated by deeper fissures in others (e.g., ventrally); it receives inputs from the spinocerebellar tracts which carry to the vermis information on the position and balance of the torso, and it sends projections to the fastigial nucleus of the cerebellum, which then sends output to the vestibular nuclei.

VT:0000867.name: cerebellum anterior vermis morphology trait
VT:0000867.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the anterior portion of the narrow middle zone between the two hemispheres of the cerebellum that is located anterior to the primary fissure.

VT:0000868.name: cerebellum anterior vermis size trait
VT:0000868.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the anterior portion of the narrow middle zone between the two hemispheres of the cerebellum that is located anterior to the primary fissure.

VT:0000869.name: cerebellum posterior vermis morphology trait
VT:0000869.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the posterior portion of the narrow middle zone between the two hemispheres of the cerebellum.

VT:0000870.name: cerebellum vermis lobule VIII morphology trait
VT:0000870.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of part of the inferior vermis of the cerebellum (vermis lobule VIII).

VT:0000871.name: cerebellum vermis lobule IX morphology trait
VT:0000871.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the triangular elevation on the vermis of the cerebellum.

VT:0000872.name: cerebellum external granule cell layer morphology trait
VT:0000872.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the transient layer of the cerebellar cortex which is composed of the dividing and migrating granule cells.

VT:0000873.name: cerebellum external granule cell layer thickness
VT:0000873.def: The distance between the surfaces of the transient layer of the cerebellar cortex which is composed of dividing and migrating granule cells.

VT:0000875.name: cerebellar Purkinje cell layer morphology trait
VT:0000875.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cell layer that lies just underneath the molecular layer of the cerebellar cortex; it contains the neuronal cell bodies of the Purkinje cells that are arranged side by side in a single layer, and candelabrum interneurons are vertically oriented between the Purkinje cells.

VT:0000877.name: Purkinje cell morphology trait
VT:0000877.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the neurons located at the interface of the molecular and internal granule layers of the cerebellar cortex; these inhibitory neurons provide the output of the cerebellar cortex through axons that project into the white matter, and extensive dendritic trees from the Purkinje cells extend upward in a single plane into the molecular layer where they synapse with parallel fibers of granule cells.

VT:0000878.name: Purkinje cell quanitity
VT:0000878.def: The proportion or number of neuronal cells that are located in the interface of the molecular and granular layers of the cerebellar cortex.

VT:0000881.name: cochlear hair bundle ankle links morphology trait
VT:0000881.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the long, single-stranded filaments that form a dense web or mesh around the base of cochlear hair bundles just above the region in which the stereocilia begin to taper down.

VT:0000882.name: cochlear hair bundle horizontal top connectors morphology trait
VT:0000882.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the inter-stereocilial links that connect the top of a shorter stereocilium to an adjacent longer stereocilium at a short distance below the tip links; the appearance of horizontal top connectors, which persist into adulthood, occurs concomitant with this loss of ankle links; top connectors are essentially unaffected by treatment with subtilisin and EGTA.

VT:0000883.name: cochlear hair bundle tip links morphology trait
VT:0000883.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the single, three-stranded inter-row filaments that extend obliquely from the tip of one stereocilium to the lateral side of an adjacent taller stereocilium; in the mouse, tip links are already detectable at E17 and persist throughout life; tips links are thought to gate the mechanotransducer channel, are lost from the cell surface after exposure to either calcium chelator BAPTA or lanthanum, and resist degradation by the protease subtilisin.

VT:0000884.name: Purkinje cell layer lamination integrity trait
VT:0000884.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the layer of large neuron cell bodies between the molecular and granular layers of the cerebellum.

VT:0000886.name: cerebellar granule layer morphology trait
VT:0000886.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the innermost cortical layer of the cerebellum; contains densely packed small neurons, mostly granule cells with some Golgi cells are found at the outer border.

VT:0000887.name: granule layer lamination integrity trait
VT:0000887.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the deepest of the three layers of the cerebellum that contains granule cells.

VT:0000889.name: cerebellar molecular layer morphology trait
VT:0000889.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the outermost layer of the cerebral cortex that contains the parallel fibers of the granule cells, interneurons such as stellate and basket cells, and the dendrites of the underlying Purkinje cells.

VT:0000890.name: cerebellar molecular layer thickness
VT:0000890.def: The distance between the surfaces of the outer of the three cortical layers of the cerebellum.

VT:0000892.name: cochlear hair cell stereociliary bundle orientation trait
VT:0000892.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the location or arrangement of inner and/or outer hair cell stereociliary bundles in relation to the hair cells.

VT:0000893.name: cochlear hair cell stereocilia quantity
VT:0000893.def: The proportion or number of the nonmotile, actin-filled specialized microvilli (stereocilia) normally arrayed on the sensory epithelial cells of the cochlea, which are normally in synaptic contact with the auditory nerve.

VT:0000894.name: cochlear hair cell stereocilia size trait
VT:0000894.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the nonmotile, actin-filled specialized microvilli (stereocilia) which are normally arrayed on cochlear inner and outer hair cells.

VT:0000895.name: obsolete cochlear inner hair cell afferent innervation pattern trait
VT:0000895.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement, distribution or supply of afferent terminals and/or their synapses in the cochlear IHC region.\nconsider: VT:0010155, VT:0010185

VT:0000896.name: obsolete cochlear inner hair cell efferent innervation pattern trait
VT:0000896.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement, distribution or supply of nerve fibers to the normally dense plexus of efferent terminals that contact radial fibers of the spiral ganglion below cochlear IHCs or of the sparser plexus of terminals positioned around IHC somata; normally, lateral olivocochlear neurons, which are found in and/or around the lateral superior olive, project mainly to the ipsilateral cochlea and terminate mostly on dendritic fibers below IHCs.\nconsider: VT:0010157, VT:0010186

VT:0000897.name: midbrain morphology trait
VT:0000897.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the middle of the three cerebral vesicles of the embryo; this region controls sensory and motor functions, including eye movement and coordination of auditory and visual reflexes.

VT:0000898.name: midbrain cell quantity
VT:0000898.def: The proportion or number of cells in the middle of the three cerebral vesicles of the embryo.

VT:0000899.name: corpora quadrigemina morphology trait
VT:0000899.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the inferior and/or superior colliculus.

VT:0000900.name: corpora quadrigemina size trait
VT:0000900.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the inferior and/or superior colliculus.

VT:0000901.name: corpora quadrigemina organization trait
VT:0000901.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of the inferior and/or superior colliculus.

VT:0000904.name: superior colliculus morphology trait
VT:0000904.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the paired superior eminence of the mesencephalic tectum that is involved in auditory processing.

VT:0000905.name: superior colliculus size trait
VT:0000905.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the paired superior eminence of the mesencephalic tectum.

VT:0000906.name: trigeminal V mesencephalic nucleus morphology trait
VT:0000906.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the group of sensory neurons residing in a long, narrow plate in the midbrain; axons pass with the trigeminal nerve.

VT:0000907.name: trigeminal V mesencephalic nucleus size trait
VT:0000907.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the group of sensory neurons residing in a long, narrow plate in the midbrain; axons pass with the trigeminal nerve.

VT:0000909.name: facial motor nucleus morphology trait
VT:0000909.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the group of motor neurons residing in the pons that innervate the muscles of facial expression.

VT:0000910.name: facial motor nucleus size trait
VT:0000910.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the group of motor neurons residing in the pons that innervate the muscles of facial expression.

VT:0000911.name: trigeminal motor nucleus morphology trait
VT:0000911.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the group of motor neurons innervating the muscles of mastication.

VT:0000912.name: trigeminal motor nucleus size trait
VT:0000912.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the group of motor neurons innervating the muscles of mastication.

VT:0000913.name: brain development trait
VT:0000913.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the brain during its formation and differentiation.

VT:0000920.name: myelination trait
VT:0000920.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which myelin sheaths are formed and maintained around neurons.

VT:0000923.name: roof plate morphology trait
VT:0000923.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a transient group of neuroepithelial cells located at the dorsal midline of the neural tube that profoundly influences the development of the vertebrate central nervous system.

VT:0000925.name: floor plate morphology trait
VT:0000925.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a transient group of neuroepithelial cells located at the ventral midline of the neural tube that profoundly influences the development of the vertebrate central nervous system.

VT:0000927.name: floor plate size trait
VT:0000927.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the floor plate.

VT:0000933.name: rhombomere morphology trait
VT:0000933.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the transverse segments in the hindbrain region of the developing neural tube.

VT:0000934.name: telencephalon development trait
VT:0000934.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the anterior division of the embryonic prosencephalon during its formation and differentiation.

VT:0000935.name: telencephalic vesicle development trait
VT:0000935.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the stereotypic invaginations forming the paired diverticula of the telencephalon, from which the forebrain develops.

VT:0000936.name: telencephalic vesicle size trait
VT:0000936.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the paired diverticula of the telencephalon, from which the forebrain develops.

VT:0000937.name: motor neuron morphology trait
VT:0000937.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells that innervate an effector (muscle or glandular) tissue and are responsible for transmission of motor impulses.

VT:0000939.name: motor neuron quantity
VT:0000939.def: The proportion or number of cells that innervate an effector (muscle or glandular) tissue and are responsible for transmission of motor impulses.

VT:0000940.name: obsolete motor neuron innervation pattern trait
VT:0000940.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement, distribution or supply of the nerve fibers of motor axons to an effector tissue.\nconsider: VT:0010286, VT:0010289

VT:0000941.name: motor neuron target finding trait
VT:0000941.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of innervating neurons to stop at target site and form terminal arbors.

VT:0000942.name: motor neuron axon outgrowth trait
VT:0000942.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the projection of innervating motor neurons to endplate targets.

VT:0000944.name: cochlear outer hair cell afferent innervation morphology trait
VT:0000944.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the afferent terminals and/or their synapses in the cochlear OHC region.
synonyms: cochlear outer hair cell afferent innervation

VT:0000952.name: central nervous system glial cell morphology trait
VT:0000952.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the non-neuronal cells of the central nervous system that form the myelin insulation of nervous pathways, guide neuronal migration during development, and exchange metabolites with neurons.
synonyms: central nervous system glia morphology trait

VT:0000953.name: oligodendrocyte morphology trait
VT:0000953.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the neuroglia of the central nervous system that form the insulating myelin sheath of axons.

VT:0000954.name: oligodendrocyte progenitor quantity
VT:0000954.def: The proportion or number of cells that differentiate into the neuroglia of the central nervous system that form the insulating myelin sheath of axons.

VT:0000955.name: spinal cord morphology trait
VT:0000955.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cylindrical tissue of the vertebral canal that extends from the medulla oblongata to the conus medullaris.

VT:0000959.name: somatic sensory system morphology trait
VT:0000959.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the neural tissue involved in the transmission of sensory signals.

VT:0000960.name: sensory ganglion morphology trait
VT:0000960.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the clusters of neurons in the somatic peripheral nervous system which contain the cell bodies of sensory nerve axons, interneurons, and non-neuonal supporting cells.

VT:0000961.name: dorsal root ganglion morphology trait
VT:0000961.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the group of nerve cell bodies of each segmental nerve projecting from the spinal cord.

VT:0000962.name: obsolete dorsal root ganglion organization trait
VT:0000962.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the segmentation pattern of one or more dorsal root ganglia.

VT:0000964.name: dorsal root ganglion size trait
VT:0000964.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of one or more of the nerve cell bodies of each segmental nerve projecting from the spinal cord.

VT:0000965.name: sensory neuron morphology trait
VT:0000965.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells that innervate an effector (muscle or glandular) tissue and are responsible for transmission of sensory impulses.

VT:0000968.name: obsolete sensory neuron innervation pattern trait
VT:0000968.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement, distribution or supply of nerve fibers to sensory termini or to the spinal cord.

VT:0000969.name: nociceptor morphology trait
VT:0000969.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the peripheral receptors for pain, including receptors sensitive to painful mechanical stimuli, extreme heat or cold, and chemical stimuli.

VT:0000970.name: polymodal receptor morphology trait
VT:0000970.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of a sensory receptor that may be stimulated by mechanical, thermal or chemical means.

VT:0000971.name: thermoreceptor morphology trait
VT:0000971.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of any of the cellular receptors that mediate the sense of temperature; in vertebrates, these are most often located under the skin.

VT:0000972.name: mechanoreceptor morphology trait
VT:0000972.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the receptors of the body, usually nerve termini, that respond to mechanical pressure or distortion.

VT:0000973.name: cutaneous/subcutaneous mechanoreceptor morphology trait
VT:0000973.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the receptors that respond to mechanical pressure or distortion in the skin.

VT:0000974.name: obsolete hair guard neuron morphology trait
VT:0000974.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the subcutaneous mechanoreceptors that innervate guard hairs.

VT:0000976.name: obsolete hair guard cell innervation pattern trait
VT:0000976.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement, distribution or supply of nerve fibers to the hair guard cells.

VT:0000977.name: obsolete hair-tylotrich neuron morphology trait
VT:0000977.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the subcutaneous mechanoreceptors that innervate tylotrich hair follicles.

VT:0000978.name: obsolete hair-tylotrich cell innervation pattern trait
VT:0000978.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement, distribution or supply of nerve fibers to hair tylotrich cells.

VT:0000979.name: obsolete hair-down neuron morphology trait
VT:0000979.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the subcutaneous mechanoreceptors that innervate vellus hairs.

VT:0000981.name: obsolete hair-down cell innervation pattern trait
VT:0000981.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement, distribution or supply of nerve fibers to hair down cells.

VT:0000982.name: Meissner's corpuscle morphology trait
VT:0000982.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any or all of the numerous oval bodies found in the dermal papillae of thick skin; believed to be mechanoreceptors for tactile sensation.

VT:0000983.name: Meissner's corpuscle size trait
VT:0000983.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of any of the numerous oval bodies found in the dermal papillae of thick skin; believed to be mechanoreceptors for tactile sensation.

VT:0000984.name: obsolete Meissner's corpuscle innervation pattern trait
VT:0000984.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement, distribution or supply of nerve fibers to any part of the numerous oval bodies found in the dermal papillae of thick skin and which are believed to be mechanoreceptors for tactile sensation.\nconsider: VT:0010187, VT:0010188

VT:0000985.name: Merkel's receptor morphology trait
VT:0000985.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the modified epidermal cells located in the stratum basale and found mostly in areas where sensory perception is acute.

VT:0000986.name: Merkel's receptor quantity
VT:0000986.def: The proportion or number of modified epidermal cells located in the stratum basale and found mostly in areas where sensory perception is acute.

VT:0000987.name: obsolete Merkel's receptor innervation pattern trait
VT:0000987.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement, distribution or supply of nerve fibers to the modified epidermal cells located in the stratum basale and found mostly in areas where sensory perception is acute.\nconsider: VT:0010148, VT:0010150

VT:0000988.name: Pacinian corpuscle morphology trait
VT:0000988.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the rapidly adapting mechanoreceptors found in subcutaneous tissue beneath both hairy and glabrous skin, and which normally contain an afferent nerve fiber surrounded by a capsule with multiple concentric layers.

VT:0000989.name: Ruffini's corpuscle morphology trait
VT:0000989.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the sensory cells in the subcutaneous tissue of the digits specialized to transduce mechanical stimuli.

VT:0000990.name: skeletal muscle mechanoreceptor morphology trait
VT:0000990.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the receptors that respond to mechanical pressure or distortion in any of the striated muscles connected at either or both extremities with the bony framework of the body.

VT:0000991.name: primary muscle spindle morphology trait
VT:0000991.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the sensory organ in muscle; involved in the stretch reflex and sensitive to stretch velocity.

VT:0000992.name: primary muscle spindle size trait
VT:0000992.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the sensory organ in muscle; involved in the stretch reflex and is sensitive to stretch velocity.

VT:0000994.name: secondary muscle spindle morphology trait
VT:0000994.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the sensory organ in muscle; involved in the stretch reflex and not sensitive to stretch velocity.

VT:0000995.name: secondary muscle spindle size trait
VT:0000995.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the sensory organ in muscle; involved in the stretch reflex and is not sensitive to stretch velocity.

VT:0000997.name: joint capsule morphology trait
VT:0000997.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the sac that encloses the articulating ends of bones participating in a synovial joint; formed by an outer fibrous layer and an inner synovial membrane.

VT:0000999.name: Golgi tendon organ morphology trait
VT:0000999.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the sensory organ in muscle that is involved in regulating muscle tension.

VT:0001001.name: chemoreceptor morphology trait
VT:0001001.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the cells specialized to detect chemical substances and relay that information centrally in the nervous system.

VT:0001002.name: taste bud morphology trait
VT:0001002.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the small sensory organs located in the tongue that contain gustatory receptor cells, basal cells, and supporting cells.

VT:0001003.name: olfactory receptor morphology trait
VT:0001003.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the proteins, usually projecting from the cilia of olfactory receptor neurons, that specifically bind odorant molecules and trigger responses in the specialized neurons of the olfactory epithelium.

VT:0001004.name: retinal photoreceptor morphology trait
VT:0001004.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the receptors sensitive to light.

VT:0001005.name: retinal rod cell morphology trait
VT:0001005.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the photoreceptors that contain rhodopsin.

VT:0001006.name: retinal cone cell morphology trait
VT:0001006.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the retinal receptors that give rise to color vision.

VT:0001007.name: sympathetic nervous system morphology trait
VT:0001007.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the part of the autonomic nervous system that innervates smooth muscle, cardiac muscle and glands and mediates the body's response to stressful situations.

VT:0001008.name: sympathetic ganglion morphology trait
VT:0001008.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the groups of neuronal cell bodies of the autonomic nervous system.

VT:0001009.name: paravertebral ganglion cell quantity
VT:0001009.def: The proportion or number of cells in the group of neuronal cell bodies of the autonomic nervous system that are located at intervals along the sympathetic trunks.

VT:0001010.name: prevertebral ganglion cell quantity
VT:0001010.def: The proportion or number of cells in the group of neuronal cell bodies of the autonomic nervous system that are located on the superior part of the abdominal aorta.

VT:0001011.name: superior cervical ganglion morphology trait
VT:0001011.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the group of neurons that is the largest of the sympathetic trunk; normally lies at the base of the skull and innervates the head and neck.

VT:0001013.name: superior cervical ganglion size trait
VT:0001013.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the group of neurons that is the largest of the ganglia of the sympathetic trunk; normally lies at the base of the skull and innervates the head and neck.

VT:0001016.name: middle cervical ganglion morphology trait
VT:0001016.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the small ganglion located at the level of the cricoid cartilage of the laryngeal wall.

VT:0001017.name: stellate ganglion morphology trait
VT:0001017.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the group of neurons formed by the fusion of the inferior cervical and first thoracic ganglia.

VT:0001018.name: cochlear outer hair cell efferent innervation morphology trait
VT:0001018.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the efferent terminals, occurring as clusters, in the cochlear OHC region; normally, medial olivocochlear neurons, which are primarily found in rostral and ventral periolivary regions, project mainly to the contralateral cochlea, and terminate directly on OHCs.
synonyms: cochlear OHC hair cell efferent innervation

VT:0001019.name: L4 dorsal root ganglion morphology trait
VT:0001019.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the group of nerve cell bodies located on the dorsal spinal roots within the vertebral column at the level of the fourth lumbar vertebra.
synonyms: L4 dorsal root ganglia morphology trait

VT:0001020.name: L4 ganglion size trait
VT:0001020.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the group of nerve cell bodies located on the dorsal spinal roots within the vertebral column at the level of the fourth lumbar vertebra.

VT:0001022.name: L5 dorsal root ganglion morphology trait
VT:0001022.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the group of nerve cell bodies located on the dorsal spinal roots within the vertebral column at the level of the fifth lumbar vertebra.
synonyms: L5 dorsal root ganglia morphology trait

VT:0001023.name: L5 ganglion size trait
VT:0001023.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the group of nerve cell bodies located on the dorsal spinal roots within the vertebral column at the level of the fifth lumbar vertebra.

VT:0001025.name: sympathetic neuron morphology trait
VT:0001025.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the neurons of the part of the autonomic nervous system that innervates smooth muscle, cardiac muscle and glands and mediates the body's response to stressful situations.

VT:0001026.name: adrenergic neuron morphology trait
VT:0001026.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the neurons that release catecholamines at a synapse after an impulse.

VT:0001027.name: obsolete adrenergic innervation pattern trait
VT:0001027.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement, distribution or supply of nerve fibers of the autonomic nervous system that use norepinephrine as their neurotransmitter to a target tissue or cell.\nconsider: VT:0010038, VT:0010039

VT:0001028.name: cochlear outer hair cell stereociliary bundle morphology trait
VT:0001028.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the mechanosensitive hair bundles located at the apical end of cochlear OHCs; each hair bundle is normally composed of ~100 nonmotile, actin-filled microvilli (stereocilia) arranged in rows of increasing height and coupled to one another by morphologically distinct links: tip links, horizontal top connectors, shaft connectors, and ankle links; most hair bundles also possess a single motile kinocilium immediately adjacent to the tallest (outermost) row of stereocilia; a fifth link type, the kinocilial link, connects the kinocilium to its neighboring stereocilia.

VT:0001031.name: outer hair cell stereocilia quantity
VT:0001031.def: The proportion or numbers of the nonmotile, actin-filled specialized microvilli (stereocilia) normally arrayed on the outer sensory epithelial cells of the cochlea, which are normally in synaptic contact with the auditory nerve.

VT:0001032.name: peptidergic neuron morphology trait
VT:0001032.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the nerve fibers believed to release small peptides as their neurotransmitter.

VT:0001033.name: parasympathetic nervous system morphology trait
VT:0001033.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the part of the autonomic nervous system that innervates smooth muscle, cardiac muscle and glands and regulates homeostasis.

VT:0001034.name: parasympathetic ganglion morphology trait
VT:0001034.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the ganglia of the parasympathetic nervous system, including the ciliary, pterygopalatine, submandibular, and otic ganglia in the cranial region and intrinsic (terminal) ganglia associated with target organs in the thorax and abdomen.

VT:0001035.name: submandibular ganglion morphology trait
VT:0001035.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the ganglion associated with the lingual nerve.

VT:0001036.name: submandibular ganglion size trait
VT:0001036.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the small parasympathetic ganglion of the lingual nerve.

VT:0001037.name: parasympathetic neuron morphology trait
VT:0001037.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the neurons of the autonomic nervous system that are responsible for innervation of smooth muscle, cardiac muscle and glands and regulation of homeostasis.

VT:0001038.name: cholinergic neuron morphology trait
VT:0001038.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the neurons that utilize acetylcholine as a neurotransmitter.

VT:0001039.name: obsolete cholinergic innervation pattern trait
VT:0001039.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement, distribution or supply of nerve fibers that utilize acetylcholine as a neurotransmitter to a target tissue or cell.\nconsider: VT:0010041, VT:0010062

VT:0001041.name: obsolete lacrimal gland cholinergic innervation pattern trait
VT:0001041.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement, distribution or supply of nerve fibers to the gland that secretes tears.\nconsider: VT:0010100, VT:0010123

VT:0001042.name: obsolete sublingual salivary gland cholinergic innervation pattern trait
VT:0001042.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement, distribution or supply of nerve fibers to the exocrine gland on the floor of the mouth that secretes saliva.\nconsider: VT:0010121, VT:0010126

VT:0001043.name: obsolete parotid salivary gland cholinergic innervation pattern trait
VT:0001043.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement, distribution or supply of nerve fibers to the exocrine gland lateral to the jaw that secretes saliva.\nconsider: VT:0010103, VT:0010124

VT:0001044.name: enteric nervous system morphology trait
VT:0001044.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the part of the autonomic nervous system that innervates the gastrointestinal tract, the pancreas, and the gallbladder and can autonomously sense the tension and the chemical environment in the gut and regulate blood vessel tone, motility, secretions, and fluid transport.

VT:0001045.name: enteric ganglion morphology trait
VT:0001045.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the groups of nerve cell bodies associated with the enteric neurons.

VT:0001046.name: enteric neuron morphology trait
VT:0001046.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the neurons that innervate the alimentary tube.

VT:0001047.name: enteric cholinergic neuron morphology trait
VT:0001047.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the neurons that utilize acetylcholine as a neurotransmitter and innervate the alimentary tube.

VT:0001048.name: enteric neuron quantity
VT:0001048.def: The proportion or number of neurons that innervate the alimentary tube.

VT:0001049.name: obsolete enteric cholinergic innervation pattern trait
VT:0001049.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement, distribution or supply of nerve fibers that utilize acetylcholine as a neurotransmitter to the alimentary tube.\nconsider: VT:0010074, VT:0010099

VT:0001051.name: somatic motor system morphology trait
VT:0001051.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the neural tissue involved in the transmission of motor signals.

VT:0001052.name: obsolete muscle innervation pattern trait
VT:0001052.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement, distribution or supply of sensory or motor nerve fibers to targets in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement of an organ or part of the body.\nconsider: VT:0010189, VT:0010262

VT:0001053.name: neuromuscular synapse morphology trait
VT:0001053.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the membrane to membrane contact of a motor axon and a muscle myofiber.

VT:0001056.name: cranial nerve morphology trait
VT:0001056.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the twelve nerves that emerge from the cranium as opposed to the spinal nerves.

VT:0001059.name: optic nerve size trait
VT:0001059.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the second cranial nerve, which is responsible for conveying visual information from the retina to the brain.

VT:0001061.name: oculomotor nerve morphology trait
VT:0001061.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the 3rd cranial nerve, which normally sends motor fibers to the levator muscles of the eyelid and to the superior rectus, inferior rectus, and inferior oblique muscles of the eye; and also sends parasympathetic efferents to the muscles controlling pupillary constriction and accommodation.

VT:0001062.name: oculomotor nerve size trait
VT:0001062.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the nerve of the extraocular muscles, iris and ciliary body.

VT:0001063.name: trochlear nerve morphology trait
VT:0001063.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the 4th cranial nerve, which normally carries the motor innervation of the superior oblique muscles of the eye.

VT:0001064.name: trochlear nerve size trait
VT:0001064.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the nerve of the superior oblique muscle.

VT:0001065.name: trigeminal nerve morphology trait
VT:0001065.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the chief sensory nerve of the face and motor nerve of the muscles of mastication; has three major divisions: ophthalmic, maxillary and mandibular.

VT:0001067.name: mandibular nerve morphology trait
VT:0001067.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the third division of the trigeminal nerve.

VT:0001068.name: mandibular nerve branching morphology trait
VT:0001068.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the projected axons of the mandibular nerve, the third division of the trigeminal nerve.

VT:0001070.name: abducens nerve morphology trait
VT:0001070.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the 6th cranial nerve, which originates in the abducens nucleus of the pons and sends motor fibers to the lateral rectus muscles of the eye.

VT:0001071.name: facial nerve morphology trait
VT:0001071.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the motor axons from the pons to the face.

VT:0001072.name: vestibulocochlear nerve morphology trait
VT:0001072.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the sensory nerve innervating the receptor cells of the membranous labyrinth.

VT:0001073.name: glossopharyngeal nerve morphology trait
VT:0001073.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of sensory and autonomic axons to the parotid gland, carotid body, posterior third of the tongue.

VT:0001074.name: vagus nerve morphology trait
VT:0001074.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the autonomic, sensory and motor axons of the tenth cranial nerve to the pharynx, larynx, trachea, lungs, heart and GI tract.

VT:0001075.name: accessory nerve morphology trait
VT:0001075.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the 11th cranial nerve, which normally originates from neurons in the medulla and in the cervical spinal cord.

VT:0001076.name: hypoglossal nerve morphology trait
VT:0001076.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of motor axons to the tongue.

VT:0001077.name: spinal nerve morphology trait
VT:0001077.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of any of the paired peripheral nerves formed by the union of the dorsal and ventral spinal roots from each spinal cord segment.

VT:0001078.name: phrenic nerve morphology trait
VT:0001078.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the motor and sensory neuron axons that project to the diaphragm and other tissues.

VT:0001081.name: cranial ganglion morphology trait
VT:0001081.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the groups of nerve cell bodies associated with the twelve cranial nerves.

VT:0001082.name: geniculate ganglion morphology trait
VT:0001082.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the group of sensory neuron cell bodies associated with the facial nerve (seventh cranial nerve).

VT:0001083.name: geniculate ganglion size trait
VT:0001083.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the intermediate nerve fibers associated with the facial nerve.

VT:0001084.name: petrosal ganglion morphology trait
VT:0001084.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lower group of sensory neuron cell bodies associated with the glossopharyngeal nerve.
synonyms: inferior glossopharyngeal ganglion of the glossopharyngeal (IX) nerve morphology trait

VT:0001085.name: petrosal ganglion size trait
VT:0001085.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the inferior of two sensory ganglia on the glossopharyngeal nerve immediately inferior to its exit from the jugular formamen.

VT:0001087.name: nodose ganglion morphology trait
VT:0001087.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the large group of sensory neuron cell bodies, anterior to the jugular vein, associated with the vagus nerve (tenth cranial nerve).
synonyms: inferior vagus ganglion of the vagus (X) nerve morphology trait

VT:0001088.name: nodose ganglion size trait
VT:0001088.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the large group of sensory neuron cell bodies, anterior to the jugular vein, associated with the vagus nerve (tenth cranial nerve).

VT:0001089.name: nodose ganglion neuron quantity
VT:0001089.def: The proportion or number of the sensory neurons comprising the nodose ganglion.

VT:0001091.name: outer hair cell stereocilia size trait
VT:0001091.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the nonmotile, actin-filled specialized microvilli (stereocilia) which are normally arrayed on cochlear outer hair cells.

VT:0001092.name: trigeminal ganglion morphology trait
VT:0001092.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the group of sensory neuron cell bodies associated with the trigeminal nerve (fifth cranial nerve).
synonyms: trigeminal ganglion of trigenmial (V) nerve morphology trait

VT:0001094.name: trigeminal ganglion cell size trait
VT:0001094.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the cells of the trigeminal ganglion, the group of sensory neuron cell bodies associated with the fifth cranial nerve.

VT:0001095.name: trigeminal ganglion size trait
VT:0001095.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the group of sensory neuron cell bodies associated with the trigeminal nerve.

VT:0001096.name: glossopharyngeal ganglion morphology trait
VT:0001096.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the group of neuron cell bodies associated with the ninth cranial nerve.

VT:0001097.name: superior glossopharyngeal ganglion morphology trait
VT:0001097.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the upper ganglion of the glossopharyngeal nerve located at the jugular foramen.
synonyms: superior glossopharyngeal ganglion of the glossopharyngeal (IX) nerve morphology trait

VT:0001098.name: superior glossopharyngeal ganglion size trait
VT:0001098.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the upper ganglion of the glossopharyngeal nerve located at the jugular foramen.

VT:0001100.name: vagus ganglion morphology trait
VT:0001100.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the group of sensory neuron cell bodies associated with the vagus nerve.

VT:0001101.name: superior vagus ganglion morphology trait
VT:0001101.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the upper ganglion of the vagus nerve located at the jugular foramen.
synonyms: superior vagus ganglion of the vagus (X) nerve morphology trait

VT:0001102.name: superior vagus ganglion size trait
VT:0001102.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the upper ganglion of the vagus nerve located at the jugular foramen.

VT:0001105.name: peripheral nervous system glial cell morphology trait
VT:0001105.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the non-neuronal cells of the peripheral nervous system that form the myelin insulation of nervous pathways, guide neuronal migration during development, and exchange metabolites with neurons.
synonyms: peripheral nervous system glia morphology trait

VT:0001106.name: Schwann cell morphology trait
VT:0001106.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells which form the insulating myelin sheaths of peripheral axons.

VT:0001107.name: Schwann cell quantity
VT:0001107.def: The proportion or number of the cells that form the insulating myelin sheaths of peripheral axons.

VT:0001119.name: female reproductive system morphology trait
VT:0001119.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the organs associated with producing offspring in the gender that bears the offspring.

VT:0001120.name: uterus morphology trait
VT:0001120.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the hollow muscular organ where the embryo/fetus develops.

VT:0001125.name: oocyte morphology trait
VT:0001125.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the female germ cell that has entered meiosis.

VT:0001126.name: ovary morphology trait
VT:0001126.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the female reproductive gland containing the germ cells.

VT:0001127.name: ovary size trait
VT:0001127.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the female reproductive gland containing the germ cells.

VT:0001130.name: ovarian folliculogenesis trait
VT:0001130.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the formation of the spherical ovum in the ovary.

VT:0001131.name: ovarian follicle morphology trait
VT:0001131.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the ovarian structure containing an oocyte.

VT:0001133.name: luteal cell differentiation trait
VT:0001133.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which relatively unspecialized cells acquire the specialized features of the cells of the corpus luteum of the ovary.

VT:0001135.name: uterine cervix morphology trait
VT:0001135.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the opening of the uterus to the vagina.

VT:0001137.name: uterine cervix epithelium morphology trait
VT:0001137.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the epithelial layer of the cervix.

VT:0001138.name: uterine cervix squamous epithelium morphology trait
VT:0001138.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the scaly epithelial layer of the cervix.

VT:0001139.name: vagina morphology trait
VT:0001139.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the female reproductive canal located between the uterus and the vulva.

VT:0001140.name: vagina epithelium morphology trait
VT:0001140.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the epithelial layer of the vagina.

VT:0001141.name: vaginal epithelium thickness
VT:0001141.def: The distance between the surfaces of the vaginal epithelial layer.

VT:0001142.name: vaginal opening morphology trait
