VT:0001142.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the opening to the genital canal in the female.

VT:0001143.name: vaginal opening size trait
VT:0001143.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the external vaginal opening.

VT:0001145.name: male reproductive system morphology trait
VT:0001145.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the organs associated with producing offspring in the gender that produces spermatozoa.

VT:0001146.name: testis morphology trait
VT:0001146.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the male reproductive gland(s) where sperm production occurs.

VT:0001148.name: testis size trait
VT:0001148.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the male reproductive gland(s) where sperm production occurs.

VT:0001150.name: scrotum size trait
VT:0001150.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the external sac of skin that encloses the testes.

VT:0001151.name: foreskin size trait
VT:0001151.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the loose fold of skin that covers the penis.

VT:0001153.name: seminiferous tubule size trait
VT:0001153.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the tubules in the testes where spermatogenesis occurs.

VT:0001156.name: spermatogenesis trait
VT:0001156.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the formation of the male gametes.

VT:0001158.name: prostate morphology trait
VT:0001158.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the gland surrounding the beginning of the urethra in males that secretes part of the seminal fluid.

VT:0001163.name: coagulating gland morphology trait
VT:0001163.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the anterior lobe of the prostate.

VT:0001168.name: prostate epithelium morphology trait
VT:0001168.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the prostate epithelium.

VT:0001169.name: bulbourethral gland morphology trait
VT:0001169.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the gland in males that lies along the prostate gland and secretes a fluid component of the seminal fluid into the urethra.

VT:0001170.name: bulbourethral gland size trait
VT:0001170.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the gland in males that lies along the prostate gland and secretes a fluid component of the seminal fluid into the urethra.

VT:0001173.name: bulbourethral gland ductal cell quantity
VT:0001173.def: The proportion or number of cells found in the ducts through which the bulbourethral glands discharge mucus into the spongy part of the urethra.

VT:0001175.name: lung morphology trait
VT:0001175.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of either or both of the spongy organs of respiration contained within the pleural cavity of the thorax.

VT:0001176.name: lung development trait
VT:0001176.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the either or both of the spongy organs of respiration contained within the pleural cavity of the thorax during its/their formation and differentiation.

VT:0001178.name: lung cell quantity
VT:0001178.def: The proportion or number of cells in all or part of either or both of the spongy organs of respiration contained within the pleural cavity of the thorax.

VT:0001179.name: alveolar septum thickness
VT:0001179.def: The distance between the surfaces of the structure that separates the air sacs (alveoli) in the lung.

VT:0001180.name: inner hair cell stereociliary bundle morphology trait
VT:0001180.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the typically linear or U-shaped pattern of arrangement of mechanosensitive hair bundles located at the apical end of cochlear IHCs; each hair bundle is normally composed of ~100 nonmotile, actin-filled microvilli (stereocilia) arranged in rows of increasing height and coupled to one another by morphologically distinct links: tip links, horizontal top connectors, shaft connectors, and ankle links; most hair bundles also possess a single motile kinocilium immediately adjacent to the tallest row of stereocilia; a fifth link type, the kinocilial link, connects the kinocilium to its neighboring stereocilia.

VT:0001183.name: respiratory alveoli size trait
VT:0001183.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the saclike terminal dilation of the respiratory bronchioles.

VT:0001200.name: skin thickness
VT:0001200.def: The distance between the surfaces of the membranous protective covering of the body.

VT:0001201.name: skin translucence
VT:0001201.def: The ability of light to be transmitted diffusely through the membranous protective covering of the body.

VT:0001213.name: skin cell quantity
VT:0001213.def: The proportion or number of cells in the membranous protective covering of the body.

VT:0001216.name: epidermis morphology trait
VT:0001216.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the superficial epithelial portion of the skin.

VT:0001219.name: epidermis thickness
VT:0001219.def: The distance between the surfaces of the superficial epithelial portion of the skin.

VT:0001222.name: epidermis cell quantity
VT:0001222.def: The proportion or number of cells in the superficial epithelial portion of the skin.

VT:0001225.name: epidermis development trait
VT:0001225.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the superficial epithelial portion of the skin during its formation and differentiation.

VT:0001231.name: epidermis stratum basale morphology trait
VT:0001231.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the deepest layer of the epidermis, which is composed of dividing stem cells and anchoring cells.

VT:0001236.name: epidermis stratum spinosum morphology trait
VT:0001236.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the layer of polyhedral cells in the epidermis between the stratum granulosum and stratum basale.

VT:0001237.name: epidermis stratum spinosum cell size trait
VT:0001237.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the cells of the layer between the stratum granulosum and stratum basale in the epidermis.

VT:0001238.name: epidermis stratum spinosum thickness
VT:0001238.def: The distance between the surfaces of the layer between the stratum granulosum and stratum basale in the epidermis.

VT:0001239.name: epidermis stratum granulosum morphology trait
VT:0001239.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the layer of flattened cells containing basophilic granules of keratohyalin and lying just above the stratum spinosum (spiny layer) of the epidermis.

VT:0001240.name: epidermis stratum corneum morphology trait
VT:0001240.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the outer layer of the epidermis, consisting of several layers of flat keratinized non-nucleated cells.

VT:0001242.name: epidermis stratum corneum thickness
VT:0001242.def: The distance between the surfaces of the outer layer of the epidermis, consisting of several layers of flat keratinized non-nucleated cells.

VT:0001243.name: dermis morphology trait
VT:0001243.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the layer of the skin deep to the epidermis, consisting of a dense bed of vascular, connective tissue.

VT:0001245.name: dermis thickness
VT:0001245.def: The distance between the surfaces of the layer of skin deep to the epidermis, consisting of a dense bed of vascular connective tissue.

VT:0001248.name: connective tissue morphology trait
VT:0001248.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the physical or functional supporting tissue of the body, a major constituent of which is an extracellular matrix of ground substance, protein fibers, and structural glycoproteins.

VT:0001250.name: dermis stratum papillare morphology trait
VT:0001250.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the outer layer of the dermis, characterized by ridges or papillae protruding into the epidermis.

VT:0001253.name: body height
VT:0001253.def: The vertical dimension of the body of an organism, usually measured from the top of the head to the bottom of feet or hindlimbs.

VT:0001256.name: body length
VT:0001256.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the body of an organism.

VT:0001259.name: body mass
VT:0001259.def: The amount of matter in the body of an organism.

VT:0001274.name: vibrissa shape trait
VT:0001274.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical form or contours of the stiff hairs projecting from the face, which act as touch receptors.

VT:0001277.name: vibrissa organization trait
VT:0001277.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of the stiff hairs projecting from the face, which act as touch receptors.

VT:0001280.name: vibrissa retention trait
VT:0001280.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to maintain the whiskers without noticeable loss.

VT:0001281.name: vibrissa length
VT:0001281.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the stiff hairs projecting from the face, which act as touch receptors.

VT:0001283.name: obsolete vibrissa density
VT:0001283.def: OBSOLETE. The amount of space between whiskers.

VT:0001286.name: eye development trait
VT:0001286.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the organ of vision and its supporting structures.

VT:0001288.name: lens induction trait
VT:0001288.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the beginning of the formation of the transparent structure of the eye responsible for focusing light rays.

VT:0001289.name: hyaloid capillary system development trait
VT:0001289.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the transient vascular system of the eye during its formation, differentiation, and degeneration.

VT:0001290.name: time of eyelid opening
VT:0001290.def: The stage of development when the eyelids first separate.

VT:0001292.name: lens vesicle development trait
VT:0001292.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the primordium of the lens of the eye during its formation and differentiation.

VT:0001299.name: eye orientation trait
VT:0001299.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the location or arrangement of the eyes and their supporting structures in relation to each other or in relation to other craniofacial structures.

VT:0001300.name: obsolete distance between the eyes
VT:0001300.def: OBSOLETE. The distance between the eyes.\nconsider: VT:0001299

VT:0001301.name: inner hair cell stereocilia quantity
VT:0001301.def: The proportion or numbers of the nonmotile, actin-filled specialized microvilli (stereocilia) normally arrayed on the inner sensory epithelial cells of the cochlea, which are normally in synaptic contact with the auditory nerve.

VT:0001303.name: lens morphology trait
VT:0001303.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the transparent structure of the eye responsible for focusing light rays.

VT:0001304.name: lens clarity trait
VT:0001304.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the degree of transparency of the structure of the eye responsible for focusing light rays.

VT:0001305.name: lens size trait
VT:0001305.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the transparent structure of the eye responsible for focusing light rays.

VT:0001308.name: lens polarity trait
VT:0001308.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the orientation of the lens during development.

VT:0001310.name: conjunctiva morphology trait
VT:0001310.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the mucous membrane that lines the inner surface of the eyelids and the front of the eyeball.

VT:0001312.name: cornea morphology trait
VT:0001312.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the transparent anterior portion of the fibrous coat of the eye that serves as the chief refractory structure.

VT:0001314.name: cornea clarity trait
VT:0001314.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the degree of transparency of the transparent anterior portion of the fibrous coat of the eye that serves as the chief refractory structure.

VT:0001317.name: pupil morphology trait
VT:0001317.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the central circular aperture of the iris through which light rays enter the eye.

VT:0001318.name: pupil clarity trait
VT:0001318.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the degree of transparency of the central circular aperture of the iris through which light rays normally enter the eye.

VT:0001319.name: pupil shape trait
VT:0001319.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical form or contours of the aperture of the iris through which light rays enter the eye.

VT:0001321.name: pupil size trait
VT:0001321.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the central circular aperture of the iris through which light rays enter the eye.

VT:0001322.name: iris morphology trait
VT:0001322.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the adjustable membrane, composed of the stroma and pigmented epithelium, located just in front of the crystalline lens within the eye.

VT:0001323.name: inner hair cell stereocilia size trait
VT:0001323.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the nonmotile, actin-filled specialized microvilli (stereocilia) normally arrayed on cochlear inner hair cells.

VT:0001324.name: eye pigmentation trait
VT:0001324.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the deposition or aggregation of coloring matter in the eye.

VT:0001325.name: retina morphology trait
VT:0001325.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the thin layer of neural tissue lining the back of the eyeball which contains visual receptors.

VT:0001328.name: retinal layer organization trait
VT:0001328.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of the sheets of cells comprising the optic part of the retina.

VT:0001329.name: retina cell quantity
VT:0001329.def: The proportion or number of cells in the thin layer of neural tissue lining the back of the eyeball which contains visual receptors.

VT:0001330.name: optic nerve morphology trait
VT:0001330.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the second cranial nerve which is responsible for conveying visual information from the retina to the brain; it extends from the retina to the optic chiasma where part of its fibers become the optic tract and cross to the opposite side and pass to the geniculate bodies.

VT:0001332.name: obsolete optic nerve innervation pattern trait
VT:0001332.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement, distribution or supply of nerve fibers from the second cranial nerve which is responsible for conveying visual information from the retina to the brain.\nconsider: VT:0006221, VT:0010141

VT:0001334.name: optic tract size trait
VT:0001334.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the paired bands of optic nerve fibers running from the optic chiasma to the lateral geniculate body and midbrain.

VT:0001335.name: inner hair cell synaptic ribbon morphology trait
VT:0001335.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the presynaptic active zone of mature cochlear IHCs which usually contain a single synaptic ribbon, i.e. a submicrometer, electron-dense structure tethering synaptic vesicles; each spiral ganglion neuron receives input from only one IHC synapse.

VT:0001336.name: active-zone-anchored inner hair cell synaptic ribbon morphology trait
VT:0001336.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the usually single synaptic ribbon, a characteristic osmiophilic, electron-dense structure to which synaptic vesicles are tethered at the active zone of the cochlear inner hair cell afferent synapse.

VT:0001337.name: eye moisture amount
VT:0001337.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of moisture in the eye.

VT:0001340.name: eyelid morphology trait
VT:0001340.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the skin folds covering the front of the eyeball.

VT:0001345.name: meibomian gland size trait
VT:0001345.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the sebaceous glands embedded in the tarsal plate of each eyelid.

VT:0001346.name: lacrimal gland morphology trait
VT:0001346.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the glands that secrete tears.

VT:0001348.name: lacrimal gland physiology trait
VT:0001348.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the glands that secrete tears.

VT:0001349.name: tear production trait
VT:0001349.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the secretion of watery saline solution by the lacrimal glands.

VT:0001359.name: organ of Corti patterning trait
VT:0001359.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the organization of the various cell types within the organ of Corti into a set number of distinct rows.

VT:0001360.name: social investigation trait
VT:0001360.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the behavior of animals to approach and examine other animals.

VT:0001365.name: Deiters cell quantity
VT:0001365.def: The proportion or numbers of the supporting cells of the spiral organ which are attached to the basement membrane and receive the hair cells between their free extremities.

VT:0001366.name: pillar cell quantity
VT:0001366.def: The proportion or numbers of the supporting cells that form the inner and outer walls of the tunnel in the organ of Corti.

VT:0001378.name: ejaculation trait
VT:0001378.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the propulsion of semen from the genital ducts and the urethra to the exterior.

VT:0001379.name: penile erection physiology trait
VT:0001379.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the achievement of a rigid and elevated state of the penis when the erectile tissue becomes filled with blood.

VT:0001387.name: spiral ligament size trait
VT:0001387.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the thickened periosteal lining of the bony cochlea that forms the outer wall of the cochlear duct to which the basal lamina attaches.

VT:0001388.name: stationary movement trait
VT:0001388.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to change body posture or shift a body part.

VT:0001392.name: locomotor behavior trait
VT:0001392.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to move from place to place.

VT:0001398.name: strial basal cell tight junction morphology trait
VT:0001398.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, or pattern of the tight junctions between basal cells of stria vascularis, resulting in the paracellular barrier between basal cells; closing the intrastrial space off from the perilymph and establishing its electrical isolation.

VT:0001412.name: scratching trait
VT:0001412.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to scraping of the skin, usually with the nails.

VT:0001416.name: strial marginal cell quantity
VT:0001416.def: The proportion or numbers of the polarized columnar cells of epithelial origin which cover the lateral surface of the cochlear duct, secrete K+ and form a continuous sheet in contact with the endolymph.

VT:0001418.name: tectorial membrane size trait
VT:0001418.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the overlaying membrane of the cochlear duct.

VT:0001421.name: scala media size trait
VT:0001421.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the division of the spiral canal of the cochlea that contains the organ of Corti (the neuroepithelial receptor organ for hearing).

VT:0001422.name: drinking behavior trait
VT:0001422.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the consumption of liquids.

VT:0001431.name: eating behavior trait
VT:0001431.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the consumption of solids.

VT:0001437.name: swallowing reflex trait
VT:0001437.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to pull food through the esophagus to the stomach in response to feeding.

VT:0001440.name: grooming behavior trait
VT:0001440.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to actions or reactions of an organism with regard to the standard behavior of cleaning and/or keeping outward appearance tidy (self, mate or offspring).

VT:0001444.name: scala tympani size trait
VT:0001444.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the spiral canal of the cochlea lying on the basal side of the spiral lamina.

VT:0001445.name: vestibular hair cell stereociliary bundle morphology trait
VT:0001445.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the mechanosensitive hair bundles which are composed of thick long microvilli (stereocilia) and are located at the apical end of vestibular hair cells of the utricle and saccule.
synonyms: vestibular hair cell stereocilia morphology trait

VT:0001447.name: nest-building behavior trait
VT:0001447.def: Any measurable or observable behavioral characteristic related to the construction of a container or shelter made out of available materials.

VT:0001449.name: obsolete learning/memory trait
VT:0001449.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to ascertain, retain or recall information.

VT:0001450.name: vestibular hair bundle inter-stereocilial link morphology trait
VT:0001450.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure or pattern of the morphologically and biochemically distinct link types that extend between the stereocilia of vestibular hair bundles.

VT:0001451.name: vestibular hair bundle shaft connector morphology trait
VT:0001451.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure or pattern of the links that connect the shafts of neighboring stereocilia in vestibular hair bundles; each shaft connector is composed of a ruthenium red-reactive, electron-dense particle that is connected to the plasma membrane by several fine strands of variable length.

VT:0001452.name: vestibular hair cell stereocilia quantity
VT:0001452.def: The proportion or numbers of the nonmotile, actin-filled specialized microvilli (stereocilia) which are normally arrayed on vestibular hair cells in a staircase-like pattern.

VT:0001455.name: vestibular hair cell stereocilia size trait
VT:0001455.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the nonmotile, actin-filled specialized microvilli (stereocilia) which are normally arrayed on vestibular hair cells in a staircase-like pattern.

VT:0001456.name: otic capsule size trait
VT:0001456.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the cartilage or bony capsule surrounding the inner ear mechanism.

VT:0001457.name: vestibular dark cell morphology trait
VT:0001457.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the nonsensory epithelial cells located above the vestibular melanocytes and adjacent to the sensory structures in the utricle and in the ampullae at the ends of each of the semicircular canals; these cells provide and maintain the high K+ ionic environment within the vestibular labyrinth and are therefore homologous to the marginal cells of the stria vascularis; they are joined to each other by tight junctions and provide a barrier between endolymph and perilymph.

VT:0001459.name: vestibule size trait
VT:0001459.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the cavity between the semicircular canals and the cochlea of the inner ear.

VT:0001464.name: incus size trait
VT:0001464.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the middle of the three auditory ossicles.

VT:0001465.name: malleus size trait
VT:0001465.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the largest of the three auditory ossicles, which resembles a club.

VT:0001501.name: sleep behavior trait
VT:0001501.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the behaviors related to the readily reversible state of reduced awareness and metabolic activity that occurs periodically in many animals.

VT:0001502.name: behavioral circadian rhythm trait
VT:0001502.def: Any measurable or observable behavioral characteristic related to a daily biological activity cycle.

VT:0001504.name: posture trait
VT:0001504.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the position of the limbs or carriage of the body.

VT:0001505.name: body posture trait
VT:0001505.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to carriage of the body.

VT:0001516.name: motor coordination/balance trait
VT:0001516.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of an animal to maintain skillful and effective interaction of movements or maintenance of equilibrium.

VT:0001525.name: balance trait
VT:0001525.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to maintain equilibrium.

VT:0001529.name: vocalization trait
VT:0001529.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to produce sound from the vocal organs.

VT:0001539.name: caudal vertebra quantity
VT:0001539.def: The proportion or number of the bony segments of the tail; in tailless vertebrates, these vertebrae may be united to form the coccyx.

VT:0001541.name: osteoclast physiology trait
VT:0001541.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in large, multinucleated cells that function in the absorption and removal of osseous tissue.

VT:0001542.name: bone strength trait
VT:0001542.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of bone to withstand the application of force without yielding or breaking.

VT:0001544.name: cardiovascular system physiology trait
VT:0001544.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the heart or blood vessels.

VT:0001547.name: lipid amount
VT:0001547.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in a body fluid or tissue of fat-soluble substances (molecules composed of carbon and hydrogen and are characteristically insoluble in water).

VT:0001553.name: blood free fatty acid amount
VT:0001553.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of organic, monobasic acids derived from hydrocarbons, which are complexed with serum albumin for transport; they are saturated and unsaturated.

VT:0001560.name: blood insulin amount
VT:0001560.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this polypeptide hormone, secreted by beta cells of the pancreas, that promotes glucose utilization, protein synthesis, and the formation and storage of neutral lipids.

VT:0001562.name: blood calcium amount
VT:0001562.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this metallic bivalent element with atomic symbol Ca and atomic number 20.

VT:0001565.name: blood phosphate amount
VT:0001565.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this salt or ester of phosphoric acid.

VT:0001569.name: blood bilirubin amount
VT:0001569.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this yellow heme breakdown product.

VT:0001570.name: blood enzyme amount
VT:0001570.def: The proportion or quantity in whole blood, serum, or plasma of any of the proteins that act as catalysts for biological reactions.

VT:0001573.name: blood alanine transaminase amount
VT:0001573.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this enzyme, which transfers amino groups from l-alanine to 2-ketoglutarate, or the reverse (from l-glutamate to pyruvate); serum concentration is increased in viral hepatitis and myocardial infarction.

VT:0001586.name: erythrocyte quantity
VT:0001586.def: The proportion or number in the blood of the cells that carry oxygen, the red blood cells.

VT:0001588.name: blood hemoglobin amount
VT:0001588.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in blood of the oxygen-carrying protein of erythrocytes.

VT:0001601.name: myelopoiesis trait
VT:0001601.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the formation of myeloid cells from the pluripotent hematopoietic stem cells in the bone marrow via myeloid stem cells, including the production of leukocytes in blood, such as monocytes and granulocytes, and precursor cells for macrophages and dendritic cells found in the lymphoid tissue.

VT:0001614.name: blood vessel morphology trait
VT:0001614.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the tubular channels through which the blood circulates.

VT:0001649.name: symphysis menti morphology trait
VT:0001649.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the fibrocartilagenous union of the two halves of the mandible (embryonic stages).

VT:0001661.name: total life span
VT:0001661.def: The full period of time from birth to death of an organism.

VT:0001663.name: gastrointestinal system physiology trait
VT:0001663.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the organ system that converts ingested food to nutrients and energy.

VT:0001664.name: digestion trait
VT:0001664.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the mechanical, chemical, and enzymatic conversion of ingested food into material suitable for assimilation for synthesis of tissues or liberation of energy.

VT:0001666.name: nutrient absorption trait
VT:0001666.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the body to take in constituents of food necessary for normal physiologic function.

VT:0001667.name: carbohydrate absorption trait
VT:0001667.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the body to take in substances composed of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen according to the general formula Cn(H2O)n; sugars and starches are examples.

VT:0001668.name: fructose absorption trait
VT:0001668.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the body to take in this 5-carbon sugar.

VT:0001669.name: glucose absorption trait
VT:0001669.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the body to take in the monosaccharide that is the end product of carbohydrate digestion; D-glucose serves as a primary energy source for living organisms.

VT:0001670.name: mineral absorption trait
VT:0001670.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the body to take in any inorganic element or compound that has importance in body functions.

VT:0001671.name: vitamin absorption trait
VT:0001671.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the body to take in any of a group of organic substances, present in food, that are essential to normal metabolism.

VT:0001674.name: germ layer development trait
VT:0001674.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the primary cellular layers from which the organs and tissues develop.

VT:0001675.name: ectoderm development trait
VT:0001675.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the outermost of the three germ layers during its formation and differentiation during gastrulation.

VT:0001676.name: apical ectodermal ridge development trait
VT:0001676.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the multilayered ectodermal region at the tip of a limb bud necessary for the proper development of the underlying mesenchyme.

VT:0001680.name: mesoderm development trait
VT:0001680.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the middle of the three embryonic germ layers during its formation and differentiation during gastrulation.

VT:0001684.name: axial mesoderm development trait
VT:0001684.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the portion of the middle primary germ layer, which gives rise to the notochord, during its formation during gastrulation.

VT:0001685.name: endoderm development trait
VT:0001685.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the innermost of the three germ layers during its formation and differentiation during gastrulation.

VT:0001688.name: somite development trait
VT:0001688.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of any of the paired, metamerically arranged cell masses formed in the embryonic paraxial mesoderm.

VT:0001690.name: somite differentiation initiation trait
VT:0001690.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the start of the process by which relatively unspecialized cells, tissues, or structures acquire the specialized features of the paired, metamerically arranged cell masses formed in the early embryo.

VT:0001691.name: somite shape trait
VT:0001691.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical form or contours of any of the paired, metamerically arranged cell masses formed in the embryonic paraxial mesoderm.

VT:0001695.name: gastrulation trait
VT:0001695.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the development and invagination of the embryonic germ layers.

VT:0001697.name: embryo size trait
VT:0001697.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the anatomical entity that comprises the organism in the early stages of growth and differentiation that are characterized by cleavage, the laying down of fundamental tissues, and the formation of primitive organs and organ systems.

VT:0001700.name: embryo turning trait
VT:0001700.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the axial rotation of the germ layers of the embryo during the primitive streak/early somite stage (Mus:E8.5-E9.5) such that the curvature of the entire trunk region is reversed and the neural ectoderm moves to the convex region and the midgut region becomes located in the concave region.

VT:0001704.name: dorsal-ventral axis patterning trait
VT:0001704.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the establishment, maintenance, and elaboration of a pattern along the axis that runs from the front or lower side of an organism to the back or upper side of the body.

VT:0001705.name: proximal-distal axis patterning trait
VT:0001705.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the establishment, maintenance, and elaboration of a pattern in relation to proximity to the trunk or point of origin.

VT:0001706.name: left-right axis patterning trait
VT:0001706.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the establishment, maintenance, and elaboration of a pattern in relation to the left and right sides of the body.

VT:0001710.name: amniotic fold morphology trait
VT:0001710.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the involutions of the amnion.

VT:0001711.name: placenta morphology trait
VT:0001711.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the organ of metabolic interchange between fetus and mother, partly of embryonic origin and partly of maternal origin.

VT:0001712.name: placenta development trait
VT:0001712.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the organ of metabolic exchange between the fetus and mother.

VT:0001716.name: placenta labyrinth morphology trait
VT:0001716.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the structure where embryonic blood vessels are surrounded by trophoblast cells and maternal blood.

VT:0001718.name: yolk sac morphology trait
VT:0001718.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the highly vascular layer surrounding the yolk of an embryo; it contributes to hematopoietic circulation in mammals.

VT:0001721.name: blood island morphology trait
VT:0001721.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the pools of blood in the yolk sac.

VT:0001722.name: yolk sac color
VT:0001722.def: The visually perceived hue of the highly vascular layer surrounding the yolk of an embryo; it contributes to hematopoietic circulation in mammals.

VT:0001723.name: yolk sac vascular plexus morphology trait
VT:0001723.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the pattern of the primary (honeycomb-like) vasculature of the yolk sac prior to remodeling into a mature vascular network.

VT:0001724.name: extraembryonic endoderm morphology trait
VT:0001724.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the endoderm of the extraembryonic tissue that appears prior to gastrulation and performs critical functions during embryogenesis including nutrient uptake and transport from the mother to the embryo.

VT:0001725.name: umbilical cord morphology trait
VT:0001725.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the connective stalk between the fetus and the placenta.

VT:0001726.name: allantois morphology trait
VT:0001726.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the fetal membrane between the chorion and the amnion and yolk sac, which contributes to the formation of the umbilical cord and placental blood vessels in mammals.

VT:0001727.name: embryo implantation trait
VT:0001727.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the mammalian blastocyst to attach to the endometrium of the uterus.

VT:0001731.name: postnatal growth trait
VT:0001731.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the increase in size or mass of an organism after birth.

VT:0001739.name: secretion by adrenal gland trait
VT:0001739.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of physiologically active substances by the suprarenal gland.

VT:0001740.name: epinephrine secretion trait
VT:0001740.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release by the adrenal gland of a catecholamine secreted upon stimulation of the sympathetic nervous system.

VT:0001744.name: corticosterone secretion trait
VT:0001744.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of this adrenocortical steroid that induces glycogen deposition and regulates sodium conservation and potassium secretion.

VT:0001746.name: secretion by pituitary trait
VT:0001746.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of physiologically active substances from the pituitary.

VT:0001747.name: adrenocorticotropin secretion trait
VT:0001747.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of this pituitary hormone from the pituitary gland that stimulates the secretion of adrenal cortical steroids and induces growth of the adrenal cortex.

VT:0001752.name: secretion by hypothalamus trait
VT:0001752.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of physiologically active substances from the hypothalamus.

VT:0001753.name: hypothalamus corticotropin-releasing hormone secretion trait
VT:0001753.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of this factor, which stimulates the pituitary to release adrenocorticotropic hormone, from the hypothalamus.

VT:0001754.name: blood corticotropin-releasing hormone amount
VT:0001754.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of CRH in whole blood, serum, or plasma; CRH is normally released by the hypothalamus and stimulates the release of corticotropin by the anterior pituitary gland.

VT:0001756.name: urine production trait
VT:0001756.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the production and excretion of the fluid and dissolved substances excreted by the kidneys.

VT:0001757.name: urine molecular composition trait
VT:0001757.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the fluid and dissolved substances that is excreted by the kidneys.

VT:0001758.name: urine glucose amount
VT:0001758.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of the monosaccharide that is the end product of carbohydrate digestion.

VT:0001764.name: homeostasis trait
VT:0001764.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to a state of equilibrium in the body with respect to various functions and to chemical composition of the fluids and tissues.

VT:0001765.name: ion homeostasis trait
VT:0001765.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to any process involved in the maintenance of an internal equilibrium of ions within an organism or cell.

VT:0001770.name: iron amount
VT:0001770.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in a body tissue or fluid of this metallic element that normally occurs in the heme of hemoglobin, myoglobin, transferrin, ferritin, and iron-containing porphyrins; it is an essential component of enzymes such as catalase, peroxidase, and various cytochromes.

VT:0001771.name: blood magnesium amount
VT:0001771.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this alkaline earth element, atomic number 12, atomic symbol Mg.

VT:0001775.name: selenium amount
VT:0001775.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in a body tissue or fluid of this essential trace element, required for glutathione peroxidase and other enzymes.

VT:0001776.name: blood sodium amount
VT:0001776.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this metallic element, the most plentiful extracellular ion in the body and the principal determinant of extracellular fluid volume.

VT:0001777.name: body temperature regulation trait
VT:0001777.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the control of body heat.

VT:0001778.name: brown adipose amount
VT:0001778.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the thermogenic form of adipose capable of rapid liberation of energy; composed of brown adipocytes, which contain multiple small droplets of triglycerides and a high number of mitochondria.

VT:0001781.name: white adipose amount
VT:0001781.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the connective tissue consisting of fat-storing cells and arranged in lobular groups or along minor blood vessels.

VT:0001784.name: fluid regulation trait
VT:0001784.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the control of intracellular and/or extracellular fluid.

VT:0001790.name: immune system physiology trait
VT:0001790.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the organs or cells associated with the body's defense against foreign organisms or substances and aberrant native cells.

VT:0001798.name: macrophage phagocytosis trait
VT:0001798.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to he ability of macrophage phagocytic cells to internalize particulate matter.

VT:0001805.name: blood immunoglobulin G amount
VT:0001805.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the major antibody for antitoxins, viruses, and bacteria; also activates complement.

VT:0001807.name: blood immunoglobulin A amount
VT:0001807.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the principal immunoglobulin in exocrine secretions; prevents pathogens from invading the body through the mucosa of the gastrointestinal, pulmonary, and genitourinary tracts.

VT:0001819.name: immune system cell physiology trait
VT:0001819.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the cells associated with associated with the body's defense against foreign organisms or substances and aberrant native cells.

VT:0001828.name: T cell activation trait
VT:0001828.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the change in morphology and behavior of a mature or immature T cell resulting from exposure to a mitogen, cytokine, chemokine, cellular ligand, or an antigen for which it is specific.

VT:0001830.name: effector T cell quantity
VT:0001830.def: The proportion or numbers of the set of T lymphocytes that are able to respond immediately upon contact with cells bearing the appropriate peptide:MHC complex for the cell.

VT:0001835.name: antigen presentation trait
VT:0001835.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which an antigen-presenting cell expresses antigen (peptide or lipid) on its cell surface in association with an MHC protein complex.

VT:0001874.name: epidermis stratum spinosum cell quantity
VT:0001874.def: The proportion or number of cells in the layer between the stratum granulosum and stratum basale in the epidermis.

VT:0001879.name: lymphatic vessel morphology trait
VT:0001879.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the the lymphatic vessels, vessels that contain or convey lymph, that originate as an interfibrillar or intercellular cleft or space in a tissue or organ.

VT:0001881.name: mammary gland physiology trait
VT:0001881.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the milk-producing glands in female mammals, consisting of lobes containing clusters of alveoli with a system of ducts to convey the milk to an external nipple or teat.

VT:0001882.name: lactation trait
VT:0001882.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the production of milk from the mammary gland.

VT:0001884.name: mammary alveoli morphology trait
VT:0001884.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the sac-like structure of the mammary gland that synthesizes and secretes milk after pregnancy.

VT:0001885.name: mammary duct morphology trait
VT:0001885.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the tubular structure running from the nipple to the alveoli clusters in the mammary gland.

VT:0001895.name: hippocampus physiology trait
VT:0001895.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the deep lying structure of the cerebrum involved with memory storage and spatial navigation.

VT:0001898.name: long-term synaptic depression trait
VT:0001898.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the persistent activity-dependent decrease in synaptic efficacy between neurons, often following slow, weak stimulation of neurons.

VT:0001900.name: synaptic plasticity trait
VT:0001900.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the nervous system to change its reactivity as a result of successive activations.

VT:0001905.name: dopamine amount
VT:0001905.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of this catecholamine neurotransmitter, derived from tyrosine and the precursor to norepinephrine and epinephrine.

VT:0001907.name: cerebellum physiology trait
VT:0001907.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the portion of the brain in the back of the head between the cerebrum and the pons, that controls balance for walking and standing, modulates the force and range of movement and is involved in the learning of motor skills.

VT:0001908.name: somatosensory cortex physiology trait
VT:0001908.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the area of the parietal lobe that lies posterior to the central sulcus and is concerned with receiving and processing general sensations from the body surface.

VT:0001909.name: NMDA receptor mediated synaptic activity in barrel cortex
VT:0001909.def: The degree of function or response of excitatory synaptic current in the barrel cortex.

VT:0001911.name: cerebrospinal fluid production trait
VT:0001911.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the secretion of the fluid that fills the ventricles and other cavities of the brain and spinal cord.

VT:0001919.name: reproductive system physiology trait
VT:0001919.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the organs associated with producing offspring.

VT:0001922.name: male fertility trait
VT:0001922.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of a male to produce live offspring.

VT:0001923.name: female fertility trait
VT:0001923.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of a female to produce live offspring.

VT:0001927.name: estrous cycle trait
VT:0001927.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the sexual cycle of female animals.

VT:0001928.name: ovulation trait
VT:0001928.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the release of an ovum from a rupturing Graafian follicle, normally regulated by a surge in luteinizing hormone.

VT:0001929.name: gametogenesis trait
VT:0001929.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the formation or differentiation of germ cells.

VT:0001930.name: meiosis trait
VT:0001930.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of nuclear division that results in gametes with one half the normal chromosome number of the original cell.

VT:0001931.name: oogenesis trait
VT:0001931.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the formation of female germ cells.

VT:0001932.name: spermiogenesis trait
VT:0001932.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which immature spermatids become mature sperm.

VT:0001933.name: single birth offspring quantity
VT:0001933.def: The proportion or number of offspring produced from a single pregnancy (mammals) or ovulation (fish) or nesting (birds)

VT:0001938.name: time of sexual maturation trait
VT:0001938.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the time of maturation of the sexual organs.

VT:0001940.name: testis cell quantity
VT:0001940.def: The proportion or number of cells in the male reproductive glands where sperm production occurs.

VT:0001942.name: lung capacity
VT:0001942.def: The volume of or amount of air contained in the lungs at various points of the respiratory cycle.

VT:0001943.name: respiration trait
VT:0001943.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the movement of gases into and out of the lung.

VT:0001944.name: pancreas morphology trait
VT:0001944.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the organ that secretes pancreatic juice into the duodenum and secretes glucagon and insulin into the bloodstream.

VT:0001945.name: bronchoconstriction trait
VT:0001945.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the reduction in the caliber of the bronchus or bronchi.

VT:0001947.name: mucociliary clearance trait
VT:0001947.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the mechanism that removes mucus and other foreign particles and microorganisms from the lungs by directed ciliary and secretory activity of the respiratory submucosal glands.

VT:0001961.name: reflex trait
VT:0001961.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to an involuntary response to a peripheral stimulus.

VT:0001964.name: auditory threshold
VT:0001964.def: The point at which one may first detect auditory signals at given frequencies.

VT:0001968.name: tactile sensory behavior trait
VT:0001968.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the actions or reactions of an organism in response to a tactile stimulus.

VT:0001970.name: pain threshold
VT:0001970.def: The point at which stimulation first elicits the perception of pain.

VT:0001983.name: olfactory system physiology trait
VT:0001983.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the organs involved in smell.

VT:0001984.name: olfaction trait
VT:0001984.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the series of events required for an organism to receive an olfactory stimulus, convert it to a molecular signal, and recognize and characterize the signal; olfaction involves the detection of chemical composition of an organism's ambient medium by chemoreceptors.

VT:0001985.name: gustatory system physiology trait
VT:0001985.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to a function of or process in the organs involved in the perception of taste.

VT:0001986.name: taste sensitivity trait
VT:0001986.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to perceive a particular flavor or suggestion of something imparting a flavor by the chemoreceptors of the gustatory system.

VT:0002001.name: visual acuity trait
VT:0002001.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the sharpness or clarity of vision.

VT:0002059.name: seminal gland morphology trait
VT:0002059.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of one of the two folded, sac shaped glands that is a diverticulum of the ductus deferens.

VT:0002062.name: obsolete conditioning behavior trait
VT:0002062.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to change the frequency or form of a behavior as a result of the influence of the environment.

VT:0002063.name: learning/memory/conditioning trait
VT:0002063.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to actions or reactions of an organism associated with the ability to receive, store, process or recall informational stimuli.

VT:0002067.name: sensation behavior trait
VT:0002067.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to actions or reactions of an organism in response to a sensory stimulus; a sensory stimulus is any change in the external environment that is perceived and processed by any of the faculties by which outside stimuli are perceived.

VT:0002068.name: parental behavior trait
VT:0002068.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the behavior of animals towards offspring.

VT:0002069.name: consumption behavior trait
VT:0002069.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to actions or reactions of an organism with regard to the consumption of solids or liquids.

VT:0002073.name: obsolete hair physiology trait
VT:0002073.def: OBSOLETE. The function of or processes involved in the amount, growth or development of the filamentous appendages growing out of the skin, consisting primarily of keratin, and comprising a cylindrical shaft and a root which is contained in a follicle.\nconsider: VT:4000007

VT:0002074.name: hair texture trait
VT:0002074.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the visual or tactile surface characteristics of the fine, keratinized filamentous growths arising from the epidermis of mammals.

VT:0002076.name: hair follicle morphology trait
VT:0002076.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the tubular invaginations of the epidermis from which the hair shaft develops.

VT:0002084.name: developmental patterning trait
VT:0002084.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process in the embryo that results in the creation of defined areas or spaces to which cells respond and are eventually instructed to differentiate.

VT:0002085.name: embryonic cell/tissue morphology trait
VT:0002085.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of any cell type or tissue in the embryo.

VT:0002086.name: extraembryonic tissue morphology trait
VT:0002086.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the membranes involved with embryonic protection and nutrition.

VT:0002090.name: vision trait
VT:0002090.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes involved with the ability to see.

VT:0002092.name: eye morphology trait
VT:0002092.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the organ of vision and its supporting structures.

VT:0002093.name: obsolete cornea/lens morphology trait
VT:0002093.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the lens or cornea.\nconsider: VT:0001312 or VT:0001303

VT:0002095.name: skin pigmentation trait
VT:0002095.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the deposition or aggregation of coloring matter in the membranous protective covering of the body.

VT:0002096.name: skin morphology trait
VT:0002096.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the membranous protective covering of the body.

VT:0002098.name: vibrissa morphology trait
VT:0002098.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the stiff hairs projecting from the face, which act as touch receptors.

VT:0002100.name: tooth morphology trait
VT:0002100.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bone-like structures embedded in the jaw and used for mastication.

VT:0002102.name: ear morphology trait
VT:0002102.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the organ of hearing, responsible for maintaining equilibrium as well as sensing sound and divided in mammals into the external ear, the middle ear, and the inner ear.

VT:0002104.name: hearing physiology trait
VT:0002104.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes involved in the perception of sound.

VT:0002106.name: muscular system physiology trait
VT:0002106.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement of an organ or part of the body.

VT:0002108.name: muscular system morphology trait
VT:0002108.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement of an organ or part of the body.

VT:0002109.name: limb morphology trait
VT:0002109.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the projecting, paired, jointed appendages of the body used for locomotion or grasping.

VT:0002110.name: digit morphology trait
VT:0002110.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the fingers or toes, or their corresponding parts in other vertebrates.

VT:0002111.name: tail morphology trait
VT:0002111.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the appendage at the caudal end of the vertebral column in some vertebrates including remnant structures in species that normally lack a tail.

VT:0002114.name: axial skeleton morphology trait
VT:0002114.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the craniofacial, vertebral, rib, or sternal bones.

VT:0002115.name: skeleton extremities morphology trait
VT:0002115.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the bony framework of the limb, autopod, tail, or fin.

VT:0002116.name: craniofacial bone morphology trait
VT:0002116.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bones of the face and/or cranium.

VT:0002118.name: lipid homeostasis trait
VT:0002118.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the internal equilibrium of lipids (molecules composed of carbon and hydrogen and characteristically insoluble in water) within an organism or cell.

VT:0002121.name: metabolism trait
VT:0002121.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the processes that cause many of the chemical changes in living organisms, including anabolism and catabolism; metabolic processes typically transform small molecules, but also include macromolecular processes such as DNA repair and replication, and protein synthesis and degradation.

VT:0002123.name: hematopoiesis trait
VT:0002123.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the development of blood cells; in the fetus, they develop in the aorta, genital ridge and mesonephros region and in adults, in the bone marrow and lymphatic tissues.

VT:0002124.name: obsolete red blood cell trait
VT:0002124.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, pattern or maintenance of erythrocytes or oxygen-transporting material in the blood.\nconsider: VT:0002447

VT:0002127.name: cardiovascular system morphology trait
VT:0002127.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the heart or blood vessels.

VT:0002128.name: obsolete blood circulation trait
VT:0002128.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the flow of blood within the body.\nconsider: VT:0000153 or VT:0000182

VT:0002132.name: respiratory system morphology trait
VT:0002132.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the system responsible for the exchange of oxygen and carbon dioxide with the environment.

VT:0002133.name: respiratory system physiology trait
VT:0002133.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the system responsible for the exchange of oxygen and carbon dioxide with the environment.

VT:0002135.name: kidney morphology trait
VT:0002135.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the paired organs responsible for urine excretion and regulation of ion concentrations.

VT:0002136.name: kidney physiology trait
VT:0002136.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the paired organs responsible for urine excretion and regulation of ion concentrations.

VT:0002138.name: hepatobiliary system morphology trait
VT:0002138.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of any of the tissues of the liver, gall bladder, or bile ducts.

VT:0002139.name: hepatobiliary system physiology trait
VT:0002139.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the liver, gall bladder, or bile ducts.

VT:0002144.name: B cell development trait
VT:0002144.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to morphology or physiology during the formation or differentiation of mature B cells, lymphocytes of B lineage with the phenotype CD19-positive and capable of B cell-mediated immunity.

VT:0002145.name: T cell development trait
VT:0002145.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to morphology or physiology during the formation or differentiation of mature lymphocytes that are responsible for cell-mediated immunity and immune system regulation.

VT:0002151.name: neural tube morphology/development trait
VT:0002151.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, pattern, or morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the epithelial tube formed from the neuroectoderm of the early embryo by the closure of the neural groove; develops into the spinal cord and brain.

VT:0002152.name: brain morphology trait
VT:0002152.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the brain, one of the two components of the central nervous system and the center of thought and emotion; controls coordination, bodily activities and the interpretation of information from the senses (sight, hearing, smell, etc.).

VT:0002160.name: reproductive system morphology trait
VT:0002160.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the organs or tissues involved in the production of offspring.

VT:0002161.name: female fecundity trait
VT:0002161.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to a female's potential reproductive capacity.

VT:0002163.name: gland morphology trait
VT:0002163.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of an organized aggregation of cells functioning as a secretory or excretory organ.

VT:0002164.name: gland physiology trait
VT:0002164.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes in an organized aggregation of cells functioning as a secretory or excretory organ.

VT:0002174.name: gastrulation movement trait
VT:0002174.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the migration of embryonic cells during the development and invagination of the primary germ layers.

VT:0002176.name: brain mass
VT:0002176.def: The amount of matter in the brain, one of the two components of the central nervous system and the center of thought and emotion; controls coordination, bodily activities and the interpretation of information from the senses (sight, hearing, smell, etc.).

VT:0002177.name: outer ear morphology trait
VT:0002177.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of any of the components of the auricles or external acoustic meatus.

VT:0002181.name: brain cell morphology trait
VT:0002181.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any or all brain cell types.

VT:0002182.name: astrocyte morphology trait
VT:0002182.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the large neuroglia cells of nervous tissue.

VT:0002184.name: innervation trait
VT:0002184.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement, distribution or supply of the connection of nerve fibers to a target tissue or cell.

VT:0002187.name: fibula morphology trait
VT:0002187.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lateral and smaller bone of the lower/hind limb.

VT:0002191.name: artery morphology trait
VT:0002191.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the blood vessels that carry blood away from the heart.

VT:0002199.name: brain commissure morphology trait
VT:0002199.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the nerve fiber tracts that span the longitudinal fissure between the cerebral and/or cerebellar hemispheres of the brain.

VT:0002200.name: brain ventricle/choroid plexus morphology trait
VT:0002200.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cavities of the brain filled with cerebrospinal fluid, or the associated fringe of their tela choroidea.

VT:0002204.name: obsolete neurotransmitter amount
VT:0002204.def: OBSOLETE. The proportion, quantity, or volume of endogenous signaling molecules secreted by neurons that alter the behavior of neurons or effector cells.

VT:0002206.name: CNS synaptic transmission trait
VT:0002206.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the communication from a neuron to a target across a synapse in the central nervous system.

VT:0002207.name: long-term potentiation trait
VT:0002207.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the persistent robust synaptic response induced by synchronous stimulation of pre- and postsynaptic cells.

VT:0002208.name: germ cell morphology trait
VT:0002208.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the germ cell, that is, any of the reproductive (generative) cells of a multicellular organism, whether they are undifferentiated or fully differentiated.

VT:0002209.name: germ cell quantity
VT:0002209.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the proportion or numbers of any of the reproductive (generative) cells of a multicellular organism, whether they are undifferentiated or fully differentiated.

VT:0002210.name: sex determination trait
VT:0002210.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to primary or secondary sexual development or characteristics.

VT:0002211.name: primary sex determination trait
VT:0002211.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process that results in the initial specification of sexual status of an organism.

VT:0002212.name: secondary sex determination trait
VT:0002212.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the appearance and development of traits, other than the sex organs, that distinguish the sexes.

VT:0002216.name: seminiferous tubule morphology trait
VT:0002216.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the tubules in the testes where spermatogenesis occurs.

VT:0002221.name: immune system organ size trait
VT:0002221.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the organs associated with the body's defense against foreign organisms or substances and aberrant native cells.

VT:0002224.name: spleen size trait
VT:0002224.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the organ that functions to filter blood and to store red corpuscles and platelets.

VT:0002227.name: spleen capsule morphology trait
VT:0002227.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the connective tissue that surrounds the spleen.

VT:0002228.name: spleen trabecular vein morphology trait
VT:0002228.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of one of the veins that feeds the splenic vein.

VT:0002230.name: primitive streak development trait
VT:0002230.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the midline ridge of embryonic epiblast that later develops into mesoderm and endoderm.

VT:0002231.name: primitive streak morphology trait
VT:0002231.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the midline ridge of the embryonic epiblast that later develops into mesoderm and endoderm.

VT:0002233.name: nose morphology trait
VT:0002233.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the organ that is specialized for smell and is part of the respiratory system.

VT:0002234.name: pharynx morphology trait
VT:0002234.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the passage between the mouth and the posterior nares and the larynx and esophagus.

VT:0002235.name: external nares morphology trait
VT:0002235.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the anterior opening to the nasal cavity.

VT:0002236.name: internal nares morphology trait
VT:0002236.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the portion of the opening of the nasal cavity into the nasal pharynx.

VT:0002237.name: nasal cavity morphology trait
VT:0002237.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the portion of the respiratory tract that extends from the nares to the pharynx; the nasal cavity is lined with ciliated mucosa.

VT:0002238.name: nasal mucosa morphology trait
VT:0002238.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the mucous membrane that lines the nasal cavity.

VT:0002239.name: nasal septum morphology trait
VT:0002239.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the structure that separates the two nasal cavities.

VT:0002240.name: paranasal sinus morphology trait
VT:0002240.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the paired, air-filled cavities surrounded by the bones of the face that are lined by mucous membranes and are continuous with the nasal cavity.

VT:0002241.name: laryngeal mucosa goblet cell morphology trait
VT:0002241.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the epithelial cells lining the larynx, which produce mucins.

VT:0002242.name: olfactory mucosa morphology trait
VT:0002242.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the portion of the nasal mucosa that contains the olfactory sensory endings.

VT:0002243.name: vomeronasal organ morphology trait
VT:0002243.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the specialized portion of the nasal septum that is composed of chemosensitive cells and lies anteriorly in the nasal cavity.

VT:0002244.name: turbinated bone morphology trait
VT:0002244.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the small curved bones that extend horizontally along the lateral wall of the nasal passage.

VT:0002245.name: ethmoid sinus morphology trait
VT:0002245.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of these small spaces found within the ethmoid bone.

VT:0002246.name: frontal sinus morphology trait
VT:0002246.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of these paired air spaces within the frontal bone.

VT:0002248.name: sphenoid sinus morphology trait
VT:0002248.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the paired evaginations of the mucous membrane of the nasal cavity into the air space located within the sphenoid bone, and which opens to the upper posterior nasal cavity.

VT:0002249.name: larynx morphology trait
VT:0002249.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the most superior portion of the respiratory tract, between the pharynx and the trachea.

VT:0002250.name: hypopharynx morphology trait
VT:0002250.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the portion of the pharynx that lies below the upper edge of the epiglottis and opens into the larynx and the esophagus.

VT:0002251.name: nasopharynx morphology trait
VT:0002251.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the section of the pharynx that lies above the soft palate.

VT:0002252.name: oropharynx morphology trait
VT:0002252.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the portion of the pharynx that lies between the soft palate and the upper edge of the epiglottis.

VT:0002253.name: pharyngeal muscle morphology trait
VT:0002253.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the muscles of the pharynx, the inferior, middle, and superior constrictors, palatopharyngeus, salpingopharyngeus, and stylopharyngeus.

VT:0002255.name: glottis morphology trait
VT:0002255.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the vocal apparatus of the larynx, which includes the vocal cords and the opening between them.

VT:0002256.name: laryngeal cartilage morphology trait
VT:0002256.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cartilaginous structures that support the larynx.

VT:0002257.name: arytenoid cartilage morphology trait
