VT:0002257.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the paired triangular cartilages located postlaterally at the level of the thyroid cartilage.

VT:0002258.name: cricoid cartilage morphology trait
VT:0002258.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the most inferior of the laryngeal cartilages.

VT:0002259.name: epiglottis morphology trait
VT:0002259.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the most superior of the laryngeal cartilages, which is found at the root of the tongue and folds back over the entrance to the larynx during swallowing.

VT:0002260.name: thyroid cartilage morphology trait
VT:0002260.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the largest of the laryngeal cartilages.

VT:0002261.name: laryngeal mucosa morphology trait
VT:0002261.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the mucous lining of the larynx, which is composed of squamous epithelium in the upper larynx and ciliated columnar epithelium in the lower larynx.

VT:0002262.name: nasal mucosa goblet cell morphology trait
VT:0002262.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells lining the nasal epithelium that produce and secrete mucins.

VT:0002263.name: laryngeal muscle morphology trait
VT:0002263.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the muscles associated with the larynx.

VT:0002264.name: bronchus morphology trait
VT:0002264.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the upper conducting airways of the lung; these airways arise from the terminus of the trachea.

VT:0002265.name: left major bronchus morphology trait
VT:0002265.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the conducting airway leading to the left lobe of the lungs.

VT:0002266.name: right major bronchus morphology trait
VT:0002266.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the conducting airway leading to the right lobe of the lungs.

VT:0002267.name: bronchiole morphology trait
VT:0002267.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the conducting airway of the lungs found terminal to the bronchi; these structures contain neither cartilage nor mucous-secreting glands; the epithelium of the bronchioles becomes thinner with each branching.

VT:0002268.name: terminal bronchiole morphology trait
VT:0002268.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the last conducting structure of non-respiratory bronchioles; after this point, the airways have alveoli in their walls.

VT:0002270.name: respiratory alveolus morphology trait
VT:0002270.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the small sac-like dilations of the distal airspace of the lung; they are present along the walls of the alveolar sacs, alveolar ducts and terminal bronchioles; gas exchange of oxygen and carbon dioxide between alveolar air and blood in the pulmonary capillaries takes place across the cell walls.

VT:0002271.name: respiratory alveolar duct morphology trait
VT:0002271.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the respiratory conducting tubes distal to the respiratory bronchiole that lead to the alveolar sacs and the alveoli.

VT:0002272.name: nervous system electrophysiology trait
VT:0002272.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the functions of or processes in the nervous system as they relate to electrical phenomena.

VT:0002273.name: respiratory alveolar epithelial cell morphology trait
VT:0002273.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells lining the alveoli.

VT:0002274.name: type I pneumocyte morphology trait
VT:0002274.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the epithelial cells lining the alveoli through which gas exchange occurs; these are thin cells with a large surface area.

VT:0002275.name: type II pneumocyte morphology trait
VT:0002275.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the epithelial cells lining the alveoli that produce surfactant.

VT:0002276.name: lung interstitium morphology trait
VT:0002276.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the connective tissue located between the respiratory (airway and alveolar) epithelium, the capillary endothelium and pleural mesothelium.

VT:0002277.name: respiratory mucosa morphology trait
VT:0002277.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the mucous membrane lining the respiratory tract.

VT:0002278.name: respiratory muscle morphology trait
VT:0002278.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the muscles involved in breathing.

VT:0002279.name: diaphragm morphology trait
VT:0002279.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the thin musculomebranous barrier that separates the abdominal and thoracic cavities; often used for breathing control.

VT:0002280.name: intercostal muscle morphology trait
VT:0002280.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the respiratory muscles that arise from the lower border of one rib and insert into the upper border of the adjoining rib.

VT:0002281.name: respiratory mucosa goblet cell morphology trait
VT:0002281.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells of the respiratory epithelial lining that produce and secrete mucins.

VT:0002282.name: trachea morphology trait
VT:0002282.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the tube descending from the larynx and branching into the right and left main bronchi.

VT:0002284.name: tracheal smooth muscle morphology trait
VT:0002284.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the unstriated, involuntary muscle lining the tube descending from the larynx and branching into the right and left main bronchi.

VT:0002285.name: tracheal ciliated epithelium morphology trait
VT:0002285.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the epithelial lining of the trachea which contains numerous ciliated cells.

VT:0002292.name: gestation period duration
VT:0002292.def: The length of time between when a fertilized egg implants in the wall of the uterus and the birth of offspring.

VT:0002295.name: pulmonary blood flow trait
VT:0002295.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the circulation of blood through the lungs.

VT:0002314.name: respiratory mechanics trait
VT:0002314.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the action of the lungs, diaphragm, ribs and chest wall during respiration.

VT:0002322.name: respiratory transport trait
VT:0002322.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of gas exchange.

VT:0002324.name: blood-air barrier morphology trait
VT:0002324.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the membrane between the capillary blood and alveolar air, comprised of the alveolar epithelium and the capillary epithelium and their adherent basement membranes and epithelial cell cytoplasm.

VT:0002327.name: respiratory function trait
VT:0002327.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the processes involved in respiration.

VT:0002329.name: blood gas amount
VT:0002329.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of oxygen and carbon dioxide in whole blood, serum, or plasma.

VT:0002332.name: exercise endurance trait
VT:0002332.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to perform during controlled physical activity.

VT:0002336.name: pulmonary gas exchange trait
VT:0002336.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the exchange of oxygen and carbon dioxide between the alveolar air and pulmonary capillary blood.

VT:0002338.name: pulmonary ventilation trait
VT:0002338.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the total volume of gas per minute inspired or expired.

VT:0002339.name: lymph node morphology trait
VT:0002339.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the oval or bean shaped bodies located along the lymphatic system that consist of densely packed lymphocytes, lymph fluid and connective tissue; the sites where acquired immune responses are launched.

VT:0002340.name: axillary lymph node morphology trait
VT:0002340.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lymph nodes located around the axillary vein that receive lymphatic drainage from the upper or forelimb, scapular region and pectoral region.

VT:0002342.name: lymph node trabecula morphology trait
VT:0002342.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the membranous processes on the internal surface of the lymph node capsule, consisting of connective tissue and muscle fibers.

VT:0002343.name: lymph node cortex morphology trait
VT:0002343.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the outer area of the lymph node that has B and T cell domains.

VT:0002344.name: lymph node B cell domain morphology trait
VT:0002344.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lymph node cortex in which B lymphocytes reside.
synonyms: B cell dependent cortex morphology trait
nodular lymph node cortex morphology trait

VT:0002345.name: lymph node primary follicle morphology trait
VT:0002345.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the immunologically inactive B cell area of the lymph node cortex.

VT:0002346.name: lymph node secondary follicle morphology trait
VT:0002346.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the immunologically active area of the lymph node cortex.

VT:0002347.name: lymph node T cell domain morphology trait
VT:0002347.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the area of the lymph node in which T lymphocytes reside.
synonyms: T cell dependent paracortex morphology trait

VT:0002348.name: lymph node medulla morphology trait
VT:0002348.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the area of the lymph node through which lymph flows on its way to the efferent lymphatics; it contains macrophages and antibody-secreting plasma cells.

VT:0002349.name: afferent lymphatic vessel morphology trait
VT:0002349.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lymphatic tube entering the lymph node.

VT:0002350.name: efferent lymphatic vessel morphology trait
VT:0002350.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lymphatic tube exiting the lymph node.

VT:0002351.name: cervical lymph node morphology trait
VT:0002351.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lymph nodes found near the neck and shoulders.

VT:0002352.name: popliteal lymph node morphology trait
VT:0002352.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lymph nodes which drain the legs.

VT:0002353.name: inguinal lymph node morphology trait
VT:0002353.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lymph nodes located in the groin area.

VT:0002354.name: spleen trabecular artery morphology trait
VT:0002354.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of one of the branches of the splenic artery.

VT:0002356.name: spleen red pulp morphology trait
VT:0002356.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the parenchymatous tissue network of the spleen that consists of loose plates or cords (sinuses) infiltrated with red blood cells where most of the blood filtration occurs and degenerate erythrocytes are removed from the circulation.

VT:0002357.name: spleen white pulp morphology trait
VT:0002357.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the parenchymatous tissue of the spleen that surrounds splenic blood vessels, consists of compact masses of lymphatic cells and is where foreign material removed from the blood is used to initiate an immune reaction that results in the production of antibodies.

VT:0002358.name: spleen periarteriolar lymphoid sheath morphology trait
VT:0002358.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the area of the spleen within the marginal sinus in which T cells surround the central arteriole.
synonyms: splenic periarteriolar lymphoid sheath morphology trait
T cell domain of the splenic white pulp morphology trait

VT:0002359.name: spleen germinal center morphology trait
VT:0002359.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the area of the spleen secondary B follicle where rapid B-cell proliferation, somatic hypermutation, and selection for antigen binding occurs.

VT:0002360.name: spleen B cell corona morphology trait
VT:0002360.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the area of the spleen secondary B follicle that surrounds the germinal center and harbors the small recirculating B lymphocytes.
synonyms: B cell domain of the spleen morphology trait
splenic B cell corona morphology trait

VT:0002361.name: spleen central arteriole morphology trait
VT:0002361.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the blood vessel surrounded by the periarteriolar lymphoid sheath that connects the trabecular artery to the trabecular vein.

VT:0002362.name: spleen marginal zone morphology trait
VT:0002362.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the zone between the red and white pulp of the spleen containing numerous macrophages and lymphocytes, and a rich plexus of sinusoids supplied by white pulp arterioles carrying blood-borne antigens.

VT:0002363.name: spleen marginal sinus morphology trait
VT:0002363.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the border region surrounding the spleen B cell follicles and the periarteriolar lymphoid sheath (PALS) that separates it from the marginal zone that mediates lymphocyte entry into the white pulp from the blood.

VT:0002364.name: thymus size trait
VT:0002364.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the primary lymphoid organ that is required for the maturation of T cells.

VT:0002367.name: thymus lobule morphology trait
VT:0002367.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the basic structural unit of the thymus, the primary lymphoid organ that is required for maturation of T cells.

VT:0002368.name: thymus capsule morphology trait
VT:0002368.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the fibrous connective tissue surrounding the thymus.

VT:0002369.name: thymus subcapsular epithelium morphology trait
VT:0002369.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the epithelial cells lining the capsule and trabeculae of the thymus.

VT:0002370.name: thymus trabecula morphology trait
VT:0002370.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the thymic connective tissue which extends into the parenchyma.

VT:0002371.name: thymus cortex morphology trait
VT:0002371.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the outer part of a thymus lobule that surrounds the medulla and is composed of closely packed lymphocytes.

VT:0002375.name: thymus medulla morphology trait
VT:0002375.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the inner area of thymus lobules.

VT:0002376.name: dendritic cell physiology trait
VT:0002376.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the immunocompetent cells of the lymphoid and hemopoietic systems and skin, which function to process antigens and present them to T cells, thus stimulating cellular immunity.

VT:0002377.name: mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue morphology trait
VT:0002377.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the regional immune system associated with the mucosa.

VT:0002378.name: gut-associated lymphoid tissue morphology trait
VT:0002378.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the regional immune system located in the gut.

VT:0002379.name: oropharyngeal lymphoid tissue morphology trait
VT:0002379.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the circular lymphoid tissue formed by the lingual, pharyngeal, and facial tonsils.

VT:0002380.name: tonsil morphology trait
VT:0002380.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of either of the two small almond-shaped masses of lymph tissue found on either side of the oropharynx.

VT:0002384.name: nasopharyngeal tonsil morphology trait
VT:0002384.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lymph tissue in the roof and posterior wall of the nasopharynx.

VT:0002385.name: lingual tonsillar tissue morphology trait
VT:0002385.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lymph tissue on the floor of the oropharyngeal passage, near the root of the tongue.

VT:0002386.name: tubal tonsil morphology trait
VT:0002386.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lymph tissue associated with the pharyngeal opening of the auditory tube.

VT:0002388.name: Peyer's patch epithelium morphology trait
VT:0002388.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the specialized epithelium of the protruding lymphoid tissue located on the mucosa of the small intestine that is composed of densely packed B cell follicles.

VT:0002389.name: Peyer's patch follicle morphology trait
VT:0002389.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the area of the Peyer's patch normally occupied by B cells.

VT:0002391.name: Peyer's patch germinal center morphology trait
VT:0002391.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the area of the Peyer's patch where B cells proliferate and differentiate into plasma cells.

VT:0002393.name: bronchus-associated lymphoid tissue morphology trait
VT:0002393.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the regional immune system located near the bronchus.

VT:0002398.name: bone marrow cell morphology trait
VT:0002398.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells found in the bone marrow.

VT:0002399.name: pluripotent precursor cell morphology trait
VT:0002399.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells that give rise to most types of cells necessary for fetal development.

VT:0002400.name: multipotent stem cell morphology trait
VT:0002400.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the specialized cells that are committed to giving rise to cells with particular functions.

VT:0002401.name: lymphopoiesis trait
VT:0002401.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the formation of lymphocytes and plasma cells from lymphoid stem cells which develop from the pluripotent hematopoietic stem cells in the bone marrow; lymphoid stem cells differentiate into T-lymphocytes; B-lymphocytes; plasma cells; or NK cells (natural killer cells), depending on the organ or tissues to which they migrate.

VT:0002403.name: pre-B cell morphology trait
VT:0002403.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells in the B lymphocyte lineage that have undergone VDJ rearrangement of the immunoglobulin heavy chain and are in the process of V-J rearrangement of the light chain: these cells express mu heavy chain on the cell surface.

VT:0002407.name: double-negative T cell morphology trait
VT:0002407.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the subset of T cells found in the thymus that express neither CD4 nor CD8.
synonyms: double negative T cell morphology trait

VT:0002408.name: double-positive T cell morphology trait
VT:0002408.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the subset of T cells found in the thymus that express both CD4 and CD8.
synonyms: double positive T cell morphology trait

VT:0002414.name: myeloblast morphology trait
VT:0002414.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells found in the bone marrow that give rise to the granulocyte line of blood cells.

VT:0002415.name: neutrophil development trait
VT:0002415.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the granular leukocytes that have a three- to five-lobed nucleus and cytoplasm that contains inconspicuous granules stainable by neutral dyes.

VT:0002416.name: proerythroblast morphology trait
VT:0002416.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the immature, nucleated erythrocyte precursors that give rise to reticulocytes.

VT:0002419.name: innate immune response trait
VT:0002419.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity to change, adjust, or alter processes in the early phase of the response to infection; normally, it is present at all times, does not increase with exposure to specific pathogens, and does not discriminate between pathogens.

VT:0002422.name: basophil morphology trait
VT:0002422.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the granular leukocytes that are characterized by pale-staining, lobate nucleus and cytoplasm and contain dark-staining granules of varying size and are stained by basic dyes.

VT:0002423.name: mast cell physiology trait
VT:0002423.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the granulated cells found in most tissues and which contain large amounts of histamine and heparin in granules.

VT:0002424.name: reticulocyte morphology trait
VT:0002424.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the immature erythrocytes containing a basophilic cytoplasmic network.

VT:0002428.name: semicircular canal morphology trait
VT:0002428.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the organ of balance composed of three long bony tubes of the labyrinth.

VT:0002429.name: blood cell morphology trait
VT:0002429.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of any of the cells found in the blood.

VT:0002432.name: CD4-positive T cell morphology trait
VT:0002432.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the subset of T lymphocytes that carry the CD4 marker, recognize intravesicular peptides bound to MHC class-II molecules, and turn on antibody production.
synonyms: single positive T cell morphology trait

VT:0002433.name: T-helper 1 cell morphology trait
VT:0002433.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the type of T-helper cell whose cytokine production favors cellular immune responses and delayed type hypersensitivity.
synonyms: helper T cell type 1 morphology trait

VT:0002434.name: T-helper 2 cell morphology trait
VT:0002434.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the type of T-helper cell whose cytokine production promotes defense against extracellular parasites and humoral immune responses typical of allergy.
synonyms: helper T cell type 2 morphology trait

VT:0002435.name: effector T cell morphology trait
VT:0002435.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the set of T lymphocytes that are able to respond immediately upon contact with cells bearing the appropriate peptide:MHC complex for the cell.
synonyms: single positive T cell morphology trait

VT:0002436.name: CD8-positive, alpha-beta cytotoxic T cell morphology trait
VT:0002436.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell capable of killing target cells in an antigen specific manner.
synonyms: CD8-positive, alpha-beta cytotoxic T lymphocyte morphology trait
CD8-positive, alpha-beta cytotoxic T-cell morphology trait
CD8-positive, alpha-beta cytotoxic T-lymphocyte morphology trait

VT:0002439.name: plasma cell morphology trait
VT:0002439.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a terminally differentiated, post-mitotic, short-lived cell of the B cell lineage devoted to producing large amounts of immunoglobulin.

VT:0002440.name: memory B cell morphology trait
VT:0002440.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a distinctly differentiated long-lived B cell that is readily activated upon re-encounter of its antigenic determinant; memory B cells differentiate from antigen-activated B cells which have been selected for expression of higher affinity immunoglobulin.

VT:0002441.name: granulocyte morphology trait
VT:0002441.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of leukocytes that have abundant granules in the cytoplasm, including basophils, neutrophils, and eosinophils.

VT:0002442.name: leukocyte physiology trait
VT:0002442.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in any of the white blood cells (basophils, eosinophils, neutrophils, lymphocytes, dendritic cells, macrophages, mast cells, or monocytes).

VT:0002443.name: eosinophil development trait
VT:0002443.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the granular leukocytes having a two-lobed nucleus and cytoplasm containing coarse, round granules that are uniform in size and stainable by eosin.

VT:0002444.name: T cell physiology trait
VT:0002444.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in lymphocytes that are responsible for cell-mediated immunity and immune system regulation.

VT:0002445.name: mononuclear leukocyte differentiation trait
VT:0002445.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which relatively unspecialized cells acquire the specialized features of leukocytes with a single non-segmented nucleus in the mature form.

VT:0002446.name: macrophage morphology trait
VT:0002446.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the large mononuclear phagocytes which differentiate from monocytes, are typically resident in a particular tissue, and are capable of phagocytosing a variety of extracellular particulate material, including immune complexes, microorganisms, and dead cells.

VT:0002447.name: erythrocyte morphology trait
VT:0002447.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the fetal and adult cells in the blood that carry oxygen, red blood cells.

VT:0002450.name: immune system organ development trait
VT:0002450.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the organs associated with the body's defense against foreign organisms or substances and aberrant native cells.

VT:0002451.name: macrophage physiology trait
VT:0002451.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the large mononuclear phagocytes which differentiate from monocytes, are typically resident in a particular tissue, and capable of phagocytosing a variety of extracellular particulate material, including immune complexes, microorganisms, and dead cells.

VT:0002453.name: B cell antigen presentation trait
VT:0002453.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of B lymphocytes to process and/or present antigen.

VT:0002454.name: macrophage antigen presentation trait
VT:0002454.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of macrophage phagocytic cells to process and present antigen to T lymphocytes.

VT:0002455.name: dendritic cell antigen presentation trait
VT:0002455.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of dendritic cells to process and present antigen to T lymphocytes.

VT:0002456.name: Langerhans cell antigen presentation trait
VT:0002456.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of phagocytic cells of the epidermis to display antigen for recognition by T lymphocytes.

VT:0002458.name: B cell quantity
VT:0002458.def: The proportion or number of lymphocytes of B lineage with the phenotype CD19-positive and capable of B cell-mediated immunity.

VT:0002459.name: B cell physiology trait
VT:0002459.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in lymphocytes of B lineage with the phenotype CD19-positive and capable of B cell-mediated immunity.

VT:0002460.name: blood immunoglobulin amount
VT:0002460.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of members of a diverse group of plasma proteins, made up of polypeptide chains, that function as a primary mechanism for protection against disease.

VT:0002462.name: granulocyte physiology trait
VT:0002462.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in leukocytes that have abundant granules in the cytoplasm, including basophils, neutrophils, and eosinophils.

VT:0002463.name: neutrophil physiology trait
VT:0002463.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the immature or mature forms of a granular leukocyte that in its mature form has a nucleus with three to five lobes connected by slender threads of chromatin, and cytoplasm containing fine inconspicuous granules and stainable by neutral dyes.

VT:0002464.name: basophil physiology trait
VT:0002464.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the granular leukocytes that are characterized by pale-staining, lobate nucleus and cytoplasm and contain dark-staining granules of varying size and are stained by basic dyes.

VT:0002465.name: eosinophil physiology trait
VT:0002465.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the immature or mature forms of a granular leukocyte with a nucleus that usually has two lobes connected by one or more slender threads of chromatin, and cytoplasm containing coarse, round granules that are uniform in size and which can be stained by the dye eosin; involved in clearance of parasitic infections and in allergic reactions.

VT:0002467.name: neutrophil phagocytosis trait
VT:0002467.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of neutrophils (granular leukocytes that have a three- to five-lobed nucleus and cytoplasm that contains inconspicuous granules stainable by neutral dyes) to internalize particulate matter.

VT:0002471.name: complement physiology trait
VT:0002471.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes involved in the cascade of proteins that act together to attack extracellular pathogens.

VT:0002472.name: complement alternative pathway physiology trait
VT:0002472.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the plasma protein cascade triggered by direct contact with pathogen surfaces.

VT:0002473.name: complement classical pathway physiology trait
VT:0002473.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the plasma protein cascade triggered by antigen:antibody complexes.

VT:0002483.name: obsolete acute phase protein physiology trait
VT:0002483.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of the series of proteins found in the blood shortly after infection, which participate in the early phases of host defense against infection.

VT:0002484.name: obsolete C-reactive protein physiology trait
VT:0002484.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of this plasma protein that normally circulates in increased amounts during inflammation or after tissue damage.

VT:0002486.name: obsolete serum amyloid protein physiology trait
VT:0002486.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of an acute-phase reaction protein that is a precursor to amyloid A protein; it is present in very high levels during acute inflammatory episodes, and is present in low concentrations in normal sera, but is found at higher concentrations in sera of older persons and in patients with amyloidosis.
synonyms: Serum Amyloid A Protein physiology trait

VT:0002491.name: blood immunoglobulin D amount
VT:0002491.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of immunoglobulin present on the surface of B lymphocytes that acts as an antigen receptor.

VT:0002492.name: blood immunoglobulin E amount
VT:0002492.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of immunoglobulin that attaches to mast cells in the respiratory and intestinal tracts and plays a major role in allergic reactions.

VT:0002504.name: serotonin activity
VT:0002504.def: The degree of function or response of this biochemical messenger and regulator, found in the CNS, gastrointestinal tract, and produced by platelets; it normally mediates neurotransmission, gastrointestinal motility, hemostasis, and cardiovascular integrity.

VT:0002543.name: phalanx length
VT:0002543.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of any of the long bones of the digits.

VT:0002544.name: digit length
VT:0002544.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the fingers or toes, or their corresponding parts in other vertebrates.

VT:0002551.name: blood coagulation trait
VT:0002551.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the sequential process by which the multiple coagulation factors of the blood interact, ultimately resulting in the formation of an insoluble fibrin clot; it may be divided into three stages: stage 1, the formation of intrinsic and extrinsic prothrombin converting principle; stage 2, the formation of thrombin; stage 3, the formation of stable fibrin polymers.

VT:0002557.name: conspecific interaction trait
VT:0002557.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the behavior of animals towards other individuals of the same species.

VT:0002566.name: sexual interaction trait
VT:0002566.def: Any measurable or observable behavioral characteristic related to activities used to persuade or induce an individual to mate and activities involved in the physical act of mating.

VT:0002568.name: obsolete behavioral response to addictive substance trait
VT:0002568.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to a behavioral reaction to an addictive substance.

VT:0002572.name: emotion/affect behavior trait
VT:0002572.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to actions or reactions in tests for emotional-related behaviors.

VT:0002576.name: enamel morphology trait
VT:0002576.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the hard outer coating of the exposed portion of the tooth.

VT:0002579.name: secondary lens fiber morphology trait
VT:0002579.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the lens fibers which result from elongation and differentiation of epithelial cells throughout life; they are arranged around a core of primary lens fibers.

VT:0002581.name: ileum morphology trait
VT:0002581.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the portion of the small intestine that extends from the jejunum to the colon.

VT:0002582.name: extraembryonic tissue organization trait
VT:0002582.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of the membranes involved with the embryo's protection and nutrition.

VT:0002602.name: eosinophil quantity
VT:0002602.def: The proportion or number of the immature or mature form of a granular leukocyte with a nucleus that usually has two lobes connected by one or more slender threads of chromatin, and cytoplasm containing coarse, round granules that are uniform in size and which can be stained by the dye eosin.

VT:0002607.name: basophil quantity
VT:0002607.def: The proportion or number of granular leukocytes that are characterized by pale-staining, lobate nucleus and cytoplasm, contain dark-staining granules of varying size, and are stained by basic dyes.

VT:0002619.name: lymphocyte morphology trait
VT:0002619.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells involved in adaptive immune reactions of the body, including B cells, T cells and natural killer cells.

VT:0002620.name: monocyte morphology trait
VT:0002620.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the large, phagocytic mononuclear leukocytes produced in the vertebrate bone marrow and released into the blood.

VT:0002622.name: cochlear hair cell morphology trait
VT:0002622.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the sensory epithelial cells of the cochlea; these cells are in synaptic contact with the auditory nerve.

VT:0002623.name: vestibular hair cell morphology trait
VT:0002623.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the sensory epithelium of the maculae and cristae of the membranous labyrinth of the internal ear; afferent and efferent nerve fibers of the vestibular nerve end synaptically on them; from the apical end of each cell a bundle of stereocilia and a kinocilium extend into the statoconial membrane of the maculae and the cupula of the cristae.

VT:0002625.name: heart left ventricle cell size trait
VT:0002625.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the cells in the left lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0002630.name: endocochlear potential trait
VT:0002630.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the electrical potential difference between the endolymphatic and perilymphatic compartments of the cochlea.

VT:0002631.name: epididymis morphology trait
VT:0002631.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the elongated structure connected to the posterior surface of the testes that transports, stores, and matures spermatozoa between testes and vas deferens.

VT:0002634.name: sensorimotor gating trait
VT:0002634.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which inhibitory neural pathways filter multiple stimuli and allow attention to be focused on one stimulus; usually measured by pre-pulse inhibition (PPI).

VT:0002636.name: time of vaginal opening
VT:0002636.def: The timing of the opening of the genital canal in a female.

VT:0002637.name: uterus size trait
VT:0002637.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the hollow muscular organ where the embryo/fetus develops.

VT:0002641.name: erythrocyte shape trait
VT:0002641.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical form or contours of the cells in the blood that carry oxygen, red blood cells.

VT:0002644.name: blood triglyceride amount
VT:0002644.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of triacylglycerols (glycerol esterified at each of its three hydroxyl groups by a fatty acid).

VT:0002645.name: cholesterol absorption trait
VT:0002645.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the body to take in these most abundant steroids in animal tissues, and precursors to steroid hormones and bile salts; also components of plasma membranes.

VT:0002648.name: enamel delamination trait
VT:0002648.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the separation of the hard outer coating of the exposed portion of the tooth from the underlying hard tissue.

VT:0002649.name: enamel rod organization trait
VT:0002649.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of the structural units of tooth enamel.

VT:0002650.name: ameloblast development trait
VT:0002650.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the epithelial cells of the inner layer of the enamel organ of the developing tooth during their formation and differentiation.

VT:0002651.name: sciatic nerve morphology trait
VT:0002651.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the nerve which originates in the lumbar and sacral spinal cord and supplies motor and sensory innervation to the lower extremity.

VT:0002653.name: ependyma morphology trait
VT:0002653.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cellular membrane that lines the brain ventricles and the central canal of the spinal cord.

VT:0002655.name: keratinocyte morphology trait
VT:0002655.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells of the epidermis that produce keratin in the process of differentiating into the dead and fully keratinized cells of the stratum corneum.

VT:0002656.name: keratinocyte development trait
VT:0002656.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the cells of the epidermis that produce keratin in the process of differentiating into the dead and fully keratinized cells of the stratum corneum.

VT:0002658.name: liver regeneration trait
VT:0002658.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which the liver regenerates healthy tissue following tissue loss.

VT:0002660.name: caput epididymis morphology trait
VT:0002660.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the head of the epididymis.

VT:0002661.name: corpus epididymis morphology trait
VT:0002661.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the body of the epididymis.

VT:0002662.name: cauda epididymis morphology trait
VT:0002662.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the tail of the epididymis.

VT:0002663.name: blastocele development trait
VT:0002663.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the cavity in the blastula of the developing embryo.

VT:0002664.name: blood adrenocorticotropin amount
VT:0002664.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the pituitary hormone that stimulates the secretion of adrenal cortical steroids and induces growth of the adrenal cortex.

VT:0002668.name: blood potassium amount
VT:0002668.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this alkaline metallic element, the most abundant intracellular ion.

VT:0002669.name: scrotum morphology trait
VT:0002669.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the external sac of skin that encloses the testes.

VT:0002673.name: sperm quantity
VT:0002673.def: The proportion or number of spermatozoa.

VT:0002674.name: sperm motility trait
VT:0002674.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the mobility of the spermatozoa.

VT:0002679.name: corpus luteum morphology trait
VT:0002679.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the yellow endocrine body formed in the ovary after follicle rupture.

VT:0002680.name: corpus luteum quantity
VT:0002680.def: The proportion or number of yellow endocrine bodies formed in the ovary after follicle rupture.

VT:0002682.name: obsolete mature ovarian follicle quantity
VT:0002682.def: OBSOLETE. The proportion or number of fluid-filled, oocyte-containing ovarian structures at their last stage of growth (characterized by the formation of a cavity [antrum] filled with follicular fluid).

VT:0002683.name: onset of fertility
VT:0002683.def: The age at which an organism develops the ability to produce viable offspring.

VT:0002685.name: spermatogonia proliferation trait
VT:0002685.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which the spermatogonial stem cells undergo expansion by cell division.

VT:0002689.name: molar morphology trait
VT:0002689.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the most posterior teeth located on either side of the jaw, and characterized by a large crown and broad chewing surface.

VT:0002693.name: pancreas gland physiology trait
VT:0002693.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the organ that secretes pancreatic juice into the duodenum and secretes glucagon and insulin into the bloodstream.

VT:0002694.name: secretion by pancreas trait
VT:0002694.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of physiologically active substances from the pancreas.

VT:0002695.name: blood glucagon amount
VT:0002695.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a polypeptide hormone secreted by the pancreas that increases the blood glucose level by stimulating the liver to change stored glycogen to glucose; opposes the action of insulin.

VT:0002697.name: eye size trait
VT:0002697.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the organ of vision.

VT:0002698.name: sclera morphology trait
VT:0002698.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the fibrous, outer envelope of the eyeball, covering it entirely excepting the segment covered anteriorly by the cornea.

VT:0002699.name: vitreous body morphology trait
VT:0002699.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the transparent, semigelatinous substance that fills the cavity behind the crystalline lens of the eye and in front of the retina.

VT:0002700.name: vitreous body clarity
VT:0002700.def: The degree of transparency of the gel filling the inner portion of the eyeball between the lens and retina.

VT:0002703.name: kidney tubule morphology trait
VT:0002703.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the loops of Henle, proximal and distal convoluted tubules, and collecting ducts in the kidney.

VT:0002705.name: kidney tubule size trait
VT:0002705.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the loops of Henle, proximal and distal convoluted tubules, and collecting ducts in the kidney.

VT:0002706.name: kidney size trait
VT:0002706.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of one or both of the paired organs responsible for urine excretion and regulation of ion concentrations.

VT:0002707.name: kidney mass
VT:0002707.def: The amount of matter in one or both of the paired organs responsible for urine excretion and regulation of ion concentrations.

VT:0002713.name: glycogen catabolism trait
VT:0002713.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to break down glycogen; or rate of glycogen breakdown.

VT:0002716.name: preputial gland size trait
VT:0002716.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the modified sebaceous glands of the corona and neck of the glans penis.

VT:0002717.name: preputial gland morphology trait
VT:0002717.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the sebaceous glands of the corona and neck of the glans penis.

VT:0002718.name: inner cell mass morphology trait
VT:0002718.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the cells of the blastocyst of placental mammals that develop into the body of the embryo and some extraembryonic tissues.

VT:0002722.name: immune system organ morphology trait
VT:0002722.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the organs associated with the body's defense against foreign organisms or substances and aberrant native cells.

VT:0002723.name: obsolete immune serum protein activity trait
VT:0002723.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the degree of function or response of circulating immune proteins.

VT:0002725.name: vein morphology trait
VT:0002725.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the blood vessels that carry blood towards the heart.

VT:0002726.name: pulmonary vein morphology trait
VT:0002726.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the blood vessels that return oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium of the heart.

VT:0002729.name: inner ear canal morphology trait
VT:0002729.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the tubular ducts of the inner ear.

VT:0002731.name: colon size trait
VT:0002731.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the portion of the large intestine between the cecum and the rectum.

VT:0002733.name: thermal nociception trait
VT:0002733.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to sense pain elicited by thermal stimulation.

VT:0002734.name: mechanical nociception trait
VT:0002734.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to sense pain elicited by mechanical stimulation.

VT:0002735.name: chemical nociception trait
VT:0002735.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to sense pain elicited by chemical stimulation.

VT:0002739.name: olfactory bulb development trait
VT:0002739.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the olfactory bulb during its formation and differentiation.

VT:0002741.name: olfactory bulb size trait
VT:0002741.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the forebrain region that coordinates neuronal signaling involved in the perception of smell; it receives input from the sensory neurons and outputs to the olfactory cortex.

VT:0002742.name: submandibular lymph node size trait
VT:0002742.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the lymph nodes beneath the mandible that receive vessels from the face and tongue and drain into the superior deep cervical nodes.

VT:0002746.name: semilunar valve morphology trait
VT:0002746.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the valves that gate the flow of blood from the ventricles into the aorta and pulmonary trunk.

VT:0002751.name: autonomic nervous system morphology trait
VT:0002751.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the neuronal regulatory system for the viscera, the smooth muscles of the body and exocrine glands.

VT:0002752.name: somatic nervous system morphology trait
VT:0002752.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the part of the peripheral nervous system that is responsible for conveying voluntary motor and external sensory information, including all nerves controlling the skeletal muscular system and external sensory receptors.

VT:0002753.name: heart left ventricle size trait
VT:0002753.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the left lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0002754.name: heart right ventricle size trait
VT:0002754.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the right lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0002756.name: cerebral cortex pyramidal cell quantity
VT:0002756.def: The proportion or number of projection neurons in the pyramidal cell layer of the cerebral cortex.

VT:0002758.name: tail length
VT:0002758.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the appendage at the caudal end of the vertebral column.

VT:0002759.name: caudal vertebra morphology trait
VT:0002759.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the bony segments of the tail; in tailless vertebrates, these vertebrae may be united to form the coccyx.

VT:0002761.name: hippocampus mossy fiber morphology trait
VT:0002761.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the axons of neuronal cells in the dentate gyrus.

VT:0002769.name: vas deferens morphology trait
VT:0002769.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the secretory duct of the testicle that carries spermatozoa, running from the epididymis, of which it is the continuation, to the prostatic urethra, where it terminates to form the ejaculatory duct.

VT:0002773.name: blood luteinizing hormone amount
VT:0002773.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of LH, the hormone that regulates steroid production by the interstitial cells of the testis and the ovary.

VT:0002779.name: secretion by sex gland trait
VT:0002779.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of physiologically active substances from any of the organized aggregations of cells that function as secretory or excretory organs and are associated with reproduction.

VT:0002782.name: secretion by testes trait
VT:0002782.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of physiologically active substances from the male reproductive glands where sperm production occurs.

VT:0002783.name: secretion by ovary trait
VT:0002783.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of physiologically active substances from the female reproductive gland containing the germ cells.

VT:0002784.name: Sertoli cell morphology trait
VT:0002784.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells of the seminiferous tubules that create the blood-testes barrier and enable spermatogenesis.

VT:0002785.name: Leydig cell quantity
VT:0002785.def: The proportion or number of the testosterone-secreting cells in the interstitial area, between the seminiferous tubules, in the testis.

VT:0002786.name: Leydig cell morphology trait
VT:0002786.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the testosterone-secreting cells in the interstitial area, between the seminiferous tubules, in the testis.

VT:0002790.name: blood follicle stimulating hormone amount
VT:0002790.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the hormone that, in females, stimulates the Graafian follicles of the ovary and assists in follicular maturation and the secretion of estradiol; in the male it stimulates the epithelium of the seminiferous tubules and is partly responsible for spermatogenesis.
synonyms: serum levels of follicle stimulating hormone

VT:0002792.name: retina blood vessel morphology trait
VT:0002792.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the blood vessels supplying the retina.
synonyms: morphology trait of the retinal vasculature

VT:0002796.name: skin barrier function trait
VT:0002796.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the membranous protective covering of the body to provide a protective barrier, to prevent water loss, moderate water integration and prevent foreign substances and bacteria from entering the body.

VT:0002809.name: spinal cord size trait
VT:0002809.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the cylindrical tissue of the vertebral canal that extends from the medulla oblongata to the conus medullaris.

VT:0002817.name: tooth mineralization trait
VT:0002817.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which calcium salts are deposited into the dental enamel, dentin and cementum.

VT:0002818.name: dentin morphology trait
VT:0002818.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the hard portion of the tooth surrounding the pulp, covered by enamel on the crown and cementum on the root.

VT:0002819.name: pulp cavity morphology trait
VT:0002819.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the central hollow space of a tooth.

VT:0002820.name: premaxillary bone morphology trait
VT:0002820.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the anterior and inner portion of the maxilla.

VT:0002823.name: rib development trait
VT:0002823.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the bones forming the bony wall of the chest.

VT:0002824.name: chorioallantoic fusion trait
VT:0002824.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the formation of the membrane that forms the fetal portion of the placenta in most mammals; derived from the fusion of the chorion and the allantois.

VT:0002825.name: notochord morphology trait
VT:0002825.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the axial fibrocellular cord in embryos around which develops the vertebral primordia.

VT:0002827.name: kidney corpuscle morphology trait
VT:0002827.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a tuft of glomerular capillaries and the glomerular capsule (Bowman's capsule) that encloses it.

VT:0002828.name: glomerular capsule morphology trait
VT:0002828.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the expanded beginning of a nephron that encloses the glomerulus.

VT:0002829.name: juxtaglomerular apparatus morphology trait
VT:0002829.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the complex of modified smooth muscle cells consisting of juxtaglomerular cells, extraglomerular mesangium lacis cells, the macula densa of the distal convoluted tubule, and granular epithelial peripolar cells; these cells are found in the walls of afferent and efferent glomerular arterioles.

VT:0002835.name: cranial suture morphology trait
VT:0002835.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the fibrous joints between the bones of the head.

VT:0002836.name: chorion morphology trait
VT:0002836.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the outermost extraembryonic membrane.

VT:0002840.name: lens fiber morphology trait
VT:0002840.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the elongated cells of the crystalline lens of the eye.

VT:0002845.name: aorta mass
VT:0002845.def: The amount of matter in the main trunk of the systemic arteries.

VT:0002846.name: aorta capacity
VT:0002846.def: The volume of or amount contained in the main trunk of the systemic arteries.

VT:0002847.name: glomerular filtration trait
VT:0002847.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the filtration of water out of the plasma through glomerular capillary walls into the Bowman's capsule.

VT:0002851.name: blood sulfate amount
VT:0002851.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this salt or ester of sulfuric acid.

VT:0002855.name: cochlear ganglion morphology trait
VT:0002855.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the group of nerve cell bodies that conveys auditory sensation from the organ of Corti to the hindbrain and resides on the cochlear part of the vestibulocochlear nerve (eighth cranial nerve).
synonyms: morphology trait of the spiral ganglion of vestibulocochlear (VIII) nerve

VT:0002856.name: vestibular ganglion morphology trait
VT:0002856.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the group of neurons associated with the vestibular part of the eighth cranial nerve that are involved in equilibration.
synonyms: vestibular ganglion of the vestibulocochlear (VIII) nerve morphology trait

VT:0002858.name: posterior semicircular canal morphology trait
VT:0002858.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the posterior segment of the long bony tube of the labyrinth that is involved in the sense of balance.

VT:0002861.name: tail bud morphology trait
VT:0002861.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the primordial region of the embryo that arises to form the tail of the adult.

VT:0002864.name: ocular fundus morphology trait
VT:0002864.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the posterior concave interior of the eye, consisting of the retina, the choroid, the posterior segment of the sclera, the optic disk, and blood vessels.

VT:0002869.name: blood anti-insulin autoantibody amount
VT:0002869.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of antibodies to insulin.

VT:0002871.name: urine albumin amount
VT:0002871.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of this simple protein.

VT:0002876.name: thyroid gland physiology trait
VT:0002876.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the two-lobed endocrine gland found in all vertebrates, located in front of and on either side of the trachea in humans, that produces various hormones, such as triiodothyronine and calcitonin.

VT:0002878.name: corticospinal tract morphology trait
VT:0002878.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the fibers that arise from the cells within the cerebral cortex layer V, pass through the medullary pyramid, and descend into the gray matter of the spinal cord.

VT:0002882.name: neuron morphology trait
VT:0002882.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the functional cells of the nervous system that receive, conduct, and transmit impulses.

VT:0002884.name: branchial arch development trait
VT:0002884.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the transient structures of the embryo that develop into regions of the head and neck in higher vertebrates; in fish and amphibians, they support the gills.

VT:0002885.name: AMPA-mediated synaptic current trait
VT:0002885.def: The measured amplitude or duration of response to stimulation of AMPA receptors.

VT:0002886.name: glutamate receptor current trait
VT:0002886.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the measured amplitude or duration of response to stimulation of glutamanergic receptors.

VT:0002888.name: NMDA-mediated synaptic current trait
VT:0002888.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the measured amplitude or duration of response to stimulation of NMDA receptors.

VT:0002893.name: urine keto acid amount
VT:0002893.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of organic acids containing a ketone group and a carboxylic acid group.

VT:0002894.name: otolith morphology trait
VT:0002894.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the crystalline particles composed of calcium carbonate and a protein which adhere to the gelatinous membrane of the maculae of the utricle and saccule (otolithic membrane).

VT:0002895.name: otolithic membrane morphology trait
VT:0002895.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the gelatinous membrane which is supported by the stereocilia of the hair cells of the maculae of the saccule and utriculus of the inner ear; adhering to its surface are numerous calciferous crystalline particles called otoliths (statoconia).

VT:0002896.name: bone mineralization trait
VT:0002896.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which minerals (inorganic elements or compounds that have importance in body functions) are introduced into osseous tissue.

VT:0002899.name: stamina trait
VT:0002899.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the duration of activity (physical or mental) an individual can endure.

VT:0002900.name: urine phosphate amount
VT:0002900.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of this salt or ester of phosphoric acid.

VT:0002903.name: blood parathyroid hormone amount
VT:0002903.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this regulator of calcium and phosphorus concentration.

VT:0002907.name: parturition trait
VT:0002907.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of labor and delivery in female animals.

VT:0002909.name: adrenal gland physiology trait
VT:0002909.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the endocrine glands positioned in relation to the superior end of each kidney.

VT:0002910.name: excitatory postsynaptic current
VT:0002910.def: The size or duration of currents detected in postsynaptic cells when an excitatory impulse arrives at the synapse causing depolarization.

VT:0002911.name: inhibitory postsynaptic potential
VT:0002911.def: The membrane potential detected in postsynaptic cells when an inhibitory impulse arrives at the synapse causing hyperpolarization.

VT:0002912.name: excitatory postsynaptic potential
VT:0002912.def: The potential detected in postsynaptic cells when an excitatory impulse arrives at the synapse causing depolarization.

VT:0002913.name: PNS synaptic transmission trait
VT:0002913.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the communication from a neuron to a target across a synapse in the peripheral nervous system.

VT:0002914.name: endplate potential activity
VT:0002914.def: The degree of function or response of peripheral synapses to stimulation; these amplitudes are larger than central synapse potentials.

VT:0002915.name: synaptic depression trait
VT:0002915.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the duration of the reduction of effectiveness of synaptic connections between neurons and target after repetitive stimulation.

VT:0002918.name: paired-pulse facilitation trait
VT:0002918.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the response of central synapses when activated twice in rapid succession.

VT:0002921.name: post-tetanic potential
VT:0002921.def: The size or duration of potentials that persist after tetanic stimulation of central synapses.

VT:0002924.name: central nervous system synapse formation trait
VT:0002924.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of generating connections between an axon and effector tissue or neuron.

VT:0002928.name: bile duct morphology trait
VT:0002928.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the channels that secrete bile from the liver to the gall bladder and intestines.

VT:0002929.name: bile duct development trait
VT:0002929.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the channels that secrete bile from the liver to the gall bladder and intestines during their formation and differentiation.

VT:0002932.name: joint morphology trait
VT:0002932.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the articulation point of two or more rigid skeletal components (bones, cartilage, or parts of a single bone).

VT:0002937.name: synovial blood flow trait
VT:0002937.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to blood flow to the synovial joint.

VT:0002945.name: inhibitory postsynaptic current
VT:0002945.def: The size or duration of currents detected in postsynaptic cells when an inhibitory impulse arrives at the synapse causing hyperpolarization.

VT:0002946.name: time of axon outgrowth
VT:0002946.def: The time required for an axon to extend from a neuron cell body and find the target.

VT:0002948.name: neuron specification trait
VT:0002948.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the developmental patterning of neurons.

VT:0002949.name: neural crest cell development trait
VT:0002949.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the transient and migratory group of cells that emerge from the dorsal region of the neural tube and disperse to many peripheral locations, ultimately differentiating to form various tissues of the adult.

VT:0002950.name: neural crest cell migration trait
VT:0002950.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the directed and orderly movement from point to point of the transient and migratory group of cells that emerge from the dorsal region of the neural tube and migrate to many peripheral locations, ultimately differentiating to form various tissues of the adult.

VT:0002961.name: axon guidance trait
VT:0002961.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the signaling mechanisms that allow precise navigation and connections of axonal growth cones to effector tissues.

VT:0002970.name: white adipose morphology trait
VT:0002970.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the connective tissue consisting of fat-storing cells and arranged in lobular groups or along minor blood vessels.

VT:0002971.name: brown adipose morphology trait
VT:0002971.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the thermogenic form of adipose tissue that is composed of brown adipocytes.

VT:0002975.name: blood vessel smooth muscle size trait
VT:0002975.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the nonstriated, involuntary muscle tissue of the structures that convey blood throughout the body.

VT:0002982.name: germ cell migration trait
VT:0002982.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the directed and orderly movement of a germ cell, a cell specialized to produce haploid gametes, from point to point.

VT:0002983.name: retinal ganglion cell quantity
VT:0002983.def: The proportion or number of cells in the innermost nuclear layer of the retina, which projects axons through the optic nerve to the brain.

VT:0002985.name: urine calcium amount
VT:0002985.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of this metallic bivalent element with atomic symbol Ca and atomic number 20.

VT:0002987.name: urine solute amount
VT:0002987.def: The total proportion, quantity, or volume of substances dissolved in urine, total solute amount.

VT:0002990.name: ureter length
VT:0002990.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the tube that conducts the urine from the renal pelvis to the bladder.

VT:0002991.name: sebaceous gland physiology trait
VT:0002991.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes in any of the small, sacculated organs found within the dermis that normally secrete sebum.

VT:0002992.name: sebaceous lipid secretion trait
VT:0002992.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of lipids onto the hair and skin from the sebaceous glands.

VT:0002997.name: seminal gland size trait
VT:0002997.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the two folded, sac shaped glands that are diverticula of the ductus deferens.

VT:0002998.name: bone remodeling trait
VT:0002998.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of the turnover of bone matrix that involves a balance of resorption and formation by osteoclasts and osteoblasts, respectively.

VT:0003005.name: hippocampus fimbria morphology trait
VT:0003005.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the flattened band of efferent fibers arising from the subiculum and medial border of the hippocampus, which then thickens to form the fornix and fibers of the hippocampal commissure.

VT:0003006.name: hippocampus fornix morphology trait
VT:0003006.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the compact, white, heavily myelinated fiber bundle arising from the Ammon horn of the hippocampus in each cerebral hemisphere and projecting to the hypothalamus and the mammillary body.

VT:0003009.name: cytokine secretion trait
VT:0003009.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of any of the non-antibody proteins made by inflammatory leukocytes and some non-leukocytic cells that affect the behavior of other cells.

VT:0003011.name: dark adaptation trait
VT:0003011.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the time required for the eye to recover its sensitivity in the dark following exposure to bright lights.

VT:0003014.name: kidney medulla morphology trait
VT:0003014.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the inner portion of the kidney consisting of the renal pyramids.

VT:0003015.name: blood bicarbonate amount
VT:0003015.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of inorganic salts that contain the -HCO3 radical, which are an important factor in regulating the pH of the blood.

VT:0003018.name: blood chloride amount
VT:0003018.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of chlorine salts.

VT:0003027.name: blood pH regulation trait
VT:0003027.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of the buffer systems of the blood in combination with the respiratory and renal systems that control the relative acidity or alkalinity of the blood, as measured by the concentration of the hydrogen ion.

VT:0003044.name: basement membrane development trait
VT:0003044.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the extracellular supportive tissue closely adjacent to the basal surface of the epithelium of muscle cells, fat cells and Schwann cells, which is comprised of type IV collagen, laminin, and sulfated proteoglycans and other components.

VT:0003047.name: thoracic vertebra morphology trait
VT:0003047.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the bony segments of the vertebral column located anterior to the lumbar vertebrae and posterior to the cervical vertebrae; they articulate with the ribs.

VT:0003051.name: tail shape trait
VT:0003051.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical form or contours of the appendage at the caudal end of the vertebral column.

VT:0003055.name: epiphyseal plate morphology trait
