VT:0003055.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cartilaginous center of ossification on the long bones permitting growth of the bone in both directions during development.

VT:0003056.name: hyoid bone morphology trait
VT:0003056.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the U-shaped bone lying between the mandible and the larynx that supports the tongue muscles.

VT:0003057.name: epicardium morphology trait
VT:0003057.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the visceral layer of the pericardium that surrounds and attaches to all the surfaces of the heart.
synonyms: morphology trait of the visceral layer of serous pericardium

VT:0003065.name: liver copper amount
VT:0003065.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of copper present in liver tissue.

VT:0003069.name: superior semicircular canal morphology trait
VT:0003069.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the upper, superior segment of the long bony tube of the labyrinth that is involved in the sense of balance.

VT:0003072.name: metatarsus morphology trait
VT:0003072.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the bones of the lower/hindlimbs that articulate proximally with the tarsus and distally with the phalanges.

VT:0003073.name: metacarpus morphology trait
VT:0003073.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the bones of the forelimbs that articulate proximally with the carpal bones and distally with the phalanges.

VT:0003074.name: metacarpus quantity
VT:0003074.def: The proportion or number of bones of the forelimbs that articulate proximally with the carpal bones and distally with the phalanges.

VT:0003081.name: soleus morphology trait
VT:0003081.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the superficial flat broad muscle of the calf that is responsible for plantar flexion of the foot.

VT:0003082.name: gastrocnemius morphology trait
VT:0003082.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the two-headed large muscle of the posterior portion of the lower hindlimb, the most superficial of the calf muscles.

VT:0003083.name: tibialis anterior morphology trait
VT:0003083.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the muscle of the shin that is responsible for dorsiflexion and inversion of the foot.

VT:0003084.name: skeletal muscle fiber morphology trait
VT:0003084.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the skeletal muscle fibers, the large multinucleated cells that make up the striated muscles connected at either or both extremities with the bony framework of the body.

VT:0003085.name: egg cylinder morphology trait
VT:0003085.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the transient cup-like structure of the epiblast that consists of a single layer of embryonic cells.

VT:0003088.name: prepulse inhibition trait
VT:0003088.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of a relatively mild stimulus to suppress the response to a strong, startle-eliciting stimulus.

VT:0003090.name: muscle progenitor cell migration trait
VT:0003090.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the directed and orderly movement from point to point of cells that will develop into muscle cells.

VT:0003092.name: corneal stroma thickness
VT:0003092.def: The distance between the surfaces of the lamellated connective tissue layer of the cornea.

VT:0003093.name: anterior stroma morphology trait
VT:0003093.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the anterior segment of the lamellated connective tissue layer of the cornea.

VT:0003094.name: posterior stroma morphology trait
VT:0003094.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the posterior segment of the lamellated connective tissue layer of the cornea.

VT:0003095.name: corneal stroma development trait
VT:0003095.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the lamellated connective tissue layer of the cornea during its formation or differentiation.

VT:0003096.name: cornea light-scattering trait
VT:0003096.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the transmission of light through the cornea.

VT:0003099.name: retinal attachment trait
VT:0003099.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the connection of the retina from the underlying inner wall of the eye.

VT:0003102.name: sclera thickness
VT:0003102.def: The distance between the surfaces of the fibrous, outer envelope of the eyeball.

VT:0003104.name: skull size trait
VT:0003104.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the bones surrounding the brain and bones of the lower face and jaws.

VT:0003105.name: heart atrium morphology trait
VT:0003105.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the upper chamber(s) of the heart that receive blood from the vasculature and send blood into a ventricle.

VT:0003107.name: behavioral response to novelty trait
VT:0003107.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity of an organism to change, adjust, or alter its actions or reactions as a result of exposure to a new stimulus or situation.

VT:0003110.name: processus brevis morphology trait
VT:0003110.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the part of the malleus that contacts the upper part of the tympanic membrane where the tympanic cavity makes a deep pocket (epitympanic pocket) surrounding this cartilaginous nodule.
synonyms: lateral process of malleus morphology trait

VT:0003112.name: parathyroid gland size trait
VT:0003112.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the two small, paired endocrine glands, usually found embedded in the connective tissue capsule on the posterior surface of the thyroid gland; they secrete parathyroid hormone (PTH) that regulates calcium and phosphorus metabolism.

VT:0003114.name: parathyroid gland pigmentation trait
VT:0003114.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the deposition or aggregation of coloring matter in either of the two small, paired endocrine glands, usually found embedded in the connective tissue capsule on the posterior surface of the thyroid gland; they secrete parathyroid hormone (PTH) that regulates calcium and phosphorus metabolism.

VT:0003115.name: respiratory system development trait
VT:0003115.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the system responsible for the exchange of oxygen and carbon dioxide with the environment during its formation and differentiation.

VT:0003117.name: tracheal-esophageal septation trait
VT:0003117.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to separation of the trachea and esophagus during development.

VT:0003118.name: tracheal-bronchial branching morphogenesis trait
VT:0003118.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the repeated division of the trachea and bronchi during development of the lung.

VT:0003119.name: gastrointestinal system development trait
VT:0003119.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the system that converts ingested food to nutrients and energy.

VT:0003120.name: tracheal cartilage morphology trait
VT:0003120.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cartilaginous structures that support the tube descending from the larynx and branching into the right and left main bronchi.

VT:0003125.name: cloaca septation trait
VT:0003125.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the separation of the single opening of the digestive, urinary, and reproductive tracts (cloaca) into multiple isolated openings during development.

VT:0003126.name: vulva morphology trait
VT:0003126.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the external genitalia of the female.

VT:0003127.name: clitoris morphology trait
VT:0003127.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the small, erectile body located at the anterior end of the vulva.

VT:0003133.name: early pro-B cell quantity
VT:0003133.def: The proportion or number of cells in the B lymphocyte lineage that undergo D-J rearrangement of the immunoglobulin heavy chain.

VT:0003134.name: late pro-B cell quantity
VT:0003134.def: The proportion or number of the cells in the B lymphocyte lineage that undergo V-DJ rearrangement of the immunoglobulin heavy chain.

VT:0003135.name: reticulocyte quantity
VT:0003135.def: The proportion or number of the immature erythrocytes containing a basophilic cytoplasmic network.

VT:0003140.name: heart atrium size trait
VT:0003140.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the upper chamber(s) of the heart that receive blood from the vasculature and send blood into a ventricle.

VT:0003143.name: otolith size trait
VT:0003143.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the crystalline calciferous particles adhering to the otolithic membrane.

VT:0003144.name: otolith quantity
VT:0003144.def: The proportion or number of the crystalline calciferous particles adhering to the otolithic membrane.

VT:0003145.name: otolithic membrane attachment trait
VT:0003145.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the connection of the otolithic (otoconial) membrane to the underlying neuroepithelium.

VT:0003148.name: cochlear coil quantity
VT:0003148.def: The proportion or number of turns in the spiral-shaped bony canal in the inner ear containing the hair cells that transduce sound.

VT:0003149.name: tectorial membrane morphology trait
VT:0003149.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the overlaying membrane of cochlear duct, an extracellular matrix of the inner ear that contacts the stereocilia bundles of specialized sensory hair cells; sound induces movement of these hair cells relative to the tectorial membrane, deflects the stereocilia, and leads to fluctuations in hair cell membrane potential, transducing sound into electrical signals.

VT:0003150.name: tectorial membrane attachment trait
VT:0003150.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the connection of the overlaying membrane of the cochlear duct to the cochlear epithelium or spiral limbus.

VT:0003151.name: tunnel of Corti morphology trait
VT:0003151.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the triangular, fluid-filled space normally found between the inner and outer rows of supporting pillar cells in the organ of Corti.

VT:0003154.name: soft palate morphology trait
VT:0003154.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the musculomembranous fold that partly separates the mouth and pharynx, located behind the hard palate.

VT:0003156.name: leukocyte migration trait
VT:0003156.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the directed and orderly movement of white blood cells from point to point.

VT:0003159.name: esophageal smooth muscle morphology trait
VT:0003159.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the nonstriated, involuntary muscle tissue lining the portion of the alimentary canal between the pharynx and stomach.

VT:0003160.name: esophagus development trait
VT:0003160.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the part of the digestive canal through which food passes from the pharynx to the stomach during its formation and differentiation.

VT:0003162.name: lateral semicircular canal size trait
VT:0003162.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the lateral long bony tube of the labyrinth that is involved in the sense of balance.

VT:0003164.name: posterior semicircular canal size trait
VT:0003164.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the posterior segment of the long bony tube of the labyrinth that is involved in the sense of balance.

VT:0003166.name: superior semicircular canal size trait
VT:0003166.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the upper, superior segment of the long bony tube of the labyrinth that is involved in the sense of balance.

VT:0003167.name: scala tympani morphology trait
VT:0003167.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the division of the spiral canal of the cochlea lying on the basal side of the spiral lamina.

VT:0003168.name: scala vestibuli morphology trait
VT:0003168.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the division of the spiral canal of the cochlea lying on the apical side of the spiral lamina and vestibular membrane.

VT:0003169.name: scala media morphology trait
VT:0003169.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the division of the spiral canal of the cochlea that contains the organ of Corti (the neuroepithelial receptor organ for hearing).

VT:0003179.name: platelet quantity
VT:0003179.def: The proportion or number of the disc-like fragments of megakaryocytes that are found in the blood and function in clotting.

VT:0003180.name: pulmonary endothelial cell surface area
VT:0003180.def: The two-dimensional extent of the semi-permeable membrane that encloses the cytoplasm of a pulmonary endothelial cell.

VT:0003185.name: angiotensin I-converting enzyme activity
VT:0003185.def: The degree of function or response of the exopeptidase that catalyses the conversion of angiotensin I to angiotensin II, a potent vasoconstrictor, and is also involved in the inactivation of bradykinin.

VT:0003202.name: neuron apoptosis trait
VT:0003202.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which neurons undergo programmed cell death.

VT:0003208.name: neuromere morphology trait
VT:0003208.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the segments of the developing neural tube.

VT:0003209.name: pulmonary elastic fiber morphology trait
VT:0003209.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a slender connective tissue fiber in pulmonary tissue characterized by great elasticity.

VT:0003210.name: heart elastic fiber morphology trait
VT:0003210.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the slender connective tissue fiber in cardiac tissue characterized by great elasticity.

VT:0003211.name: aorta elastic tissue morphology trait
VT:0003211.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the slender connective tissue fiber in tissue of the main trunk of the systemic arteries which is characterized by great elasticity.

VT:0003228.name: sinus venosus morphology trait
VT:0003228.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the cavity at the caudal end of the embryonic cardiac tube in which the veins from the intra- and extraembryonic circulatory arcs unite; in the adult this becomes the portion of the right atrium known as the sinus of the vena cava.

VT:0003229.name: yolk sac vasculature morphology trait
VT:0003229.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the vessels of the highly vascular layer surrounding the yolk of an embryo; it contributes to hematopoietic circulation in mammals.

VT:0003231.name: placenta vascular morphology trait
VT:0003231.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the vessels of the organ of metabolic interchange between fetus and mother.

VT:0003232.name: forebrain development trait
VT:0003232.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the anterior primitive cerebral vesicle; this is the most rostral of three primary vesicles of the embryonic neural tube.

VT:0003235.name: alisphenoid morphology trait
VT:0003235.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of either of the broad curved wing-like expanses on each side of the sphenoid bone in adults; may exist independently in the young.

VT:0003236.name: lens capsule morphology trait
VT:0003236.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the elastic, clear, membrane-like structure, that is the outermost layer of the transparent structure of the eye responsible for focusing light rays.

VT:0003237.name: lens epithelium morphology trait
VT:0003237.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the one or more of the layers of epithelial cells in the transparent structure of the eye responsible for focusing light rays.

VT:0003240.name: hippocampus neuron quantity
VT:0003240.def: The proportion or number of neurons in the deep lying structure of the cerebrum involved with memory storage and spatial navigation.

VT:0003241.name: cerebral cortex neuron quantity
VT:0003241.def: The proportion or number of neurons in the cerebral cortex region of the brain.

VT:0003242.name: basal ganglion neuron quantity
VT:0003242.def: The proportion or number of neurons in the group of nuclei associated with the ability to carry out willed movements, including the caudate, putamen, nucleus accumbens, globus pallidus, substantia nigra, and subthalamic nucleus.

VT:0003243.name: dopaminergic neuron morphology trait
VT:0003243.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the neurons that utilize dopamine as a neurotransmitter.

VT:0003244.name: dopaminergic neuron quantity
VT:0003244.def: The proportion or number of neurons that utilize dopamine as a neurotransmitter.

VT:0003245.name: GABA neuron morphology trait
VT:0003245.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the neurons that utilize gamma-aminobutyric acid as a neurotransmitter.

VT:0003246.name: GABA neuron quantity
VT:0003246.def: The proportion or number of neurons that utilize gamma-aminobutyric acid as a neurotransmitter.

VT:0003247.name: glutaminergic neuron morphology trait
VT:0003247.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the neurons that utilize glutamate as a neurotransmitter.

VT:0003248.name: glutaminergic neuron quantity
VT:0003248.def: The proportion or number of neurons that utilize glutamate as a neurotransmitter.

VT:0003249.name: muscle fatty acid amount
VT:0003249.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of organic, monobasic acids derived from hydrocarbons in the contractile tissue that effects movement; they are saturated and unsaturated.

VT:0003252.name: bile duct physiology trait
VT:0003252.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the channels that secrete bile from the liver to the gall bladder and intestines.

VT:0003253.name: bile duct size trait
VT:0003253.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the bile ducts.

VT:0003257.name: abdominal wall morphology trait
VT:0003257.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the margins that enclose the abdominal cavity; the major part is muscular but also includes skin, subcutaneous fat, fascia and the parietal peritoneum.

VT:0003271.name: duodenum morphology trait
VT:0003271.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the first division of the small intestine that extends from the pyloris to the junction with the jejunum.

VT:0003283.name: digestive organ orientation trait
VT:0003283.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the location or arrangement of the alimentary tract organs in relation to each other or to the body.

VT:0003284.name: large intestine orientation trait
VT:0003284.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the location or arrangement of the large intestinal tract in relation to other organs or to the body.

VT:0003289.name: intestinal peristalsis trait
VT:0003289.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the intestinal movement characterized by waves of alternate circular contraction and relaxation of the muscular walls of the bowel that move bowel contents forward.

VT:0003308.name: cochlea sensory epithelium morphology trait
VT:0003308.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the epithelial cell layer containing the sensory hair cells and their associated sensory nerve terminals.

VT:0003309.name: modiolus morphology trait
VT:0003309.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the conic central core of spongy bone about which the spiral canal turns.

VT:0003310.name: modiolus size trait
VT:0003310.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the central conical bony pillar of the cochlea.

VT:0003311.name: urine amino acid amount
VT:0003311.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of the organic compounds, which, when polymerized, form proteins.

VT:0003315.name: perineum morphology trait
VT:0003315.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the area between the genital organs and the anus that lies beneath the pelvic diaphragm.

VT:0003328.name: portal blood pressure
VT:0003328.def: The arterial blood pressure in the hepatic portal system.

VT:0003330.name: auditory tube morphology trait
VT:0003330.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the tube connecting the tympanic cavity and the nasopharynx that allows equalization of pressure between the tympanic cavity and the environment.

VT:0003339.name: pancreatic beta cell quantity
VT:0003339.def: The proportion or number of the cells of the pancreas that secrete insulin.

VT:0003345.name: rib quantity
VT:0003345.def: The proportion or number of the elongated, curved bones forming the bony wall of the chest.

VT:0003346.name: pectoralis muscle morphology trait
VT:0003346.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the two muscles that make up the upper and fore part of the chest that adduct and rotate the forelimb and lift the ribs.

VT:0003349.name: blood renin amount
VT:0003349.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this enzyme which is secreted by the kidney; it cleaves a bond in angiotensionogen to generate angiotensin I.

VT:0003351.name: blood thyroid hormone amount
VT:0003351.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of hormones in the blood that are synthesized and secreted by the thyroid.

VT:0003356.name: luteinization trait
VT:0003356.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the transformation of the mature ovarian follicle and its theca interna into a corpus luteum after ovulation.

VT:0003357.name: granulosa cell differentiation trait
VT:0003357.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which a relatively unspecialized cell acquires the specialized features of a granulosa cell, a supporting cell for the developing female gamete in the ovary of mammals.

VT:0003358.name: hypaxial muscle morphology trait
VT:0003358.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the muscles derived from the lateral myotome and lateral portion of the dermomyotome; these include the thoracic intercostal and abdominal muscles, limb muscles and superficial back muscles, as well as the diaphragm and the tip of the tongue.

VT:0003359.name: hypaxial muscle cell quantity
VT:0003359.def: The proportion or number of cells in any of the muscles derived from the lateral myotome and lateral portion of the dermomyotome; these include the thoracic intercostal and abdominal muscles, limb muscles and superficial back muscles, as well as the diaphragm and the tip of the tongue.

VT:0003361.name: blood gonadotropin amount
VT:0003361.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the peptide hormones that stimulate gonadal functions such as gametogenesis and sex steroid hormone production in the ovary and the testis.

VT:0003366.name: blood glucocorticoid amount
VT:0003366.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the corticosteroids regulating carbohydrate metabolism and exhibiting anti-inflammatory activity.

VT:0003369.name: blood estrogen amount
VT:0003369.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of any substance that causes development of the female reproductive organs and secondary sexual characteristics.

VT:0003372.name: blood mineralcorticoid amount
VT:0003372.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of corticosteroids that influence water and electrolyte metabolism and balance.

VT:0003377.name: menarche initiation trait
VT:0003377.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the start of menstrual cycles.

VT:0003381.name: vitreal fibrous tissue morphology trait
VT:0003381.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the fibrous tissue in the vitreous body of the eye.

VT:0003383.name: gluconeogenesis trait
VT:0003383.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the formation of glucose from non-carbohydrates, such as proteins or fat.

VT:0003384.name: ventral body wall morphology trait
VT:0003384.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the anterior portion of a human body or the lower surface of an animal body comprised of ectoderm and mesoderm layers that encloses the body cavity.

VT:0003385.name: body wall morphology trait
VT:0003385.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the external portion of an animal body comprised of ectoderm and mesoderm layers that encloses the body cavity.

VT:0003396.name: embryonic hematopoiesis trait
VT:0003396.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the development of primarily large, nucleated erythroblasts as well as some megakaryocytes and primitive macrophages occurring in blood islands in the yolk sac, generally occurs from E7-E11 in the mouse and through 10 weeks in humans.

VT:0003398.name: skeletal muscle size trait
VT:0003398.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of one or more of the striated muscles connected at either or both extremities with the bony framework of the body.

VT:0003399.name: skeletal muscle fiber size trait
VT:0003399.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the skeletal muscle fibers, the large multinucleated cells that make up the striated muscles connected at either or both extremities with the bony framework of the body.

VT:0003401.name: tail bud size trait
VT:0003401.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the primordial region of the embryo that arises to form the tail of the adult.

VT:0003402.name: liver mass
VT:0003402.def: The amount of matter in the bile-secreting exocrine gland, which is important for detoxification; for fat, carbohydrate, and protein metabolism; and for glycogen storage.

VT:0003405.name: platelet shape trait
VT:0003405.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical form or contours of disc-like fragments of megakaryocytes that are found in the blood and function in clotting.

VT:0003407.name: central nervous system regeneration trait
VT:0003407.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of central nervous system tissue to regenerate following injury or disease.

VT:0003409.name: hypertrophic chondrocyte zone thickness
VT:0003409.def: The distance between the surfaces of the layer of the epiphyseal plate where no cell division occurs and chondrocytes begin to terminally differentiate.

VT:0003412.name: afterhyperpolarization trait
VT:0003412.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the currents that follow an action potential and influence firing frequency and neuronal integration.

VT:0003419.name: endochondral ossification initiation trait
VT:0003419.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the start of bone formation in bones that form from cartilage.

VT:0003420.name: intramembranous ossification initiation trait
VT:0003420.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the start of bone formation in bones that form without a cartilaginous intermediate, including the cranium and clavicle.

VT:0003421.name: thyroid gland development trait
VT:0003421.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the two-lobed endocrine gland found in all vertebrates, located in front of and on either side of the trachea in humans, that produces various hormones, such as triiodothyronine and calcitonin.

VT:0003424.name: neuronal precursor differentiation trait
VT:0003424.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which relatively unspecialized cells acquire the specialized features of neurons.

VT:0003425.name: optic vesicle development trait
VT:0003425.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the hollow outgrowth from the lateral aspects of the embryonic forebrain from which the retina and optic nerve develop.

VT:0003431.name: parathyroid gland physiology trait
VT:0003431.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the paired endocrine gland that normally produces parathyroid hormone (PTH) that regulates calcium and phosphorus metabolism.

VT:0003437.name: carotid body morphology trait
VT:0003437.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a small epithelioid structure consisting of a small cluster of chemoreceptive and supporting cells located near the bifurcation of the common carotid artery that serves as a chemoreceptive organ that senses the pH, carbon dioxide, and oxygen concentrations in the blood and plays a crucial role in their homeostatic control.

VT:0003442.name: blood glycerol amount
VT:0003442.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma this trihydroxy alcohol, the backbone of lipids, which is important for gluconeogenesis during starvation.

VT:0003444.name: neurotransmitter uptake trait
VT:0003444.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the reabsorption of endogenous signaling molecules released into a synaptic cleft; neurotransmitters are released from presynaptic neurons and travel across the synaptic cleft to either excite or inhibit the target cell.

VT:0003446.name: kidney cell quantity
VT:0003446.def: The proportion or number of cells in one or both of the paired organs responsible for urine excretion and regulation of ion concentrations.

VT:0003449.name: intestinal goblet cell morphology trait
VT:0003449.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the unicellular mucin-secreting glands of the intestine.

VT:0003450.name: pancreas size trait
VT:0003450.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the organ that secretes pancreatic juice into the duodenum and secretes glucagon and insulin into the bloodstream.

VT:0003452.name: parotid gland morphology trait
VT:0003452.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of either of the largest of the major salivary glands situated below and in front of each ear and opening into the parotid duct.

VT:0003456.name: tail size trait
VT:0003456.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the appendage at the caudal end of the vertebral column.

VT:0003457.name: blood ketone body amount
VT:0003457.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of acetoacetate, 3-hydroxybutyrate and acetone; produced by fatty acid and carbohydrate metabolism and seen in conditions such as starvation and diabetes mellitus.

VT:0003463.name: single cell response trait
VT:0003463.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the response from a specific stimulus obtained upon extra- or intracellular recordings from single cells.

VT:0003464.name: single cell response threshold
VT:0003464.def: The point at which a stimulus first elicits a recordable response recorded in a single cell.

VT:0003467.name: single cell response intensity
VT:0003467.def: The degree of de- or hyperpolarization or number of action potentials in response to a specific stimulus recorded in a single cell.

VT:0003470.name: summary potential trait
VT:0003470.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the electrophysiological recording of the activity of several cells.

VT:0003471.name: summary potential threshold
VT:0003471.def: The point at which a stimulus first elicits a recordable response recorded in several cells or a tissue slice.

VT:0003474.name: summary potential intensity
VT:0003474.def: The degree of de- or hyperpolarization or number of action potentials in response to a specific stimulus recorded in several cells or a tissue slice.

VT:0003477.name: nerve fiber response trait
VT:0003477.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity to change, adjust, or alter the electrophysiological recordings from the elongated processes of neurons over time or as a result of internal or external influences.

VT:0003478.name: nerve fiber response threshold
VT:0003478.def: The point at which a stimulus first elicits a recordable response recorded in a single or several nerve fiber(s).

VT:0003479.name: nerve fiber response intensity
VT:0003479.def: The degree of de- or hyperpolarization or number of action potentials in response to a specific stimulus recorded in a single or several nerve fiber(s).

VT:0003484.name: channel response trait
VT:0003484.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity to change, adjust, or alter the electrophysiological recordings from ion channels over time or as a result of internal or external influences.

VT:0003485.name: channel response threshold
VT:0003485.def: The point at which a stimulus first elicits a recordable response recorded from ion channels.

VT:0003486.name: channel response intensity
VT:0003486.def: The degree of de- or hyperpolarization or number of action potentials in response to a specific stimulus recorded from ion channels.

VT:0003491.name: voluntary movement trait
VT:0003491.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to coordinated movements executed with a purpose that can be improved by learning and/or experience.

VT:0003492.name: involuntary movement trait
VT:0003492.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to movements that occur independent of planning (e.g. reflexive behavior).

VT:0003498.name: thyroid gland cell quantity
VT:0003498.def: The proportion or number of cells in the two-lobed endocrine gland found in all vertebrates, located in front of and on either side of the trachea in humans, that produces various hormones, such as triiodothyronine and calcitonin.

VT:0003501.name: iodide oxidation trait
VT:0003501.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to thyroid function in oxidation and organification of iodide.

VT:0003506.name: growth hormone secretion trait
VT:0003506.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of growth hormone.

VT:0003507.name: ovary physiology trait
VT:0003507.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the female reproductive gland containing the germ cells.

VT:0003508.name: blood dihydrotestosterone amount
VT:0003508.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this potent androgenic metabolite of testosterone.

VT:0003511.name: labium morphology trait
VT:0003511.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the folds of skin which form the inner lips (labia minora) and outer lips (labia majora) on both sides of the vaginal opening.

VT:0003512.name: labia size trait
VT:0003512.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the folds of skin which form the inner lips (labia minora) and outer lips (labia majora) on both sides of the vaginal opening.

VT:0003514.name: interlabial sulcus morphology trait
VT:0003514.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of grooves or furrows in the folds of skin between the labia on both sides of the vaginal opening.

VT:0003515.name: labia majora morphology trait
VT:0003515.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the folds of skin which form the outer lips (labia majora) on both sides of the vaginal opening.

VT:0003517.name: labia majora size trait
VT:0003517.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the folds of skin which form the outer lips (labia majora) on both sides of the vaginal opening.

VT:0003519.name: labia majora shape trait
VT:0003519.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical form or contours of the folds of skin which form the outer lips (labia majora) on both sides of the vaginal opening.

VT:0003520.name: labia minora morphology trait
VT:0003520.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the folds of skin which form the inner lips (labia minora) on both sides of the vaginal opening.

VT:0003522.name: labia minora size trait
VT:0003522.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the folds of skin which form the inner lips (labia minora) on both sides of the vaginal opening.

VT:0003524.name: labia minora shape trait
VT:0003524.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical form or contours of the folds of skin which form the inner lips (labia minora) on both sides of the vaginal opening.

VT:0003528.name: vulva size trait
VT:0003528.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the external genitalia of the female.

VT:0003529.name: clitoris size trait
VT:0003529.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the small, erectile body located at the anterior end of the vulva.

VT:0003531.name: vagina development trait
VT:0003531.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the female reproductive canal located between the uterus and the vulva during its formation and differentiation.

VT:0003538.name: hymen development trait
VT:0003538.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation or differentiation of the thin membrane which may partially occlude the opening of the vagina; often absent in normal females.

VT:0003553.name: foreskin morphology trait
VT:0003553.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the loose fold of skin that covers the penis.

VT:0003562.name: pancreatic beta cell physiology trait
VT:0003562.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the insulin-producing cells of the islets of Langerhans in the pancreas.

VT:0003563.name: pancreatic alpha cell physiology trait
VT:0003563.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the glucagon-producing cells of the islets of Langerhans in the pancreas.

VT:0003564.name: insulin secretion trait
VT:0003564.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of this hormone secreted by beta cells of the pancreas, which promotes glucose utilization, protein synthesis, and the formation and storage of neutral lipids.

VT:0003565.name: glucagon secretion trait
VT:0003565.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of this hormone secreted by the alpha cells of the islets of Langerhans; it normally plays a role in regulation of blood glucose concentration, ketone metabolism, and other biochemical and physiological processes.

VT:0003568.name: uterine lumen morphology trait
VT:0003568.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the opening or lumen of the uterus.

VT:0003572.name: uterus development trait
VT:0003572.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the hollow muscular organ where the embryo/fetus develops.

VT:0003574.name: oviduct morphology trait
VT:0003574.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the tube through which the ova pass from the ovary to the uterus (mammals) or to the outside (fish, birds).

VT:0003576.name: oviduct size trait
VT:0003576.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the tube through which the ova pass from the ovary to the uterus (mammals) or to the outside (fish, birds).

VT:0003582.name: ovary development trait
VT:0003582.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the female reproductive gland containing the germ cells during its formation and differentiation.

VT:0003585.name: ureter size trait
VT:0003585.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the tube that conducts the urine from the renal pelvis to the bladder.

VT:0003588.name: ureter width
VT:0003588.def: The distance from side to side of the tube that conducts the urine from the renal pelvis to the bladder.

VT:0003589.name: ureter physiology trait
VT:0003589.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the tube that conducts the urine from the renal pelvis to the urinary bladder.

VT:0003592.name: urethra width
VT:0003592.def: The distance from side to side of the canal that leads from the bladder and discharges urine externally.

VT:0003594.name: urethra size trait
VT:0003594.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the canal that leads from the bladder and discharges urine externally.

VT:0003599.name: penis size trait
VT:0003599.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the organ of copulation and urination in the male.

VT:0003606.name: nephron physiology trait
VT:0003606.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the filtering unit of the kidney that includes the renal corpuscle, proximal and distal convoluted tubules, loop of Henle, and the collecting tubule.

VT:0003607.name: prostate physiology trait
VT:0003607.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the gland surrounding the beginning of the urethra in males that secretes part of the seminal fluid.

VT:0003610.name: scrotum cell quantity
VT:0003610.def: The proportion or number of cells in the external sac of skin that encloses the testes.

VT:0003613.name: kidney medulla development trait
VT:0003613.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the inner portion of the kidney during its formation and differentiation.

VT:0003617.name: urinary bladder cell quantity
VT:0003617.def: The proportion or number of cells in the inflatable musculomembranous bag for holding urine.

VT:0003618.name: cervical opening size trait
VT:0003618.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the cervical opening.

VT:0003619.name: urine color
VT:0003619.def: The visually perceived hue of the fluid and dissolved substances excreted by the kidneys.

VT:0003626.name: kidney medulla cell quantity
VT:0003626.def: The proportion or number of cells in the inner portion of the kidney consisting of the renal pyramids.

VT:0003627.name: leukocyte tethering or rolling trait
VT:0003627.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the transient adhesive interactions between leukocytes and endothelial cells lining blood vessels mediated primarily by selectins and which are typically the first step in cellular extravasation.

VT:0003628.name: leukocyte adhesion trait
VT:0003628.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which leukocytes adhere to the luminal aspects of high endothelial venules prior to transmigration out of the vessel.

VT:0003630.name: urothelium morphology trait
VT:0003630.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the epithelial lining in organs of the urinary tract.

VT:0003632.name: nervous system morphology trait
VT:0003632.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the components of the system responsible for receiving and processing information about an organism's environment and controlling behavior.

VT:0003633.name: nervous system physiology trait
VT:0003633.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the components of the system responsible for receiving and processing information about an organism's environment and controlling behavior.

VT:0003634.name: glial cell morphology trait
VT:0003634.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the non-neuronal cells of the nervous system that form the myelin insulation of nervous pathways, guide neuronal migration during development, and exchange metabolites with neurons.

VT:0003635.name: synaptic transmission trait
VT:0003635.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the communication from a neuron to a target across a synapse.

VT:0003637.name: cochlear ganglion cell quantity
VT:0003637.def: The proportion or number of the group of nerve cell bodies that convey auditory sensation from the organ of Corti to the hindbrain and reside on the cochlear part of the vestibulocochlear nerve (eighth cranial nerve).

VT:0003641.name: lung size trait
VT:0003641.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of either or both of the spongy organs of respiration contained within the pleural cavity of the thorax.

VT:0003646.name: muscle fatigue trait
VT:0003646.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of muscle exhaustion following contraction.

VT:0003647.name: oligodendrocyte quantity
VT:0003647.def: The proportion or number of the neuroglia of the central nervous system that form the insulating myelin sheath of axons.

VT:0003648.name: radial glial cell morphology trait
VT:0003648.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the supporting cells of the developing central nervous system that guide neuronal migration during development and exchange metabolites with developing and migrating neurons; these cells differentiate into astrocytes and some neuronal types in the adult.

VT:0003650.name: kidney shape trait
VT:0003650.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical form or contours of the paired organs responsible for urine excretion and regulation of ion concentrations.

VT:0003651.name: axon outgrowth trait
VT:0003651.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of an axon to extend from a neuron cell body.

VT:0003652.name: skin elasticity trait
VT:0003652.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the membranous protective covering of the body to recover size and shape after deformation in any way.

VT:0003656.name: erythrocyte physiology trait
VT:0003656.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the cells in the blood that carry oxygen, red blood cells.

VT:0003661.name: locus ceruleus morphology trait
VT:0003661.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the dense cluster of neurons within the dorsorostral pons; it is the major location of neurons that release norepinephrine throughout the brain, and is responsible for physiological responses to stress and panic.

VT:0003662.name: epiphyseal plate proliferative zone morphology trait
VT:0003662.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the germinal layer of the epiphyseal plate where cells are actively dividing as well as producing extracellular matrix.
synonyms: epiphysial plate proliferative zone morphology trait
zone of proliferating cartilage morphology trait

VT:0003663.name: behavioral response to thermal stimulus trait
VT:0003663.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity of an organism to change, adjust, or alter its actions or reactions as a result of a detectable change or difference in temperature.

VT:0003666.name: sperm capacitation trait
VT:0003666.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the change undergone by spermatozoa in the female genital tract that enables them to penetrate and fertilize an egg.

VT:0003668.name: periodontal ligament morphology trait
VT:0003668.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the fibrous connective tissue that surrounds the root of a tooth, separating it from and attaching it to the alveolar bone; normally extends from the base of the gingival mucosa to the fundus of the bony socket, and its main function is to hold the tooth in its socket.

VT:0003670.name: glomerular capsule size trait
VT:0003670.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the expanded beginning of a nephron that encloses the glomerulus.

VT:0003671.name: eyelid aperture
VT:0003671.def: The distance from the upper eyelid to the lower eyelid.

VT:0003672.name: ureter development trait
VT:0003672.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the tube that conducts the urine from the renal pelvis to the bladder.

VT:0003673.name: inguinal canal morphology trait
VT:0003673.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the passage in the lower abdominal wall through which the spermatic cord in the male or the round ligament in the female, nerves and vessels pass from the pelvic cavity to the scrotum or labia majora, respectively.

VT:0003677.name: ear lobe morphology trait
VT:0003677.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the soft tissue at the base of the outer ear; consists of fat and fibrous tissue not reinforced by the auricular cartilage.

VT:0003679.name: ear lobe size trait
VT:0003679.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the soft tissue at the base of the outer ear; consists of fat and fibrous tissue not reinforced by the auricular cartilage.

VT:0003684.name: inferior olivary complex morphology trait
VT:0003684.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the capsule-shaped structure in the ventral medulla located just lateral and dorsal to the medullary pyramids; neurons in the inferior olivary nucleus are the source of climbing fiber input to the cerebellar cortex and have been implicated in various functions, such as learning and timing of movements.

VT:0003685.name: cardiac ganglion morphology trait
VT:0003685.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the parasympathetic ganglia of the cardiac plexus between the arch of the aorta and the bifurcation of the pulmonary artery.

VT:0003686.name: eye muscle morphology trait
VT:0003686.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the muscles of the organ of vision.

VT:0003687.name: intraocular muscle morphology trait
VT:0003687.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of any of the unstriated, involuntary muscles within the eyeball.

VT:0003690.name: glia physiology trait
VT:0003690.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the non-neuronal cells of the nervous system, which are interposed between neurons and the blood vessels supplying the nervous system.

VT:0003691.name: microglial cell physiology trait
VT:0003691.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the small, migratory, phagocytic, interstitial cells derived from myeloid progenitor cells and found in the parenchyma of the central nervous system; microglia are scavengers, engulfing dead cells and other debris, and in Alzheimer's disease, microglia are found associated with dying nerve cells and amyloid plaques.

VT:0003693.name: embryo hatching trait
VT:0003693.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the mammalian embryo to break out of the zona pellucida, the thick, solid, transparent outer membrane that surrounds the developing ovum and embryo prior to implantation.

VT:0003696.name: zona pellucida morphology trait
VT:0003696.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the thick solid transparent outer membrane that surrounds the developing ovum and embryo prior to implantation.

VT:0003698.name: male reproductive system physiology trait
VT:0003698.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the functions of or processes in the male organs associated with producing offspring.

VT:0003699.name: female reproductive system physiology trait
VT:0003699.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the female organs associated with producing offspring.

VT:0003701.name: sister chromatid exchange trait
VT:0003701.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to crossovers between sister chromatids during meiosis.

VT:0003703.name: vestibulocochlear ganglion morphology trait
VT:0003703.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the group of neuron cell bodies associated with the eighth cranial nerve during embryogenesis; splits in later development to form the cochlear and vestibular ganglia.

VT:0003704.name: hair follicle development trait
VT:0003704.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation or differentiation of the tubular invaginations of the epidermis from which the hair shaft develops.

VT:0003705.name: hypodermis morphology trait
VT:0003705.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the irregular layer of adipose and connective tissue, stroma, or membrane immediately deep to the skin and superficial to the deep fascia; usually consists primarily of either just loose connective tissue, or a fatty layer that may also include a muscle layer, and/or a fibrous layer; may also occur as a membranous layer only, being nearly devoid of fat.

VT:0003713.name: obsolete ear rotation trait
VT:0003713.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the orientation of the outer ears in relation to the anterior-posterior body axis, does not refer to the point of emergence on the head.\nconsider: VT:0010274

VT:0003720.name: neural tube closure trait
VT:0003720.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the invagination and fusion of the neuroepithelial layer in early development.

VT:0003722.name: ureter quantity
VT:0003722.def: The proportion or number of tubes that conduct the urine from the renal pelvis to the bladder.

VT:0003723.name: long bone morphology trait
VT:0003723.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the elongated bones of the extremities, consisting of a tubular shaft (diaphysis) and two extremities (epiphyses).

VT:0003725.name: blood autoantibody amount
VT:0003725.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of antibodies to self-antigens.

VT:0003727.name: retinal layer morphology trait
VT:0003727.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of any of the layers that make up the thin layer of neural tissue lining the back of the eyeball which contains visual receptors.

VT:0003728.name: retinal photoreceptor layer morphology trait
VT:0003728.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the layer of light-sensitive receptors in the eye.

VT:0003729.name: photoreceptor outer segment morphology trait
VT:0003729.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the photoreceptor layer which contains stacks of membranous discs that are rich in the visual pigment rhodopsin.

VT:0003730.name: photoreceptor inner segment morphology trait
VT:0003730.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the photoreceptor layer which contains the machinery of the cell (mitochondria, golgi, endoplasmic reticulum, etc).

VT:0003731.name: retinal outer nuclear layer morphology trait
VT:0003731.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the retinal layer that contains the nuclei and cell bodies of rods and cones.

VT:0003732.name: retinal outer plexiform layer morphology trait
VT:0003732.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the retinal layer that is the site of synapses between the rods and cones (axons) and the horizontal and bipolar cells (dendrites).

VT:0003733.name: retinal inner nuclear layer morphology trait
VT:0003733.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the retinal layer which contains the cell bodies of bipolar, horizontal, and amacrine cells.

VT:0003734.name: retinal inner plexiform layer morphology trait
VT:0003734.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the retinal cell layer where bipolar and amacrine cell axons synapse with ganglion cell dendrites.

VT:0003737.name: outer ear cartilage morphology trait
VT:0003737.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the nonvascular, resilient, flexible connective tissue of the external portion of the organ of hearing.

VT:0003739.name: auditory ossicle size trait
VT:0003739.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of any of the small bones of the middle ear.

VT:0003743.name: facial morphology trait
VT:0003743.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the region of the body that includes the front part of the head from the chin to the top of the forehead, where the mouth, eyes, nose, and other features are located.

VT:0003744.name: orofacial morphology trait
VT:0003744.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the oral cavities of the face.

VT:0003745.name: mouth mucosa morphology trait
VT:0003745.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the mucus-secreting tissue that lines the oral cavity.

VT:0003749.name: mouth shape trait
VT:0003749.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical form or contours of the oral cavity.

VT:0003755.name: palate morphology trait
VT:0003755.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the roof of the mouth in vertebrates formed anteriorly by a bony projection of the upper jaw (hard palate) and posteriorly by the fold of connective tissue (soft palate).

VT:0003756.name: hard palate morphology trait
VT:0003756.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the anterior part of the palate that is supported by and includes the palatal extensions of the maxillary and palatine bones.

VT:0003759.name: palate width
VT:0003759.def: The distance from side to side of the roof of the oral cavity.

VT:0003760.name: palate length
VT:0003760.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the roof of the oral cavity.

VT:0003762.name: immune system organ physiology trait
VT:0003762.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the organs associated with the body's defense against foreign organisms or substances and aberrant native cells.

VT:0003763.name: thymus physiology trait
VT:0003763.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the primary lymphoid organ that is required for maturation of T cells.

VT:0003764.name: palate depth
VT:0003764.def: The average distance of the deepest point in the midline of the palate relative to the midline point on the anterior crest of the alveolar gum pad ridge.

VT:0003769.name: lip morphology trait
VT:0003769.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the fleshy margins of the mouth.

VT:0003771.name: lip shape trait
VT:0003771.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical form or contours of the fleshy margins of the mouth.

VT:0003784.name: lip vermillion border width
VT:0003784.def: The distance from side to side of the line between the lip and the facial skin around the mouth.

VT:0003791.name: minor salivary gland morphology trait
VT:0003791.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the smaller, largely mucus-secreting, exocrine glands of the oral cavity, consisting of the labial, buccal, molar, lingual, and palatine glands.

VT:0003792.name: major salivary gland morphology trait
VT:0003792.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the three largest glands of the oral cavity that secrete most of the saliva, including the parotid, submandibular, and sublingual glands.

VT:0003793.name: submandibular gland morphology trait
VT:0003793.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of either of the large major salivary glands situated beneath the mandible.

VT:0003794.name: somite formation initiation trait
VT:0003794.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the start of the induction and/or formation of any of the paired, metamerically arranged cell masses formed in the embryonic paraxial mesoderm.

VT:0003795.name: obsolete bone structure trait
VT:0003795.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the composite material or the layered arrangement of bony tissue, common to multiple bones of the skeleton.\nconsider: VT:0010003

VT:0003796.name: obsolete cortical bone morphology trait
VT:0003796.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the superficial thin layer of compact bone.\nReplace with VT:0003797.

VT:0003797.name: compact bone morphology trait
VT:0003797.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the outer layers of solid, hard bone that cover spongy bone; consist of parallel osteons containing mineral deposits and interstitial lamellae.

VT:0003798.name: Harderian gland pigmentation trait
VT:0003798.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the deposition or aggregation of coloring matter in the sebaceous gland located behind the eyeball in some species that excretes fluid that facilitates movement of the nictitating membrane.

VT:0003799.name: macrophage migration trait
VT:0003799.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the directed and orderly movement of macrophages from point to point.

VT:0003800.name: digit quantity
VT:0003800.def: The proportion or number of fingers or toes, or their corresponding parts in other vertebrates.

VT:0003806.name: nucleotide metabolism trait
VT:0003806.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the chemical reactions and pathways involving a nucleotide, a nucleoside that is esterified with (ortho)phosphate or an oligophosphate at any hydroxyl group on the glycose moiety; may be mono-, di- or triphosphate; this definition includes cyclic nucleotides (nucleoside cyclic phosphates).

VT:0003809.name: hair shaft morphology trait
VT:0003809.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the free portion of the hair, consisting of the cuticle, cortex, and the medulla.

VT:0003810.name: hair cuticle morphology trait
VT:0003810.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the outermost layer of the hair shaft.

VT:0003811.name: hair cortex morphology trait
VT:0003811.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the principal structural component of the hair shaft.

VT:0003812.name: hair medulla morphology trait
VT:0003812.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the central axis of the hair shaft.

VT:0003815.name: obsolete hair quantity
VT:0003815.def: OBSOLETE. The proportion or number of fine, keratinized filamentous growths arising from the epidermis of mammals.\nsee VT:0000416

VT:0003816.name: pituitary gland development trait
VT:0003816.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the compound gland suspended from the base of the hypothalamus, which secretes somatotropins, prolactin, TSH (thyroid-stimulating hormone), gonadotropins, and adrenal corticotropin.

VT:0003817.name: Rathke's pouch morphology trait
VT:0003817.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the pouch of ectoderm that grows out from the upper surface of the embryonic stomodeum and gives rise to the anterior and intermediate lobes of the pituitary gland.

VT:0003818.name: eye muscle development trait
VT:0003818.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the muscles of the organ of vision during their formation and differentiation.

VT:0003825.name: pillar cell morphology trait
VT:0003825.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the supporting cells that form the inner and outer walls of the tunnel in the organ of Corti.

VT:0003826.name: Mullerian duct morphology trait
VT:0003826.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the transient embryonic tubes that empty into the cloaca and in the female develop into the oviducts, uterus, and vagina.

VT:0003827.name: Wolffian duct morphology trait
VT:0003827.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the transient embryonic tubes that empty into the cloaca and differentiate into the vas deferens in the male in higher vertebrates.

VT:0003830.name: testis development trait
VT:0003830.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the male reproductive glands where sperm production occurs.

VT:0003833.name: satellite cell quantity
VT:0003833.def: The proportion or number of unfused, spindle-shaped cells in skeletal muscle that play a role in muscle repair and regeneration.

VT:0003834.name: adrenergic chromaffin cell morphology trait
VT:0003834.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells responsible for epinephrine and norepinephrine secretion.

VT:0003838.name: milk secretion trait
VT:0003838.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the controlled release of milk from the mammary gland.

VT:0003840.name: coronal suture morphology trait
VT:0003840.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the articulation between the parietal bones and the frontal bone.

VT:0003841.name: lambdoid suture morphology trait
VT:0003841.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the articulation between the parietal bones and the occipital bone.

VT:0003842.name: metopic suture morphology trait
VT:0003842.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the articulation of the frontal bone from the sagittal suture to the root of the nose.

VT:0003843.name: sagittal suture morphology trait
VT:0003843.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the articulation between the parietal bones.

VT:0003844.name: squamosal suture morphology trait
VT:0003844.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the articulation of the squamous portion of the temporal bones with the parietal bones.

VT:0003847.name: obsolete lens bow organization trait
VT:0003847.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement of the area where the lens epithelium pushes into the lens proper and forms new lens fibers.

VT:0003850.name: thymocyte activation trait
VT:0003850.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of producing activated thymocytes from naive thymocytes.

VT:0003853.name: skin water amount
VT:0003853.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of moisture in the membranous protective covering of the body.

VT:0003854.name: forelimb stylopod morphology trait
VT:0003854.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the proximal element of the developing forelimb that will give rise to the humerus.

VT:0003855.name: forelimb zeugopod morphology trait
VT:0003855.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the distal elements of the developing forelimb that will give rise to the radius and ulna.

VT:0003856.name: hindlimb stylopod morphology trait
VT:0003856.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the proximal element of the developing hindlimb that will give rise to the femur.

VT:0003857.name: hindlimb zeugopod morphology trait
VT:0003857.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the distal elements of the developing hindlimb that will give rise to the tibia and fibula.

VT:0003859.name: Harderian gland physiology trait
VT:0003859.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the sebaceous gland located behind the eyeball in the orbit that secretes lipids, porphyrins, and indoles such as melatonin.

VT:0003861.name: nervous system development trait
VT:0003861.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the components of the system responsible for receiving and processing information about an organism's environment and controlling behavior.

VT:0003864.name: midbrain development trait
VT:0003864.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the part of the brainstem developing from the middle of the three primary cerebral vesicles of the embryo.

VT:0003871.name: myelin sheath morphology trait
VT:0003871.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the insulating envelope that surrounds nerve fibers or axons.

VT:0003876.name: cerebrum physiology trait
VT:0003876.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the largest part of the brain, derived from the telencephalon, which is composed of right and left hemispheres, each of which contains an outer cerebral cortex and a subcortical basal ganglia; cerebral functions include sensorimotor, emotional, and intellectual activities.

VT:0003877.name: serotonergic neuron morphology trait
VT:0003877.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the neurons that secrete serotonin.

VT:0003878.name: ear physiology trait
VT:0003878.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of and processes in the organ of hearing and equilibrium.

VT:0003879.name: hair cell physiology trait
VT:0003879.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the sensory epithelial cells of the inner ear.

VT:0003880.name: central pattern generator physiology trait
VT:0003880.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the functions of or processes in the neural networks that produce rhythmic patterned output without sensory input and underlie rhythmic motor patterns.

VT:0003881.name: nephron morphology trait
VT:0003881.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the filtering unit of the kidney that includes the renal corpuscle, proximal and distal convoluted tubules, loop of Henle, and the collecting tubule.

VT:0003883.name: stomach size trait
VT:0003883.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the sac-like structure of the digestive canal between the esophagus and the small intestine.

VT:0003885.name: rostral-caudal body axis extension trait
VT:0003885.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the elongation of the long (rostral-caudal) axis of the body once patterning has been established.

VT:0003886.name: embryonic epiblast morphology trait
VT:0003886.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the tissue that gives rise to the ectoderm, endoderm and mesoderm of the embryo proper.

VT:0003887.name: hepatocyte apoptosis trait
VT:0003887.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which liver cells undergo programmed cell death.

VT:0003890.name: embryonic-extraembryonic boundary morphology trait
VT:0003890.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the connection between the embryo proper and extraembryonic tissues.

VT:0003892.name: gastric gland morphology trait
VT:0003892.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of any of the branched tubular glands in the mucosa of the fundus and body of the stomach that contain parietal cells that secrete hydrochloric acid and zymogenic cells that produce pepsin.

VT:0003893.name: hepatocyte proliferation trait
VT:0003893.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which liver cells undergo expansion by cell division.

VT:0003894.name: obsolete Purkinje cell innervation pattern trait
VT:0003894.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement, distribution or supply of nerve fibers that connect to the Purkinje cells.\nconsider: VT:0010151, VT:0010154

VT:0003905.name: aorta elastin amount
VT:0003905.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of elastin in the aorta.

VT:0003920.name: heart right ventricle morphology trait
VT:0003920.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the right lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0003921.name: heart left ventricle morphology trait
VT:0003921.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the left lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0003930.name: tooth hard tissue morphology trait
VT:0003930.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the hard portion of the tooth surrounding the pulp, including the dentin, enamel and the cementum on the root.

VT:0003932.name: molar crown morphology trait
VT:0003932.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the upper part of the molar, which is normally covered with enamel.

VT:0003933.name: cementum morphology trait
VT:0003933.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bonelike rigid connective tissue covering the root of a tooth.
