VT:0003934.name: pancreas development trait
VT:0003934.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the organ that secretes pancreatic juice into the duodenum and secretes glucagon and insulin into the bloodstream.

VT:0003935.name: craniofacial development trait
VT:0003935.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the region of the body that includes the front part of the head from the chin to the top of the forehead, where the mouth, eyes, nose, and other features are and the part of the skull enclosing the brain.

VT:0003936.name: reproductive system development trait
VT:0003936.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the organs involved in the production of offspring.

VT:0003938.name: ear development trait
VT:0003938.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the organ of hearing, responsible for maintaining equilibrium as well as sensing sound, during its formation and differentiation.

VT:0003939.name: myotome morphology trait
VT:0003939.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the mesoderm that is derived from the somite and is fated to become the skeletal musculature.

VT:0003940.name: dermatome morphology trait
VT:0003940.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lateral portion of the embryonic somite that is fated to become the dermis.

VT:0003941.name: skin development trait
VT:0003941.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation or differentiation of the membranous protective covering of the body.

VT:0003942.name: urinary system development trait
VT:0003942.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the organs involved in the production or excretion of urine.

VT:0003943.name: hepatobiliary system development trait
VT:0003943.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the liver, gall bladder, or bile ducts during their formation and differentiation.

VT:0003945.name: lymphocyte physiology trait
VT:0003945.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in any of the white blood cells that include B cells, T cells, and NK cells.

VT:0003947.name: cholesterol amount
VT:0003947.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the body of these most abundant steroids in animal tissues, and precursors to steroid hormones and bile salts; also components of plasma membranes.

VT:0003949.name: blood lipid amount
VT:0003949.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of fat-soluble substances (molecules composed of carbon and hydrogen and are characteristically insoluble in water).

VT:0003951.name: copper homeostasis trait
VT:0003951.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the state of equilibrium in the body with respect to this metallic element that normally occurs in a number of proteins including amine oxidases and chaperone proteins.

VT:0003952.name: copper amount
VT:0003952.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in a body tissue or fluid of this metallic element that has formula Cu, and normally occurs as a cofactor for a number of proteins including amine oxidases and chaperone proteins.

VT:0003954.name: Reichert's membrane morphology trait
VT:0003954.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the extraembryonic basement membrane in rodents that forms on the inner surface of the trophectoderm and is secreted by the distal endoderm; required for the maternofetal exchange of nutrients and is important for the post-gastrulation development.

VT:0003955.name: ultimobranchial body morphology trait
VT:0003955.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the sac-like structure emanating from the caudal-most branchial pouch of the embryo; develops into the lateral portion of the thyroid that produces calcitonin in higher vertebrates.

VT:0003974.name: endocardium morphology trait
VT:0003974.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the thin serous membrane, primarily composed of endothelial tissue, that lines the interior of the heart.

VT:0003977.name: blood carnitine amount
VT:0003977.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of carnitine, a quaternary ammonium amino acid derivative involved in transport of fatty acids across the mitochondrial membrane.

VT:0003984.name: embryonic growth trait
VT:0003984.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the increase in size or mass during the embryonic period (sensu Mus: up to E14, or the completion of organogenesis).

VT:0003986.name: cochlear ganglion size trait
VT:0003986.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the cochlear ganglion or of the sensory neuron cell bodies that convey auditory sensation from the organ of Corti to the hindbrain and reside on the cochlear part of the vestibulocochlear nerve (eighth cranial nerve).

VT:0003987.name: vestibular ganglion size trait
VT:0003987.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the vestibular ganglion or of the sensory neuron cell bodies associated with the eighth cranial nerve.

VT:0003989.name: barrel cortex morphology trait
VT:0003989.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the discrete functional unit of the somatosensory cortex that processes tactile information derived from the vibrissae.

VT:0003993.name: ventral spinal root morphology trait
VT:0003993.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the anterior bundle of nerves emerging from the spinal cord to join with the posterior/dorsal nerve bundle at each spinal cord segment to form one of the 31 paired peripheral nerves.

VT:0003994.name: dorsal spinal root morphology trait
VT:0003994.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the posterior bundle of nerves emerging from the spinal cord to join with the anterior/ventral nerve bundle at each spinal cord segment to form one of the 31 paired peripheral nerves.

VT:0004002.name: jejunum morphology trait
VT:0004002.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the portion of the small intestine that extends from the duodenum to the ileum.

VT:0004005.name: intestinal smooth muscle contractility trait
VT:0004005.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the unstriated, involuntary muscle tissue of the intestines to shorten or to develop increased tension.

VT:0004006.name: jejunal smooth muscle contractility trait
VT:0004006.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the unstriated, involuntary muscle tissue of the portion of the small intestine that extends from the duodenum to the ileum to shorten or to develop increased tension.

VT:0004007.name: lung blood vessel morphology trait
VT:0004007.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the blood vessels of either or both of the spongy organs of respiration contained within the pleural cavity of the thorax.

VT:0004008.name: GABA-mediated receptor current
VT:0004008.def: The measured amplitude, current density, or duration of response to stimulation of GABA receptors.

VT:0004020.name: amniotic fluid amount
VT:0004020.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the liquid that envelops the fetus inside the amniotic sac.

VT:0004021.name: rod electrophysiology trait
VT:0004021.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the rhodopsin-containing photoreceptor cells of the retina.

VT:0004022.name: cone electrophysiology trait
VT:0004022.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the cells in the outer layer of the retina that are stimulated by wavelengths of light of different colors; essential for color discrimination.

VT:0004032.name: interventricular groove morphology trait
VT:0004032.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the indentation dividing the two ventricles, comprised of the sulcus interventricularis anterior and the sulcus interventricularis posterior.

VT:0004035.name: sublingual gland morphology trait
VT:0004035.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the small mucin-producing salivary glands in the floor of the mouth beneath the tongue, anterior to the submandibular gland.

VT:0004043.name: pH regulation trait
VT:0004043.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of the buffer systems of the body in combination with the respiratory and renal systems that control the relative acidity or alkalinity of the body, as measured by the concentration of hydrogen ion.

VT:0004047.name: milk trait
VT:0004047.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the content or the appearance of milk.

VT:0004050.name: kidney sympathetic nerve activity
VT:0004050.def: The degree of function or response of the nerve projecting to the kidney from the division of the nervous system that mediates the body's response to stress.

VT:0004054.name: periocular mesenchyme morphology trait
VT:0004054.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the mesenchymal cells that give rise to the corneal endothelium, corneal stroma, sclera, iris stroma, ciliary muscle, ciliary stroma, and trabecular meshwork of the eye.

VT:0004062.name: heart right atrium capacity
VT:0004062.def: The volume of or amount contained in the right upper chamber of the heart.

VT:0004063.name: heart left atrium capacity
VT:0004063.def: The volume of or amount contained in the left upper chamber of the heart.

VT:0004066.name: primitive node morphology trait
VT:0004066.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the regional thickening of cells at the rostral tip of the vertebrate primitive streak through which gastrulating cells migrate anteriorally to form tissues in the future head and neck; this region organizes the formation of the three embryonic layers and establishes the longitudinal axis and the polarity of the embryo.

VT:0004067.name: heart ventricle trabeculae morphology trait
VT:0004067.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the supporting bundles of muscular fibers lining the walls of the ventricles of the heart.

VT:0004069.name: muscle spindle morphology trait
VT:0004069.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the sensory organs in muscle that are involved in the stretch reflex.

VT:0004074.name: Schwann cell precursor morphology trait
VT:0004074.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the progenitors of cells that sheath the axons of the peripheral nervous system.

VT:0004075.name: Schwann cell precursor quantity
VT:0004075.def: The proportion or number of the progenitors of cells that sheath the axons of the peripheral nervous system.

VT:0004076.name: vitelline vascular remodeling trait
VT:0004076.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the conversion of the primary (honeycomb-like) vascular plexus of the yolk sac into a mature vascular network.

VT:0004077.name: striatum morphology trait
VT:0004077.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a large cluster of dopaminergic nerve cells, consisting of the caudate nucleus and the putamen, that controls movement, balance, and walking.

VT:0004078.name: caudate nucleus morphology trait
VT:0004078.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of one or both C-shaped structures containing input neurons involved with control of voluntary movement in the brain.

VT:0004079.name: putamen morphology trait
VT:0004079.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lens-shaped basal ganglion involved with control of voluntary movement in the brain.

VT:0004080.name: nucleus accumbens morphology trait
VT:0004080.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the group of neurons located at the head of the caudate nucleus and anterior to the putamen; these neurons normally are involved in sensations of pleasure and reactions to addictive substances.

VT:0004081.name: globus pallidus morphology trait
VT:0004081.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of one of the basal ganglia involved with control of voluntary movement in the brain; consists of an external and an internal segment.

VT:0004082.name: habenula morphology trait
VT:0004082.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the group of nuclei that makes up the small eminence on the dorsomedial surface of the thalamus, just in front of the dorsal commissure on the lateral edge of the habenular trigone.

VT:0004087.name: muscle cell morphology trait
VT:0004087.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells comprising the contractile tissue that effects movement of an organ or part of the body.

VT:0004088.name: sarcoplasmic reticulum morphology trait
VT:0004088.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the endoplasmic reticulum of skeletal or cardiac muscle, i.e., the complex of vesicles, tubules, and cisternae that form a continuous structure around striated myofibrils, with a repetition of structure within each sarcomere.

VT:0004090.name: sarcomere morphology trait
VT:0004090.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the segment of a myofibril between two Z lines, comprised of multi-protein complexes consisting of three different filament systems; these systems work together to contract and relax muscle.

VT:0004091.name: Z line morphology trait
VT:0004091.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cross-striation bisecting the I band of striated muscle myofibrils and serving as the anchoring point of actin filaments at either end of the sarcomere.

VT:0004093.name: Z line configuration trait
VT:0004093.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement of the cross-striation bisecting the I band of striated muscle myofibrils and serving as the anchoring point of actin filaments at either end of the sarcomere.

VT:0004094.name: M line morphology trait
VT:0004094.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the fine line in the center of the A band of the sarcomere of striated muscle myofibrils.

VT:0004095.name: eyelash morphology trait
VT:0004095.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the short hairs fringing the edge of the eyelid.

VT:0004096.name: midbrain-hindbrain boundary development trait
VT:0004096.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation of the midbrain-hindbrain domain, comprised of the mesencephalic vesicle and the first rhombencephalic vesicle at early somitogenesis stages during its formation and differentiation; this area is an organizing center at the boundary patterns the midbrain and hindbrain primordia of the neural plate.

VT:0004097.name: cerebellar cortex morphology trait
VT:0004097.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the thin mantle of gray matter that covers the surface of each cerebral hemisphere, including the six layers of nerve cells and the nerve pathways that connect them; together, these regions are responsible for the processes of conscious thought, perception, emotion and memory as well as advanced motor function.

VT:0004098.name: cerebellar granule cell morphology trait
VT:0004098.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the small neurons of the granule cell layer that send parallel fibers to the upper molecular layer, where they synapse with Purkinje cell dendrites.

VT:0004099.name: cerebellar glomerulus morphology trait
VT:0004099.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the intertwined cluster of nerve fibers surrounded by glia where mossy fibers from the pontine nuclei in the white matter synapse with granule cell axons, Golgi cell axons and unipolar brush interneuron axons.

VT:0004100.name: spinal cord interneuron morphology trait
VT:0004100.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of neurons that exclusively interact with other neurons in the spinal cord.

VT:0004101.name: brain interneuron morphology trait
VT:0004101.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the neurons that exclusively interact with other neurons in the brain; this includes most brain neuronal cell types.

VT:0004102.name: dorsal striatum morphology trait
VT:0004102.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the regions of the caudate nucleus and the putamen that lie dorsal to the anterior commissure.

VT:0004103.name: ventral striatum morphology trait
VT:0004103.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the regions of the nucleus accumbens and some nuclei of the olfactory tubercle that lie ventral to the anterior commissure.

VT:0004104.name: eye shape trait
VT:0004104.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical form or contours of the organ of vision.

VT:0004107.name: thoracic duct morphology trait
VT:0004107.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the largest lymph vessel in the body, beginning at the cisterna chyli at about the level of the second lumbar vertebra.

VT:0004108.name: esophageal peristalsis trait
VT:0004108.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the esophageal movement characterized by waves of alternate circular contraction and relaxation of the muscular walls that move the esophagus contents forward.

VT:0004109.name: Sertoli cell development trait
VT:0004109.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the cells of the seminiferous tubules that create the blood-testes barrier and enable spermatogenesis.

VT:0004111.name: coronary artery morphology trait
VT:0004111.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of any of the arteries that branch from the aorta to supply blood to the heart.

VT:0004113.name: aortic arch morphology trait
VT:0004113.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the portion of the descending aorta proceeding from the arch of the aorta and extending to the diaphragm.

VT:0004114.name: atrioventricular node morphology trait
VT:0004114.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the small nodular mass of specialized muscle fibers located in the interatrial septum near the opening of the coronary sinus; this node gives rise to the electrical connection between the atria and ventricles and responds to the sinoatrial node.

VT:0004115.name: sinoatrial node morphology trait
VT:0004115.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the small mass of modified cardiac muscle fibers located at the junction of the superior vena cava and the right atrium that is the source of contraction impulses for the heart.

VT:0004117.name: atrioventricular bundle morphology trait
VT:0004117.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the specialized cardiac muscle fibers that originate in the atrioventricular node and extend into the ventricle.

VT:0004118.name: baroreceptor morphology trait
VT:0004118.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the sensory nerve endings in the wall of the atria of the heart, vena cava, aortic arch and carotid sinus that are sensitive to changes in blood pressure.

VT:0004121.name: sarcolemma morphology trait
VT:0004121.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the plasma membrane of a muscle fiber that is capable of conducting electrical impulses.

VT:0004123.name: impulse conducting system morphology trait
VT:0004123.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the impulse-conducting system composed of modified cardiac muscle and having the power of spontaneous rhythmicity and conduction more highly developed than the rest of the heart.

VT:0004124.name: Purkinje fiber morphology trait
VT:0004124.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the cardiac muscle fibers composing the terminal portion of the heart conduction system located in the ventricle.

VT:0004127.name: hypodermis thickness
VT:0004127.def: The distance between the surfaces of the irregular layer of adipose and connective tissue, stroma, or membrane immediately deep to the skin and superficial to the deep fascia.

VT:0004128.name: adipocyte morphology trait
VT:0004128.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the cells in the body that store fats.

VT:0004130.name: muscle cell glucose uptake trait
VT:0004130.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of contractile cells that effect movement of an organ or part of the body to take in the monosaccharide that is the end product of carbohydrate digestion.

VT:0004131.name: embryonic cilia morphology trait
VT:0004131.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the earliest cilia of the embryo, found on the cells of the embryonic node.

VT:0004134.name: thorax morphology trait
VT:0004134.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the part of the body between the head and the abdomen or any of its component parts.

VT:0004135.name: mammary gland embryonic development trait
VT:0004135.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation during early embryogenesis of the milk-secreting gland in female mammals.

VT:0004136.name: tongue muscle morphology trait
VT:0004136.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the muscular portion of the mobile mass of muscular tissue and surrounding epithelial tissue occupying the cavity of the mouth and forming part of the floor.

VT:0004137.name: gastric surface mucous cell morphology trait
VT:0004137.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the mucus secreting epithelial cells that line the luminal surface of the stomach, gastric pits and gastric glands.

VT:0004138.name: mucous neck cell morphology trait
VT:0004138.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the mucin-producing epithelial cells present in the neck of the gastric glands.

VT:0004139.name: gastric parietal cell morphology trait
VT:0004139.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the gastric acid producing epithelial cells that are distributed throughout the length of the gastric gland.

VT:0004140.name: chief cell morphology trait
VT:0004140.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the pepsinogen producing epithelial cells that are clustered at the base of the gastric gland.

VT:0004141.name: enteroendocrine cell morphology trait
VT:0004141.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the hormone- or neurotransmitter-secreting epithelial cells present throughout the epithelium of the digestive tract.

VT:0004142.name: muscle tone
VT:0004142.def: The resting tautness or laxity of a muscle, normally somewhere in the middle of the range between total contraction and total relaxation.

VT:0004145.name: muscle electrophysiology trait
VT:0004145.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the degree of function or response of the musculature as it relates to electrical phenomena.

VT:0004147.name: porphyrin amount
VT:0004147.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in a body tissue or fluid of porphyrins or protoporphyrins.

VT:0004152.name: blood iron amount
VT:0004152.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this metallic element that normally occurs in the heme of hemoglobin, myoglobin, transferrin, ferritin, and iron-containing porphyrins; it is an essential component of enzymes such as catalase, peroxidase, and various cytochromes.

VT:0004153.name: kidney tubule apoptosis trait
VT:0004153.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which the cells of the loops of Henle, proximal and distal convoluted tubules, and collecting ducts in the kidney undergo programmed cell death.

VT:0004162.name: mammillary body morphology trait
VT:0004162.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the protrusion at the posterior end of the hypothalamus that contains hypothalamic nuclei.

VT:0004163.name: adenophysis morphology trait
VT:0004163.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the anterior part of the pituitary that secretes a variety of hormones; its function is regulated by the hypothalamus.

VT:0004164.name: neurohypophysis morphology trait
VT:0004164.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the posterior part of the pituitary gland that secretes hormones involved in blood pressure regulation.

VT:0004165.name: lateral geniculate nucleus morphology trait
VT:0004165.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the group of neurons that serve as the primary processor of visual information received from the retina via the optic tract and send processed information to the visual cortex of the occipital lobe.

VT:0004166.name: limbic system morphology trait
VT:0004166.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of a collection of structures in the brain involved in emotion, motivation, and emotional aspects of memory; these structures act together to control the endocrine system and the autonomic nervous system.

VT:0004167.name: cingulate gyrus morphology trait
VT:0004167.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the ridge in the cerebral cortex located dorsal to the corpus callosum that controls autonomic functions regulating heart rate and blood pressure as well as cognitive and attentional processing.

VT:0004168.name: parahippocampal gyrus morphology trait
VT:0004168.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the ridge in the cerebral cortex that contains the olfactory cortex and that plays a role in the formation of topographical memory.

VT:0004169.name: fornicate gyrus morphology trait
VT:0004169.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the horseshoe-shaped gyrus of the cerebral cortex that consists of the cingulate gyrus and the parahippocampal gyrus.

VT:0004170.name: orbitofrontal cortex morphology trait
VT:0004170.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the region of the cerebral cortex covering the basal surface of the frontal lobes; this region normally controls emotion and decision making.

VT:0004171.name: pallium development trait
VT:0004171.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of roof region of the telencephalon during its formation and differentiation.

VT:0004172.name: subpallium development trait
VT:0004172.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the base region of the telencephalon during its formation and differentiation.

VT:0004173.name: intervertebral disk morphology trait
VT:0004173.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cartilaginous and gelatinous structures found between the bodies of adjacent vertebrae.

VT:0004174.name: vertebral column orientation trait
VT:0004174.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the location or arrangement of vertebra within the spinal column and the resulting rectilinear direction or curvature produced.

VT:0004182.name: spermiation trait
VT:0004182.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process in which mature spermatozoa are released from supporting Sertoli cells into spermiduct or vas deferens.

VT:0004183.name: sympathetic nervous system physiology trait
VT:0004183.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the functions of or processes in the part of the autonomic nervous system that innervates smooth muscle, cardiac muscle and glands and mediates the body's response to stressful situations.

VT:0004184.name: baroreceptor physiology trait
VT:0004184.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the functions of or processes in the sensory nerve endings found in the wall of the atria of the heart, vena cava, aortic arch and carotid sinus that are sensitive to changes in blood pressure.

VT:0004185.name: adipocyte glucose uptake trait
VT:0004185.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of fat-storing cells to take in the monosaccharide that is the end product of carbohydrate digestion; D-glucose serves as a primary energy source for living organisms.

VT:0004186.name: area postrema morphology trait
VT:0004186.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the small, elevated area in the lateral wall of the inferior recess of the fourth ventricle, involved in the control of cardiorespiratory physiology.

VT:0004188.name: timing of embryo turning
VT:0004188.def: The time of completion of axial rotation.

VT:0004189.name: alveolar process morphology trait
VT:0004189.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the projecting ridge of bone that holds the tooth sockets.

VT:0004190.name: direction of embryo turning
VT:0004190.def: The direction of axial rotation of the embryo when viewed towards the caudal pole during the late primitive streak/early somite stage (Mus E8.5-E9.5).

VT:0004192.name: kidney pyramid morphology trait
VT:0004192.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the conical mass of tissue, containing part of the secreting and collecting tubules, whose base faces the renal cortex.

VT:0004193.name: kidney papilla morphology trait
VT:0004193.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the apex of the renal pyramid that projects into a calyx.

VT:0004194.name: kidney pelvis morphology trait
VT:0004194.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the flattened, funnel-shaped expansion of the ureter that is formed by convergence of the major calices.

VT:0004195.name: kidney calyx morphology trait
VT:0004195.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the branches of the renal pelvis that surround each renal papilla and collect urine.

VT:0004201.name: fetal growth trait
VT:0004201.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the increase in size or mass during the fetal period (sensu Mus: from E14 through birth).

VT:0004203.name: cranial flexure morphology trait
VT:0004203.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the sharp, ventrally concave bend in the developing midbrain of the embryo.

VT:0004204.name: stapes size trait
VT:0004204.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the smallest and innermost of the three auditory ossicles.

VT:0004206.name: dermomyotome development trait
VT:0004206.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation or differentiation of the portion of the embryonic somite that remains after migration of the sclerotomic tissue.

VT:0004209.name: sweet taste sensitivity trait
VT:0004209.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to perceive a particular flavor or suggestion of something sweet by the chemoreceptors of the gustatory system.

VT:0004210.name: bitter taste sensitivity trait
VT:0004210.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to perceive a particular flavor or suggestion of something bitter by the chemoreceptors of the gustatory system.

VT:0004211.name: sour taste sensitivity trait
VT:0004211.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to perceive a particular flavor or suggestion of something sour by the chemoreceptors of the gustatory system.

VT:0004212.name: salty taste sensitivity trait
VT:0004212.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to perceive a particular flavor or suggestion of something salty by the chemoreceptors of the gustatory system.

VT:0004213.name: umami taste sensitivity trait
VT:0004213.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to perceive a particular flavor or suggestion of something umami (savory) by the chemoreceptors of the gustatory system.

VT:0004214.name: long bone diaphysis morphology trait
VT:0004214.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the main or mid section (shaft) of a long bone.

VT:0004220.name: peripheral nervous system regeneration trait
VT:0004220.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the ability of peripheral nervous system tissue to regenerate following injury or disease.

VT:0004221.name: iridocorneal angle morphology trait
VT:0004221.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, or pattern of any of the acute angles occurring between the iris and the cornea at the periphery of the anterior chamber of the eye.
synonyms: morphology trait of the angle of the iris

VT:0004223.name: trabecular meshwork size trait
VT:0004223.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the pore-like structure surrounding the entire circumference of the anterior chamber through which aqueous humor circulates.

VT:0004226.name: canal of Schlemm size trait
VT:0004226.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the vascular structure encircling the anterior chamber of the eye, through which the aqueous humor is returned to the blood circulation.

VT:0004229.name: embryonic erythropoiesis trait
VT:0004229.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the processes in the development of primarily large, nucleated erythroblasts occurring in blood islands in the yolk sac, generally occurs from E7-E11 in the mouse and through 10 weeks in humans.

VT:0004230.name: embryonic erythrocyte morphology trait
VT:0004230.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the embryonic blood cells that carry oxygen.

VT:0004234.name: masticatory muscle morphology trait
VT:0004234.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the muscles responsible for the movement of the jaws during mastication, including the masseter, temporalis, and medial and lateral pterygoid muscles.

VT:0004235.name: masseter muscle morphology trait
VT:0004235.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the masticatory muscle of the posterior cheek with origin from the inferior border and medial surface of the zygomatic arch, with insertion into the lateral surface of the ramus of the mandible, with nerve supply from the masseteric nerve, and whose action closes the jaw during chewing.

VT:0004236.name: masseter muscle size trait
VT:0004236.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the masticatory muscle of the posterior cheek with origin from the inferior border and medial surface of the zygomatic arch, with insertion into the lateral surface of the ramus of the mandible, with nerve supply from the masseteric nerve, and whose action closes the jaw during chewing.

VT:0004237.name: pterygoid muscle morphology trait
VT:0004237.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the muscles descending from the sphenoid bone to the lower jaw including the internal, or medial, pterygoid muscle and external, or lateral, pterygoid muscle; action of the former is closing the jaws and that of the latter is opening the jaws, protruding the mandible, and moving the mandible from side to side.

VT:0004238.name: pterygoid muscle size trait
VT:0004238.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of either or both of the muscles descending from the sphenoid bone to the lower jaw including the internal, or medial, pterygoid muscle and external, or lateral, pterygoid muscle; action of the former is closing the jaws and that of the latter is opening the jaws, protruding the mandible, and moving the mandible from side to side.

VT:0004239.name: temporalis muscle morphology trait
VT:0004239.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the superior-most masticatory muscle.

VT:0004240.name: temporalis muscle size trait
VT:0004240.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the superior-most masticatory muscle.

VT:0004242.name: plasmacytoid dendritic cell morphology trait
VT:0004242.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of phagocytic dendritic cells that are morphologically similar to plasma cells, but do not express B lineage markers, and produce large amounts of alpha/beta interferons (IFN-/) in response to viral and bacterial stimuli; plasmacytoid dendritic cells are found in the thymic medulla and lymph node T cell areas and are responsible for immune tolerance.

VT:0004243.name: motor nerve terminal sprouting trait
VT:0004243.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of a motor neuron to form new neuritic processes (sprouts) that emerge from the nodes of Ranvier or terminal arborizations in response to nerve injury (such as denervation), application of nerve toxin, or muscle inactivity (usually due to disease).

VT:0004244.name: spontaneous abortion trait
VT:0004244.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the natural or accidental termination of a pregnancy at a stage where the embryo or the fetus is incapable of surviving independently of the mother.

VT:0004246.name: extensor digitorum longus morphology trait
VT:0004246.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the penniform muscle of the lateral front part of the leg responsible for extension of the toes and dorsiflexion of the ankle.

VT:0004248.name: epaxial muscle morphology trait
VT:0004248.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the muscles derived from the region of the myotome closest to the neural tube; includes the intrinsic back muscles.

VT:0004249.name: crista ampullaris morphology trait
VT:0004249.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the elevation found on the inner surface of the ampullae of each semicircular duct; filaments of the vestibular nerve pass through the crista to reach hair cells on its surface; the hair cells are capped by the cupula, a gelatinous protein-polysaccharide mass.

VT:0004252.name: heart tube looping direction
VT:0004252.def: The orientation of bending during the process by which the embryonic heart tube bends to transform from a straight tube into the final folded configuration of the adult heart.

VT:0004255.name: spongiotrophoblast layer morphology trait (sensu Rodentia)
VT:0004255.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the middle layer of the placenta between the outermost giant cells and the innermost labyrinth layer; it has a structural role and also produces several layer-specific secreted factors.

VT:0004256.name: placenta maternal decidual layer morphology trait
VT:0004256.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the maternal uterine-derived portion of the placenta.

VT:0004257.name: placenta mass
VT:0004257.def: The amount of matter in the organ of metabolic interchange between fetus and mother.

VT:0004258.name: placenta size trait
VT:0004258.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the organ of metabolic interchange between fetus and mother.

VT:0004261.name: embryonic neuroepithelium morphology trait
VT:0004261.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the epithelial cells that line the neural tube and develop into the neurons and glia of the nervous system and into the neural crest cells.

VT:0004262.name: physical strength trait
VT:0004262.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of an organism to exert force on physical objects or of the body to support its load.

VT:0004263.name: limb posture trait
VT:0004263.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the position of the limbs, the projecting, paired, jointed appendages of the body used for locomotion or grasping, relative to the body.

VT:0004264.name: extraembryonic tissue physiology trait
VT:0004264.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the membranes involved with embryonic protection and nutrition.

VT:0004265.name: placental transport trait
VT:0004265.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the conveyance of metabolic products and nutrients across the placenta.

VT:0004266.name: placenta color
VT:0004266.def: The visually perceived hue of the organ of metabolic interchange between fetus and mother, partly of embryonic origin and partly of maternal origin.

VT:0004267.name: optic tract morphology trait
VT:0004267.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the paired bands of optic nerve fibers running from the optic chiasma to the lateral geniculate body and midbrain.

VT:0004268.name: optic stalk morphology trait
VT:0004268.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the narrow, proximal portion of the optic vesicle which connects the embryonic eye and forebrain.

VT:0004269.name: optic cup morphology trait
VT:0004269.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the double walled structure formed by expansion and invagination of the distal end of the optic vesicle that develops into the pigmented and sensory layers of the retina; the mouth of the optic cup eventually forms the pupil of the eye.

VT:0004271.name: paw/hand/foot/hoof morphology trait
VT:0004271.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the pedal or prehensile extremity of vertebrates.

VT:0004272.name: basement membrane morphology trait
VT:0004272.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the extracellular supportive tissue adjacent to the basal surface of the epithelia, including the epithelium of muscle cells, fat cells and Schwann cells; it is comprised of type IV collagen, laminin, and sulfated proteoglycans and other components and consists of two layers, the basal lamina and the lamina reticularis.

VT:0004273.name: basal lamina morphology trait
VT:0004273.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the sheet of extracellular matrix characteristically situated under epithelial cells, around muscles, nerves, capillaries, and fat cells, and situated between these elements and the underlying or surrounding connective tissue.

VT:0004274.name: embryonic/fetal subventricular zone morphology trait
VT:0004274.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the transient proliferative population of neurons that expands exponentially during late prenatal development; it is a continuous germinal zone distinct from the ventricular zone that surrounds the brain ventricles.

VT:0004275.name: postnatal subventricular zone morphology trait
VT:0004275.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the mitotically active layer of cells surrounding the brain ventricles in the adult that consists of migrating neuroblasts, astrocytes and transitory amplifying progenitor cells.

VT:0004276.name: medial ganglionic eminence morphology trait
VT:0004276.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a distinct elevation of a transient proliferating cell mass of the fetal subventricular zone; this mass contributes most of its cells to the neocortex; however, hippocampal neurons, thalamus, septum and olfactory bulb neurons are also partly derived from the MGE.

VT:0004277.name: lateral ganglionic eminence morphology trait
VT:0004277.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a distinct elevation of a transient proliferating cell mass of the fetal subventricular zone; this mass contributes most of its cells to the striatum; however, neocortex, thalamus, septum and olfactory bulb neurons are also partly derived from the LGE.

VT:0004278.name: caudal ganglionic eminence morphology trait
VT:0004278.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the caudally located, distinct elevation of a transient proliferating cell mass of the fetal subventricular zone, located adjacent to the lateral ventricle.

VT:0004280.name: oculomotor nucleus morphology trait
VT:0004280.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the group of motor neurons in the floor of the midbrain that gives rise to motor fibers of the oculomotor nerve.

VT:0004281.name: hypoglossal nucleus morphology trait
VT:0004281.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the group of motor neurons throughout most of the length of the medulla oblongata that give rise to the motor fibers of the hypoglossal nerve.

VT:0004284.name: Descemet membrane morphology trait
VT:0004284.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the transparent homogeneous acellular layer found between the substantia propria and the endothelial layer of the cornea, considered to be a highly developed basement membrane.
synonyms: amina limitans posterior corneae morphology trait
posterior limiting lamina of cornea morphology trait
posterior limiting layer of cornea morphology trait

VT:0004286.name: internal auditory canal morphology trait
VT:0004286.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the canal beginning at the opening of the internal acoustic meatus in the posterior cranial fossa, passing laterally through the petrous portion of the temporal bone to end at the fundus, where a thin plate of bone separates it from the vestibule; it gives passage to the facial and vestibulocochlear nerves together with the labyrinthine artery and veins.

VT:0004287.name: spiral limbus morphology trait
VT:0004287.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the border of the spiral lamina, i.e., the thickened periosteum covering the upper plate of the bony spiral lamina of the cochlea.
synonyms: limbus laminae spiralis osseae morphology trait

VT:0004288.name: spiral ligament morphology trait
VT:0004288.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the thickened periosteal lining of the bony cochlea that forms the outer wall of the cochlear duct to which the basal lamina attaches.
synonyms: ligamentum spirale ductus cochlearis morphology trait
spiral ligament of cochlea morphology trait
spiral ligament of cochlear duct morphology trait

VT:0004289.name: bony labyrinth morphology trait
VT:0004289.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the series of cavities (cochlea, vestibule, and semicircular canals) contained within the otic capsule of the petrous portion of the temporal bone; the bony labyrinth is filled with perilymph, in which the delicate, endolymph-filled membranous labyrinth is suspended.

VT:0004290.name: stapes footpiece morphology trait
VT:0004290.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the flat portion of the stapes that fits in the oval window.

VT:0004291.name: conductive hearing physiology trait
VT:0004291.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in sound conduction through the middle-ear apparatus, e.g., velocity transfer responses at the umbo or incus level during sound stimulation of the tympanic membrane.

VT:0004292.name: spiral ligament fibrocyte morphology trait
VT:0004292.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of any of the four types of fibrocytes (types I, II , III and IV) that constitute the spiral ligament.

VT:0004293.name: type I spiral ligament fibrocyte morphology trait
VT:0004293.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the type I spiral ligament fibrocytes which occupy the region beneath the stria vascularis.

VT:0004294.name: type II spiral ligament fibrocyte morphology trait
VT:0004294.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the type II spiral ligament fibrocytes found in the suprastrial zone and the central area of the spiral ligament beneath the spiral prominence.

VT:0004295.name: type III spiral ligament fibrocyte morphology trait
VT:0004295.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the type III spiral ligament fibrocytes which form a cell layer attached to the otic capsule.

VT:0004296.name: type IV spiral ligament fibrocyte morphology trait
VT:0004296.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the type IV spiral ligament fibrocytes found in the triangular space inferior to the basilar crest.

VT:0004297.name: proprioceptive neuron morphology trait
VT:0004297.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the sensory neurons of the dorsal root ganglia that sense body position and send information to the spinal cord about how much the muscle is stretched.

VT:0004300.name: organ of Corti supporting cell morphology trait
VT:0004300.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the highly differentiated epithelial cells with distinctive morphological features surrounding the hair cells in the organ of Corti; inner hair cells (IHCs) are normally surrounded by (inner and outer) phalangeal cells while OHCs are in contact with Deiters and pillar cells; Hensen cells are positioned further laterally in the organ of Corti.

VT:0004302.name: Deiters cell morphology trait
VT:0004302.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the supporting cells of the spiral organ which are attached to the basement membrane and receive the hair cells between their free extremities.

VT:0004303.name: Hensen cell morphology trait
VT:0004303.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the supporting cells that form the lateral border of the organ of Corti, immediately to the outer side of Deiters' cells.

VT:0004305.name: Rosenthal canal morphology trait
VT:0004305.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the winding tube of the bony labyrinth that makes two and a half turns about the modiolus of the cochlea; it is divided incompletely into two compartments by a winding shelf of bone, the bony spiral lamina.

VT:0004306.name: Rosenthal canal size trait
VT:0004306.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the winding tube of the bony labyrinth that makes two and a half turns about the modiolus of the cochlea.

VT:0004308.name: basilar membrane morphology trait
VT:0004308.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the membrane extending from the bony spiral membrane to the basilar crest of the cochlea; it forms the greater part of the floor of the cochlear duct separating the latter from the scala tympani, and it supports the organ of Corti.
synonyms: lamina basilaris ductus cochlearis morphology trait
morphology trait of the basilar membrane of cochlear duct

VT:0004310.name: otic vesicle size trait
VT:0004310.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the paired epithelial sacs formed from the otic placode that give rise to the structures of the inner ear.

VT:0004311.name: otic vesicle cell quantity
VT:0004311.def: The proportion or number of the cells in the paired epithelial sacs formed from the otic placode that give rise to the structures of the inner ear.

VT:0004313.name: vestibulocochlear ganglion size trait
VT:0004313.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the group of neuron cell bodies associated with the eighth cranial nerve during embryogenesis; splits in later development to form the cochlear and vestibular ganglia.

VT:0004316.name: saccule size trait
VT:0004316.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to physical magnitude of the smaller of the two sacs in the vestibule.

VT:0004320.name: sternum shape trait
VT:0004320.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical form or contours of the long, flat bone of the chest.

VT:0004321.name: sternum length
VT:0004321.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the long, flat bone of the chest.

VT:0004322.name: sternebra morphology trait
VT:0004322.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the segments of the primordial sternum of the embryo; these segments fuse to form the body of the adult vertebrate sternum.

VT:0004323.name: sternum size trait
VT:0004323.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the long, flat bone of the chest.

VT:0004326.name: vestibular hair cell quantity
VT:0004326.def: The proportion or numbers of the cells in the sensory epithelium of the maculae and cristae of the membranous labyrinth of the internal ear.

VT:0004330.name: saccular macula morphology trait
VT:0004330.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the oval neuroepithelial sensory receptor in the anterior wall of the saccule; hair cells of the neuroepithelium support the statoconial membrane and have terminal arborizations of vestibular nerve fibers around their bodies.

VT:0004333.name: utricular macula morphology trait
VT:0004333.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure or pattern of the neuroepithelial sensory receptor in the inferolateral wall of the utricle; hair cells of the neuroepithelium support the statoconial membrane and have terminal arborizations of vestibular nerve fibers around their bodies; normally sensitive to linear acceleration in the longitudinal axis of the body and to gravitational influences.

VT:0004335.name: utricle size trait
VT:0004335.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the larger of the two sacs in the vestibule.

VT:0004337.name: clavicle cell quantity
VT:0004337.def: The proportion or number of cells in one or both of the doubly curved long bones that form part of the shoulder girdle and articulate with the sternum and the scapula.

VT:0004338.name: clavicle size trait
VT:0004338.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of one or both of the doubly curved long bones that form part of the shoulder girdle and articulate with the sternum and the scapula.

VT:0004340.name: scapula length
VT:0004340.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of either or both of the large, flat bones of the shoulder girdle.

VT:0004343.name: scapula size trait
VT:0004343.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of either or both of the large, flat bones of the shoulder girdle.

VT:0004344.name: scapula bone cell quantity
VT:0004344.def: The proportion or number of bone cells in either or both of the large, flat bones of the shoulder girdle.

VT:0004345.name: acromion morphology trait
VT:0004345.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lateral extension of the spine of the scapula which projects as a broad flattened process and articulates with the clavicle, and forms the point of the shoulder.

VT:0004347.name: scapular spine morphology trait
VT:0004347.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the triangular ridge on the dorsal aspect of the scapula, which separates the supra- from the infraspinatous fossa and where the trapezius and deltoid muscles are attached.

VT:0004348.name: femur length
VT:0004348.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the long bone of the thigh.

VT:0004350.name: humerus length
VT:0004350.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the bone of the forelimb that articulates with the scapula above and the radius and ulna below.

VT:0004353.name: deltoid tuberosity morphology trait
VT:0004353.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the rough elevation at the middle of the lateral side of the shaft of the humerus to which the deltoid muscle attaches.

VT:0004355.name: radius length
VT:0004355.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the bone situated on the lateral side of the ulna in the forelimb.

VT:0004356.name: radius cell quantity
VT:0004356.def: The proportion or number of cells in the bone situated on the lateral side of the ulna in the forelimb.

VT:0004357.name: tibia length
VT:0004357.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the medial and larger of the two bones of the lower leg, which articulates with the femur, fibula, and talus.

VT:0004358.name: tibia curvature trait
VT:0004358.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the degree or shape of the bend in the medial and larger of the two bones of the lower leg, which articulates with the femur, fibula, and talus.

VT:0004361.name: ulna curvature trait
VT:0004361.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the degree or shape of the bend in the medial and larger of the two bones of the forearm or lower forelimb; fused with the radius in some species.

VT:0004364.name: stria vascularis size trait
VT:0004364.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the stratified, secretory epithelium which lines the upper part of the cochlear spiral ligament and maintains K+ homeostasis in the endolymph.

VT:0004365.name: strial basal cell morphology trait
VT:0004365.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, or pattern of the polarized cells which are juxtaposed to fibrocytes in the underlying spiral ligament.

VT:0004366.name: strial marginal cell morphology trait
VT:0004366.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the polarized columnar cells of epithelial origin which cover the lateral surface of the cochlear duct, secrete K+ and form a continuous sheet in contact with the endolymph; marginal cells form extensive interdigitations with the basal and intermediate cells in the normal adult stria.

VT:0004367.name: strial intermediate cell morphology trait
VT:0004367.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, or pattern of the melanocytes known to migrate from the neural crest during ontogeny to become located between the epithelial marginal cell layer and the mesodermal basal cell layer within the intrastrial space; the predominant cellular component of the electrogenic machinery that generates an endocochlear potential (80-100 mV).
synonyms: stria vascularis intermediate cell morphology trait

VT:0004368.name: stria vascularis blood vessel morphology trait
VT:0004368.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the blood vessels supplying the stria vascularis in the cochlea of the inner ear.
synonyms: morphology trait of the stria vascularis vasculature

VT:0004370.name: ulna length
VT:0004370.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the medial and larger of the two bones of the forearm or lower forelimb; fused with the radius in some species.

VT:0004371.name: femur curvature trait
VT:0004371.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the degree or shape of the bend in the long bone of the thigh.

VT:0004372.name: fibula curvature trait
VT:0004372.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the degree or shape of the bend in the lateral and smaller bone of the lower/hind limb.

VT:0004373.name: humerus curvature trait
VT:0004373.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the degree or shape of the bend in the bone of the forelimb that articulates with the scapula above and the radius and ulna below.

VT:0004374.name: radius curvature trait
VT:0004374.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the degree or shape of the bend in the bone situated on the lateral side of the ulna in the forelimb.

VT:0004387.name: prechordal plate morphology trait
VT:0004387.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the horseshoe-shaped thickening of the endoderm at the cranial (rostral) end of the primitive streak formed by the involution of Spemann's organizer cells which, together with the notochord, induces the formation of the neural plate from the overlying ectodermal cells and contributes mesodermal type cells to the surrounding tissue.

VT:0004389.name: respiratory bronchiole morphology trait
VT:0004389.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the smallest bronchioles, which connect the terminal bronchioles to alveolar ducts and have alveoli rising from their walls.

VT:0004390.name: bronchoalveolar duct junction morphology trait
VT:0004390.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the branch point connecting the respiratory bronchioles to the alveolar ducts.

VT:0004391.name: respiratory conducting tube morphology trait
VT:0004391.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the tubes of the respiratory system that allow passage of air from the trachea to the alveoli of the lungs.

VT:0004392.name: CD8-positive T cell physiology trait
VT:0004392.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the subset of T lymphocytes that express the CD8 marker on the cell surface.
synonyms: single positive T cell physiology trait

VT:0004393.name: cochlear inner hair cell morphology trait
VT:0004393.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the sensory cells of the organ of Corti which are in synaptic contact with sensory as well as efferent fibers of the auditory nerve; there is a single row of flask-shaped inner hair cells tightly surrounded by supporting interphalangeal cells; the apical end of each cell is anchored to the cuticular plate and about 100 stereocilia arranged in a more or less linear (or shallow) U-shaped pattern extend from the cell's surface through the cuticular plate into the endolymphic space inferior to the tectorial membrane.

VT:0004394.name: cochlear inner hair cell quantity
VT:0004394.def: The proportion or number of the flask-shaped inner hair sensory cells of the organ of Corti which are in synaptic contact with sensory as well as efferent fibers of the auditory nerve.

VT:0004399.name: cochlear outer hair cell morphology trait
VT:0004399.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the sensory cells of the organ of Corti which are in synaptic contact with sensory as well as efferent fibers of the auditory nerve; there are three rows of columnar outer hair cells largely surrounded by cortilymph and supporting phalangeal cells; the apical end of each cell is anchored to the cuticular plate and about 100 stereocilia arranged in a V-shaped pattern extend from the cell's surface through the cuticular plate into the tectorial membrane.

VT:0004400.name: cochlear outer hair cell quantity
VT:0004400.def: The proportion or number of the columnar outer hair sensory cells of the organ of Corti.

VT:0004406.name: cochlear hair cell quantity
VT:0004406.def: The proportion or number of the sensory epithelial cells of the cochlea, which are normally in synaptic contact with the auditory nerve.

VT:0004409.name: ampullary crest neuroepithelium morphology trait
VT:0004409.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the specialized sensory hair cells of the ampullary crest of the ampulla of each semicircular duct.

VT:0004412.name: cochlear potential trait
VT:0004412.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the bioelectric potentials produced by the hair cells of the organ of Corti in response to sound; cochlear microphonics faithfully represent the frequency and intensity of the acoustic stimulation.

VT:0004415.name: cochlear nerve compound action potential
VT:0004415.def: The combined potentials resulting from activation of the auditory division of the eighth cranial nerve.

VT:0004423.name: squama temporalis morphology trait
VT:0004423.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the thin, scale-like part of the temporal bone forming part of the lateral wall of the cranial vault.
synonyms: squamous part of temporal bone morphology trait

VT:0004425.name: otolith organ morphology trait
VT:0004425.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the utricle and saccule of the inner ear which possess otoliths and respond to linear acceleration and deceleration, including gravity.

VT:0004426.name: cochlear labyrinth morphology trait
VT:0004426.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the portion of the membranous labyrinth concerned with the sense of hearing (vs. the vestibular labyrinth, which is concerned with the sense of equilibration) and innervated by the cochlear nerve; it is located within the cochlea of the bony labyrinth, and consists of the cochlear duct, which contains the spiral organ.

VT:0004427.name: vestibular labyrinth morphology trait
VT:0004427.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the portion of the membranous labyrinth concerned with the sense of equilibration (vs. the cochlear labyrinth, which is concerned with the sense of hearing) and innervated by the vestibular nerve; it is located within the semicircular canals and vestibule of the bony labyrinth, and consists of the utricle, saccule, and the semicircular, utriculosaccular, and endolymphatic ducts.

VT:0004428.name: type I vestibular cell morphology trait
VT:0004428.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the flask-shaped sensory cells of the maculae and cristae of the vestibular labyrinth of the inner ear, which are normally enclosed in calyx endings of afferent neurons; afferent and efferent nerve fibers of the vestibular nerve synapse with them; from the apical end of each cell a bundle of stereocilia and a kinocilium extend into the otolithic membrane of the maculae or the cupula of the cristae.

VT:0004429.name: type II vestibular cell morphology trait
VT:0004429.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the cylindrical sensory cells of the maculae and cristae of the vestibular labyrinth of the inner ear which are normally contacted by bouton endings of afferent and efferent neurons; afferent and efferent nerve fibers of the vestibular nerve synapse with them; from the apical end of each cell a bundle of stereocilia and a kinocilium extend into the otolithic membrane of the maculae or the cupula of the cristae.

VT:0004430.name: Claudius cell morphology trait
VT:0004430.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the columnar cells located on the floor of the ductus cochlearis external to the spiral organ.

VT:0004431.name: hair cell mechanoelectric transduction trait
VT:0004431.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the conversion of mechanical energy into electric(al) energy by sensory cells, such as auditory and vestibular hair cells, required for auditory sensation.

VT:0004432.name: cochlear hair cell physiology trait
VT:0004432.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the cochlear hair cells, i.e., the sensory cells in the spiral organ which are in synaptic contact with sensory as well as efferent fibers of the cochlear (auditory) nerve.

VT:0004433.name: cochlear inner hair cell physiology trait
VT:0004433.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the cochlear IHCs which constitute the true sensory cell type sending impulses via the cochlear (auditory) nerve.

VT:0004434.name: cochlear outer hair cell physiology trait
VT:0004434.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the cochlear OHCs which are known to enhance the performance of the cochlea, both qualitatively (increased selectivity) and quantitatively (increased sensitivity); in addition to the mechanoelectric transduction required for auditory sensation, OHCs also perform electromechanical transduction, whereby transmembrane voltage drives rapid changes in the length and stiffness of OHCs at audio frequencies in vitro (electromotility).

VT:0004435.name: cochlear outer hair cell electromotility trait
VT:0004435.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the motility of the cochlear OHCs in response to electrical stimulation; normally, the motile response (i.e. rapid change in length and stiffness of OHCs) is closely coupled to the changing transduction current and provides a region-specific amplification in the movement of the spiral organ that enhances transduction at the IHCs in that specific region of the cochlear spiral, increasing both sensitivity and specificity; electromotility is believed to arise through voltage-gated conformational changes in motor protein (prestin) or proteins located in the lateral wall of the OHC.

VT:0004438.name: vestibular hair cell physiology trait
VT:0004438.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the sensory epithelium of the maculae and cristae in the membranous labyrinth of the inner ear.

VT:0004448.name: presphenoid bone morphology trait
VT:0004448.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the anterior part of the body of the sphenoid bone in front of the basisphenoid; it is usually a separate bone in the young or fetus, but becomes a part of the sphenoid in the adult.

VT:0004452.name: pterygoid process morphology trait
VT:0004452.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the process projecting downward from either side of the sphenoid bone, in vertebrates divided into two plates, an inner and an outer (sometimes called the lateral and medial); the posterior nares pass through the space, called the pterygoid fossa, between the processes.

VT:0004453.name: pterygoid bone morphology trait
VT:0004453.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bone region which corresponds to the inner plate of the pterygoid process of the mammalian skull.

VT:0004457.name: orbitosphenoid morphology trait
VT:0004457.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bone that is situated in the orbit on either side of the presphenoid; it generally forms a part of the sphenoid in the adult, and may be independent in the young.

VT:0004466.name: cochlear outer hair cell length
VT:0004466.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the cochlear outer hair cells.

VT:0004469.name: zygomatic arch morphology trait
VT:0004469.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bony arch in vertebrates that extends along the side or front of the skull beneath the eye socket and is formed by the temporal process of the zygomatic bone and the zygomatic process of the temporal bone.

VT:0004479.name: oval window morphology trait
VT:0004479.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the oval opening on the medial wall of the tympanic cavity leading into the vestibule, close to the foot of the stapes.
synonyms: morphology trait of the fenestra of the vestibule

VT:0004480.name: round window morphology trait
VT:0004480.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the opening on the medial wall of the middle ear leading into the cochlea, closed in life by the secondary tympanic membrane; serves to regulate fluid pressure in the inner ear.
synonyms: morphology trait of the fenestra of the cochlea

VT:0004481.name: conjunctival epithelium morphology trait
VT:0004481.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the conjunctival layer of epithelial cells covering inner surface of the eyelid and the front of the eyeball except over the cornea.

VT:0004482.name: interdental cell morphology trait
VT:0004482.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the long, spindle-shaped cells arranged in parallel rows, oriented with their vertical axis perpendicular to the luminal surface of the spiral limbus; they secrete K+ into the endolymph and secrete the tectoral membrane.

VT:0004491.name: outer hair cell stereociliary bundle orientation trait
VT:0004491.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the location or arrangement of outer hair cell (OHC) stereociliary bundles in relation to the hair cells.

VT:0004492.name: inner hair cell stereociliary bundle orientation trait
VT:0004492.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the location or arrangement of inner hair cell (IHC) stereociliary bundles in relation to the hair cells.

VT:0004493.name: cochlea size trait
VT:0004493.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the spiral-shaped bony canal in the inner ear containing the hair cells that transduce sound.

VT:0004762.name: blood anti-double stranded DNA antibody amount
VT:0004762.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of antibodies that recognize double stranded DNA.

VT:0004771.name: blood anti-single stranded DNA antibody amount
