VT:0004771.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of antibodies that recognize single stranded DNA.
synonyms: circulating anti-single stranded DNA antibody amount

VT:0004794.name: blood anti-nuclear antigen antibody amount
VT:0004794.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of antibodies to nuclear antigens.

VT:0004796.name: blood anti-histone antibody amount
VT:0004796.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of antibodies to histones.

VT:0004797.name: blood anti-erythrocyte antigen antibody amount
VT:0004797.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of antibodies to erythrocyte antigen.

VT:0004816.name: class switch recombination trait
VT:0004816.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the rearrangement of the heavy chain genes of differentiating B cells such that the initially encoded heavy chain IgM molecule is altered to one encoding IgG, IgA or IgE; normally, this allows the body to produce antibodies with different effector functions.

VT:0004829.name: blood anti-chromatin antibody amount
VT:0004829.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of antibodies that recognize chromatin.

VT:0004917.name: T cell selection trait
VT:0004917.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process through which T cells that express T cell receptors that are restricted by self MHC protein complexes and tolerant to self antigens are selected for further maturation.

VT:0004918.name: negative T cell selection trait
VT:0004918.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of elimination of immature T cells which react strongly with self-antigens.

VT:0004919.name: positive T cell selection trait
VT:0004919.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of sparing immature T cells which react with self-MHC protein complexes with low affinity levels from apoptotic death.

VT:0004939.name: B cell morphology trait
VT:0004939.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of lymphocytes of B lineage with the phenotype CD19-positive and capable of B cell-mediated immunity.

VT:0004940.name: B-1 B cell morphology trait
VT:0004940.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the subset of B cells found predominantly in the peritoneum, pleural cavities, and spleen, which are enriched for self-reactivity; B-1 B cells are thought to be the primary source of natural IgM immunoglobulin, that is, IgM produced in large quantities without prior antigenic stimulation and generally reactive against various microorganisms, as well as the source of T-independent IgA immunoglobulin in the mucosal areas.

VT:0004941.name: regulatory T cell morphology trait
VT:0004941.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the specialized subpopulation of T cells that act to suppress activation of the immune system and thus maintain immune system homeostasis and prevent pathological self-reactivity; these may include T cells that express the CD8 transmembrane glycoprotein (CD8-positive T cells), those that express CD4 and CD25 (CD4-positive, CD25-positive regulatory T cells or Tregs) and other T cell types that have suppressor function.

VT:0004942.name: B cell selection trait
VT:0004942.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process dependent upon B cell antigen receptor signaling in response to self or foreign antigen through which B cells are selected for survival.

VT:0004943.name: B cell positive selection trait
VT:0004943.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to any process by which B cells are selected to survive based on signaling through the B cell antigen receptor.

VT:0004944.name: B cell negative selection trait
VT:0004944.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process through which B cells which react strongly with self-antigens are eliminated, usually through anergy or deletion.

VT:0004946.name: regulatory T cell physiology trait
VT:0004946.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the specialized subpopulation of T cells that act to suppress activation of the immune system and thus maintain immune system homeostasis and prevent pathological self-reactivity; these may include T cells that express the CD8 transmembrane glycoprotein (CD8-positive T cells), those that express CD4 and CD25 (CD4-positive, CD25-positive regulatory T cells or Tregs) and other T cell types that have suppressor function.

VT:0004951.name: spleen mass
VT:0004951.def: The amount of matter in the organ that functions to filter blood and to store red corpuscles and platelets.

VT:0004954.name: thymus mass
VT:0004954.def: The amount of matter in the primary lymphoid organ that is required for maturation of T cells.

VT:0004972.name: regulatory T cell quantity
VT:0004972.def: The proportion or number of the specialized subpopulation of T cells that act to suppress activation of the immune system and thus maintain immune system homeostasis and prevent pathological self-reactivity.

VT:0004976.name: B-1 B cell quantity
VT:0004976.def: The proportion or number of the subset of B cells found predominantly in the peritoneum, pleural cavities, and spleen, which are enriched for self-reactivity; B-1 B cells are thought to be the primary source of natural IgM immunoglobulin, that is, IgM produced in large quantities without prior antigenic stimulation and generally reactive against various microorganisms, as well as the source of T-independent IgA immunoglobulin in the mucosal areas.

VT:0004995.name: B cell clonal deletion trait
VT:0004995.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of removal by apoptosis of immature B lymphocytes that interact with self antigens during maturation.

VT:0005000.name: immune tolerance trait
VT:0005000.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process that directly activates any of the steps required for tolerance, a physiologic state in which the immune system does not react destructively against the components of an organism that harbors it or against antigens that are introduced to it.

VT:0005001.name: clonal deletion trait
VT:0005001.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of removal of immature lymphocytes that interact with self antigens during maturation.

VT:0005002.name: T cell clonal deletion trait
VT:0005002.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of removal of immature T lymphocytes that interact with self antigens during maturation.

VT:0005004.name: lymphocyte anergy trait
VT:0005004.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of establishing a state of functional inactivation of self-reactive lymphocytes.

VT:0005005.name: self tolerance trait
VT:0005005.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the response to autologous (self) antigens.

VT:0005006.name: osteoblast physiology trait
VT:0005006.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in this bone-forming cell, which normally forms an osseous matrix in which it becomes enclosed as an osteocyte.

VT:0005007.name: bone mineral mass
VT:0005007.def: The amount of matter in the minerals (inorganic elements or compounds that have importance in body functions) in osseous tissue forming a part of the skeleton.

VT:0005008.name: osteoblast development trait
VT:0005008.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of this bone-forming cell, which normally forms an osseous matrix in which it becomes enclosed as an osteocyte.

VT:0005010.name: CD8-positive T cell morphology trait
VT:0005010.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the regulatory subset of T lymphocytes that are involved in MHC class I restricted interactions.
synonyms: single positive T cell morphology trait

VT:0005019.name: early pro-B cell morphology trait
VT:0005019.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of cells in the B lymphocyte lineage that undergo D-J rearrangement of the immunoglobulin heavy chain.

VT:0005020.name: late pro-B cell morphology trait
VT:0005020.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells in the B lymphocyte lineage that undergo V-DJ rearrangement of the immunoglobulin heavy chain.

VT:0005022.name: immature B cell morphology trait
VT:0005022.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells of the B lymphocyte lineage that have undergone VDJ rearrangement of the heavy chain and V-J rearrangement of the light chain; these cells express IgM on the cell surface but have not yet been selected for self-reactivity.

VT:0005028.name: trophectoderm morphology trait
VT:0005028.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the outermost layer of cells in the blastodermic vesicle, which will develop into the trophoblast layer and then contact the endometrium and take part in establishing the mammalian embryo's means of nutrition.

VT:0005029.name: amnion morphology trait
VT:0005029.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the innermost layer of the extraembryonic membranes.

VT:0005031.name: trophoblast layer morphology trait
VT:0005031.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the mesectodermal cell layer arising from the trophectoderm that erodes the uterine mucosa and contributes to the formation of the placenta.

VT:0005032.name: ectoplacental cone morphology trait
VT:0005032.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the thickened trophoblast of the blastocyst in rodents that becomes the fetal portion of the placenta.

VT:0005033.name: trophoblast giant cell morphology trait
VT:0005033.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells covering the blastocyst that erode the uterine mucosa and contribute to the formation of the placenta.

VT:0005034.name: anus morphology trait
VT:0005034.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the lower opening of the digestive tract.

VT:0005045.name: thymus cortex area
VT:0005045.def: The two-dimensional extent of the outer part of a thymus lobule that surrounds the medulla and is composed of closely packed lymphocytes.

VT:0005061.name: eosinophil morphology trait
VT:0005061.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the immature or mature form of a granular leukocyte with a nucleus that usually has two lobes connected by one or more slender threads of chromatin, and cytoplasm containing coarse, round granules that are uniform in size and which can be stained by the dye eosin; involved in clearance of parasitic infections and in allergic reactions.

VT:0005065.name: neutrophil morphology trait
VT:0005065.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the immature or mature forms of a granular leukocyte that in its mature form has a nucleus with three to five lobes connected by slender threads of chromatin, and cytoplasm containing fine inconspicuous granules and stainable by neutral dyes.

VT:0005068.name: natural killer cell morphology trait
VT:0005068.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of non-T, non-B lymphocytes, having a granular morphology and which are important in innate immunity to viruses and other intracellular pathogens; in addition, these cells can kill certain tumor cells.

VT:0005069.name: natural killer cell physiology trait
VT:0005069.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in non-T, non-B lymphocytes, having a granular morphology and which are important in innate immunity to viruses and other intracellular pathogens; in addition, these cells can kill certain tumor cells.

VT:0005070.name: natural killer cell cytolysis trait
VT:0005070.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of natural killer cells to induce pathological breakdown of target cells by the destruction of their outer membrane.

VT:0005073.name: granulocyte migration trait
VT:0005073.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the directed and orderly movement of cells with abundant granules in the cytoplasm, including neutrophils, eosinophils, or basophils, from point to point.

VT:0005074.name: granulocyte bactericidal activity
VT:0005074.def: The degree of function or response of neutrophils, eosinophils, or basophils in the killing of bacteria.

VT:0005078.name: cytotoxic T cell physiology trait
VT:0005078.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the subset of CD8-positive T lymphocytes capable of directly killing appropriately targeted cells.

VT:0005079.name: cytotoxic T cell cytolysis trait
VT:0005079.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of cytotoxic T cells to induce pathological breakdown of target cells by the destruction of their outer membrane.

VT:0005081.name: dermis stratum reticulare morphology trait
VT:0005081.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the inner layer of the dermis, consisting chiefly of dense fibrous tissue.

VT:0005082.name: epidermis stratum lucidum morphology trait
VT:0005082.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the clear, translucent layer of the epidermis in the deepest level of the stratum corneum.

VT:0005083.name: biliary tract morphology trait
VT:0005083.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the gall bladder or its ducts.

VT:0005084.name: gall bladder morphology trait
VT:0005084.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the organ which serves as a storage reservoir for bile.

VT:0005085.name: gall bladder physiology trait
VT:0005085.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the organ that stores and concentrates bile.

VT:0005086.name: bile amount
VT:0005086.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the bitter, alkaline, brownish-yellow or greenish-yellow fluid that is secreted by the liver, stored in the gallbladder, and discharged into the duodenum and aids in the emulsification, digestion, and absorption of fats.

VT:0005089.name: double-negative T cell quantity
VT:0005089.def: The proportion or numbers of the subset of T cells found in the thymus that express neither CD4 nor CD8.

VT:0005092.name: double-positive T cell quantity
VT:0005092.def: The proportion or number of the subset of T cells found in the thymus that express both CD4 and CD8.

VT:0005096.name: erythroblast quantity
VT:0005096.def: The proportion or number of nucleated red blood cells.

VT:0005098.name: choroid morphology trait
VT:0005098.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the thin, highly vascularized membrane covering most of the posterior of the eye between the retina and the sclera.

VT:0005099.name: ciliary body morphology trait
VT:0005099.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the thickened portion of the vascular tunic, which lies between the choroid and the iris.

VT:0005100.name: choroid pigmentation trait
VT:0005100.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the deposition or aggregation of coloring matter in the thin, highly vascularized membrane covering most of the posterior of the eye between the retina and the sclera.

VT:0005102.name: iris pigmentation trait
VT:0005102.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the deposition or aggregation of coloring matter in the adjustable membrane, composed of the stroma and pigmented epithelium, located just in front of the crystalline lens within the eye.

VT:0005104.name: tarsus morphology trait
VT:0005104.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the bones of the lower/hind limb between the tibia and fibula and the metatarsus.

VT:0005105.name: auditory ossicle morphology trait
VT:0005105.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the small bones of the middle ear.

VT:0005106.name: incus morphology trait
VT:0005106.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the middle of the three auditory ossicles.

VT:0005107.name: stapes morphology trait
VT:0005107.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the smallest and innermost of the three auditory ossicles.

VT:0005108.name: ulna morphology trait
VT:0005108.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the medial and larger of the two bones of the forearm or lower forelimb; fused with the radius in some species.

VT:0005109.name: talus morphology trait
VT:0005109.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the tarsal bone that articulates with the tibia and fibula.

VT:0005110.name: talus size trait
VT:0005110.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the tarsal bone that articulates with the tibia and fibula.

VT:0005112.name: anterior horn morphology trait
VT:0005112.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the ventral gray column of the spinal cord.

VT:0005113.name: anterior horn cell quantity
VT:0005113.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or number of cells in the ventral gray column of the spinal cord.

VT:0005116.name: blood pituitary hormone amount
VT:0005116.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of any of the hormones secreted by the pituitary.

VT:0005119.name: blood thyroid-stimulating hormone amount
VT:0005119.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the hormone that stimulates the growth and function of the thyroid gland.

VT:0005120.name: blood growth hormone amount
VT:0005120.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the hormone that promotes body growth, fat mobilization, and inhibition of glucose utilization.
synonyms: serum levels of pituitary growth hormone

VT:0005121.name: blood prolactin amount
VT:0005121.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the hormone that stimulates milk secretion.

VT:0005144.name: blood VLDL cholesterol amount
VT:0005144.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the lipoprotein:cholesterol complex that normally transports triglycerides from the intestine and liver to muscle and adipose tissue.
synonyms: blood very low density lipoprotein cholesterol amount

VT:0005149.name: gubernaculum morphology trait
VT:0005149.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the genitoinguinal ligaments that, in the male, connect the fetal testis to the developing scrotum, and, in the female, connect the ovaries to the uterus.

VT:0005153.name: B cell proliferation trait
VT:0005153.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which the B cell population undergoes expansion by cell division.

VT:0005158.name: ovary cell quantity
VT:0005158.def: The proportion or number of cells in the female reproductive gland containing the germ cells.

VT:0005160.name: urine protein amount
VT:0005160.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of macromolecules consisting of long chains of amino acids in peptide linkage in the urine.

VT:0005168.name: female meiosis trait
VT:0005168.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of nuclear division that results in ova with one half the normal chromosome number of the original cell.

VT:0005169.name: male meiosis trait
VT:0005169.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of nuclear division that results in sperm with one half the normal chromosome number of the original cell.

VT:0005180.name: blood testosterone amount
VT:0005180.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a potent androgen that promotes development of male secondary sex characteristics and the development of spermatozoa and may regulate sexual desire and help maintain bone and muscle health in both males and females.

VT:0005183.name: blood estradiol amount
VT:0005183.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this most potent estrogen.

VT:0005184.name: blood progesterone amount
VT:0005184.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this anti-estrogenic steroid.

VT:0005187.name: penis morphology trait
VT:0005187.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the organ of copulation and urination in the male.

VT:0005189.name: perineum length
VT:0005189.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the space between the genitals and the anus.

VT:0005193.name: anterior eye segment morphology trait
VT:0005193.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the parts of the eye that lie in front of, or ventral to, the lens (inclusive).

VT:0005194.name: anterior uvea morphology trait
VT:0005194.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the front, or ventral, portion of the vascular, pigmentary, or middle coat of the eye, including the ciliary body and the iris.
synonyms: vascular layer of the eyeball morphology trait
vascular tunic of the eye morphology trait

VT:0005195.name: posterior eye segment morphology trait
VT:0005195.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of any of the parts of the eye that lie in back of, or dorsal to, the lens (but not inclusive).

VT:0005196.name: posterior uvea morphology trait
VT:0005196.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the rear, or dorsal, portion of the vascular, pigmentary, or middle coat of the eye, includes the choroid.
synonyms: morphology trait of the vascular layer of the eyeball
vascular tunic of the eye morphology trait

VT:0005197.name: uvea morphology trait
VT:0005197.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the pigmented vascular coat of the eyeball, consisting of the iris, ciliary body, and choroid.
synonyms: morphology trait of the vascular layer of the eyeball

VT:0005198.name: aqueous drainage system morphology trait
VT:0005198.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the structures associated with drainage of the aqueous humor from the eye, these include the trabecular meshwork, Schlemm's canal, the uveoscleral network, and the aqueous veins.

VT:0005201.name: retinal pigment epithelium morphology trait
VT:0005201.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the epithelial layer of the retina composed of cells containing pigment granules.

VT:0005203.name: trabecular meshwork morphology trait
VT:0005203.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the pore-like structure surrounding the entire circumference of the anterior chamber through which aqueous humor circulates.

VT:0005204.name: canal of Schlemm morphology trait
VT:0005204.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the vascular structure encircling the anterior chamber of the eye, through which the aqueous humor is returned to the blood circulation.
synonyms: venous sinus of sclera morphology trait

VT:0005205.name: eye anterior chamber morphology trait
VT:0005205.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the space in the eye, filled with aqueous humor, and bounded anteriorly by the cornea and a small portion of the sclera and posteriorly by a small portion of the ciliary body, the iris, and part of the crystalline lens.

VT:0005206.name: aqueous humor morphology trait
VT:0005206.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the clear, watery fluid that fills the anterior and possibly posterior chambers of the eye.

VT:0005207.name: aqueous vein morphology trait
VT:0005207.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the vessel that receives aqueous humor from the sinus venosus sclerae (canal of Schlemm).

VT:0005208.name: iris stroma morphology trait
VT:0005208.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the lamellated connective tissue of the iris.

VT:0005209.name: gastric mucosa morphology trait
VT:0005209.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the surface epithelium of the stomach, which is made up of several different cell types.

VT:0005211.name: gastric mucosa thickness
VT:0005211.def: The distance between the surfaces of the epithelial layer of the stomach.

VT:0005215.name: islet of Langerhans morphology trait
VT:0005215.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the cellular masses consisting of several to several hundred cells in the interstitial tissue of the pancreas; they are composed of five different cell types that make up the endocrine portion of the pancreas.

VT:0005216.name: pancreatic alpha cell morphology trait
VT:0005216.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the cells of the pancreas that secrete glucagon.

VT:0005217.name: pancreatic beta cell morphology trait
VT:0005217.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the cells of the pancreas that secrete insulin.

VT:0005218.name: pancreatic delta cell morphology trait
VT:0005218.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the cells found in the pancreas and gastrointestinal tract that secrete somatostatin.

VT:0005220.name: exocrine pancreas morphology trait
VT:0005220.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the acinar gland portion of the pancreas that secretes digestive enzymes.

VT:0005221.name: rostral-caudal axis patterning trait
VT:0005221.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the establishment, maintenance, and elaboration of a pattern along the axis that runs from the head to the tail of the body.

VT:0005222.name: somite size trait
VT:0005222.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of any of the paired, metamerically arranged cell masses formed in the embryonic paraxial mesoderm.

VT:0005223.name: rostral-caudal axis somite development trait
VT:0005223.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the somites along the axis that runs from the rostral to the caudal region of the body.

VT:0005224.name: left-right axis somite development trait
VT:0005224.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the somites along the axis that runs from the left to the right side of the body.
synonyms: left-right axis symmetry of the somites

VT:0005225.name: vertebra development trait
VT:0005225.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the bony segments of the spinal column during their formation and differentiation.

VT:0005226.name: vertebral arch development trait
VT:0005226.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the posterior projection from the body of a vertebra that encloses the vertebral foramen.

VT:0005227.name: vertebral body development trait
VT:0005227.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the main portion of the vertebra anterior to the vertebral canal, and distinct from the vertebral arch, during its formation and differentiation.

VT:0005228.name: vertebral body/neural arch fusion trait
VT:0005228.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the joining of the main portion of the vertebra anterior to the vertebral canal and the posterior element of a developing vertebra, which will become the vertebral arch and the posterolateral portion of the vertebral body.

VT:0005229.name: intervertebral disk development trait
VT:0005229.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the cartilaginous and gelatinous structures found between the bodies of adjacent vertebrae.

VT:0005231.name: brachial lymph node morphology trait
VT:0005231.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lymph nodes located along the brachial vein that receive drainage from most of the free upper limb and send efferent vessels to the central axillary lymph nodes.
synonyms: humeral axillary lymph node morphology trait

VT:0005232.name: mesenteric lymph node morphology trait
VT:0005232.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lymph nodes located in the mesentery, of which there are 3 classes: ileocolic, juxtaintestinal mesenteric, and central superior group.

VT:0005235.name: olfactory lobe morphology trait
VT:0005235.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the composite substructure of the telencephalon that is identified with olfaction; in humans this includes the olfactory tract, the anterior olfactory nucleus, the olfactory tubercle, the medial olfactory stria, the lateral olfactory stria, parts of the amygdala and the prepyriform area.

VT:0005236.name: olfactory nerve morphology trait
VT:0005236.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the first cranial nerve, which conveys the sense of smell.

VT:0005237.name: olfactory tract morphology trait
VT:0005237.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the nerve-like, white band composed primarily of nerve fibers originating from the mitral cells and tufted cells of the olfactory bulb, but also containing the scattered cells of the anterior olfactory nucleus.

VT:0005239.name: Bruch membrane morphology trait
VT:0005239.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the transparent, nearly structureless inner layer of the choroid in contact with the pigmented layer of the retina.
synonyms: morphology trait of the basal lamina of the choroid
morphology trait of the basal layer of the choroid

VT:0005240.name: amacrine cell morphology trait
VT:0005240.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of one of the three types of interneurons found in the inner nuclear layer of the mature retina; they integrate, modulate, and interpose a temporal domain in the visual message presented to the retinal ganglion cells, with which they synapse in the inner plexiform layer.

VT:0005241.name: retinal ganglion layer morphology trait
VT:0005241.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the innermost nuclear layer of the retina, which projects axons through the optic nerve to the brain.

VT:0005246.name: orbit morphology trait
VT:0005246.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bony cavity that contains the eyeball or of any of the parts of the bones which form the cavity.

VT:0005247.name: extraocular muscle morphology trait
VT:0005247.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of any of the striated muscles that move the eye and include: superior rectus, inferior rectus, medial rectus, lateral rectus, superior oblique, inferior oblique, retractor bulbi, levator palpebrae superioris.

VT:0005248.name: Harderian gland morphology trait
VT:0005248.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the gland located behind the eyeball in some species that excretes fluid that facilitates movement of the nictitating membrane.

VT:0005249.name: palatine bone morphology trait
VT:0005249.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of either of two irregularly shaped bones that form the back of the hard palate and help to form the nasal cavity and the floor of the orbits.

VT:0005250.name: Sertoli cell quantity
VT:0005250.def: The proportion or number of cells of the seminiferous tubules that create the blood-testes barrier and enable spermatogenesis.

VT:0005252.name: meibomian gland morphology trait
VT:0005252.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of sebaceous glands embedded in the tarsal plate of each eyelid.

VT:0005253.name: eye physiology trait
VT:0005253.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the organ of vision and its supporting structures.

VT:0005254.name: visual axis alignment trait
VT:0005254.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the alignment of the visual axes of the eyes.

VT:0005257.name: intraocular pressure
VT:0005257.def: The amount of force per unit area exerted by the intraocular fluid within the eye.

VT:0005265.name: blood urea nitrogen amount
VT:0005265.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of nitrogen, in the form of urea, in whole blood, serum, or plasma; commonly used to measure renal function.

VT:0005267.name: olfactory cortex morphology trait
VT:0005267.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the piriform cortex, part of the olfactory tract, which receives its major afferents from the olfactory bulb, and is primarily responsible for the identification of odors.

VT:0005269.name: occipital bone morphology trait
VT:0005269.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bone at the lower, posterior part of the skull.

VT:0005270.name: zygomatic bone morphology trait
VT:0005270.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the quadrilateral bone that forms the prominence of the cheek, the lateral wall and margin of the orbit, and the anterior two thirds of the zygomatic arch.

VT:0005271.name: lacrimal bone morphology trait
VT:0005271.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the irregularly thin plate that forms part of the medial wall of the orbit behind the frontal process of the maxilla.

VT:0005272.name: temporal bone morphology trait
VT:0005272.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the large, irregular bone located at the base and side of the skull; consists of three parts which are distinct at birth: squamous, tympanic, and petrous.

VT:0005273.name: cranial base morphology trait
VT:0005273.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bones that form the floor of the cranial cavity.
synonyms: morphology trait of the base of skull

VT:0005274.name: viscerocranium morphology trait
VT:0005274.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the part of the skull that comprises the facial bones.

VT:0005275.name: skin tensile strength trait
VT:0005275.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the membranous protective covering of the body to withstand applied tension without tearing.

VT:0005277.name: brainstem morphology trait
VT:0005277.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the midbrain, pons, or medulla.

VT:0005278.name: cholesterol homeostasis trait
VT:0005278.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the state of equilibrium in the body of these most abundant steroids in animal tissues, and precursors to steroid hormones and bile salts; also components of plasma membranes.

VT:0005280.name: adipose fatty acid amount
VT:0005280.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of organic, monobasic acids derived from hydrocarbons present in fat-storing cells/tissue; they are saturated and unsaturated.

VT:0005285.name: adipose unsaturated fatty acid amount
VT:0005285.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of organic, monobasic acids derived from hydrocarbons present in fat-storing cells/tissue; the carbon chain has one or more double or triple carbon-carbon bonds.

VT:0005286.name: adipose saturated fatty acid amount
VT:0005286.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of organic, monobasic acids derived from hydrocarbons present in fat-storing cells/tissue; the carbon chain contains only single carbon-carbon bonds.

VT:0005294.name: heart ventricle morphology trait
VT:0005294.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the lower chamber(s) of the heart.

VT:0005296.name: humerus morphology trait
VT:0005296.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the bone of the forelimb that articulates with the scapula above and the radius and ulna below.

VT:0005298.name: clavicle morphology trait
VT:0005298.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of one or both of the doubly curved long bones that form part of the shoulder girdle and articulate with the sternum and the scapula.

VT:0005299.name: eye posterior chamber morphology trait
VT:0005299.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the ring-like space, filled with aqueous humor, between the iris/pupil anteriorly and the lens and ciliary body posteriorly.

VT:0005300.name: corneal stroma morphology trait
VT:0005300.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the lamellated connective tissue of the cornea.

VT:0005301.name: corneal endothelium morphology trait
VT:0005301.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the single layer of large flattened cells that cover the surface of the cornea.

VT:0005303.name: urinary bladder physiology trait
VT:0005303.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the distensible musculomembranous bag for holding urine.

VT:0005305.name: coagulating gland size trait
VT:0005305.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the anterior lobe of the prostate.

VT:0005306.name: phalanx morphology trait
VT:0005306.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the long bones of the digits.

VT:0005308.name: blood ammonia amount
VT:0005308.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this colorless alkaline gas, formed in the body during organic decomposition.

VT:0005310.name: salivary gland physiology trait
VT:0005310.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes in any of the glands in the mouth that secrete saliva.

VT:0005311.name: blood amino acid amount
VT:0005311.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the organic compounds, which, when polymerized, form proteins.

VT:0005316.name: obsolete tactition trait
VT:0005316.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the series of events required for an organism to receive a touch stimulus, convert it to a molecular signal, and recognize and characterize the signal.\nReplace with VT:0015099

VT:0005325.name: kidney glomerulus morphology trait
VT:0005325.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the capillary loops at the beginning of each nephric tubule in the kidney.

VT:0005326.name: podocyte morphology trait
VT:0005326.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the epithelial cells of the glomerulus, attached to the outer surface of the glomerular capillary basement membrane by cytoplasmic foot processes.

VT:0005327.name: mesangial cell morphology trait
VT:0005327.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the phagocytic cells in the capillary tuft of the renal glomerulus, interposed between endothelial cells and the basement membrane in the central or stalk region of the tuft.

VT:0005328.name: blood creatinine amount
VT:0005328.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this product of creatine catabolism.

VT:0005329.name: heart muscle morphology trait
VT:0005329.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the striated, involuntary muscle comprising the myocardium.

VT:0005334.name: fat pad morphology trait
VT:0005334.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the encapsulated adipose tissue.

VT:0005335.name: gonadal fat pad morphology trait
VT:0005335.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the ovaries or testes.

VT:0005336.name: inguinal fat pad morphology trait
VT:0005336.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the encapsulated adipose tissue found in the groin.

VT:0005337.name: retroperitoneal fat pad morphology trait
VT:0005337.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the encapsulated adipose tissue found on the dorsal/posterior side of the serous membrane lining the abdominal cavity and covering most of the viscera.

VT:0005342.name: lipid absorption trait
VT:0005342.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the body to take in fat-soluble substances (molecules composed of carbon and hydrogen and characteristically insoluble in water).

VT:0005345.name: blood corticosterone amount
VT:0005345.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this adrenocortical steroid; induces glycogen deposition and regulates sodium conservation and potassium secretion.

VT:0005346.name: blood aldosterone amount
VT:0005346.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this hormone, secreted by the adrenal cortex; regulates sodium conservation and potassium secretion in the distal renal tubule.

VT:0005353.name: patella morphology trait
VT:0005353.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the large sesamoid bone that articulates with the femur and, in some species, covers the anterior surface of the knee.

VT:0005354.name: ilium morphology trait
VT:0005354.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the broad, flaring portion of the hip bone, which fuses with the ischium and the pubis.

VT:0005355.name: thyroid gland size trait
VT:0005355.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the two-lobed endocrine gland found in all vertebrates, located in front of and on either side of the trachea in humans, that produces various hormones, such as triiodothyronine and calcitonin.

VT:0005358.name: incisor morphology trait
VT:0005358.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the teeth that are most anterior and prominent in the jaw.

VT:0005359.name: incisor growth trait
VT:0005359.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the increase in size of the long pointed teeth, most anterior and prominent in the jaw.

VT:0005361.name: pituitary gland size trait
VT:0005361.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the pituitary gland, the compound gland suspended from the base of the hypothalamus, which secretes somatotropins, prolactin, TSH (thyroid-stimulating hormone), gonadotropins, adrenal corticotropin, and other related peptides.

VT:0005362.name: Langerhans cell physiology trait
VT:0005362.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the stellate dendritic cell of myeloid origin, that appears clear on light microscopy and has a dark-staining, indented nucleus and characteristic inclusions (Birbeck granules) in the cytoplasm; Langerhans cells are found principally in the stratum spinosum of the epidermis, but they also occur in other stratified epithelia and have been identified in the lung, lymph nodes, spleen, and thymus.

VT:0005369.name: muscular system trait
VT:0005369.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement of an organ or part of the body.

VT:0005372.name: life span trait
VT:0005372.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic pertaining to the period of time an organism survives or is expected to survive or maintains or is expected to maintain a specific function.

VT:0005380.name: embryonic development trait
VT:0005380.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of an embryo during the progression from its formation until the end of its embryonic life stage.

VT:0005382.name: head trait
VT:0005382.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the portion of the body containing the brain and organs of sight, hearing, taste, and smell.

VT:0005388.name: respiratory system trait
VT:0005388.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of the system responsible for the exchange of oxygen and carbon dioxide with the environment.

VT:0005389.name: reproductive system trait
VT:0005389.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of the organs associated with producing offspring.

VT:0005391.name: vision system trait
VT:0005391.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to see.

VT:0005392.name: nociception system trait
VT:0005392.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the series of events required for an organism to sense pain, or to the morphology of the structures involved in any of these events.

VT:0005394.name: olfactory system trait
VT:0005394.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the series of events required for an organism to receive an olfactory stimulus, convert it to a molecular signal, and recognize and characterize the signal, or to the morphology of the structures involved in any of these events.

VT:0005402.name: action potential trait
VT:0005402.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the change in electrical potential of a neuron or muscle fiber when stimulated above its threshold potential.

VT:0005403.name: nerve conduction trait
VT:0005403.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the act of transmitting electricity along a single nerve.

VT:0005404.name: axon morphology trait
VT:0005404.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the single process of a nerve cell that normally conducts impulses away from the cell body.

VT:0005406.name: heart size trait
VT:0005406.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the organ that pumps blood through the body or any of its component structures.

VT:0005410.name: fertilization trait
VT:0005410.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process beginning with penetration of the secondary oocyte by the sperm and completed by fusion of the male and female pronuclei.

VT:0005416.name: blood protein amount
VT:0005416.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of any of the macromolecules consisting of long chains of amino acids in peptide linkage.

VT:0005418.name: blood hormone amount
VT:0005418.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of any of the chemical substances that have specific regulatory effects on the activity of a certain organ or organs; originally applied to substances secreted by various endocrine glands and transported in the bloodstream to the target organs, it is sometimes extended to include substances that are not produced by the endocrine glands but that have similar effects.

VT:0005423.name: somatic nervous system physiology trait
VT:0005423.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the part of the peripheral nervous system that is responsible for conveying voluntary motor and external sensory information, including all nerves controlling the skeletal muscular system and external sensory receptors.

VT:0005424.name: body movement coordination trait
VT:0005424.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to skillful and effective interaction of motions of the whole body or a portion of the body.

VT:0005425.name: macrophage quantity
VT:0005425.def: The proportion or numbers of the large mononuclear phagocytes which differentiate from monocytes, are typically resident in a particular tissue, and are capable of phagocytosing a variety of extracellular particulate material, including immune complexes, microorganisms, and dead cells.

VT:0005431.name: oocyte quantity
VT:0005431.def: The proportion or number of female germ cells that have entered meiosis.

VT:0005432.name: pro-B cell morphology trait
VT:0005432.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the progenitor cells of the B cell lineage, with some lineage specific activity such as early stages of recombination of B cell receptor genes, but are not yet fully committed to the B cell lineage until the expression of PAX5 occurs.

VT:0005437.name: blood glycogen amount
VT:0005437.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the polysaccharide which is the storage form for glucose in the liver and muscles; readily converted to glucose when blood glucose level decreases.

VT:0005442.name: cerebral cortex pyramidal cell morphology trait
VT:0005442.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the projection neurons in the pyramidal cell layer of the cerebral cortex.
synonyms: cerebral cortex projection neuron morphology trait
cerebral cortex pyramidal neuron morphology trait

VT:0005443.name: ethanol metabolism trait
VT:0005443.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to metabolize the clear, colorless liquid that is the primary ingredient in alcoholic beverages.

VT:0005444.name: retinol metabolism trait
VT:0005444.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the chemical reactions and pathways involving retinol, one of the three compounds that makes up vitamin A; retinol plays an essential role in metabolic functioning of the retina, the growth of and differentiation of epithelial tissue, the growth of bone, reproduction, and the immune response.

VT:0005445.name: neurotransmitter release trait
VT:0005445.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the secretion of endogenous signaling molecules into a synaptic cleft; neurotransmitters are released from presynaptic neurons and travel across the synaptic cleft to either excite or inhibit the target cell.

VT:0005446.name: synaptic epinephrine release trait
VT:0005446.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the secretion across synapses of the active sympathomimetic hormone that stimulates both the alpha- and beta- adrenergic systems, causes systemic vasoconstriction and gastrointestinal relaxation, stimulates the heart, and dilates bronchi and cerebral vessels.

VT:0005447.name: synaptic norepinephrine release trait
VT:0005447.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the secretion across synapses of this widespread central and autonomic neurotransmitter, the principal transmitter of most postganglionic sympathetic fibers and of the diffuse projection system in the brain arising from the locus ceruleus.

VT:0005448.name: energy balance trait
VT:0005448.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the equilibrium between intake and expenditure of calories.

VT:0005450.name: energy expenditure trait
VT:0005450.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the utilization of calories.

VT:0005452.name: adipose amount
VT:0005452.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of fat-storing cells/tissue.

VT:0005460.name: leukopoiesis trait
VT:0005460.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of generating white blood cells (leukocytes) from the pluripotent hematopoietic stem cells of the bone marrow; two significant pathways generate various types of leukocytes: myelopoiesis, in which leukocytes in the blood are derived from myeloid stem cells, and lymphopoiesis, in which leukocytes of the lymphatic system (lymphocytes) are generated from lymphoid stem cells.

VT:0005461.name: dendritic cell morphology trait
VT:0005461.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a cell of hematopoietic origin, typically resident in particular tissues, specialized in the uptake, processing, and transport of antigens to lymph nodes for the purpose of stimulating an immune response via T cell activation.

VT:0005462.name: mast cell development trait
VT:0005462.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of a cell that is found in almost all tissues, containing numerous basophilic granules and capable of releasing large amounts of histamine and heparin upon activation.

VT:0005463.name: CD4-positive T cell physiology trait
VT:0005463.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the subset of T lymphocytes that carry the CD4 marker, recognize intravesicular peptides bound to MHC class-II molecules, and turn on antibody production.
synonyms: single positive T cell physiology trait

VT:0005464.name: platelet physiology trait
VT:0005464.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the disc-like fragments of megakaryocytes that are found in the blood and function in clotting.

VT:0005465.name: T-helper 1 physiology trait
VT:0005465.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the type of T-helper cell whose cytokine production favors cellular immune responses and delayed type hypersensitivity.

VT:0005466.name: T-helper 2 physiology trait
VT:0005466.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the type of T-helper cell whose cytokine production promotes defense against extracellular parasites and humoral immune responses typical of allergy.

VT:0005475.name: blood thyroxine amount
VT:0005475.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the major hormone derived from the thyroid gland; it normally affects cellular metabolism.

VT:0005476.name: blood triiodothyronine amount
VT:0005476.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this hormone synthesized and secreted by the thyroid; normally, this is the main thyroid hormone used by the tissues.

VT:0005488.name: bronchial epithelial cell quantity
VT:0005488.def: The proportion or number of cells lining the inner surfaces of the bronchi.

VT:0005490.name: club cell quantity
VT:0005490.def: The proportion or number of the rounded, club-shaped, nonciliated cells found between ciliated cells in bronchiolar epithelium.

VT:0005493.name: stomach epithelial cell quantity
VT:0005493.def: The proportion or number of cells in the epithelial layer of the stomach.

VT:0005495.name: macrophage recruitment trait
VT:0005495.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the accumulation of macrophages in a specific location in response to a wide variety of substances released at the sites of inflammatory reactions.

VT:0005499.name: olfactory system morphology trait
VT:0005499.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the organs involved in smell.

VT:0005500.name: gustatory system morphology trait
VT:0005500.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the components of the organs involved in taste.

VT:0005501.name: skin physiology trait
VT:0005501.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the membranous protective covering of the body.

VT:0005502.name: urinary system physiology trait
VT:0005502.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in any of the organs involved in the production or excretion of urine.

VT:0005503.name: tendon morphology trait
VT:0005503.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the fibrous bands or cords of connective tissue at the ends of muscle fibers that attach muscles to bones and other structures.

VT:0005504.name: ligament morphology trait
VT:0005504.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the flexible bands or sheets of fibrous tissue that connect bones, cartilages, or other structures.

VT:0005521.name: blood atrial natriuretic factor amount
VT:0005521.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of this peptide hormone in whole blood, serum, or plasma; it regulates the water-electrolyte balance and acts as a vasodilator.

VT:0005524.name: kidney plasma flow trait
VT:0005524.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to plasma passing through the kidney.

VT:0005535.name: body temperature trait
VT:0005535.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the level of heat maintained by a living being.

VT:0005537.name: cerebral aqueduct morphology trait
VT:0005537.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the channel in the mesencephalon that connects the third and fourth ventricles.

VT:0005541.name: iris stromal pigmentation trait
VT:0005541.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the deposition or aggregation of coloring matter in the lamellated connective tissue of the iris.

VT:0005543.name: cornea thickness trait
VT:0005543.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the distance between the surfaces of the cornea, the transparent anterior portion of the fibrous coat of the eye that serves as the chief refractory structure.

VT:0005545.name: lens development trait
VT:0005545.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the transparent structure of the eye responsible for focusing light rays.

VT:0005547.name: Muller cell morphology trait
VT:0005547.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the elongated neuroglial cells that traverse all the layers of the retina and that act as supporting elements.

VT:0005551.name: eye electrophysiology trait
VT:0005551.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the eye as determined through electrophysiological recordings from single cells or summary recordings from multiple cells (e.g. electroretinogram).

VT:0005567.name: blood total protein amount
VT:0005567.def: The total proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of macromolecules consisting of long chains of amino acids in peptide linkage.

VT:0005581.name: renin activity
VT:0005581.def: The degree of function or response of this enzyme, which cleaves angiotensinogen and creates angiotensin I.

VT:0005584.name: enzyme/coenzyme activity trait
VT:0005584.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the degree of function or response of any of these proteins, or their cofactors, which act as catalysts to induce chemical changes in other substances.

VT:0005587.name: Meckel's cartilage development trait
VT:0005587.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the cartilage bar in the mandibular arch that forms a temporary supporting structure in the embryonic mandible; gives rise to middle ear bones and sphenomandibular and anterior malleolar ligaments.

VT:0005592.name: blood vessel smooth muscle morphology trait
VT:0005592.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the nonstriated, involuntary muscle tissue of the structures that convey blood throughout the body.

VT:0005593.name: blood vessel smooth muscle contractility trait
VT:0005593.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the nonstriated, involuntary muscle tissue of the structures that convey blood throughout the body to shorten or develop increased tension.

VT:0005594.name: blood vessel smooth muscle dilation trait
VT:0005594.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the widening of the nonstriated, involuntary muscle tissue of the structures that convey blood throughout the body.

VT:0005595.name: blood vessel smooth muscle physiology trait
VT:0005595.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the nonstriated, involuntary muscle tissue of the structures that convey blood throughout the body.

VT:0005603.name: neuron size trait
VT:0005603.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of any of the structural and functional units of the nervous system, which consist of the nerve cell body, the dendrites, and the axon.

VT:0005609.name: blood antidiuretic hormone amount
VT:0005609.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of this peptide hormone in whole blood, serum, or plasma; it is normally released by the neurohypophysis to control water metabolism and balance by regulating water loss; it also contracts smooth muscle.

VT:0005623.name: meninges morphology trait
VT:0005623.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the membranes covering the spinal cord and brain, including the dura mater (external), arachnoid (middle), and pia mater (internal).

VT:0005629.name: lung mass
VT:0005629.def: The amount of matter in either or both of the spongy organs of respiration contained within the pleural cavity of the thorax.

VT:0005636.name: mineral homeostasis trait
VT:0005636.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the state of equilibrium in the body with respect to any of the inorganic elements or compounds that have importance in body functions.

VT:0005637.name: iron homeostasis trait
VT:0005637.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the state of equilibrium in the body with respect to this metallic element that normally occurs in the heme of hemoglobin, myoglobin, transferrin, ferritin, and iron-containing porphyrins; it is an essential component of enzymes such as catalase, peroxidase, and various cytochromes.

VT:0005645.name: hypothalamus physiology trait
VT:0005645.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the functions of or processes in the ventral and medial region of the diencephalon forming the walls of the ventral half of the third ventricle, which is normally involved in the functions of the autonomic (visceral motor) nervous system and, through its vascular link with the anterior lobe of the pituitary gland, in endocrine mechanisms.

VT:0005646.name: pituitary gland physiology trait
VT:0005646.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the unpaired compound gland suspended from the base of the hypothalamus by a short extension of the infundibulum, the infundibular or pituitary stalk.

VT:0005647.name: sex gland physiology trait
VT:0005647.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes in any of the organized aggregations of cells that function as secretory or excretory organs and are associated with reproduction.

VT:0005650.name: limb bud morphology trait
VT:0005650.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the swellings on the trunk of the embryo that become limbs, the projecting, paired, jointed appendages of the body used for locomotion or grasping.

VT:0005651.name: gonad rudiment morphology trait
VT:0005651.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the undifferentiated mesoderm that gives rise to the gonads.

VT:0005657.name: neural plate morphology trait
VT:0005657.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a distinct elevation of a transient proliferating cell mass of the fetal subventricular zone; this mass contributes most of its cells to the neocortex; however, hippocampal neurons, thalamus, septum and olfactory bulb neurons are also partly derived from the MGE flat, thickened layer of ectodermal cells in the neuroectodermal area of the embryo's dorsal surface that develops into the neural tube and neural crest.

VT:0005660.name: blood epinephrine amount
VT:0005660.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this catecholamine hormone that stimulates the adrenergic receptors and that causes systemic vasoconstriction and gastrointestinal relaxation, stimulates the heart, and dilates bronchi and cerebral vessels.

VT:0005663.name: blood norepinephrine amount
VT:0005663.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this catecholamine hormone secreted by the adrenal medulla which also acts as a neurotransmitter in the central and sympathetic nervous systems; precursor of epinephrine.

VT:0005666.name: adipose physiology trait
VT:0005666.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the fat-storing cells/tissue.

VT:0005667.name: blood leptin amount
VT:0005667.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the peptide hormone secreted by white adipocytes and believed to regulate food intake and energy balance.

VT:0005674.name: arterial trunk division extent
VT:0005674.def: The degree to which the septation of the path through which blood exits the heart has reached its end point.

VT:0005675.name: gall bladder size trait
VT:0005675.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the gall bladder, the organ that serves as a storage reservoir for bile.

VT:0006000.name: corneal epithelium morphology trait
VT:0006000.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the layers of epithelial cells covering the front of the cornea.

VT:0006004.name: interneuron morphology trait
VT:0006004.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the neurons that exclusively interact with other neurons.

VT:0006005.name: interneuron quantity
VT:0006005.def: The proportion or number of neurons that interact only with other neurons.

VT:0006006.name: sensory neuron quantity
VT:0006006.def: The proportion or number of cells that innervate an effector (muscle or glandular) tissue and are responsible for transmission of sensory impulses.

VT:0006007.name: basal ganglion morphology trait
VT:0006007.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of a group of nuclei associated with the ability to carry out willed movements, including the caudate, putamen, nucleus accumbens, globus pallidus, substantia nigra, and subthalamic nucleus.

VT:0006008.name: neurogenesis trait
VT:0006008.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of neurons during their formation and differentiation.

VT:0006009.name: neuron migration trait
VT:0006009.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the directed and orderly movement of immature neurons from germinal zones to specific positions where they will reside as they mature.

VT:0006011.name: endolymphatic duct morphology trait
VT:0006011.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the small membranous canal, connecting with both saccule and utricle of the membranous labyrinth, passing through the aqueduct of vestibule, and terminating in the endolymphatic sac.

VT:0006014.name: endolymphatic sac size trait
VT:0006014.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the dilated blind extremity of the endolymphatic duct.

VT:0006018.name: tympanic membrane morphology trait
VT:0006018.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the thin, tense membrane forming the greater part of the lateral wall of the tympanic cavity and separating it from the external acoustic meatus; the tympanic membrane constitutes the boundary between the external and middle ear.

VT:0006019.name: tympanic membrane size trait
VT:0006019.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the drum membrane that forms the greater part of the lateral wall of the tympanic cavity.

VT:0006020.name: tympanic ring size trait
VT:0006020.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the bony ring at the ear canal to which the tympanic membrane is attached.

VT:0006021.name: Reissner membrane morphology trait
VT:0006021.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the Reissner's membrane which separates the cochlear duct from the vestibular canal, i.e., the endolymph of the scala media from the perilymph of the scala vestibuli; the Reissner membrane consists of squamous epithelial cells with microvilli toward the ductus, a basement membrane, and a thin layer of connective tissue toward the scala.
synonyms: membrana vestibularis ductus cochlearis morphology trait
morphology trait of the vestibular wall of cochlear duct
paries vestibularis ductus cochlearis morphology trait

VT:0006025.name: Reissner membrane size trait
VT:0006025.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the Reissner's membrane which separates the cochlear duct from the vestibular canal, i.e. the endolymph of the scala media from the perilymph of the scala vestibuli; the Reissner membrane consists of squamous epithelial cells with microvilli toward the ductus, a basement membrane, and a thin layer of connective tissue toward the scala.

VT:0006026.name: terminal bronchiole tube size trait
VT:0006026.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the luminal space of the terminal lung buds.

VT:0006027.name: respiratory alveolus development
VT:0006027.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the sacs for holding air in the lungs which are formed by the terminal dilation of air passageways.

VT:0006028.name: bronchiole branching trait
VT:0006028.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphogenesis of the bronchioles.

VT:0006029.name: sclerotome morphology trait
VT:0006029.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of one or more of the masses of mesodermal tissue that is derived from the somites and is adjacent to the notochord that give rise to the ribs and vertebrae.

VT:0006030.name: otic vesicle morphology trait
VT:0006030.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the paired epithelial sacs formed from the otic placode that give rise to the structures of the inner ear.

VT:0006031.name: branchial pouch morphology trait
VT:0006031.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the series of projections that form between the branchial arches.

VT:0006032.name: ureteric bud morphology trait
VT:0006032.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the ureteric bud that with the metanephric mesenchyme gives rise to the kidneys.

VT:0006033.name: external auditory canal morphology trait
VT:0006033.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the canal that connects the outer and middle ear.

VT:0006034.name: urine myoglobin amount
VT:0006034.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of the oxygen-carrying protein of muscle.

VT:0006055.name: blood vessel endothelial cell morphology trait
VT:0006055.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the cells that line the blood vessels.

VT:0006057.name: blood vessel endothelial cell quantity
VT:0006057.def: The proportion or number of cells that line blood vessels.

VT:0006061.name: heart atrium symmetry
VT:0006061.def: Correspondence in size, shape, and relative position of the upper chambers of the heart on opposite sides of a dividing line or plane or about a center or axis.

VT:0006062.name: vena cava morphology trait
VT:0006062.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of either of the two largest veins in the body.

VT:0006063.name: inferior vena cava morphology trait
VT:0006063.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the principal vein draining blood from the lower portion of the body.

VT:0006064.name: superior vena cava morphology trait
VT:0006064.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the principal vein draining blood from the upper portion of the body.

VT:0006065.name: heart orientation trait
VT:0006065.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the location or arrangement within the chest cavity of the organ that pumps blood through the body.

VT:0006068.name: horizontal cell morphology trait
VT:0006068.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the laterally interconnecting neurons in the outer plexiform layer that connect rods of one part of the retina with cones in another part of the retina.

VT:0006069.name: retinal neuronal layer morphology trait
VT:0006069.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of any of the neuronal layers that make up the retina, including the ganglion cell, inner plexiform, inner nuclear, outer plexiform, outer nuclear layers, the inner and outer segments.

VT:0006070.name: retinal photoreceptor quantity
VT:0006070.def: The proportion or number of rods and/or cones.

VT:0006071.name: retinal progenitor cell development trait
VT:0006071.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the cells that give rise to the various cells of the retina.

VT:0006073.name: retinal bipolar cell morphology trait
VT:0006073.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the cells that transmit signals from the photoreceptors to retinal amacrine and ganglion cells.

VT:0006074.name: retinal rod bipolar cell morphology trait
VT:0006074.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bipolar cells that function in low light and transmit signals only through amacrine cells.

VT:0006075.name: retinal cone bipolar cell morphology trait
VT:0006075.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the retinal bipolar cells that connect to both ganglion and amacrine cells.

VT:0006076.name: blood homocysteine amount
VT:0006076.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this cysteine homologue produced by the demethylation of methionine, an intermediate in the biosynthesis of l-cysteine from l-methionine via l-cystathionine.

VT:0006078.name: nipple morphology trait
VT:0006078.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the erectile protuberance at the tip of the mammary gland in which the mammary ducts terminate and from which milk can be secreted.

VT:0006083.name: blood vessel elastic tissue morphology trait
