VT:0006083.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the tissue that is found in the tunica media of the vessels wall and allows vessels to stretch.

VT:0006084.name: blood phospholipid amount
VT:0006084.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the fat derivatives in which one fatty acid has been replaced by a phosphate group.

VT:0006089.name: saccule morphology trait
VT:0006089.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the smaller of the two sacs in the vestibule.

VT:0006090.name: utricle morphology trait
VT:0006090.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the larger of the two sacs in the vestibule.

VT:0006091.name: olfactory epithelium morphology trait
VT:0006091.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the epithelial cells that line the interior of the nose.

VT:0006092.name: olfactory neuron morphology trait
VT:0006092.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the neurons in the olfactory epithelium that are activated by specific odorants.

VT:0006096.name: retinal bipolar cell quantity
VT:0006096.def: The proportion or numbers of the cells that transmit signals from the photoreceptors to retinal amacrine and ganglion cells.

VT:0006097.name: cerebellum lobule development trait
VT:0006097.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the lobes of the cerebellum during their formation and differentiation.

VT:0006099.name: granule layer thickness
VT:0006099.def: The distance between the surfaces of the innermost cortical layer of the cerebellum that contains granule cells.

VT:0006100.name: tegmentum morphology trait
VT:0006100.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the floor of the midbrain which extends from the substantia nigra to the level of the cerebral aqueduct.

VT:0006102.name: tegmentum size trait
VT:0006102.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the floor of the midbrain which extends from the substantia nigra to the level of the cerebral aqueduct.

VT:0006103.name: midbrain roof plate morphology trait
VT:0006103.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the mesencephalic roof plate, including the caudal and rostral part of the midbrain roof.

VT:0006104.name: tectum morphology trait
VT:0006104.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the rostral part of the midbrain roof.

VT:0006105.name: tectum size trait
VT:0006105.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the rostral part of the midbrain roof.

VT:0006107.name: atrioventricular canal morphology trait
VT:0006107.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the common canal connecting the primordial atrium and ventricle.

VT:0006108.name: hindbrain development trait
VT:0006108.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the caudal region of the brain during its formation and differentiation.

VT:0006113.name: heart septum morphology trait
VT:0006113.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the wall between the atria or ventricles of the heart.

VT:0006126.name: outflow tract development trait
VT:0006126.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the path through which blood exits the heart.

VT:0006127.name: great vessel orientation trait
VT:0006127.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the location or arrangement of the pulmonary vessels and aorta in relation to the heart.

VT:0006151.name: cornea curvature trait
VT:0006151.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the degree or shape of the bend in the transparent anterior portion of the fibrous coat of the eye that serves as the chief refractory structure.

VT:0006162.name: eyelid thickness
VT:0006162.def: The distance between the external and internal surfaces of the skin folds covering the front of the eyeball.

VT:0006168.name: epicanthal fold morphology trait
VT:0006168.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of fold of skin of the upper eyelid that partially covers the inner corner of the eye.

VT:0006173.name: myeloid dendritic cell morphology trait
VT:0006173.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of phagocytic cells of the myeloid lineage that capture antigens in the periphery and then migrate to the lymphoid organs and secrete cytokines to initiate immune responses.

VT:0006174.name: isthmic organizer morphology trait
VT:0006174.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the organizing signaling center that forms at the boundary between the midbrain and hindbrain and plays an essential role in development of the midbrain and anterior hindbrain.

VT:0006175.name: choroid size trait
VT:0006175.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the choroid.

VT:0006192.name: conjunctival blood vessel morphology trait
VT:0006192.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the blood vessel network of the conjunctiva.

VT:0006195.name: eyeball orientation trait
VT:0006195.def: The location or arrangement of the eye proper in relation to the eye socket.

VT:0006199.name: obsolete vertical eye alignment trait
VT:0006199.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the vertical alignment between the eyes.\nconsider: VT:0001299

VT:0006210.name: orbit size trait
VT:0006210.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the bony cavity that contains the eyeball or of any of the parts of the bones which form the cavity.

VT:0006212.name: orbit width
VT:0006212.def: The distance from side to side of the bony cavity that contains the eyeball.

VT:0006213.name: orbit depth
VT:0006213.def: The distance from exterior to interior of the bony cavity that contains the eyeball or of any of the parts of the bones which form the cavity.

VT:0006214.name: orbit symmetry
VT:0006214.def: Correspondence in size, shape, and relative position of the bony cavities that contain the eyeball, or of any of the parts of the bones which form the cavity, on opposite sides of a dividing line or plane or about a center or axis.

VT:0006215.name: optic disc morphology trait
VT:0006215.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the area in the retina where all of the axons of the ganglion cells exit the retina to form the optic nerve.

VT:0006216.name: optic disc size trait
VT:0006216.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the area in the retina where all of the axons of the ganglion cells exit the retina to form the optic nerve.

VT:0006221.name: optic nerve fiber quantity
VT:0006221.def: The proportion or number of fibers in the optic nerve.

VT:0006226.name: iris cell quantity
VT:0006226.def: The proportion or number of cells in the adjustable membrane, composed of the stroma and pigmented epithelium, located just in front of the crystalline lens within the eye.

VT:0006227.name: iris development trait
VT:0006227.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the iris (the adjustable membrane, composed of the stroma and pigmented epithelium, located just in front of the crystalline lens within the eye) during its formation and differentiation.

VT:0006228.name: iris size trait
VT:0006228.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the adjustable membrane, composed of the stroma and pigmented epithelium, located just in front of the crystalline lens within the eye.

VT:0006230.name: iris stroma cell quantity
VT:0006230.def: The proportion or number of cells in the lamellated connective tissue of the iris.

VT:0006235.name: pupil quantity
VT:0006235.def: The proportion or number of pupils in one iris, each with sphincter muscle.

VT:0006237.name: choroid blood vessel morphology trait
VT:0006237.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the blood vessels of the choroid.

VT:0006241.name: pupil orientation trait
VT:0006241.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the location or arrangement of the pupil within the eye.

VT:0006245.name: lens orientation trait
VT:0006245.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the location or arrangement of the transparent structure of the eye responsible for focusing light rays.

VT:0006250.name: line of Schwalbe morphology trait
VT:0006250.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the thickened peripheral margin of the vitreous membrane of the cornea.

VT:0006251.name: ability to open eyelids
VT:0006251.def: The ability to open the eyelids.

VT:0006256.name: gustatory papillae morphology trait
VT:0006256.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the papillae that contain taste buds, including the fungiform, foliate, and circumvallate papillae.

VT:0006257.name: fungiform papillae morphology trait
VT:0006257.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the mushroom-shaped papillae, which have a single taste bud at the tip, located mostly on the dorsal anterior portion of the tongue.

VT:0006258.name: circumvallate papillae morphology trait
VT:0006258.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the large papillae, which have multiple taste buds in the trough surrounding the papillae, located near the base and on the dorsal side of the tongue.

VT:0006259.name: foliate papillae morphology trait
VT:0006259.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the papillae located on the sides of the tongue.

VT:0006260.name: gustatory papillae taste bud morphology trait
VT:0006260.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the taste buds located on the gustatory papillae, which includes the fungiform, foliate, and circumvallate papillae.

VT:0006274.name: urine sodium amount
VT:0006274.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of the monovalent cation of sodium, an alkali metal element.

VT:0006276.name: autonomic nervous system physiology trait
VT:0006276.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the sensory and motor neurons that run between the central nervous system (especially the hypothalamus and medulla oblongata) and various internal organs (heart, lungs, endocrine and exocrine glands), responsible for controlling involuntary bodily functions.

VT:0006277.name: parasympathetic nervous system physiology trait
VT:0006277.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the craniosacral portion of the autonomic nervous system.

VT:0006279.name: limb development trait
VT:0006279.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the limbs, the projecting, paired, jointed appendages of the body used for locomotion or grasping.

VT:0006280.name: digit development trait
VT:0006280.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the digits during their formation and differentiation.

VT:0006281.name: tail development trait
VT:0006281.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the appendage at the caudal end of the vertebral column in some vertebrates including remnant structures in species that normally lack a tail.

VT:0006282.name: posterior horn morphology trait
VT:0006282.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the dorsal gray matter of the spinal cord.
synonyms: spinal cord dorsal horn morphology trait

VT:0006385.name: memory T cell morphology trait
VT:0006385.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the set of distinctly differentiated long-lived T cells that have the phenotype CD45RO-positive and CD127-positive.

VT:0006387.name: T cell quantity
VT:0006387.def: The proportion or number of lymphocytes that are responsible for cell-mediated immunity and immune system regulation.

VT:0006414.name: T cell apoptosis trait
VT:0006414.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which T cells undergo programmed cell death.

VT:0007000.name: obsolete heart apex orientation trait
VT:0007000.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the location or arrangement of the top of the heart in relation to the rostral-caudal axis of the body.

VT:0007001.name: atrioventricular cushion morphology trait
VT:0007001.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the mounds of embryonic connective tissue that bulge into the embryonic atrioventricular canal; these mounds eventually fuse to form the valves between the right and left atrioventricular orifices.

VT:0007002.name: atrioventricular cushion size trait
VT:0007002.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical dimensions magnitude of the mounds of embryonic connective tissue that bulge into the embryonic atrioventricular canal; these mounds fuse to form the valves between the right and left atrioventricular orifices.

VT:0007003.name: atrioventricular cushion thickness
VT:0007003.def: The distance between the two surfaces of the mounds of embryonic connective tissue that bulge into the embryonic atrioventricular canal; these mounds fuse to form the valves between the right and left atrioventricular orifices.

VT:0007005.name: atrioventricular canal formation extent
VT:0007005.def: The degree to which the development of the common canal connecting the primordial atrium and ventricle has reached its end point.

VT:0007007.name: atrioventricular canal configuration trait
VT:0007007.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement of the common canal connecting the primordial atrium and ventricle.

VT:0007009.name: interatrial septum configuration trait
VT:0007009.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement of the wall separating the upper chambers of the heart.

VT:0007010.name: cardiomyocyte quantity
VT:0007010.def: The proportion or number of striated muscle cells in the heart as a whole or in any substructure of the heart.

VT:0007012.name: mitral valve configuration trait
VT:0007012.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement of the valve between the left atrium and the left ventricle of the heart.

VT:0007016.name: tricuspid valve configuration trait
VT:0007016.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement of the valve between the right atrium and the right ventricle of the heart.

VT:0007019.name: aortic valve configuration trait
VT:0007019.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement of the valve between the left ventricle and the ascending aorta.

VT:0007022.name: pulmonary valve configuration trait
VT:0007022.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement of the valve between the right ventricle and the pulmonary trunk.

VT:0007024.name: heart left atrium configuration trait
VT:0007024.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement of the left upper chamber of the heart.

VT:0007026.name: heart left atrium mass
VT:0007026.def: The amount of matter in the left upper chamber of the heart.

VT:0007027.name: heart right atrium mass
VT:0007027.def: The amount of matter in the right upper chamber of the heart.

VT:0007028.name: heart mass
VT:0007028.def: The amount of matter in the cardiac muscle that maintains the circulation of the blood.

VT:0007030.name: heart left ventricle capacity
VT:0007030.def: The volume of or amount contained in the left lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0007031.name: heart left ventricle mass
VT:0007031.def: The amount of matter in the left lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0007032.name: heart right ventricle capacity
VT:0007032.def: The volume of or amount contained in the right lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0007033.name: heart right ventricle mass
VT:0007033.def: The amount of matter in the right lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0007036.name: pericardium orientation trait
VT:0007036.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the location or arrangement in relation to the heart and/or great vessels of the  fibroserous membrane covering the heart and beginning of the great vessels.

VT:0007038.name: atrioventricular cushion orientation trait
VT:0007038.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the location or arrangement in relation to each other and the developing heart of the mounds of embryonic connective tissue that bulge into the embryonic atrioventricular canal; these mounds eventually fuse to form the valves between the right and left atrioventricular orifices.

VT:0007041.name: heart tube orientation trait
VT:0007041.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the location or arrangement of the early embryonic heart in relation to itself and the surrounding tissue.

VT:0007047.name: aorta configuration trait
VT:0007047.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement of the main trunk of the systemic arteries.

VT:0007048.name: aorta elastic tissue molecular composition trait
VT:0007048.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic pertaining to the proportions of molecules (proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances) within the slender connective tissue fiber in tissue of the main trunk of the systemic arteries which is characterized by great elasticity.

VT:0007052.name: aortic arch configuration trait
VT:0007052.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement of the portion of the descending aorta proceeding from the arch of the aorta and extending to the diaphragm.

VT:0007075.name: heart left ventricle wall thickness
VT:0007075.def: The distance between the surfaces of the wall of the left lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0007081.name: interatrial septum morphology trait
VT:0007081.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the wall between the upper chambers of the heart.

VT:0007082.name: heart ventricle septum morphology trait
VT:0007082.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the wall between the lower chambers of the heart.

VT:0007084.name: heart ventricle septum configuration trait
VT:0007084.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement of the wall separating the lower chambers of the heart.

VT:0007086.name: heart ventricle septum thickness
VT:0007086.def: The distance between the surfaces of the wall between the two lower chambers of the heart.

VT:0007087.name: heart left ventricle posterior wall thickness
VT:0007087.def: The distance between the surfaces of the wall closest to the back of the left lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0007088.name: heart right ventricle wall thickness
VT:0007088.def: The distance between the surfaces of the wall of the right lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0007089.name: heart right ventricle posterior wall thickness
VT:0007089.def: The distance between the surfaces of the wall closest to the back of the right lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0007090.name: aorta size trait
VT:0007090.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the main trunk of the systemic arteries.

VT:0007091.name: aorta root width
VT:0007091.def: The distance from side to side of the portion of the aorta attached to the atrioventricular fibrous rings and myocardium.

VT:0008020.name: dermis mast cell morphology trait
VT:0008020.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of cells in the dermis (the layer of the skin deep to the epidermis, consisting of a dense bed of vascular, connective tissue) containing numerous basophilic granules and capable of releasing large amounts of histamine and heparin upon activation.

VT:0008036.name: NK T cell morphology trait
VT:0008036.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the distinct lineage of T cells expressing natural killer cell markers and having T cell receptors characterized by the usage of a restricted repertoire of variable region gene segments.
synonyms: natural killer T cell morphology trait
natural killer T lymphocyte morphology trait

VT:0008037.name: T cell morphology trait
VT:0008037.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of lymphocytes that are responsible for cell-mediated immunity and immune system regulation.

VT:0008038.name: NK T cell quantity
VT:0008038.def: The proportion or number of the distinct lineage of T cells expressing natural killer cell markers and having T cell receptors characterized by the usage of a restricted repertoire of variable region gene segments.

VT:0008042.name: NK T cell physiology trait
VT:0008042.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the distinct lineage of T cells expressing natural killer cell markers and having T cell receptors characterized by the usage of a restricted repertoire of variable region gene segments.
synonyms: natural killer T cell physiology trait
natural killer T lymphocyte physiology trait

VT:0008043.name: natural killer cell quantity
VT:0008043.def: The proportion or number of non-T, non-B lymphocytes, having a granular morphology and which are important in innate immunity to viruses and other intracellular pathogens; in addition, these cells can kill certain tumor cells.

VT:0008048.name: memory T cell quantity
VT:0008048.def: The proportion or number of distinctly differentiated long-lived T cells that have the phenotype CD45RO-positive and CD127-positive.

VT:0008051.name: memory T cell physiology trait
VT:0008051.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the set of distinctly differentiated long-lived T cells that have the phenotype CD45RO-positive and CD127-positive.

VT:0008053.name: natural killer cell development trait
VT:0008053.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation or differentiation of the non-T, non-B lymphocytes, having a granular morphology and which are important in innate immunity to viruses and other intracellular pathogens; in addition, these cells can kill certain tumor cells.

VT:0008054.name: uterine natural killer cell morphology trait
VT:0008054.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the uterine subset of the non-T, non-B lymphocytes, having a granular morphology and which are important in innate immunity to viruses and other intracellular pathogens; uNK cells contribute to uterine decidualization and are recruited to implantation sites.
synonyms: granulated metrial gland cell morphology trait

VT:0008073.name: CD4-positive T cell quantity
VT:0008073.def: The proportion or number of the subset of T lymphocytes that carry the CD4 marker, recognize intravesicular peptides bound to MHC class-II molecules, and turn on antibody production.

VT:0008076.name: CD4-positive T cell development trait
VT:0008076.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the subset of T lymphocytes that carry the CD4 marker, recognize intravesicular peptides bound to MHC class-II molecules, and turn on antibody production.

VT:0008077.name: CD8-positive T cell quantity
VT:0008077.def: The proportion or number of the regulatory subset of T lymphocytes that are involved in MHC class I restricted interactions.

VT:0008080.name: CD8-positive T cell development trait
VT:0008080.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation or differentiation of the regulatory subset of T lymphocytes that are involved in MHC class I restricted interactions.

VT:0008081.name: single-positive T cell quantity
VT:0008081.def: The proportion or number of T cells bearing either CD4-positive or CD8-positive markers on their surface.

VT:0008085.name: T-helper 1 cell quantity
VT:0008085.def: The proportion or number of the type of T-helper cell whose cytokine production favors cellular immune responses and delayed type hypersensitivity.
synonyms: helper T cell type 1 cell number
helper T lymphocyte type 1 cell number

VT:0008088.name: T-helper 1 cell differentiation trait
VT:0008088.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which relatively unspecialized cells acquire the specialized features of the subset of the type of T-helper cell whose cytokine production favors cellular immune responses and delayed type hypersensitivity.
synonyms: helper T cell type 1 cell differentiation
helper T lymphocyte type 1 cell differentiation

VT:0008089.name: T-helper 2 cell quantity
VT:0008089.def: The proportion or number of the type of T-helper cell whose cytokine production promotes defense against extracellular parasites and humoral immune responses typical of allergy.
synonyms: helper T cell type 2 cell number
helper T lymphocyte type 2 cell number

VT:0008092.name: T-helper 2 cell differentiation trait
VT:0008092.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which relatively unspecialized cells acquire the specialized features of the type of T-helper cell whose cytokine production promotes defense against extracellular parasites and humoral immune responses typical of allergy.
synonyms: helper T cell type 2 cell differentiation
helper T lymphocyte type 2 cell differentiation

VT:0008093.name: memory B cell quantity
VT:0008093.def: The proportion or number of distinctly differentiated long-lived B cells that are readily activated upon re-encounter of an antigenic determinant; memory B cells differentiate from antigen-activated B cells which have been selected for expression of higher affinity immunoglobulin.

VT:0008095.name: memory B cell development trait
VT:0008095.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation or differentiation of distinctly differentiated long-lived B cells that are readily activated upon reencounter of an antigenic determinant; memory B cells differentiate from antigen-activated B cells which have been selected for expression of higher affinity immunoglobulin.

VT:0008096.name: plasma cell quantity
VT:0008096.def: The proportion or number of terminally differentiated, post-mitotic, short-lived cells of the B cell lineage devoted to producing large amounts of immunoglobulin.

VT:0008099.name: plasma cell development trait
VT:0008099.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation or differentiation of terminally differentiated, post-mitotic, short-lived cells of the B cell lineage devoted to producing large amounts of immunoglobulin.

VT:0008111.name: granulocyte development trait
VT:0008111.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of leukocytes that have abundant granules in the cytoplasm, including basophils, neutrophils, and eosinophils.

VT:0008112.name: monocyte development trait
VT:0008112.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the large, phagocytic mononuclear leukocytes produced in the vertebrate bone marrow and released into the blood.

VT:0008113.name: macrophage development trait
VT:0008113.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the large mononuclear phagocytes which differentiate from monocytes, are typically resident in a particular tissue, and are capable of phagocytosing a variety of extracellular particulate material, including immune complexes, microorganisms, and dead cells.

VT:0008114.name: Kupffer cell morphology trait
VT:0008114.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the phagocytic macrophages residing on the luminal surface of the hepatic sinusoids.

VT:0008115.name: dendritic cell development trait
VT:0008115.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of a cell of hematopoietic origin, typically resident in particular tissues, specialized in the uptake, processing, and transport of antigens to lymph nodes for the purpose of stimulating an immune response via T cell activation.

VT:0008117.name: Langerhans cell morphology trait
VT:0008117.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a stellate dendritic cell of myeloid origin, that appears clear on light microscopy and has a dark-staining, indented nucleus and characteristic inclusions (Birbeck granules) in the cytoplasm; Langerhans cells are found principally in the stratum spinosum of the epidermis, but they also occur in other stratified epithelia and have been identified in the lung, lymph nodes, spleen, and thymus.

VT:0008119.name: Langerhans cell quantity
VT:0008119.def: The proportion or number of stellate dendritic cells of myeloid origin, that appear clear on light microscopy and have a dark-staining, indented nucleus and characteristic inclusions (Birbeck granules) in the cytoplasm; Langerhans cells are found principally in the stratum spinosum of the epidermis, but they also occur in other stratified epithelia and have been identified in the lung, lymph nodes, spleen, and thymus.

VT:0008120.name: myeloid dendritic cell quantity
VT:0008120.def: The proportion or number of phagocytic cells of the myeloid lineage that capture antigens in the periphery and then migrate to the lymphoid organs and secrete cytokines to initiate immune responses.

VT:0008123.name: plasmacytoid dendritic cell quantity
VT:0008123.def: The proportion or number of phagocytic dendritic cells that are morphologically similar to plasma cells, but do not express B lineage markers, and produce large amounts of alpha/beta interferons (IFN-/) in response to viral and bacterial stimuli.

VT:0008125.name: dendritic cell quantity
VT:0008125.def: The proportion or number of cells of hematopoietic origin, typically resident in particular tissues, specialized in the uptake, processing, and transport of antigens to lymph nodes for the purpose of stimulating an immune response via T cell activation.

VT:0008131.name: Peyer's patch quantity
VT:0008131.def: The proportion or number of the protruding lymphoid tissue located on the mucosa of the small intestine that is composed of densely packed B cell follicles.

VT:0008134.name: Peyer's patch size trait
VT:0008134.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the protruding lymphoid tissue located on the mucosa of the small intestine that is composed of densely packed B cell follicles.

VT:0008164.name: B-1a B cell morphology trait
VT:0008164.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the B-1 B cell subset bearing the CD5 surface marker.

VT:0008165.name: B-1b B cell morphology trait
VT:0008165.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the B-1 B cell subset not bearing the CD5 surface marker, but having other phenotypic attributes of a B-1 B cell.

VT:0008166.name: B-2 B cell morphology trait
VT:0008166.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a conventional B cell subject to antigenic stimulation and dependent on T cell help and with a distinct surface marker expression pattern from B-1 B cells.

VT:0008167.name: B-1a B cell quantity
VT:0008167.def: The proportion or number of the B-1 B cell subset bearing the CD5 surface marker.

VT:0008169.name: B-1b B cell quantity
VT:0008169.def: The proportion or number of the B-1 B cell subset not bearing the CD5 surface marker, but having other phenotypic attributes of a B-1 B cell.

VT:0008171.name: mature B cell morphology trait
VT:0008171.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the mature form of a B cell, a type of lymphocyte whose defining characteristic is the expression of an immunoglobulin complex.

VT:0008172.name: follicular B cell morphology trait
VT:0008172.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a resting mature B cell with distinct phenotypic characteristics (CD23-positive, CD21-positive) found typically in the B cell follicle region of the spleen and lymph nodes.

VT:0008174.name: follicular B cell quantity
VT:0008174.def: The proportion or number of resting mature B cells with distinct phenotypic characteristics (CD23-positive, CD21-positive) found typically in the B cell follicle region of the spleen and lymph nodes.

VT:0008176.name: germinal center B cell morphology trait
VT:0008176.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of rapidly cycling, mature B cells which have downregulated IgD expression and exhibit high levels of binding by peanut agglutinin (PNA), and are involved in T-dependent immune responses; germinal center B cells are found typically in the germinal centers of lymph nodes and spleen.

VT:0008178.name: germinal center B cell quantity
VT:0008178.def: The proportion or number of rapidly cycling mature B cells which have downregulated IgD expression and exhibit high levels of binding by peanut agglutinin (PNA), and are involved in T-dependent immune responses; germinal center B cells are found typically in the germinal centers of lymph nodes and spleen.

VT:0008180.name: marginal zone B cell morphology trait
VT:0008180.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the CD23-negative, CD21-positive B cells of the marginal zone of the spleen expressing a B cell receptor usually reactive to bacterial cell wall components or senescent self components such as oxidized-LDL.

VT:0008182.name: marginal zone B cell quantity
VT:0008182.def: The proportion or number of CD23-negative, CD21-positive B cells of the marginal zone of the spleen expressing a B cell receptor usually reactive to bacterial cell wall components or senescent self components such as oxidized-LDL.

VT:0008184.name: naive B cell morphology trait
VT:0008184.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a mature B cell which has not yet been activated by antigen.

VT:0008185.name: naive B cell quantity
VT:0008185.def: The proportion or number of mature B cells which have not yet been activated by antigen.

VT:0008188.name: transitional stage B cell morphology trait
VT:0008188.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of an immature B cell of an intermediate stage between the pre-B cell stage and the mature naive stage; transitional B cells express surface immunoglobulin, and are subject to the process of B cell selection.

VT:0008190.name: transitional stage B cell quantity
VT:0008190.def: The proportion or number of immature B cells of an intermediate stage between the pre-B cell stage and the mature naive stage; transitional B cells express surface immunoglobulin, and are subject to the process of B cell selection.

VT:0008191.name: follicular B cell physiology trait
VT:0008191.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in resting mature B cells with distinct phenotypic characteristics (CD23-positive, CD21-positive) found typically in the B cell follicle region of the spleen.

VT:0008192.name: germinal center B cell physiology trait
VT:0008192.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in rapidly cycling mature B cells which have downregulated IgD expression and exhibit high levels of binding by peanut agglutinin (PNA), and are involved in T-dependent immune responses; germinal center B cells are found typically in the germinal centers of lymph nodes.

VT:0008193.name: marginal zone B cell physiology trait
VT:0008193.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in a CD23-negative, CD21-positive B cell of the marginal zone of the spleen expressing a B cell receptor usually reactive to bacterial cell wall components or senescent self components such as oxidized-LDL.

VT:0008194.name: memory B cell physiology trait
VT:0008194.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in a distinctly differentiated long-lived B cell that is readily activated upon re-encounter of its antigenic determinant; memory B cells differentiate from antigen-activated B cells which have been selected for expression of higher affinity immunoglobulin.

VT:0008195.name: antigen presenting cell morphology trait
VT:0008195.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a cell capable of processing and presenting lipid and protein antigens to T cells in order to initiate an immune response.

VT:0008196.name: follicular dendritic cell morphology trait
VT:0008196.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a cell with extensive dendritic processes found in the B cell areas (primary follicles and germinal centers) of lymphoid tissue; follicular dendritic cells have Fc receptors and C3b receptors, and hold antigen in the form of immune complexes on their surfaces for long periods and can present antigen to B cells during an immune response.

VT:0008197.name: follicular dendritic cell physiology trait
VT:0008197.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in a cell with extensive dendritic processes found in the B cell areas (primary follicles and germinal centers) of lymphoid tissue; follicular dendritic cells have Fc receptors and C3b receptors, and hold antigen in the form of immune complexes on their surfaces for long periods and can present antigen to B cells during an immune response.

VT:0008198.name: follicular dendritic cell antigen presentation trait
VT:0008198.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of follicular dendritic cells to process and present antigen to B lymphocytes.

VT:0008200.name: follicular dendritic cell quantity
VT:0008200.def: The proportion or number of cells with extensive dendritic processes found in the B cell areas (primary follicles and germinal centers) of lymphoid tissue; follicular dendritic cells have Fc receptors and C3b receptors, and hold antigen in the form of immune complexes on their surfaces for long periods and can present antigen to B cells during an immune response.

VT:0008207.name: B-2 B cell quantity
VT:0008207.def: The proportion or number of conventional B cells subject to antigenic stimulation and dependent on T cell help and with a distinct surface marker expression pattern from B-1 B cells.

VT:0008208.name: pro-B cell quantity
VT:0008208.def: The proportion or number of the progenitor cells of the B cell lineage, with some lineage specific activity such as early stages of recombination of B cell receptor genes, but are not yet fully committed to the B cell lineage until the expression of PAX5 occurs.

VT:0008209.name: pre-B cell quantity
VT:0008209.def: The proportion or number of cells in the B lymphocyte lineage that have undergone VDJ rearrangement of the immunoglobulin heavy chain and are in the process of V-J rearrangement of the light chain: these cells express mu heavy chain on the cell surface.

VT:0008211.name: mature B cell quantity
VT:0008211.def: The proportion or number of the mature form of B cells, a type of lymphocyte whose defining characteristic is the expression of an immunoglobulin complex.

VT:0008215.name: immature B cell quantity
VT:0008215.def: The proportion or number of the cells of the B lymphocyte lineage that have undergone VDJ rearrangement of the heavy chain and V-J rearrangement of the light chain; these cells express IgM on the cell surface but have not yet been selected for self-reactivity.

VT:0008217.name: B cell activation trait
VT:0008217.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the change in morphology and behavior of a mature or immature B cell during an immune response, resulting from exposure to a mitogen, cytokine, chemokine, cellular ligand, or an antigen for which it is specific.

VT:0008233.name: pro-B cell development trait
VT:0008233.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation or differentiation of the progenitor cells of the B cell lineage, with some lineage specific activity such as early stages of recombination of B cell receptor genes, but are not yet fully committed to the B cell lineage until the expression of PAX5 occurs.

VT:0008240.name: spleen marginal zone macrophage morphology trait
VT:0008240.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells present in the splenic marginal zone that are involved in the recognition and clearance of material, such as pathogen-derived material, from the splenic circulation.
synonyms: splenic marginal zone macrophage morphology trait

VT:0008241.name: metallophilic macrophage morphology trait
VT:0008241.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the macrophage cells that surround the white pulp of the spleen, adjacent to the marginal sinus.
synonyms: splenic marginal metallophilic macrophage morphology trait

VT:0008242.name: perivascular macrophage morphology trait
VT:0008242.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of macrophages that line the small blood vessels.

VT:0008244.name: peritoneal macrophage morphology trait
VT:0008244.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a mononuclear phagocyte that develops from bone marrow precursors but is resident in the peritoneum.

VT:0008245.name: alveolar macrophage morphology trait
VT:0008245.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the round, granular, mononuclear phagocytes found in the alveoli of the lungs which ingest small inhaled particles resulting in degradation and presentation of the antigen to immunocompetent cells.

VT:0008246.name: leukocyte morphology trait
VT:0008246.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of nucleated cells of the myeloid or lymphoid lineages, found in blood or other tissue.

VT:0008248.name: mononuclear phagocyte morphology trait
VT:0008248.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a vertebrate phagocyte with a single nucleus.

VT:0008249.name: common lymphoid progenitor morphology trait
VT:0008249.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a progenitor cell committed to the lymphoid lineage.
synonyms: common lymphocyte progenitor cell morphology trait
common lymphoid progenitor cell morphology trait

VT:0008251.name: phagocyte morphology trait
VT:0008251.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of cells capable of ingesting particulate matter via phagocytosis.

VT:0008252.name: multinucleated phagocyte morphology trait
VT:0008252.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a phagocyte formed by the fusion of mononuclear phagocytes.

VT:0008343.name: gamma-delta T cell morphology trait
VT:0008343.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of an immature or mature T cell expressing a gamma-delta T cell receptor complex.

VT:0008344.name: mature gamma-delta T cell morphology trait
VT:0008344.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a mature T cell expressing a gamma-delta T cell receptor complex.
synonyms: mature gamma-delta T lymphocyte morphology trait

VT:0008345.name: gamma-delta T cell quantity
VT:0008345.def: The proportion or number of immature or mature T cells expressing a gamma-delta T cell receptor complex.

VT:0008349.name: gamma-delta intraepithelial T cell morphology trait
VT:0008349.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a gamma-delta T cell present in columnar epithelia such as in the gastrointestinal tract; intraepithelial T cells often have distinct developmental pathways and activation requirements.
synonyms: gamma-delta intraepithelial T lymphocyte morphology trait

VT:0008351.name: gamma-delta intraepithelial T cell quantity
VT:0008351.def: The proportion or number of gamma-delta T cells present in columnar epithelia such as in the gastrointestinal tract; intraepithelial T cells often have distinct developmental pathways and activation requirements.

VT:0008354.name: mature gamma-delta T cell quantity
VT:0008354.def: The proportion or number of mature T cells expressing a gamma-delta T cell receptor complex.

VT:0008356.name: gamma-delta T cell development trait
VT:0008356.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation or differentiation of T cells expressing a gamma-delta T cell receptor complex, and/or accumulation of gamma-delta T cell precursors.

VT:0008357.name: CD4-positive, gamma-delta intraepithelial T cell morphology trait
VT:0008357.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a CD4-positive, gamma-delta T cell of the columnar epithelia such as in the gastrointestinal tract; intraepithelial T cells often have distinct developmental pathways and activation requirements.
synonyms: CD4-positive, gamma-delta intraepithelial T lymphocyte morphology trait
CD4-positive, gamma-delta intraepithelial T-cell morphology trait
CD4-positive, gamma-delta intraepithelial T-lymphocyte morphology trait

VT:0008361.name: CD8-positive, gamma-delta intraepithelial T cell morphology trait
VT:0008361.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a CD8-positive, gamma-delta T cell of the columnar epithelia such as in the gastrointestinal tract; intraepithelial T cells often have distinct developmental pathways and activation requirements.
synonyms: CD8-positive, gamma-delta intraepithelial T lymphocyte morphology trait
CD8-positive, gamma-delta intraepithelial T-cell morphology trait
CD8-positive, gamma-delta intraepithelial T-lymphocyte morphology trait

VT:0008397.name: CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell morphology trait
VT:0008397.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta T cell which regulates overall immune responses as well as the responses of other T cell subsets through direct cell-cell contact and cytokine release.
synonyms: CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T lymphocyte morphology trait
CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T-cell morphology trait
CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T-lymphocyte morphology trait
CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta Treg morphology trait

VT:0008398.name: CD8-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell morphology trait
VT:0008398.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell which regulates overall immune responses as well as the responses of other T cell subsets through direct cell-cell contact and cytokine release.
synonyms: CD8-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T lymphocyte morphology trait
CD8-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T-cell morphology trait
CD8-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T-lymphocyte morphology trait

VT:0008399.name: alpha-beta intraepithelial T cell morphology trait
VT:0008399.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of an alpha-beta T cell present in columnar epithelia such as in the gastrointestinal tract; intraepithelial T cells often have distinct developmental pathways and activation requirements.
synonyms: alpha-beta intraepithelial T lymphocyte morphology trait

VT:0008400.name: CD4-positive, alpha-beta intraepithelial T cell morphology trait
VT:0008400.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell of the columnar epithelia such as in the gastrointestinal tract; intraepithelial T cells often have distinct developmental pathways and activation requirements.
synonyms: CD4-positive, alpha-beta intraepithelial T lymphocyte morphology trait
CD4-positive, alpha-beta intraepithelial T-cell morphology trait
CD4-positive, alpha-beta intraepithelial T-lymphocyte morphology trait

VT:0008401.name: CD8-positive, alpha-beta intraepithelial T cell morphology trait
VT:0008401.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell of the columnar epithelia such as in the gastrointestinal tract; intraepithelial T cells often have distinct developmental pathways and activation requirements.
synonyms: CD8-positive, alpha-beta intraepithelial T lymphocyte morphology trait
CD8-positive, alpha-beta intraepithelial T-cell morphology trait
CD8-positive, alpha-beta intraepithelial T-lymphocyte morphology trait

VT:0008463.name: peripheral lymph node morphology trait
VT:0008463.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of any of the lymph nodes located outside the thoracic and abdominal cavities, such as the submandibular, prescapular, axillary, inguinal and popliteal lymph nodes.

VT:0008466.name: mesenteric lymph node size trait
VT:0008466.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the lymph nodes located in the mesentary, of which there are 3 classes: ileocolic, juxtaintestinal mesenteric, and central superior group.

VT:0008470.name: spleen B cell follicle morphology trait
VT:0008470.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the area of the white pulp where the affinity maturation of B cells and the generation of memory B cells and plasma cells occur.
synonyms: spleen B lymphocyte follicle morphology trait
splenic B cell follicle morphology trait

VT:0008471.name: spleen primary B follicle morphology trait
VT:0008471.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the nodules of small undifferentiated B lymphocytes and follicular dendritic cells located in the spleen white pulp.
synonyms: splenic primary B cell morphology trait

VT:0008472.name: spleen secondary B follicle morphology trait
VT:0008472.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the nodules of antigen-activated, differentiating B cells, follicular dendritic cells, antigen-presenting T cells and macrophages in the spleen white pulp.
synonyms: splenic secondary B cell follicle morphology trait

VT:0008473.name: spleen follicular dendritic cell network morphology trait
VT:0008473.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the enmeshed group of antigen presenting cells with extensive dendritic processes in the spleen B cell follicle that present antigen to B cells during an immune response.
synonyms: splenic follicular dendritic cell network morphology trait

VT:0008482.name: spleen germinal center quantity
VT:0008482.def: The proportion or number of spleen secondary B follicles where rapid B-cell proliferation, somatic hypermutation, and selection for antigen binding occur.

VT:0008484.name: spleen germinal center size trait
VT:0008484.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the spleen secondary B follicles where rapid B-cell proliferation, somatic hypermutation, and selection for antigen binding occur.

VT:0008495.name: blood immunoglobulin G1 amount
VT:0008495.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of immunoglobulin class G1.

VT:0008496.name: blood immunoglobulin G2a amount
VT:0008496.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of immunoglobulin class G2a.

VT:0008497.name: blood immunoglobulin G2b amount
VT:0008497.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of immunoglobulin class G2b.

VT:0008498.name: blood immunoglobulin G3 amount
VT:0008498.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of immunoglobulin class G3.

VT:0008522.name: lymph node germinal center morphology trait
VT:0008522.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the area of the lymph node secondary follicle where B cells are stimulated by antigens and helper T cells are stimulated to generate memory cells.

VT:0008542.name: cervical lymph node size trait
VT:0008542.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the lymph nodes found near the neck and shoulders.

VT:0008548.name: blood interferon amount
VT:0008548.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of proteins secreted by vertebrate cells in response to a wide variety of inducers; they confer resistance against many different viruses, inhibit proliferation of normal and malignant cells, impede multiplication of intracellular parasites, enhance macrophage and granulocyte phagocytosis, augment natural killer cell activity, and show several other immunomodulatory functions.

VT:0008549.name: blood interferon-alpha amount
VT:0008549.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of one of the type I interferons produced by peripheral blood leukocytes or lymphoblastoid cells that has antiviral activity and activates natural killer cells and B cells.

VT:0008550.name: blood interferon-beta amount
VT:0008550.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of one of the type I interferons produced by fibroblasts in response to stimulation by live or inactivated virus or by double-stranded RNA with antiviral, antiproliferative, and immunomodulating activity.

VT:0008551.name: blood interferon-gamma amount
VT:0008551.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the major interferon produced by mitogenically or antigenically stimulated lymphocytes that is involved in immunoregulation.

VT:0008552.name: blood tumor necrosis factor amount
VT:0008552.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a serum glycoprotein produced by activated macrophages and NK cells and involved in initiating local inflammatory responses, particularly by its action on the endothelium of local blood vessels; its actions result in increased vascular permeability and induction of expression of adhesion molecules on the endothelium.
synonyms: circulating tumor necrosis factor alpha level

VT:0008555.name: interferon secretion trait
VT:0008555.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of proteins secreted by vertebrate cells in response to a wide variety of inducers; they confer resistance against many different viruses, inhibit proliferation of normal and malignant cells, impede multiplication of intracellular parasites, enhance macrophage and granulocyte phagocytosis, augment natural killer cell activity, and show several other immunomodulatory functions.

VT:0008556.name: tumor necrosis factor secretion trait
VT:0008556.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a serum glycoprotein produced by activated macrophages and NK cells and involved in initiating local inflammatory responses, particularly by its action on the endothelium of local blood vessels; its actions result in increased vascular permeability and induction of expression of adhesion molecules on the endothelium.

VT:0008557.name: interferon-alpha secretion trait
VT:0008557.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of one of the type I interferons produced by peripheral blood leukocytes or lymphoblastoid cells that has antiviral activity and activates natural killer cells and B cells.

VT:0008558.name: interferon-beta secretion trait
VT:0008558.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of one of the type I interferons produced by fibroblasts in response to stimulation by live or inactivated virus or by double-stranded RNA with antiviral, antiproliferative, and immunomodulating activity.

VT:0008559.name: interferon-gamma secretion trait
VT:0008559.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of the major interferon produced by mitogenically or antigenically stimulated lymphocytes that is involved in immunoregulation.

VT:0008568.name: interleukin secretion trait
VT:0008568.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of soluble factors which stimulate growth-related activities of leukocytes and other cell types, that can act to enhance cell proliferation and differentiation, DNA synthesis, secretion of other biologically active molecules and responses to immune and inflammatory stimuli.

VT:0008588.name: blood interleukin amount
VT:0008588.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of soluble factors which stimulate growth-related activities of leukocytes as well as other cell types; they enhance cell proliferation and differentiation, DNA synthesis, secretion of other biologically active molecules and responses to immune and inflammatory stimuli.

VT:0008589.name: blood interleukin-1 amount
VT:0008589.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a soluble factor produced by monocytes, macrophages and other cells, which activates T-lymphocytes and potentiates their response to mitogens or antigens.
synonyms: circulating epidermal cell derived thymocyte-activating factor level

VT:0008590.name: blood interleukin-10 amount
VT:0008590.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a cytokine produced by a variety of cell types, including T-cells, monocytes, dendritic cells and epithelial cells that exerts a variety of effects on immunoregulation and inflammation.
synonyms: circulating cytokine synthesis inhibitory factor level

VT:0008595.name: blood interleukin-6 amount
VT:0008595.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a cytokine that stimulates the growth and differentiation of B-cells and is also a growth factor for hybridomas and plasmacytomas, and is produced by many different cells including T-cells, monocytes and fibroblasts.
synonyms: circulating B cell stimulatory factor-2 level

VT:0008598.name: blood interleukin-2 amount
VT:0008598.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a soluble substance elaborated by antigen- or mitogen-stimulated T-cells which induces DNA synthesis in naive lymphocytes.

VT:0008601.name: blood interleukin-4 amount
VT:0008601.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a soluble factor produced by activated T-cells that induces the expression of MHC class II genes and FC receptors on B-cells and causes their proliferation and differentiation; it also acts on T-cells, mast cells and several other hematopoietic lineage cells.
synonyms: circulating B cell stimulatory factor-1 level
circulating mast cell growth factor-2 level

VT:0008604.name: blood interleukin-7 amount
VT:0008604.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a cytokine produced by bone marrow stromal cells that promotes the growth of B-cell precursors and is co-mitogenic with interleukin-2 for mature T-cell activation.

VT:0008607.name: blood interleukin-13 amount
VT:0008607.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a cytokine synthesized by T-cells that produces proliferation, immunoglobulin isotype switching, and immunoglobulin production by immature B-cells, and appears to play a role in regulating inflammatory and immune responses.

VT:0008610.name: blood interleukin-15 amount
VT:0008610.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a cytokine that stimulates the proliferation of T-cells and can induce proliferation and differentiation of B-cells; interleukin-15 shares biological activities with interleukin-2.

VT:0008613.name: blood interleukin-17 amount
VT:0008613.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a proinflammatory cytokine produced primarily by T-cells or their precursors.
synonyms: circulating cytotoxic T lymphocyte-associated antigen 8 level

VT:0008616.name: blood interleukin-12 amount
VT:0008616.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a heterodimeric cytokine that plays a role in innate and adaptive immune responses; it is produced by dendritic cells, macrophages and a variety of other immune cells and plays a role in the stimulation of interferon-gamma production by T-cells and natural killer cells.
synonyms: circulating cytotoxic lymphocyte maturation factor level
circulating natural killer cell stimulatory factor level

VT:0008619.name: blood interleukin-23 amount
VT:0008619.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a heterodimeric cytokine that plays a role in innate and adaptive immune responses; it is produced by dendritic cells, macrophages and a variety of other immune cells.

VT:0008622.name: blood interleukin-3 amount
VT:0008622.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a multi-lineage cell growth factor secreted by lymphocytes, epithelial cells and astrocytes which stimulates clonal proliferation and differentiation of various types of blood and tissue cells.

VT:0008625.name: blood interleukin-5 amount
VT:0008625.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a cytokine that promotes differentiation and activation of eosinophils; it also triggers activated B-cells to differentiate into immunoglobulin-secreting cells.

VT:0008628.name: blood interleukin-9 amount
VT:0008628.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a multifunctional cytokine secreted by primarily by activated TH2 cells that may play a role as a regulator of allergic inflammation, and has been shown to enhance the growth and differentiation of mast cells, and can act on a variety of other immune cells.
synonyms: circulating P40 T-Cell Growth Factor level
circulating T-Cell Growth Factor P40 level

VT:0008631.name: blood interleukin-16 amount
VT:0008631.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a cytokine produced by activated T-cells that stimulates the migration of CD4-positive lymphocytes and monocytes.

VT:0008634.name: blood interleukin-18 amount
VT:0008634.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a cytokine which enhances the cytotoxic activity of NK cells and cytotoxic T-cells and appears to play a role both as neuroimmunomodulator and in the induction of mucosal immunity.

VT:0008637.name: blood interleukin-1 alpha amount
VT:0008637.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of an interleukin-1 subtype that occurs as a membrane-bound pro-protein form that is cleaved by proteases to form a secreted mature form; both membrane-bound and secreted forms of interleukin-1alpha are biologically active.

VT:0008640.name: blood interleukin-1 beta amount
VT:0008640.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of an interleukin-1 subtype that is synthesized as an inactive membrane-bound pro-protein on monocytes, macrophages and other cells; proteolytic processing of the precursor form by caspase 1 results in release of the active form of interleukin-1beta from the membrane.

VT:0008643.name: blood interleukin-12a amount
VT:0008643.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the p35 subunit of interleukin-12.

VT:0008646.name: blood interleukin-12b amount
VT:0008646.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the p40 cytokine subunit that is a component of both interleukin-12 and interleukin-23.

VT:0008649.name: blood interleukin-23a amount
VT:0008649.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the p19 subunit of interleukin-23.

VT:0008650.name: interleukin-1 secretion trait
VT:0008650.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a soluble factor produced by monocytes, macrophages and other cells, which activates T-lymphocytes and potentiates their response to mitogens or antigens.
synonyms: epidermal cell derived thymocyte-activating factor secretion

VT:0008653.name: interleukin-1 alpha secretion trait
VT:0008653.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of an interleukin-1 subtype that occurs as a membrane-bound pro-protein form that is cleaved by proteases to form a secreted mature form; both membrane-bound and secreted forms of interleukin-1alpha are biologically active.

VT:0008656.name: interleukin-1 beta secretion trait
VT:0008656.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of an interleukin-1 subtype that is synthesized as an inactive membrane-bound pro-protein on monocytes, macrophages and other cells; proteolytic processing of the precursor form by caspase 1 results in release of the active form of interleukin-1beta from the membrane.

VT:0008659.name: interleukin-10 secretion trait
VT:0008659.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a cytokine produced by a variety of cell types, including T-cells, monocytes, dendritic cells and epithelial cells that exerts a variety of effects on immunoregulation and inflammation.

VT:0008662.name: interleukin-12 secretion trait
VT:0008662.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a heterodimeric cytokine that plays a role in innate and adaptive immune responses; it is produced by dendritic cells, macrophages and a variety of other immune cells and plays a role in the stimulation of interferon-gamma production by T-cells and natural killer cells.
synonyms: natural killer cell stimulatory factor secretion

VT:0008665.name: interleukin-12a secretion trait
VT:0008665.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of the p35 subunit of interleukin-12.

VT:0008668.name: interleukin-12b secretion trait
VT:0008668.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of the p40 cytokine subunit that is a component of both interleukin-12 and interleukin-23.

VT:0008671.name: interleukin-13 secretion trait
VT:0008671.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a cytokine synthesized by T-cells that produces proliferation, immunoglobulin isotype switching, and immunoglobulin production by immature B-cells, and appears to play a role in regulating inflammatory and immune responses.

VT:0008674.name: interleukin-15 secretion trait
VT:0008674.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a cytokine that stimulates the proliferation of T-cells and can induce proliferation and differentiation of B-cells; interleukin-15 shares biological activities with interleukin-2.

VT:0008677.name: interleukin-16 secretion trait
VT:0008677.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a cytokine produced by activated T-cells that stimulates the migration of CD4-positive lymphocytes and monocytes.

VT:0008680.name: interleukin-17 secretion trait
VT:0008680.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a proinflammatory cytokine produced primarily by T-cells or their precursors.

VT:0008683.name: interleukin-18 secretion trait
VT:0008683.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a cytokine which enhances the cytotoxic activity of NK cells and cytotoxic T-cells and appears to play a role both as neuroimmunomodulator and in the induction of mucosal immunity.

VT:0008686.name: interleukin-2 secretion trait
VT:0008686.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a soluble substance elaborated by antigen- or mitogen-stimulated T-cells which induces DNA synthesis in naive lymphocytes.

VT:0008689.name: interleukin-23 secretion trait
VT:0008689.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a heterodimeric cytokine that plays a role in innate and adaptive immune responses; it is produced by dendritic cells, macrophages and a variety of other immune cells.

VT:0008692.name: interleukin-23a secretion trait
VT:0008692.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of the p19 subunit of interleukin-23.

VT:0008695.name: interleukin-3 secretion trait
VT:0008695.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a multilineage cell growth factor secreted by lymphocytes, epithelial cells and astrocytes which stimulates clonal proliferation and differentiation of various types of blood and tissue cells.

VT:0008698.name: interleukin-4 secretion trait
VT:0008698.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a soluble factor produced by activated T-cells that induces the expression of MHC class II genes and FC receptors on B-cells and causes their proliferation and differentiation; it also acts on T-cells, mast cells and several other hematopoietic lineage cells.

VT:0008701.name: interleukin-5 secretion trait
VT:0008701.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a cytokine that promotes differentiation and activation of eosinophils; it also triggers activated B-cells to differentiate into immunoglobulin-secreting cells.

VT:0008704.name: interleukin-6 secretion trait
VT:0008704.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a cytokine that stimulates the growth and differentiation of B-cells and is also a growth factor for hybridomas and plasmacytomas, and is produced by many different cells including T-cells, monocytes and fibroblasts.

VT:0008707.name: interleukin-7 secretion trait
VT:0008707.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a cytokine produced by bone marrow stromal cells that promotes the growth of B-cell precursors and is co-mitogenic with interleukin-2 for mature T-cell activation.

VT:0008710.name: interleukin-9 secretion trait
VT:0008710.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a multifunctional cytokine secreted primarily by activated TH2 cells that may play a role as a regulator of allergic inflammation, and has been shown to enhance the growth and differentiation of mast cells, and can act on a variety of other immune cells.

VT:0008713.name: cytokine amount
VT:0008713.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of any of the non-antibody proteins made by inflammatory leukocytes and some non-leukocytic cells that affect the behavior of other cells.

VT:0008719.name: neutrophil recruitment trait
VT:0008719.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the diffusion or accumulation of neutrophils (granular leukocytes that have a three- to five-lobed nucleus and cytoplasm that contains inconspicuous granules stainable by neutral dyes) in tissues or cells in response to a wide variety of substances released at the sites of inflammatory reactions.

VT:0008720.name: neutrophil migration trait
VT:0008720.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the directed and orderly movement of neutrophils (granular leukocytes that have a three- to five-lobed nucleus and cytoplasm that contains inconspicuous granules stainable by neutral dyes) from point to point.

VT:0008721.name: chemokine amount
VT:0008721.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of any of the class of pro-inflammatory cytokines that attract and activate leukocytes.

VT:0008723.name: eosinophil recruitment trait
VT:0008723.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the diffusion or accumulation of eosinophils (granular leukocytes having a two-lobed nucleus and cytoplasm containing coarse, round granules that are uniform in size and stainable by eosin) in tissues or cells in response to a wide variety of substances released at the sites of inflammatory reactions.

VT:0008724.name: eosinophil migration trait
VT:0008724.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the directed and orderly movement of eosinophils (granular leukocytes having a two-lobed nucleus and cytoplasm containing coarse, round granules that are uniform in size and stainable by eosin) from point to point.

VT:0008737.name: spleen physiology trait
VT:0008737.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the organ that filters blood and stores red corpuscles and platelets.

VT:0008739.name: spleen iron amount
VT:0008739.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of iron present in the spleen tissue.

VT:0008744.name: B cell anergy trait
VT:0008744.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process contributing to anergy in B cells, a state of functional inactivation which is part of B cell tolerance induction.

VT:0008745.name: central B cell anergy trait
VT:0008745.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the processes of B cell anergy, a state of functional inactivation that occurs as part of tolerance induction, in B cells in the bone marrow.

VT:0008746.name: peripheral B cell anergy trait
VT:0008746.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the processes of B cell anergy, a state of functional inactivation that occurs as part of tolerance induction, in B cells outside the bone marrow.

VT:0008747.name: T cell anergy trait
VT:0008747.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process contributing to anergy in T cells, a state of functional inactivation which is part of T cell tolerance induction.

VT:0008748.name: central T cell anergy trait
VT:0008748.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the processes of T cell anergy, a state of functional inactivation which is part of tolerance induction, that occur in the thymus.

VT:0008749.name: peripheral T cell anergy trait
VT:0008749.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the processes of T cell anergy, a state of functional inactivation which is part of tolerance induction, that occur outside the thymus.

VT:0008750.name: interferon amount
VT:0008750.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of proteins secreted by vertebrate cells in response to a wide variety of inducers; they confer resistance against many different viruses, inhibit proliferation of normal and malignant cells, impede multiplication of intracellular parasites, enhance macrophage and granulocyte phagocytosis, augment natural killer cell activity, and show several other immunomodulatory functions.

VT:0008751.name: interleukin amount
VT:0008751.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of soluble factors which stimulate growth-related activities of leukocytes as well as other cell types; they enhance cell proliferation and differentiation, DNA synthesis, secretion of other biologically active molecules and responses to immune and inflammatory stimuli.

VT:0008752.name: tumor necrosis factor amount
VT:0008752.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a serum glycoprotein produced by activated macrophages and NK cells and involved in initiating local inflammatory responses, particularly by its action on the endothelium of local blood vessels; its actions result in increased vascular permeability and induction of expression of adhesion molecules on the endothelium.

VT:0008754.name: T cell receptor V(D)J recombination trait
VT:0008754.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which T cell receptor V, D, and J, or V and J gene segments, depending on the specific locus, are recombined within a single locus.

VT:0008755.name: immunoglobulin V(D)J recombination trait
VT:0008755.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which immunoglobulin V, D, and J or V and J gene segments, depending on the specific locus, are recombined within a single locus.

VT:0008756.name: T cell receptor alpha chain V-J recombination trait
VT:0008756.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which V and J gene segments of the T cell receptor alpha chain are recombined.
synonyms: T cell receptor alpha chain V-J joining
