T cell receptor alpha chain V-J rearrangement
T cell receptor alpha chain V-J recombination

VT:0008757.name: T cell receptor gamma chain V-J recombination trait
VT:0008757.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which V and J gene segments of the T cell receptor gamma chain are recombined.
synonyms: T cell receptor gamma chain V-J joining
T cell receptor gamma chain V-J rearrangement
T cell receptor gamma chain V-J recombination

VT:0008758.name: T cell receptor beta chain V(D)J recombination trait
VT:0008758.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which V, D, and J segments of the T cell receptor beta chain are recombined.
synonyms: T cell receptor beta chain V(D)J joining
T cell receptor beta chain V(D)J rearrangement
T cell receptor beta chain V-D-J joining
T cell receptor beta chain V-D-J rearrangement
T cell receptor beta chain V-D-J recombination
T-cell receptor beta chain V(D)J recombination

VT:0008759.name: T cell receptor delta chain V(D)J recombination trait
VT:0008759.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which V, D, and J segments of the T cell receptor delta chain are recombined.
synonyms: T cell receptor delta chain V(D)J joining
T cell receptor delta chain V(D)J rearrangement
T cell receptor delta chain V-D-J joining
T cell receptor delta chain V-D-J rearrangement
T cell receptor delta chain V-D-J recombination
T-cell receptor delta chain V(D)J recombination

VT:0008760.name: immunoglobulin heavy chain V(D)J recombination trait
VT:0008760.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which V, D, and J gene segments of the immunoglobulin heavy chain are recombined.

VT:0008761.name: immunoglobulin light chain V-J recombination trait
VT:0008761.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which V and J gene segments of the immunoglobulin light chain are recombined.

VT:0008766.name: B cell receptor editing trait
VT:0008766.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of replacing receptors on B cells, in which RAG gene expression allows continued light-chain gene rearrangement and expression of a new light chain which combines with the previous heavy chain to form a new receptor.

VT:0008769.name: plasmacytoid dendritic cell physiology trait
VT:0008769.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the phagocytic dendritic cells that are morphologically similar to plasma cells, but do not express B lineage markers, and produce large amounts of alpha/beta interferons (IFN-/) in response to viral and bacterial stimuli; plasmacytoid dendritic cells are found in the thymic medulla and lymph node T cell areas and are responsible for immune tolerance.

VT:0008778.name: lymphangiogenesis trait
VT:0008778.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the formation of lymphatic vessels, tubular vessels involved in the transport of lymph and lymphocytes.

VT:0008781.name: B cell apoptosis trait
VT:0008781.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which B cells undergo programmed cell death.

VT:0008876.name: uterine natural killer cell quantity
VT:0008876.def: The proportion or number of the uterine subset of the non-T, non-B lymphocytes, having a granular morphology and which are important in innate immunity to viruses and other intracellular pathogens; uNK cells contribute to uterine decidualization and are recruited to implantation sites.

VT:0008894.name: intraepithelial T cell morphology trait
VT:0008894.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a T cell present in columnar epithelia such as in the gastrointestinal tract; intraepithelial T cells often have distinct developmental pathways and activation requirements.

VT:0008895.name: intraepithelial T cell quantity
VT:0008895.def: The proportion or number of T cells present in columnar epithelia such as in the gastrointestinal tract; intraepithelial T cells often have distinct developmental pathways and activation requirements.

VT:0008897.name: blood immunoglobulin G2c amount
VT:0008897.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of immunoglobulin class G2c.

VT:0009056.name: interleukin-21 secretion trait
VT:0009056.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a pleiotropic cytokine that regulates immunoglobulin production, plasma cell and Th17 T cell differentiation, CD8+ T cell expansion, and inhibits antigen presentation by dendritic cells.

VT:0009059.name: blood interleukin-21 amount
VT:0009059.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a pleiotropic cytokine that regulates immunoglobulin production, plasma cell and Th17 T cell differentiation, CD8+ T cell expansion, and inhibits antigen presentation by dendritic cells.

VT:0009258.name: thymocyte apoptosis trait
VT:0009258.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which immature T cells located in the thymus undergo programmed cell death.

VT:0009323.name: spleen development trait
VT:0009323.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the organ that filters blood and stores red corpuscles and platelets.

VT:0009332.name: splenocyte morphology trait
VT:0009332.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells of the spleen.

VT:0009333.name: splenocyte physiology trait
VT:0009333.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in any of the cells of the spleen.

VT:0009334.name: splenocyte proliferation trait
VT:0009334.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which the splenocyte cell population undergoes expansion by cell division.

VT:0009340.name: splenocyte apoptosis trait
VT:0009340.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which spleen cells undergo programmed cell death.

VT:0009539.name: Hassall's corpuscle morphology trait
VT:0009539.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the small spherical bodies of epithelial cells found in the medulla of the thymus, that are arranged in a concentric pattern around clusters of degenerating lymphocytes, eosinophils and macrophages.

VT:0009543.name: thymus corticomedullary boundary morphology trait
VT:0009543.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the dense region demarcating the thymus medulla from the surrounding cortex that is characterized by numerous blood vessels (predominantly arterioles) with some perivascular connective tissue, mature and immature T lymphocytes, dendritic cells, variable numbers of perivascular B-lymphocytes and plasma cells; site of entry of bone marrow stem cells and exit of mature, functional T cells.

VT:0009544.name: thymus epithelium morphology trait
VT:0009544.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the supporting framework of the thymus, the primary lymphoid organ that is required for maturation of T cells.

VT:0009623.name: inguinal lymph node size trait
VT:0009623.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the lymph nodes located in the groin area.

VT:0009625.name: abdominal lymph node morphology trait
VT:0009625.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the parietal or visceral lymph nodes of the abdomen.

VT:0009626.name: celiac lymph node morphology trait
VT:0009626.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern any of the visceral lymph nodes located along the celiac trunk, which drain lymph from the stomach, duodenum, pancreas, spleen, and biliary tract.

VT:0009627.name: submandibular lymph node morphology trait
VT:0009627.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lymph nodes beneath the mandible that receive vessels from the face and tongue and drain into the superior deep cervical nodes.

VT:0009629.name: brachial lymph node size trait
VT:0009629.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the lymph nodes located along the brachial vein that receive drainage from most of the free upper limb and send efferent vessels to the central axillary lymph nodes.
synonyms: humeral axillary lymph node size trait

VT:0009631.name: axillary lymph node size trait
VT:0009631.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the lymph nodes located around the axillary vein that receive lymphatic drainage from the upper or forelimb, scapular region and pectoral region.

VT:0009635.name: popliteal lymph node size trait
VT:0009635.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the lymph nodes which drain the legs.

VT:0009858.name: cellular extravasation trait
VT:0009858.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the migration of leukocytes from the blood vessels into the surrounding tissue.

VT:0009919.name: transitional stage T1 B cell morphology trait
VT:0009919.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a type of transitional stage B cell that migrates from the bone marrow into the peripheral circulation, and finally to the spleen; this cell type has the phenotype surface IgM-positive, surface IgD-negative, CD21-negative, CD23-negative, and CD62L-negative.
synonyms: T1 stage B cell morphology trait
transitional one stage B lymphocyte morphology trait
transitional one stage B-cell morphology trait
transitional one stage B-lymphocyte morphology trait

VT:0009920.name: transitional stage T2 B cell morphology trait
VT:0009920.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a type of transitional stage B cell that has the phenotype surface IgM-positive, surface IgD-positive, CD21-positive, CD23-positive, CD62L-negative, and is located in the splenic B follicles.
synonyms: T2 stage B cell morphology trait
transitional two stage B lymphocyte morphology trait
transitional two stage B-cell morphology trait
transitional two stage B-lymphocyte morphology trait

VT:0009921.name: transitional stage T3 B cell morphology trait
VT:0009921.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a type of a transitional stage B cell that expresses surface IgM and IgD, and CD62L; this cell type appears to be an anergic B cell that does not proliferate upon BCR signaling, is found in the spleen and lymph nodes, and has the phenotype surface IgM-positive, surface IgD-positive, CD21-positive, CD23-positive, and CD62L-positive.
synonyms: T3 stage B cell morphology trait
transitional three stage B lymphocyte morphology trait
transitional three stage B-cell morphology trait
transitional three stage B-lymphocyte morphology trait

VT:0009923.name: transitional stage T1 B cell quantity
VT:0009923.def: The proportion or number of a type of transitional stage B cell that migrates from the bone marrow into the peripheral circulation, and finally to the spleen; this cell type has the phenotype surface IgM-positive, surface IgD-negative, CD21-negative, CD23-negative, and CD62L-negative.
synonyms: transitional one stage B lymphocyte number

VT:0009926.name: transitional stage T2 B cell quantity
VT:0009926.def: The proportion or number of a type of transitional stage B cell that has the phenotype surface IgM-positive, surface IgD-positive, CD21-positive, CD23-positive, CD62L-negative, and is located in the splenic B follicles.
synonyms: transitional two stage B lymphocyte number

VT:0010001.name: mammary gland progenitor cell quantity
VT:0010001.def: The proportion or number of precursor cells from which the mammary cell lineage arises, capable of proliferation but unable to self-renew like stem cells, and thus proliferate indefinitely.

VT:0010002.name: mammary gland size trait
VT:0010002.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the milk-producing glands in female mammals, consisting of lobes containing clusters of alveoli with a system of ducts to convey the milk to an external nipple or teat.

VT:0010003.name: bone morphology trait
VT:0010003.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of osseous tissue forming a part of the skeleton; consists of a dense outer layer surrounded by the periosteum, and an inner spongy substance.

VT:0010004.name: milk flow trait
VT:0010004.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the rate of milk flow from the mammary gland.

VT:0010005.name: bone development trait
VT:0010005.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of a portion of osseous tissue forming a part of the skeleton; consists of a dense outer layer surrounded by the periosteum, and an inner spongy substance.

VT:0010006.name: adipose molecular composition trait
VT:0010006.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in fat-storing cells/tissue.

VT:0010007.name: skin adnexa morphology trait
VT:0010007.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the tissues or structures associated with or embedded in the skin.

VT:0010008.name: skin adnexa development trait
VT:0010008.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation or differentiation of any of the tissues or structures associated with or embedded in the skin.

VT:0010009.name: femur mass
VT:0010009.def: The amount of matter in the long bone of the thigh.

VT:0010010.name: femur strength trait
VT:0010010.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the long bone of the thigh to withstand the application of force without yielding or breaking.

VT:0010011.name: femur mineral mass
VT:0010011.def: The amount of matter in the minerals (inorganic elements or compounds that have importance in body functions) in the long bone of the thigh.

VT:0010012.name: humerus strength trait
VT:0010012.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the bone of the forelimb that articulates with the scapula above and the radius and ulna below to withstand the application of force without yielding or breaking.

VT:0010013.name: humerus mass
VT:0010013.def: The amount of matter in the bone of the forelimb that articulates with the scapula above and the radius and ulna below.

VT:0010014.name: femur circumference
VT:0010014.def: The distance around the long bone of the thigh.

VT:0010015.name: tibia mass
VT:0010015.def: The amount of matter in the medial and larger of the two bones of the lower leg, which articulates with the femur, fibula, and talus.

VT:0010016.name: adipocyte quantity
VT:0010016.def: The proportion or number of fat-storing cells.

VT:0010017.name: white adipose mass
VT:0010017.def: The amount of matter in the connective tissue consisting of fat-storing cells and arranged in lobular groups or along minor blood vessels.

VT:0010018.name: mammary gland symmetry
VT:0010018.def: Correspondence in size, shape, and relative position of milk-producing glands in female mammals on opposite sides of a dividing line or plane or about a center or axis.

VT:0010019.name: epididymis mass
VT:0010019.def: The amount of matter in the elongated structure connected to the posterior surface of the testes that transports, stores, and matures spermatozoa between testes and vas deferens.

VT:0010020.name: seminiferous tubule diameter
VT:0010020.def: The distance across the tubules in the testes where spermatogenesis occurs.

VT:0010021.name: muscle molecular composition trait
VT:0010021.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement of an organ or part of the body.

VT:0010022.name: metacarpus length
VT:0010022.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the bones of the forelimbs that articulate proximally with the carpal bones and distally with the phalanges.

VT:0010023.name: forelimb length
VT:0010023.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the anterior/superior jointed appendages used for locomotion or grasping.

VT:0010024.name: hindlimb length
VT:0010024.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the posterior/inferior jointed appendages used for locomotion or grasping.

VT:0010025.name: milk fatty acid C12:1(n-3) amount
VT:0010025.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an omega-3, unsaturated fatty acid with a twelve-carbon backbone.

VT:0010026.name: milk fatty acid C15:0 amount
VT:0010026.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with a fifteen-carbon backbone.

VT:0010027.name: milk fatty acid C24:0 amount
VT:0010027.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with a twenty-four-carbon backbone.

VT:0010028.name: milk total protein amount
VT:0010028.def: The total proportion, quantity, or volume of protein in milk.

VT:0010029.name: milk alpha-lactalbumin amount
VT:0010029.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of alpha-lactalbumin, an enzyme that catalyzes lactose synthesis in mammary epithelial cells.

VT:0010030.name: udder height
VT:0010030.def: The vertical dimension of the organ in certain species containing two or more mammary glands, each with its own nipple.

VT:0010031.name: immune serum protein secretion trait
VT:0010031.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of circulating proteins involved in the body's defense against foreign organisms or substances and aberrant native cells.

VT:0010032.name: chemokine secretion trait
VT:0010032.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of any of the class of pro-inflammatory cytokines that attract and activate leukocytes.

VT:0010033.name: complement protein amount
VT:0010033.def: The proportion, quantity or volume of any of the cascade of circulating proteins that act together to attack extracellular pathogens.

VT:0010034.name: immune serum protein amount
VT:0010034.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of circulating proteins involved in the body's defense against foreign organisms or substances and aberrant native cells.

VT:0010035.name: acute phase protein amount
VT:0010035.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the series of proteins found in the blood shortly after infection, which participate in the early phases of host defense against infection.

VT:0010036.name: C-reactive protein amount
VT:0010036.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of this plasma protein that normally circulates in increased amounts during inflammation or after tissue damage.

VT:0010037.name: serum amyloid protein amount
VT:0010037.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of an acute-phase reaction protein that is a precursor to amyloid A protein; it is present in very high levels during acute inflammatory episodes, and is present in low concentrations in normal sera, but is found at higher concentrations in sera of older persons and in patients with amyloidosis.

VT:0010038.name: adrenergic nerve fiber quantity
VT:0010038.def: The proportion or number of nerve fibers of the autonomic nervous system that use norepinephrine as their neurotransmitter.

VT:0010039.name: adrenergic nerve fiber organization trait
VT:0010039.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of nerve fibers of the autonomic nervous system that use norepinephrine as their neurotransmitter.

VT:0010040.name: lymphatic system physiology trait
VT:0010040.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the system of lymphoid channels and tissues that drains extracellular fluid from the periphery via the thoracic duct to the blood.

VT:0010041.name: cholinergic nerve fiber organization trait
VT:0010041.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of nerve fibers that utilize acetylcholine as a neurotransmitter.

VT:0010042.name: sperm morphology trait
VT:0010042.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the male gamete.

VT:0010043.name: ovarian follicle physiology trait
VT:0010043.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the ovarian follicle.

VT:0010044.name: intramuscular adipose amount
VT:0010044.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of fat-storing cells/tissue present within skeletal muscle.

VT:0010045.name: subcutaneous adipose amount
VT:0010045.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of fat-storing tissue located directly beneath the skin.

VT:0010046.name: fatty acid amount
VT:0010046.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in a body fluid or tissue of organic, monobasic acids derived from hydrocarbons; they are saturated and unsaturated.

VT:0010047.name: tendon physiology trait
VT:0010047.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the fibrous bands or cords of connective tissue at the ends of muscle fibers that attach muscles to bones and other structures.

VT:0010048.name: muscle saturated fatty acid amount
VT:0010048.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of organic, monobasic acids derived from hydrocarbons present in the contractile tissue that effects movement; the carbon chain contains only single carbon-carbon bonds.

VT:0010049.name: muscle unsaturated fatty acid amount
VT:0010049.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of organic, monobasic acids derived from hydrocarbons present in the contractile tissue that effects movement; the carbon chain has one or more double or triple carbon-carbon bonds.

VT:0010050.name: muscle fatty acid C17:0 amount
VT:0010050.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a saturated fatty acid (C17H34O2) present in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0010051.name: muscle fatty acid C14:0 amount
VT:0010051.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a saturated fatty acid (C14H28O2) present in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0010052.name: muscle fatty acid C16:0 amount
VT:0010052.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a saturated fatty acid (C16H32O2) present in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0010053.name: muscle fatty acid C18:0 amount
VT:0010053.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a saturated fatty acid (C18H36O2) present in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0010054.name: muscle fatty acid trans-11-C18:1 amount
VT:0010054.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a monounsaturated fatty acid (C18H34O2), with a carbon-carbon double bond at C-11 position, present in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0010055.name: muscle fatty acid C20:2 amount
VT:0010055.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of an unsaturated fatty acid (C20H36O2), with two carbon-carbon double bonds, present in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0010056.name: muscle fatty acid cis-11-C20:1 amount
VT:0010056.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a monounsaturated fatty acid (C20H38O2), with a carbon-carbon double bond at C-11, present in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0010057.name: muscle fatty acid cis-9,cis-12-C18:2 amount
VT:0010057.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of an omega-6 unsaturated fatty acid (C18H32O2), with two carbon-carbon double bonds, present in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0010058.name: muscle fatty acid C18:3 n-3 amount
VT:0010058.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of an omega-3, polyunsaturated fatty acid (C18H30O2), with three carbon-carbon double bonds, present in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.
synonyms: muscle fatty acid C18:3 n-3 concentration
muscle fatty acid C18:3 n-3 percentage

VT:0010059.name: muscle fatty acid cis-9-C18:1 amount
VT:0010059.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a monounsaturated, omega-9 fatty acid (C18H34O2), present in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0010060.name: muscle fatty acid cis-9-C16:1 amount
VT:0010060.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of an omega-7, monounsaturated fatty acid (C16H30O2) present in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0010061.name: brown adipocyte morphology trait
VT:0010061.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cells of the thermogenic form of adipose capable of rapid liberation of energy; contain multiple small droplets of triglycerides and a high number of mitochondria.

VT:0010062.name: cholinergic nerve fiber quantity
VT:0010062.def: The proportion or number of nerve fibers that utilize acetylcholine as a neurotransmitter.

VT:0010063.name: visceral adipose mass
VT:0010063.def: The amount of matter in the fat-storing tissue surrounding the internal organs.

VT:0010064.name: connective tissue physiology trait
VT:0010064.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the physical or functional supporting tissue of the body, a major constituent of which is an extracellular matrix of ground substance, protein fibers, and structural glycoproteins.

VT:0010065.name: connective tissue development trait
VT:0010065.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the physical or functional supporting tissue of the body, a major constituent of which is an extracellular matrix of ground substance, protein fibers, and structural glycoproteins.

VT:0010066.name: Henle's loop morphology trait
VT:0010066.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the U-shaped portion of the renal tubule, consisting of descending and ascending limbs; situated between the proximal and distal convoluted tubules.

VT:0010067.name: convoluted tubule morphology trait
VT:0010067.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the convoluted segments of nephron made up of the proximal tubule, leading from the glomerular capsule to the descending limb of Henle's loop, and the distal tubule, leading from the ascending limb of Henle's loop to a collecting tubule.

VT:0010068.name: kidney collecting duct morphology trait
VT:0010068.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the small ducts that receive urine from several renal tubules, which converge to join larger collecting tubules (papillary ducts of Bellini) that open into the renal pelvis.

VT:0010069.name: proximal convoluted tubule morphology trait
VT:0010069.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the portion of the renal tubule that extends from the glomerular capsule to the descending limb of Henle's loop.

VT:0010070.name: distal convoluted tubule morphology trait
VT:0010070.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the portion of the renal tubule that extends from the ascending limb of Henle's loop to a collecting tubule.

VT:0010071.name: lymphatic system morphology trait
VT:0010071.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the system of lymphoid channels and tissues that drains extracellular fluid from the periphery via the thoracic duct to the blood.

VT:0010072.name: lymphatic system development trait
VT:0010072.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the system of lymphoid channels and tissues that drains extracellular fluid from the periphery via the thoracic duct to the blood.

VT:0010073.name: esophagus length
VT:0010073.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the part of the digestive canal through which food passes from the pharynx to the stomach.

VT:0010074.name: enteric cholinergic nerve fiber quantity
VT:0010074.def: The proportion or number of nerve fibers that utilize acetylcholine as a neurotransmitter and transmit impulses to the alimentary tube.

VT:0010075.name: occipitomastoid suture morphology trait
VT:0010075.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the cranial suture that lies between the occipital bone and the mastoid portion of the temporal bones; continuous with the lambdoid suture.

VT:0010076.name: parietomastoid suture morphology trait
VT:0010076.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the suture that unites the mastoid process of the temporal bone with the region of the mastoid angle of the parietal bone; continuous with the squamosal suture.

VT:0010077.name: sphenofrontal suture morphology trait
VT:0010077.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the union between the orbital plate of the frontal bone and the lesser wings of the sphenoid on either side.

VT:0010078.name: sphenoparietal suture morphology trait
VT:0010078.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the union between the lower border of the parietal bone with the upper edge of the greater wing of the sphenoid.

VT:0010079.name: sphenozygomatic suture morphology trait
VT:0010079.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the junction between the zygomatic bone and greater wing of the sphenoid.

VT:0010080.name: skeletal muscle physiology trait
VT:0010080.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in any of the striated muscles connected at either or both extremities with the bony framework of the body.

VT:0010081.name: maxillary sinus morphology trait
VT:0010081.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the large pyramidal cavity within the body of the maxilla; its apex is formed by the zygomatic process and its base by the lateral wall of the nose.

VT:0010082.name: zygomatic process of maxilla morphology trait
VT:0010082.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the rough projection of the upper bony framework of the mouth, which articulates with the zygomatic bone.

VT:0010083.name: frontal process of maxilla morphology trait
VT:0010083.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the upward extension from the body of the upper bony framework of the mouth, which articulates with the frontal bone.

VT:0010084.name: long lived plasma cell morphology trait
VT:0010084.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a fully differentiated plasma cell that lives for years, as opposed to months, secretes immunoglobulin, and has the phenotype weakly CD19-positive, CD20-negative, CD38-negative, strongly CD138-positive, MHC Class II-negative, surface immunoglobulin-negative, IgD-negative, and strongly CXCR4-positive; the majority of these cells of this type reside in the bone marrow.

VT:0010085.name: short lived plasma cell morphology trait
VT:0010085.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a fully differentiated plasma cell that lives for months, not years.

VT:0010086.name: vertebral column morphology trait
VT:0010086.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the supporting, flexible bony structure that encases the spinal cord.

VT:0010087.name: ischium morphology trait
VT:0010087.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the lower, posterior part of the hip bone, which fuses with the ilium and pubis.

VT:0010088.name: pubis morphology trait
VT:0010088.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the anteroinferior portion of the hip bone, which fuses with the ilium and ischium.

VT:0010089.name: shoulder girdle morphology trait
VT:0010089.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the incomplete bony ring by which the upper/fore limbs are attached to the axial skeleton.

VT:0010090.name: pelvic girdle morphology trait
VT:0010090.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the bony structure by which the lower or hind limbs are attached to the axial skeleton.

VT:0010091.name: appendicular skeleton morphology trait
VT:0010091.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the bones of the limbs and the shoulder and pelvic girdles.

VT:0010092.name: thoracic cage morphology trait
VT:0010092.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the bony and cartilaginous structure enclosing the thoracic cavity, consisting of the thoracic vertebrae, ribs, costal cartilages, and sternum.

VT:0010093.name: costal cartilage morphology trait
VT:0010093.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the nonvascular, flexible hyaline connective tissue that forms the anterior continuation of a rib, the means by which it articulates with the sternum.

VT:0010094.name: osteoblast morphology trait
VT:0010094.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the bone-forming cell that is derived from mesenchymal osteoprogenitor cells and forms an osseous matrix in which it becomes enclosed as an osteocyte.

VT:0010095.name: osteoclast morphology trait
VT:0010095.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a large, multinucleated cell that functions in the absorption and removal of osseous tissue.

VT:0010096.name: osteoblast quantity
VT:0010096.def: The proportion or number of bone-forming cells that are derived from mesenchymal osteoprogenitor cells and form an osseous matrix in which they become enclosed as osteocytes.

VT:0010097.name: osteocyte morphology trait
VT:0010097.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a mature osteoblast that has become embedded in the bone matrix in small cavities called lacunae and has cytoplasmic processes that extend into canaliculi and make contact with the processes of other osteocytes.

VT:0010098.name: osteoclast quantity
VT:0010098.def: The proportion or number of large, multinucleated cells that function in the absorption and removal of osseous tissue.

VT:0010099.name: enteric cholinergic nerve fiber organization trait
VT:0010099.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of nerve fibers that utilize acetylcholine as a neurotransmitter and transmit impulses to the alimentary tube.

VT:0010100.name: lacrimal gland cholinergic nerve fiber organization trait
VT:0010100.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of nerve fibers that utilize acetylcholine as a neurotransmitter and transmit impulses to the gland that secretes tears.

VT:0010101.name: medullary cavity development trait
VT:0010101.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the marrow cavity in the shaft of a long bone during its formation and differentiation.

VT:0010102.name: vertebral column development trait
VT:0010102.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the supporting, flexible bony structure that encases the spinal cord.

VT:0010103.name: parotid salivary gland cholinergic nerve fiber organization trait
VT:0010103.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of nerve fibers that utilize acetylcholine as a neurotransmitter and transmit impulses to the exocrine gland lateral to the jaw that secretes saliva.

VT:0010104.name: forelimb long bone morphology trait
VT:0010104.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the elongated bones of the anterior/superior extremities, consisting of a tubular shaft (diaphysis) and two extremities (epiphyses).

VT:0010105.name: hindlimb long bone morphology trait
VT:0010105.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the elongated bones of the posterior/inferior extremities, consisting of a tubular shaft (diaphysis) and two extremities (epiphyses).

VT:0010106.name: limb muscle morphology trait
VT:0010106.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the muscles of the anterior or posterior extremities.

VT:0010107.name: hindlimb muscle morphology trait
VT:0010107.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the muscles of the posterior extremities.

VT:0010108.name: hippocampus pyramidal cell morphology trait
VT:0010108.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the projection neurons in the pyramidal layer of the hippocampus.

VT:0010109.name: hippocampus pyramidal cell quantity
VT:0010109.def: The proportion or number of projection neurons in the pyramidal layer of the hippocampus.

VT:0010110.name: heart muscle physiology trait
VT:0010110.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the striated, involuntary muscle comprising the myocardium.

VT:0010111.name: smooth muscle physiology trait
VT:0010111.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in any of the unstriated, involuntary muscle tissue of the internal organs, blood vessels, and other body structures not under willful control.

VT:0010112.name: intercalated disc morphology trait
VT:0010112.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the electron-dense junctional complex, at the end-to-end contacts of cardiac muscle cells, that contains three types of membrane junctions (fascia adherens, gap junctions and occasionally desmosomes).

VT:0010113.name: masticatory muscle size trait
VT:0010113.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of any of the muscles responsible for the movement of the jaws during mastication, including the masseter, temporalis, and medial and lateral pterygoid muscles.

VT:0010114.name: intercostal muscle size trait
VT:0010114.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the respiratory muscles that arise from the lower border of one rib and insert into the upper border of the adjoining rib.

VT:0010115.name: diaphragm size trait
VT:0010115.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the thin musculomebranous barrier that separates the abdominal and thoracic cavities; often used for breathing control.

VT:0010116.name: pectoralis muscle size trait
VT:0010116.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of either or both of the two muscles that make up the upper and fore part of the chest that adduct and rotate the forelimb and lift the ribs.

VT:0010117.name: longissimus thoracis size trait
VT:0010117.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the muscle of the back which is the intermediate and largest of the continuations of the Sacrospinalis.

VT:0010118.name: muscle cellular composition trait
VT:0010118.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic pertaining to the proportions of cells within the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement of an organ or part of the body.

VT:0010119.name: skeletal muscle cellular composition trait
VT:0010119.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of cells in any of the striated muscles connected at either or both extremities with the bony framework of the body.

VT:0010120.name: protein amount
VT:0010120.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in a body tissue or fluid of macromolecules consisting of long sequences of amino acids in peptide linkage.

VT:0010121.name: sublingual salivary gland cholinergic nerve fiber organization trait
VT:0010121.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of nerve fibers that utilitze acetylcholine as a neurotransmitter and transmit impulses to the exocrine gland on the floor of the mouth that secretes saliva.

VT:0010122.name: somite morphology trait
VT:0010122.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the paired, metamerically arranged cell masses formed in the embryonic paraxial mesoderm.

VT:0010123.name: lacrimal gland cholinergic nerve fiber quantity
VT:0010123.def: The proportion or number of nerve fibers that utilize acetylcholine as a neurotransmitter and transmit impulses to the gland that secretes tears.

VT:0010124.name: parotid salivary gland cholinergic nerve fiber quantity
VT:0010124.def: The proportion or number of nerve fibers that utilize acetylcholine as a neurotransmitter and transmit impulses to the exocrine gland lateral to the jaw that secretes saliva.

VT:0010125.name: celiac lymph node size trait
VT:0010125.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the visceral lymph nodes located along the celiac trunk, which drain lymph from the stomach, duodenum, pancreas, spleen, and biliary tract.

VT:0010126.name: sublingual salivary gland cholinergic nerve fiber quantity
VT:0010126.def: The proportion or number of nerve fibers that utilitze acetylcholine as a neurotransmitter and transmit impulses to the exocrine gland on the floor of the mouth that secretes saliva.

VT:0010127.name: bursa of Fabricius size trait
VT:0010127.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of an epithelial outgrowth of the cloaca in birds; prior to involution, it is where B-lymphocyte maturation occurs.

VT:0010128.name: sensory nerve fiber quantity
VT:0010128.def: The proportion or number of fibers of afferent nerves conveying impulses processed by the central nervous system.

VT:0010129.name: esophagus mass
VT:0010129.def: The amount of matter in the part of the digestive canal through which food passes from the pharynx to the stomach.

VT:0010130.name: DN1 thymic pro-T cell quantity
VT:0010130.def: The proportion or number of pro-T cells that have the cell surface marker phenotype CD4-negative, CD8-negative, CD44-positive, and CD25-negative.
synonyms: DN1 thymic progenitor T cell number

VT:0010131.name: cecum mass
VT:0010131.def: The amount of matter in the large sac at the ileum and large intestine junction.

VT:0010132.name: DN2 thymocyte quantity
VT:0010132.def: The proportion or number of thymocytes that have the cell surface marker phenotype CD4-negative, CD8-negative, CD44-positive, and CD25-positive.
synonyms: DN2 alpha-beta immature T lymphocyte number

VT:0010133.name: gizzard capacity
VT:0010133.def: The volume of or amount contained in the secondary, muscular stomach in some vertebrates used for grinding up food.

VT:0010134.name: DN3 thymocyte quantity
VT:0010134.def: The proportion or number of thymocytes that have the cell surface marker phenotype CD4-negative, CD8-negative, CD44-negative, and CD25-positive and expressing the T cell receptor beta-chain in complex with the pre-T cell receptor alpha chain.
synonyms: DN3 alpha-beta immature T lymphocyte number

VT:0010135.name: gizzard muscle thickness
VT:0010135.def: The distance between the surfaces of the layer of muscular tissue surrounding the secondary, muscular stomach in some vertebrates used for grinding up food.

VT:0010136.name: DN4 thymocyte quantity
VT:0010136.def: The proportion or number of thymocytes that have the cell surface marker phenotype CD4-negative, CD8-negative, CD44-negative, CD25-negative, and pre-TCR-positive.
synonyms: DN4 alpha-beta immature T lymphocyte number

VT:0010137.name: sensory nerve fiber organization trait
VT:0010137.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of the fibers of afferent nerves conveying impulses processed by the central nervous system.

VT:0010138.name: lymphatic vessel cell quantity
VT:0010138.def: The proportion or number of cells in the network of vessels which carries lymph around the body.

VT:0010139.name: immune response trait
VT:0010139.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity to change, adjust, or alter any immune system process or function as a result of a potential internal or invasive threat.

VT:0010140.name: small intestine mass
VT:0010140.def: The amount of matter in the upper portion of the digestive tract, between the stomach and the large intestine.
synonyms: tissue weight of the small intestine

VT:0010141.name: optic nerve fiber organization trait
VT:0010141.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to systematic arrangement of the fibers of the second cranial nerve which is responsible for conveying visual information from the retina to the brain.

VT:0010142.name: nerve fiber organization trait
VT:0010142.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of the elongated processes of neurons.

VT:0010143.name: nerve fiber quantity
VT:0010143.def: The proportion or number of elongated processes of neurons.

VT:0010144.name: pancreas mass
VT:0010144.def: The amount of matter in the organ that secretes pancreatic juice into the duodenum and secretes glucagon and insulin into the bloodstream.

VT:0010145.name: rectum mass
VT:0010145.def: The amount of matter in the terminal portion of the intestinal tube adjacent to the anus.

VT:0010146.name: obsolete mannose-binding protein physiology trait
VT:0010146.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of a protein involved in innate immunity, which can bind mannosylated microorganisms and activate the complement pathway.

VT:0010147.name: obsolete inflammatory mediator physiology trait
VT:0010147.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of any of the endogenous compounds that mediate the local accumulation of fluid, plasma proteins, and leukocytes at the site of injury, insult, or infection.

VT:0010148.name: Merkel's receptor nerve fiber organization trait
VT:0010148.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of nerve fibers to the modified epidermal cells located in the stratum basale and found mostly in areas where sensory perception is acute.

VT:0010149.name: obsolete chemokine physiology trait
VT:0010149.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of any of the class of pro-inflammatory cytokines that attract and activate leukocytes.

VT:0010150.name: Merkel's receptor nerve fiber quantity
VT:0010150.def: The proportion or number of nerve fibers to the modified epidermal cells located in the stratum basale and found mostly in areas where sensory perception is acute.

VT:0010151.name: Purkinje cell nerve fiber quantity
VT:0010151.def: The proportion or number of nerve fibers that connect to the neurons located at the interface of the molecular and internal granule layers of the cerebellar cortex.

VT:0010152.name: obsolete chemotactic interleukin physiology trait
VT:0010152.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of any of a subset of interleukins that are involved in attracting leukocytes to a site of tissue injury.

VT:0010153.name: obsolete interleukin-8 physiology trait
VT:0010153.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of this protein secreted by macrophages which is chemotactic for neutrophils and T cells.

VT:0010154.name: Purkinje cell nerve fiber organization trait
VT:0010154.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of nerve fibers that connect to the neurons located at the interface of the molecular and internal granule layers of the cerebellar cortex.

VT:0010155.name: cochlear inner hair cell afferent nerve fiber organization trait
VT:0010155.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of afferent terminals and/or their synapses in the cochlear IHC region.

VT:0010156.name: obsolete cytokine physiology trait
VT:0010156.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of any of the non-antibody proteins made by inflammatory leukocytes and some non-leukocytic cells that affect the behavior of other cells.

VT:0010157.name: cochlear inner hair cell efferent nerve fiber organization trait
VT:0010157.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of nerve fibers to the normally dense plexus of efferent terminals that contact radial fibers of the spiral ganglion below cochlear IHCs or of the sparser plexus of terminals positioned around IHC somata; normally, lateral olivocochlear neurons, which are found in and/or around the lateral superior olive, project mainly to the ipsilateral cochlea and terminate mostly on dendritic fibers below IHCs.

VT:0010158.name: obsolete interferon physiology trait
VT:0010158.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of any of the cytokines produced by T cells, fibroblasts and other cells in response to a challenge by a foreign agents such as viruses, bacteria, parasites and tumor cells.

VT:0010159.name: obsolete interleukin physiology trait
VT:0010159.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of any of the cytokines produced by leukocytes.

VT:0010160.name: obsolete tumor necrosis factor-alpha physiology trait
VT:0010160.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of a a serum glycoprotein produced by activated macrophages and NK cells and involved in initiating local inflammatory responses, particularly by its action on the endothelium of local blood vessels; its actions result in increased vascular permeability and induction of expression of adhesion molecules on the endothelium.

VT:0010161.name: obsolete interleukin-1 physiology trait
VT:0010161.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of this soluble factor produced by macrophages/monocytes that activates vascular endothelium and lymphocytes.

VT:0010162.name: obsolete interleukin-10 physiology trait
VT:0010162.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of this factor that is a co-regulator of mast cell growth and produced by T and B cells.

VT:0010163.name: obsolete interleukin-2 physiology trait
VT:0010163.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of this cytokine released by helper T cells that stimulates proliferation of T lymphocytes and activated B lymphocytes.

VT:0010164.name: obsolete interleukin-6 physiology trait
VT:0010164.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of this soluble factor produced by B- and T-cells, with effects on T- and B-cell growth and differentiation, and in acute phase reactions.

VT:0010165.name: obsolete interleukin-2 activity
VT:0010165.def: OBSOLETE. The degree of function or response of this cytokine released by helper T cells that stimulates proliferation of T lymphocytes and activated B lymphocytes.

VT:0010166.name: obsolete induced interleukin-2 activity
VT:0010166.def: OBSOLETE. The degree of function or response to an external intervention of the cytokine released by helper T cells that stimulates proliferation of T lymphocytes and activated B lymphocytes.

VT:0010167.name: obsolete complement protein physiology trait
VT:0010167.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of any of the complement proteins.

VT:0010168.name: obsolete C1 physiology trait
VT:0010168.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of the complement protein, C1.

VT:0010169.name: obsolete C2 physiology trait
VT:0010169.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of the complement protein, C2.

VT:0010170.name: obsolete C3 physiology trait
VT:0010170.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of the complement protein, C3.

VT:0010171.name: obsolete C4 physiology trait
VT:0010171.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of the complement protein, C4.

VT:0010172.name: obsolete C5 physiology trait
VT:0010172.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of the complement protein, C5.

VT:0010173.name: obsolete C6 physiology trait
VT:0010173.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of the complement protein, C6.

VT:0010174.name: obsolete C7 physiology trait
VT:0010174.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of the complement protein, C7.

VT:0010175.name: obsolete C8 physiology trait
VT:0010175.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of the complement protein, C8.

VT:0010176.name: obsolete C9 physiology trait
VT:0010176.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of the complement protein, C9.

VT:0010177.name: obsolete factor B physiology trait
VT:0010177.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of the complement protein, factor B.

VT:0010178.name: obsolete factor D physiology trait
VT:0010178.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of the complement protein, factor D.

VT:0010179.name: immune system development trait
VT:0010179.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation or differentiation of the organs or cells associated with the body's defense against foreign organisms or substances and aberrant native cells.

VT:0010180.name: bone marrow cell development trait
VT:0010180.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the cells found in the bone marrow during their formation and differentiation.

VT:0010181.name: myeloblast development trait
VT:0010181.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of cells found in the bone marrow, which eventually give rise to the granulocyte line of blood cells, during their formation and differentiation.

VT:0010182.name: blood cell development trait
VT:0010182.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of any of the cells found in the blood during their formation or differentiation.

VT:0010183.name: platelet morphology trait
VT:0010183.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of disc-like fragments of megakaryocytes that are found in the blood and function in clotting.

VT:0010184.name: lymphocyte proliferation trait
VT:0010184.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which lymphocyte populations (any of the white blood cells that include B cells, T cells, and NK cells) undergo expansion by cell division.

VT:0010185.name: cochlear inner hair cell afferent nerve fiber quantity
VT:0010185.def: The proportion or number of afferent terminals and/or their synapses in the cochlear IHC region.

VT:0010186.name: cochlear inner hair cell efferent nerve fiber quantity
VT:0010186.def: The proportion or number of nerve fibers to the normally dense plexus of efferent terminals that contact radial fibers of the spiral ganglion below cochlear IHCs or of the sparser plexus of terminals positioned around IHC somata; normally, lateral olivocochlear neurons, which are found in and/or around the lateral superior olive, project mainly to the ipsilateral cochlea and terminate mostly on dendritic fibers below IHCs.

VT:0010187.name: Meissner's corpuscle nerve fiber quantity
VT:0010187.def: The proportion or number of nerve fibers to any part of the numerous oval bodies found in the dermal papillae of thick skin and which are believed to be mechanoreceptors for tactile sensation.

VT:0010188.name: Meissner's corpuscle nerve fiber organization trait
VT:0010188.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of nerve fibers to any part of the numerous oval bodies found in the dermal papillae of thick skin and which are believed to be mechanoreceptors for tactile sensation.

VT:0010189.name: muscle nerve fiber organization trait
VT:0010189.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of sensory or motor nerve fibers to targets in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement of an organ or part of the body.

VT:0010190.name: basophil development trait
VT:0010190.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of granular leukocytes that are characterized by pale-staining, lobate nucleus and cytoplasm and contain dark-staining granules of varying size and stainable by basic dyes.

VT:0010191.name: immune system cell quantity
VT:0010191.def: The proportion or number of cells associated with the body's defense against foreign organisms or substances and aberrant native cells.

VT:0010192.name: CD4-negative, CD8-negative, alpha-beta intraepithelial T cell morphology trait
VT:0010192.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a CD4-negative, CD8-negative, alpha-beta T cell present in columnar epithelia such as in the gastrointestinal tract; intraepithelial T cells often have distinct developmental pathways and activation requirements.
synonyms: CD4-, CD8-, alpha-beta intraepithelial T cell morphology trait
CD4-negative, CD8-negative, alpha-beta intraepithelial T lymphocyte morphology trait
CD4-negative, CD8-negative, alpha-beta intraepithelial T-cell morphology trait
CD4-negative, CD8-negative, alpha-beta intraepithelial T-lymphocyte morphology trait

VT:0010193.name: colon length
VT:0010193.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the portion of the large intestine between the cecum and the rectum.

VT:0010194.name: colon mass
VT:0010194.def: The amount of matter in the portion of the large intestine between the cecum and the rectum.

VT:0010195.name: intestine length
VT:0010195.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the digestive tube passing from the stomach to the anus.

VT:0010196.name: intestine mass
VT:0010196.def: The amount of matter in the digestive tube passing from the stomach to the anus.

VT:0010197.name: duodenum length
VT:0010197.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the first division of the small intestine that extends from the pyloris to the junction with the jejunum.

VT:0010198.name: duodenum mass
VT:0010198.def: The amount of matter in the first division of the small intestine that extends from the pyloris to the junction with the jejunum.

VT:0010199.name: stomach capacity
VT:0010199.def: The volume of or amount contained in the sac-like structure of the digestive canal between the esophagus and the small intestine.

VT:0010200.name: stomach mass
VT:0010200.def: The amount of matter in the sac-like structure of the digestive canal between the esophagus and the small intestine.

VT:0010201.name: stomach muscle thickness
VT:0010201.def: The distance between the surfaces of the layer of smooth excitable and contractile fibers of the sac-like structure of the digestive canal between the esophagus and the small intestine.

VT:0010202.name: stomach epithelium thickness
VT:0010202.def: The distance between the surfaces of the layer of epithelial cells of the sac-like structure of the digestive canal between the esophagus and the small intestine.

VT:0010203.name: proventriculus morphology trait
VT:0010203.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the first muscular and glandular part of the stomach of birds where digestive enzymes are secreted and mixed with food.

VT:0010204.name: proventriculus capacity
VT:0010204.def: The volume of or amount contained in the first muscular and glandular part of the stomach of birds where digestive enzymes are secreted and mixed with food.

VT:0010205.name: proventriculus mass
VT:0010205.def: The amount of matter in the first muscular and glandular part of the stomach of birds where digestive enzymes are secreted and mixed with food.

VT:0010206.name: proventriculus mucosa thickness
VT:0010206.def: The distance between the surfaces of the mucosal layer lining the first muscular and glandular part of the stomach of birds where digestive enzymes are secreted and mixed with food.

VT:0010207.name: duodenum muscle thickness
VT:0010207.def: The distance between the surfaces of the muscle layer of the first division of the small intestine that extends from the pyloris to the junction with the jejunum.

VT:0010208.name: duodenum mucosa thickness
VT:0010208.def: The distance from between the surfaces of the mucosal layer lining the first division of the small intestine that extends from the pyloris to the junction with the jejunum.

VT:0010209.name: duodenum villi length
VT:0010209.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the finger-like projections of the mucosal layer of the duodenum.
synonyms: height of the villi of the duodenum

VT:0010210.name: duodenum crypt of Lieberkuhn depth
VT:0010210.def: The distance between the inferior and superior edges of any of the straight tubular glands located in the epithelial layer of the intestine between the bases of the villi of the duodenum.
synonyms: depth of the glandular crypts of the duodenum

VT:0010211.name: duodenum crypt of Lieberkuhn width
VT:0010211.def: The distance from side to side of the straight tubular glands located in the epithelial layer of the intestine between the bases of the villi of the duodenum.
synonyms: width of the glandular crypts of the duodenum

VT:0010212.name: jejunum length
VT:0010212.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the portion of the small intestine that extends from the duodenum to the ileum.

VT:0010213.name: jejunum mass
VT:0010213.def: The amount of matter in the portion of the small intestine that extends from the duodenum to the ileum.

VT:0010214.name: jejunum muscle thickness
VT:0010214.def: The distance between the surfaces of the muscle layer of the portion of the small intestine that extends from the duodenum to the ileum.

VT:0010215.name: jejunum mucosa thickness
VT:0010215.def: The distance between the surfaces of the mucosal layer lining the portion of the small intestine that extends from the duodenum to the ileum.

VT:0010216.name: jejunum villi length
VT:0010216.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the finger-like projections of the mucosal cell layer of the jejunum.
synonyms: height of the villi of the jejunum

VT:0010217.name: jejunum crypt of Lieberkuhn depth
VT:0010217.def: The distance between the inferior and superior edges of the straight tubular glands located in the epithelial layer of the intestine between the bases of the villi of the jejunum.
synonyms: depth of the glandular crypts of the jejunum

VT:0010218.name: jejunum crypt of Lieberkuhn width
VT:0010218.def: The distance from side to side of the straight tubular glands located in the epithelial layer of the intestine between the bases of the villi of the jejunum.
synonyms: width of the glandular crypts of the jejunum

VT:0010219.name: large intestine length
VT:0010219.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the distal portion of the digestive tube that extends from the ileocecal valve to the anus.

VT:0010220.name: large intestine mass
VT:0010220.def: The amount of matter in the distal portion of the digestive tube that extends from the ileocecal valve to the anus.
synonyms: tissue weight of the large intestine

VT:0010221.name: duodenum mucosa morphology trait
VT:0010221.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the mucous lining of the first division of the small intestine that extends from the pyloris to the junction with the jejunum; this consists of epithelium, lamina propria, and a layer of smooth muscle cells.

VT:0010222.name: jejunum mucosa morphology trait
VT:0010222.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the mucous lining of the portion of the small intestine that extends from the duodenum to the ileum; this consists of epithelium, lamina propria, and a layer of smooth muscle cells.

VT:0010223.name: ileum mucosa morphology trait
VT:0010223.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the mucous lining of the portion of the small intestine that extends from the jejunum to the colon; this consists of epithelium, lamina propria, and a layer of smooth muscle cells.

VT:0010224.name: ileum length
VT:0010224.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the portion of the small intestine that extends from the jejunum to the colon.

VT:0010225.name: ileum mass
VT:0010225.def: The amount of matter in the portion of the small intestine that extends from the jejunum to the colon.

VT:0010226.name: ileum muscle thickness
VT:0010226.def: The distance between the surfaces of the muscle layer of the portion of the small intestine that extends from the jejunum to the colon.

VT:0010227.name: ileum mucosa thickness
VT:0010227.def: The distance between the surfaces of the portion of the small intestine that extends from the jejunum to the colon.

VT:0010228.name: ileum villi length
VT:0010228.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the finger-like projections of the mucosal cell layer of the ileum.
synonyms: height of the villi of the ileum

VT:0010229.name: ileum crypt of Lieberkuhn depth
VT:0010229.def: The distance between the inferior and superior edges of the straight tubular glands located in the epithelial layer of the intestine between the bases of the villi of the ileum.
synonyms: depth of the glandular crypts of the ileum

VT:0010230.name: ileum crypt of Lieberkuhn width
VT:0010230.def: The distance from side to side of the straight tubular glands located in the epithelial layer of the intestine between the bases of the villi of the ileum.
synonyms: width of the glandular crypts of the ileum

VT:0010231.name: colon muscle thickness
VT:0010231.def: The distance between the surfaces of the muscle surrounding the portion of the large intestine between the cecum and the rectum.

VT:0010232.name: colon mucosa thickness
VT:0010232.def: The distance between the surfaces of the mucosal layer lining the portion of the large intestine between the cecum and the rectum.

VT:0010233.name: cecum muscle thickness
VT:0010233.def: The distance between the surfaces of the muscle surrounding the large sac at the ileum and large intestine junction.

VT:0010234.name: cecum mucosa thickness
VT:0010234.def: The distance between the surfaces of the mucosal layer lining the large sac at the ileum and large intestine junction.

VT:0010235.name: forestomach morphology trait
VT:0010235.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the large fermentation chamber situated anteriorly to the stomach in some species.

VT:0010236.name: forestomach capacity
VT:0010236.def: The volume of or amount contained in the large fermentation chamber situated anteriorly to the stomach in some species.

VT:0010237.name: forestomach mass
VT:0010237.def: The amount of matter in the large fermentation chamber situated anteriorly to the stomach in some species.

VT:0010238.name: crop morphology trait
VT:0010238.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the esophageal anatomical diverticulum in some species.

VT:0010239.name: crop mass
VT:0010239.def: The amount of matter in the esophageal anatomical diverticulum in some species.

VT:0010240.name: reticulo-rumen morphology trait
VT:0010240.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the first two compartments of the forestomach of ruminants, composed of the reticulum and the rumen which communicates anteriorly with the oesophagus and posteriorly with the omasum.

VT:0010241.name: reticulo-rumen capacity
VT:0010241.def: The volume of or amount contained in the forestomach of ruminants, composed of the reticulum and the rumen which communicates anteriorly with the esophagus and posteriorly with the omasum.

VT:0010242.name: reticulo-rumen mass
VT:0010242.def: The amount of matter in the forestomach of ruminants, composed of the reticulum and the rumen which communicates anteriorly with the oesophagus and posteriorly with the omasum.

VT:0010243.name: reticulo-rumen epithelium thickness
VT:0010243.def: The distance between the surfaces of the layer of membranous tissue that lines the internal surface of the reticulo-rumen.

VT:0010244.name: rumen papillae morphology trait
VT:0010244.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the small, finger-like projections of the surface epithelial layer in the rumen.

VT:0010245.name: omasum morphology trait
VT:0010245.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the third forestomach of ruminants which connects the reticulum to the abomasum.

VT:0010246.name: omasum capacity
VT:0010246.def: The volume of or amount contained in the third forestomach of ruminants which connects the reticulum to the abomasum.

VT:0010247.name: omasum mass
VT:0010247.def: The amount of matter in the third forestomach in ruminants which connects the reticulum to the abomasum.

VT:0010248.name: hemolymphoid system trait
VT:0010248.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the blood forming organs and tissues and the system of lymphoid channels and tissues that drains extracellular fluid from the periphery via the thoracic duct to the blood.

VT:0010249.name: blood cell physiology trait
VT:0010249.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in any of the cells found in the blood.

VT:0010250.name: hematopoietic system morphology trait
VT:0010250.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of cells found in the blood and/or the blood-forming organs and tissues.

VT:0010251.name: hemolymphoid system development trait
VT:0010251.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the blood forming organs and tissues and the system of lymphoid channels and tissues that drains extracellular fluid from the periphery via the thoracic duct to the blood.

VT:0010252.name: hemolymphoid system morphology trait
VT:0010252.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the blood forming organs and tissues and the system of lymphoid channels and tissues that drains extracellular fluid from the periphery via the thoracic duct to the blood.

VT:0010253.name: hemolymphoid system physiology trait
VT:0010253.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the blood forming organs and tissues and the system of lymphoid channels and tissues that drains extracellular fluid from the periphery via the thoracic duct to the blood.

VT:0010254.name: hematopoietic system physiology trait
VT:0010254.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the cells found in the blood and/or the blood-forming organs and tissues.

VT:0010255.name: hematopoietic system development trait
VT:0010255.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the cells found in the blood and/or the blood-forming organs and tissues.

VT:0010256.name: colostrum trait
VT:0010256.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the first secretion of the mammary gland before milk production; provides energy and passive immunity to newborn offspring.

VT:0010257.name: colostrum immunoglobulin amount
VT:0010257.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of proteins that function as a primary mechanism for protection against disease present in the first secretion of the mammary gland before milk production.

VT:0010258.name: colostrum immunoglobulin A amount
VT:0010258.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in colostrum of the principal immunoglobulin in exocrine secretions.

VT:0010259.name: colostrum immunoglobulin G amount
VT:0010259.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in colostrum of the major antibody for antitoxins, viruses, and bacteria; also activates complement.

VT:0010260.name: colostrum immunoglobulin M amount
VT:0010260.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in colostrum of an immunoglobulin formed during the early period of an immune response; also stimulates complement activity.

VT:0010261.name: milk fat amount
VT:0010261.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion, quantity, or volume of butterfat present in milk.

VT:0010262.name: muscle nerve fiber quantity
VT:0010262.def: The proportion or number of sensory or motor nerve fibers to targets in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement of an organ or part of the body.

VT:0010263.name: erythrocyte precursor morphology trait
VT:0010263.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the immature erythrocyte precursors.

VT:0010264.name: colostrum amount
VT:0010264.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the thin, yellow, milky fluid secreted by the mammary gland, before or after parturition, preceding the production of milk.

VT:0010265.name: colostrum somatic cell quantity
VT:0010265.def: The proportion or number of somatic cells (leukocytes and epithelial cells) present in colostrum.

VT:0010266.name: milk beta-lactoglobulin amount
VT:0010266.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of beta-lactoglobulin, which may bind retinol; this milk constituent is allergenic.

VT:0010267.name: milk whey acidic protein amount
VT:0010267.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of whey acidic protein (WAP), a major protein of whey in rodents and rabbits (as well as marsupials), which belongs to the four disulfide core family.

VT:0010268.name: milk lactoferrin amount
VT:0010268.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of lactoferrin, a globular multifunctional protein with antimicrobial activity; part of innate defense.

VT:0010269.name: colostrum hormone amount
VT:0010269.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in colostrum of chemical substances produced by an organ, cells of an organ, or scattered cells, having a specific regulatory effect on the activity of an organ or organs.

VT:0010270.name: colostrum steroid amount
VT:0010270.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in colostrum of members of the hormone family that includes estrogens, progesterone, glucocorticoids, and androgens.

VT:0010271.name: colostrum leptin amount
VT:0010271.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in colostrum of the peptide hormone secreted by white adipocytes and believed to regulate food intake and energy balance.

VT:0010272.name: colostrum prolactin amount
VT:0010272.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in colostrum of the hormone that stimulates milk secretion.

VT:0010273.name: colostrum growth factor amount
VT:0010273.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in colostrum of any factors which promote cell proliferation.

VT:0010274.name: ear orientation trait
VT:0010274.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the location or arrangement of the outer ears in relation to each other or to the skull.

VT:0010275.name: milk hormone amount
VT:0010275.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of any substance, usually a peptide or steroid, that has a specific metabolic regulatory effect on the activity or behavior of cells expressing a receptor for the hormone.

VT:0010276.name: milk steroid amount
VT:0010276.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of members of the hormone family that includes estrogens, progesterone, glucocorticoids, and androgens.

VT:0010277.name: milk leptin amount
VT:0010277.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of the peptide hormone secreted by white adipocytes and believed to regulate food intake and energy balance.

VT:0010278.name: milk prolactin amount
VT:0010278.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of the hormone that stimulates milk secretion.

VT:0010279.name: milk growth factor amount
VT:0010279.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of any factors which promote cell proliferation.

VT:0010280.name: milk casein amount
