VT:0010280.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of casein, the predominant phosphoprotein in milk.

VT:0010281.name: milk alpha-S1-casein amount
VT:0010281.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of the most abundant casein in the milk of ruminants and rabbits.

VT:0010282.name: milk alpha-S2-casein amount
VT:0010282.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of alpa-S2-casein, a minor form of casein.

VT:0010283.name: milk kappa-casein amount
VT:0010283.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of kappa-casein, a casein which plays a crucial role in micellar structure; its concentration determines micellar size.

VT:0010284.name: milk beta-casein amount
VT:0010284.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of beta-casein in milk.

VT:0010285.name: milk nitrogen amount
VT:0010285.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of this element in milk.

VT:0010286.name: motor nerve fiber organization trait
VT:0010286.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic arrangement of the nerve fibers that convey impulses from the central nervous system to stimulate muscle contraction or glandular secretion.

VT:0010287.name: milk lactose amount
VT:0010287.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of lactose, the major sugar found in colostrum and milk; it is composed of one molecule of glucose and one molecule of galactose.

VT:0010288.name: milk mineral amount
VT:0010288.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of any inorganic element or compound that has importance in body functions.

VT:0010289.name: motor nerve fiber quantity
VT:0010289.def: The proportion or number of nerve fibers that convey impulses from the central nervous system to stimulate muscle contraction or glandular secretion.

VT:0010290.name: milk calcium amount
VT:0010290.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of this metallic bivalent element with atomic symbol Ca and atomic number 20.

VT:0010291.name: milk potassium amount
VT:0010291.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of potassium, an alkaline metallic element.

VT:0010292.name: milk sodium amount
VT:0010292.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of sodium, a metallic element.

VT:0010293.name: milk phosphorus amount
VT:0010293.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of this nonmetallic essential element which occurs naturally in phosphates and takes part in a broad variety of chemical reactions.

VT:0010294.name: milk chloride amount
VT:0010294.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of any binary compound of chlorine.

VT:0010295.name: milk magnesium amount
VT:0010295.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of  this alkaline earth element, atomic number 12, atomic symbol Mg.

VT:0010296.name: sympathetic nerve fiber quantity
VT:0010296.def: The proportion or number of nerve fibers to sympathetic termini.

VT:0010297.name: sympathetic nerve fiber organization trait
VT:0010297.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the systematic organization of nerve fibers to sympathetic termini.

VT:0010298.name: heart ventricle size trait
VT:0010298.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the lower chamber(s) of the heart.

VT:0010299.name: angiogenesis
VT:0010299.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of blood vessel formation and remodeling, following initial formation of the vascular network.

VT:0010300.name: vasculogenesis
VT:0010300.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the initial establishment of the vascular network.

VT:0010301.name: heart physiology trait
VT:0010301.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the hollow, muscular organ that pumps blood through the body.

VT:0010302.name: blood uric acid amount
VT:0010302.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a crystalline acid occurring as an end product of purine metabolism.

VT:0010303.name: milk fatty acid amount
VT:0010303.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of straight chain monocarboxylic acids naturally occurring in fats found in milk fat; they are saturated and unsaturated.

VT:0010304.name: milk saturated fatty acid amount
VT:0010304.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of straight chain monocarboxylic acids without double bonds in their chains found in milk fat.

VT:0010305.name: milk unsaturated fatty acid amount
VT:0010305.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of straight chain monocarboxylic acids with one or more double or triple carbon-carbon bonds found in milk fat.

VT:0010306.name: milk fatty acid C4:0 amount
VT:0010306.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with a four-carbon backbone.

VT:0010307.name: milk fatty acid C5:0 amount
VT:0010307.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with a five-carbon backbone.

VT:0010308.name: milk fatty acid C6:0 amount
VT:0010308.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with a six-carbon backbone.

VT:0010309.name: milk fatty acid C7:0 amount
VT:0010309.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with a seven-carbon backbone.

VT:0010310.name: milk fatty acid C8:0 amount
VT:0010310.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with an eight-carbon backbone.

VT:0010311.name: milk fatty acid C9:0 amount
VT:0010311.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with a nine-carbon backbone.

VT:0010312.name: milk fatty acid C10:0 amount
VT:0010312.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with a ten-carbon backbone.

VT:0010313.name: milk fatty acid C11:0 amount
VT:0010313.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with an eleven-carbon backbone.

VT:0010314.name: milk fatty acid C12:0 amount
VT:0010314.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with a twelve-carbon backbone.

VT:0010315.name: milk fatty acid C14:0 amount
VT:0010315.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with a fourteen-carbon backbone.

VT:0010316.name: milk fatty acid C16:0 amount
VT:0010316.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with a sixteen-carbon backbone.

VT:0010317.name: milk fatty acid C17:0 amount
VT:0010317.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with a seventeen-carbon backbone.

VT:0010318.name: milk fatty acid C18:0 amount
VT:0010318.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone.

VT:0010319.name: milk fatty acid C20:0 amount
VT:0010319.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with a twenty-carbon backbone.

VT:0010320.name: milk fatty acid C22:0 amount
VT:0010320.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with a twenty-two-carbon backbone.

VT:0010321.name: milk trans fatty acid amount
VT:0010321.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of unsaturated fatty acids containing at least one double bond in the trans configuration.

VT:0010322.name: milk omega-3 fatty acid amount
VT:0010322.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of unsaturated fatty acids in which the first unsaturated bond is in the third position from the omega carbon (C18:3, n-3; C20:5, n-3; C22:6, n-3).

VT:0010323.name: milk omega-6 fatty acid amount
VT:0010323.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of unsaturated fatty acids in which the first unsaturated bond is in the sixth position from the omega carbon (C18:2, n-6; C18:3, n-6; C20:2, n-6; C20:3, n-6; C20:4, n-6; C22:2, n-6; C22:4, n-6; C22:5, n-6).

VT:0010324.name: milk conjugated linoleic acid amount
VT:0010324.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of any/all isomers of linoleic acid in which the double bonds are conjugated (double bonds alternate with single bonds); found especially in meat and dairy products derived from ruminants.

VT:0010325.name: milk fatty acid cis-9,cis-12-C18:2 amount
VT:0010325.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated, omega-6 fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone.

VT:0010326.name: milk fatty acid cis-9-C14:1 amount
VT:0010326.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with a fourteen-carbon backbone and a cis double bond at C-9.

VT:0010327.name: milk fatty acid cis-11-C16:1 amount
VT:0010327.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with a sixteen-carbon backbone and a cis double bond at C-11.

VT:0010328.name: milk fatty acid cis-9-C17:1 amount
VT:0010328.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with a seventeen-carbon backbone and a cis double bond at C-9.

VT:0010329.name: milk fatty acid trans-11-C18:1 amount
VT:0010329.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a trans double bond at C-11.

VT:0010330.name: milk fatty acid trans-4-C18:1 amount
VT:0010330.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a trans double bond at C-4.

VT:0010331.name: milk fatty acid trans-5-C18:1 amount
VT:0010331.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a trans double bond at C-5.

VT:0010332.name: milk fatty acid trans-6-8-C18:1 amount
VT:0010332.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a trans double bond at either C-6 or C-8.

VT:0010333.name: milk fatty acid trans-9-C18:1 amount
VT:0010333.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a trans double bond at C-9.

VT:0010334.name: milk fatty acid trans-10-C18:1 amount
VT:0010334.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a trans double bond at C-10.

VT:0010335.name: milk fatty acid trans-13-14-C18:1 amount
VT:0010335.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a trans double bond at either C-13 or C-14.

VT:0010336.name: obsolete milk fatty acid cis-14/trans-16-C18:1 amount
VT:0010336.def: OBSOLETE. The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and either a cis double bond at C-14 or a trans double bond at C-16.

VT:0010337.name: milk fatty acid cis-11-C18:1 amount
VT:0010337.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a cis double bond at C-11.

VT:0010338.name: milk fatty acid cis-12-C18:1 amount
VT:0010338.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a cis double bond at C-12.

VT:0010339.name: milk fatty acid cis-13-C18:1 amount
VT:0010339.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a cis double bond at C-13.

VT:0010340.name: milk fatty acid cis-15-C18:1 amount
VT:0010340.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a cis double bond at C-15.

VT:0010341.name: milk fatty acid cis-9,trans-13-C18:2 amount
VT:0010341.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone, a cis double bond at C-9, and a trans double bond at C-13.

VT:0010342.name: milk fatty acid cis-9,trans-12-C18:2 amount
VT:0010342.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone, a cis double bond at C-9, and a trans double bond at C-12.

VT:0010343.name: milk fatty acid trans-9,cis-12-C18:2 amount
VT:0010343.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone, a cis double bond at C-12, and a trans double bond at C-9.

VT:0010344.name: milk fatty acid trans-9,trans-12-C18:2 amount
VT:0010344.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and trans double bonds at C-9 and C-12.

VT:0010345.name: milk fatty acid trans-9,trans-14-C18:2 amount
VT:0010345.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and trans double bonds at C-9 and C-14.

VT:0010346.name: milk fatty acid trans-11,cis-15-C18:2 amount
VT:0010346.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone, a trans double bond at C-11, and a cis double bond at C-15.

VT:0010347.name: milk fatty acid trans-11,trans-15-C18:2 amount
VT:0010347.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and trans double bonds at C-11 and C-15.

VT:0010348.name: milk fatty acid cis-9,cis-11-C18:2 amount
VT:0010348.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and cis double bonds at C-9 and C-11.

VT:0010349.name: milk fatty acid cis-9,trans-11-C18:2 amount
VT:0010349.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone, a cis double bond at C-9, and a trans double bond at C-11.

VT:0010350.name: milk fatty acid cis-12,trans-14-C18:2 amount
VT:0010350.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone, a cis double bond at C-12, and a trans double bond at C-14.

VT:0010351.name: milk fatty acid trans-7,cis-9-C18:2 amount
VT:0010351.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone, a trans double bond at C-7, and a cis double bond at C-9.

VT:0010352.name: milk fatty acid trans-8,cis-10-C18:2 amount
VT:0010352.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone, a trans double bond at C-8, and a cis double bond at C-10.

VT:0010353.name: milk fatty acid trans-9,cis-11-C18:2 amount
VT:0010353.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone, a trans double bond at C-9, and a cis double bond at C-11.

VT:0010354.name: milk fatty acid trans-10,cis-12-C18:2 amount
VT:0010354.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone, a trans double bond at C-10, and a cis double bond at C-12.

VT:0010355.name: milk fatty acid trans-11,cis-13-C18:2 amount
VT:0010355.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone, a trans double bond at C-11, and a cis double bond at C-13.

VT:0010356.name: milk fatty acid trans-12,cis-14-C18:2 amount
VT:0010356.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone, a trans double bond at C-12, and a cis double bond at C-14.

VT:0010357.name: milk fatty acid trans-7,trans-9-C18:2 amount
VT:0010357.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and trans double bonds at C-7 and C-9.

VT:0010358.name: milk fatty acid trans-8,trans-10-C18:2 amount
VT:0010358.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and trans double bonds at C-8 and C-10.

VT:0010359.name: milk fatty acid trans-9,trans-11-C18:2 amount
VT:0010359.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and trans double bonds at C-9 and C-11.

VT:0010360.name: milk fatty acid trans-10,trans-12-C18:2 amount
VT:0010360.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and trans double bonds at C-10 and C-12.

VT:0010361.name: milk fatty acid trans-11,trans-13-C18:2 amount
VT:0010361.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and trans double bonds at C-11 and C-13.

VT:0010362.name: milk fatty acid trans-12,trans-14-C18:2 amount
VT:0010362.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and trans double bonds at C-12 and C-14.

VT:0010363.name: milk fatty acid cis-8-C20:1 amount
VT:0010363.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with a twenty-carbon backbone and cis double bond at C-8.

VT:0010364.name: milk fatty acid cis-11-C20:1 amount
VT:0010364.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with a twenty-carbon backbone and cis double bond at C-11.

VT:0010365.name: milk fatty acid C20:4(n-6) amount
VT:0010365.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated, omega-6 fatty acid with a twenty-carbon backbone and four double bonds.
synonyms: milk fatty acid C20:4 n-6 concentration
milk fatty acid C20:4 n-6 content
milk fatty acid C20:4 n-6 percentage

VT:0010366.name: milk fatty acid C20:5(n-3) amount
VT:0010366.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated, omega-3 fatty acid with a twenty-carbon backbone and five double bonds.
synonyms: milk fatty acid C20:5 n-3 concentration
milk fatty acid C20:5 n-3 content
milk fatty acid C20:5 n-3 percentage

VT:0010367.name: milk fatty acid C22:5(n-3) amount
VT:0010367.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated, omega-3 fatty acid with a twenty-two-carbon backbone and five double bonds.
synonyms: milk fatty acid C22:5 n-3 concentration
milk fatty acid C22:5 n-3 content
milk fatty acid C22:5 n-3 percentage

VT:0010368.name: milk fatty acid C22:6(n-3) amount
VT:0010368.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated, omega-3 fatty acid with a twenty-two-carbon backbone and six double bonds.
synonyms: milk fatty acid C22:6 n-3 concentration
milk fatty acid C22:6 n-3 content
milk fatty acid C22:6 n-3 percentage

VT:0010369.name: milk fatty acid C18:3(n-3) amount
VT:0010369.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated, omega-3 fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and three double bonds.
synonyms: milk fatty acid C18:3 n-3 concentration
milk fatty acid C18:3 n-3 content
milk fatty acid C18:3 n-3 percentage

VT:0010370.name: milk fatty acid C20:2 amount
VT:0010370.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with a twenty-carbon backbone and two double bonds.

VT:0010371.name: milk fatty acid cis-9-C18:1 amount
VT:0010371.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a cis double bond at C-9.

VT:0010372.name: milk fatty acid cis-9-C16:1 amount
VT:0010372.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with a sixteen-carbon backbone and a cis double bond at C-9.

VT:0010373.name: milk monounsaturated fatty acid amount
VT:0010373.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of organic, monobasic acids derived from hydrocarbons present in milk fat; the carbon chain has only one double or triple carbon-carbon bond.

VT:0010374.name: milk polyunsaturated fatty acid amount
VT:0010374.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of organic, monobasic acids derived from hydrocarbons present in milk fat; the carbon chain has two or more double or triple carbon-carbon bonds.

VT:0010375.name: ovary diameter
VT:0010375.def: The distance across the female reproductive gland containing the germ cells.

VT:0010376.name: milk soluble calcium amount
VT:0010376.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of calcium not linked to casein micelles; may be in an associated form (with citrate, inorganic phosphate, or chloride) or a free/ionic form.

VT:0010377.name: milk free calcium amount
VT:0010377.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of unlinked/unassociated calcium in ionic form.

VT:0010378.name: milk colloidal calcium amount
VT:0010378.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of the calcium linked to casein micelles.

VT:0010379.name: milk epithelial cell quantity
VT:0010379.def: The proportion or number of cells originating from the mammary epithelium present in milk.

VT:0010380.name: milk beta-carotene amount
VT:0010380.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of a carotenoid that is the most common precursor to vitamin A.

VT:0010381.name: milk retinol amount
VT:0010381.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of one of the active forms of vitamin A.

VT:0010382.name: milk triglyceride amount
VT:0010382.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of this molecule, glycerol esterified at each of its three hydroxyl groups by a fatty acid.

VT:0010383.name: milk cholesterol amount
VT:0010383.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of these precursors to steroid hormones and bile salts; also components of plasma membranes.

VT:0010384.name: oviduct length
VT:0010384.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the tube through which the ova pass from the ovary to the uterus (mammals) or to the outside (fish, birds).

VT:0010385.name: milk diacylglycerol amount
VT:0010385.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of glycerol with two esterified acyl moieties.

VT:0010386.name: milk monoacylglycerol amount
VT:0010386.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of glycerol with an acyl moiety esterified to position 1 or 2; an intermediate in the degradation and synthesis of lipids.

VT:0010387.name: milk phospholipid amount
VT:0010387.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of the fat derivatives in which one fatty acid has been replaced by a phosphate group.

VT:0010388.name: milk polyphenol amount
VT:0010388.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of compounds containing more than one phenol group.

VT:0010389.name: milk butyrophilin amount
VT:0010389.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of butyrophilin, one of the three predominant proteins in the milk fat globule membrane.

VT:0010390.name: milk xanthine oxidoreductase amount
VT:0010390.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of xanthine oxidoreductase, one of the three predominant proteins in the milk fat globule membrane.

VT:0010391.name: milk adipophilin amount
VT:0010391.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of adipophilin, one of the three predominant proteins in the milk fat globule membrane.

VT:0010392.name: milk mucin 1 amount
VT:0010392.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of a cell-surface associated mucin protein.

VT:0010393.name: milk CD36 molecule amount
VT:0010393.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of CD36, an integral membrane protein.

VT:0010394.name: uterine horn morphology trait
VT:0010394.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the upper right or left portion of the uterus to which the uterine tube is connected.

VT:0010395.name: endometrium thickness
VT:0010395.def: The distance between the surfaces of the glandular epithelium of the uterus.

VT:0010396.name: milk stomatin amount
VT:0010396.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of stomatin, an integral membrane protein.

VT:0010397.name: milk fat globule-EGF factor 8 protein amount
VT:0010397.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of this integrin-binding protein found in milk fat globules.
synonyms: milk fat globule-EGF factor 8 protein concentration
milk fat globule-EGF factor 8 protein content

VT:0010398.name: milk plasmin amount
VT:0010398.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of a fibrinolytic enzyme derived from the precursor plasminogen.

VT:0010399.name: milk urea amount
VT:0010399.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of the chief end product of nitrogen metabolism in mammals.

VT:0010400.name: milk ammonia amount
VT:0010400.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of an alkaline gas formed by decomposition of nitrogen-containing substances such as proteins and amino acids.

VT:0010401.name: ovarian follicle size trait
VT:0010401.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the ovarian structure containing an oocyte.

VT:0010402.name: corpus luteum size trait
VT:0010402.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the yellow endocrine body formed in the ovary after follicle rupture.

VT:0010403.name: cervical opening shape trait
VT:0010403.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical form or contours of the external os cervix.

VT:0010404.name: cervical fold quantity
VT:0010404.def: The proportion or number of ridges in the lining of the cervical canal.

VT:0010405.name: sperm size trait
VT:0010405.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the male gamete.

VT:0010406.name: sperm flagellum size trait
VT:0010406.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the whiplike locomotory organelle of the spermatozoa.

VT:0010407.name: sperm head size trait
VT:0010407.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the portion of the spermatozoa containing the nucleus.

VT:0010408.name: bulbourethral gland physiology trait
VT:0010408.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the gland in males that lies along the prostate gland and secretes a fluid component of the seminal fluid into the urethra.

VT:0010409.name: placenta physiology trait
VT:0010409.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the organ of metabolic interchange between fetus and mother, partly of embryonic origin and partly of maternal origin.

VT:0010410.name: gonadotropin-releasing hormone secretion trait
VT:0010410.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of the peptide hormone secreted by the hypothalamus that stimulates release of follicle-stimulating hormone and leuteinizing hormone from the anterior pituitary.

VT:0010411.name: secretion by placenta trait
VT:0010411.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of physiologically active substances from the organ of metabolic interchange between the fetus and mother.

VT:0010412.name: chorionic gonadotropin secretion trait
VT:0010412.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of this glycoprotein produced by trophoblastic cells originating from the placenta.

VT:0010413.name: luteinizing hormone secretion trait
VT:0010413.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a glycoprotein that, in females, stimulates the Graafian follicles of the ovary and assists in follicular maturation and the secretion of estradiol; in males, it stimulates the epithelium of the seminiferous tubules and is partly responsible for spermatogenesis.

VT:0010414.name: follicle-stimulating hormone secretion trait
VT:0010414.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of a glycoprotein that stimulates the graafian follicles of the ovary and assists in follicular maturation and the secretion of estradiol; in the male, it stimulates the epithelium of the seminiferous tubules and is partially responsible for inducing spermatogenesis.

VT:0010415.name: prolactin secretion trait
VT:0010415.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of the peptide hormone which normally stimulates milk production by the mammary gland.

VT:0010416.name: seminal gland physiology
VT:0010416.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the glandular structure that is a diverticulum of the ductus deferens; its secretion is one of the components of semen.

VT:0010417.name: leukocyte proliferation trait
VT:0010417.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which any of the white blood cells (basophils, eosinophils, neutrophils, lymphocytes, dendritic cells, macrophages, mast cells, or monocytes) undergo expansion by cell division.

VT:0010418.name: CD8-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell morphology trait
VT:0010418.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of a CD8-positive, alpha-beta-positive, FoxP3-positive T cell with suppressor function.

VT:0010419.name: CD8-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell quantity
VT:0010419.def: The proportion or number of the subset of CD8-positive, alpha-beta-positive, FoxP3-positive T cells with suppressor function.

VT:0010420.name: adrenal gland mass
VT:0010420.def: The amount of matter in the endocrine gland(s) located above the kidney responsible for hormone and epinephrine secretion.

VT:0010421.name: epididymal fat pad mass
VT:0010421.def: The amount of matter in the encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the elongated structure connected to the posterior surface of the testes that transports, stores, and matures spermatozoa between testes and vas deferens.

VT:0010422.name: femoral fat pad mass
VT:0010422.def: The amount of matter in the encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the long bone of the thigh.

VT:0010423.name: gonadal fat pad mass
VT:0010423.def: The amount of matter in the encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the ovaries or testes.

VT:0010424.name: inguinal fat pad mass
VT:0010424.def: The amount of matter in the encapsulated adipose tissue found in the groin.

VT:0010425.name: interscapular fat pad mass
VT:0010425.def: The amount of matter in the encapsulated adipose tissue located between the large, flat bones of the shoulder girdle.

VT:0010426.name: mammary fat pad mass
VT:0010426.def: The amount of matter in the encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the milk-secreting gland that lies within the breast.

VT:0010427.name: mesenteric fat pad mass
VT:0010427.def: The amount of matter in the encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the peritoneal fold that encloses the small intestine and connects it to the abdominal wall.

VT:0010428.name: parametrial fat pad mass
VT:0010428.def: The amount of matter in the encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the extension of the subserous coat of the uterus laterally between the layers of the broad ligament.

VT:0010429.name: renal fat pad mass
VT:0010429.def: The amount of matter in the encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the kidney.

VT:0010430.name: retroperitoneal fat pad mass
VT:0010430.def: The amount of matter in the encapsulated adipose tissue found on the dorsal/posterior side of the serous membrane lining the abdominal cavity and covering most of the viscera.

VT:0010431.name: uterine fat pad mass
VT:0010431.def: The amount of matter in the encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the hollow muscular organ where the embryo/fetus develops.

VT:0010432.name: milk fatty acid cis-14-C18:1 amount
VT:0010432.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a cis double bond at C-14.

VT:0010433.name: milk fatty acid trans-16-C18:1 amount
VT:0010433.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a trans double bond at C-16.

VT:0010434.name: response to infection trait
VT:0010434.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity to change, adjust, or alter immune processes or function as a result of invasion and multiplication of microorganisms in the tissues, or of exposure to components of or toxins produced by pathogenic microorganisms.

VT:0010435.name: response to bacterial infection trait
VT:0010435.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity to change, adjust, or alter immune processes or function as a result of invasion and multiplication of bacteria (unicellular, prokaryotic organisms characterized by peptidoglycan cell walls) in the tissues, or of exposure to components of or toxins produced by bacteria.

VT:0010436.name: response to fungal infection trait
VT:0010436.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity to change, adjust, or alter immune processes or function as a result of invasion and multiplication of yeast or mold in the tissues, or of exposure to components of or toxins produced by these organisms.

VT:0010437.name: response to parasitic infection trait
VT:0010437.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity to change, adjust, or alter immune processes or function as a result of invasion and multiplication of parasites (organisms that live in or on another and draw their nourishment therefrom) in the tissues, or of exposure to components of or toxins produced by parasites.

VT:0010438.name: response to prion infection trait
VT:0010438.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity to change, adjust, or alter immune processes or function as a result of invasion of the tissues by small, infectious proteinaceous particles of non-nucleic acid composition.

VT:0010439.name: response to viral infection trait
VT:0010439.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity to change, adjust, or alter immune processes or function as a result of invasion and multiplication of a virus (pathogen consisting of nucleic acid inside a protein shell, which can grow/reproduce only after infecting a host cell) in the tissues, or of exposure to components of or toxins produced by a virus.

VT:0010440.name: bacteria quantity
VT:0010440.def: The proportion or number of unicellular, prokaryotic organisms characterized by peptidoglycan cell walls.

VT:0010441.name: parasite quantity
VT:0010441.def: The proportion or number of organisms that live on or in another and draw their nourishment therefrom.

VT:0010442.name: behavior trait
VT:0010442.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of the actions or reactions of organisms.

VT:0010443.name: cerebrospinal fluid homeostasis trait
VT:0010443.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the internal equilibrium in the fluid largely secreted by the choroid plexuses of the ventricles of the brain, filling the ventricles and the subarachnoid cavities of the brain and spinal cord.

VT:0010444.name: kinesthetic behavior trait
VT:0010444.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of behavior related to the actions or reactions of an organism with regard to the movement of the body's muscles, tendons, and joints.

VT:0010445.name: social interaction trait
VT:0010445.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of actions or reactions that typically occur in organisms that are part of a group.

VT:0010446.name: nesting behavior trait
VT:0010446.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of actions or reactions related to the construction, maintenance and use of a bed or receptacle prepared by an organism for shelter.

VT:0010447.name: emission behavior trait
VT:0010447.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the actions or reactions by which an organism produces or releases matter or energy.

VT:0010448.name: forelimb muscle mass
VT:0010448.def: The amount of matter in the muscle tissue of the anterior/superior jointed appendages used for locomotion or grasping.

VT:0010449.name: hindlimb muscle mass
VT:0010449.def: The amount of matter in the muscle tissue of the posterior/inferior jointed appendages used for locomotion or grasping.

VT:0010450.name: cognitive behavior trait
VT:0010450.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of actions or reactions of an organism that occur as the result of cognition; where cognition is defined as the operation of the mind by which an organism becomes aware of objects of thought or perception.

VT:0010451.name: stress-related behavior trait
VT:0010451.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of actions or reactions related to how the body reacts to a stressor (a stimulus that causes stress), real or imagined.

VT:0010452.name: heterospecific interaction trait
VT:0010452.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the behavior of animals towards a member of another species.

VT:0010453.name: abdominal wall mass
VT:0010453.def: The amount of matter in the margins that enclose the abdominal cavity; the major part is muscular but also includes skin, subcutaneous fat, fascia and the parietal peritoneum.

VT:0010455.name: rhythmic behavior trait
VT:0010455.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of an action or reaction of an organism that recurs with measured regularity.

VT:0010456.name: cerebrospinal fluid mineral amount
VT:0010456.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in cerebrospinal fluid (largely secreted by the choroid plexuses of the ventricles of the brain, filling the ventricles and the subarachnoid cavities of the brain and spinal cord) of any inorganic element or compound that has importance in body functions.

VT:0010457.name: platelet size trait
VT:0010457.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of disc-like fragments of megakaryocytes that are found in the blood and function in clotting.

VT:0010458.name: outer ear area
VT:0010458.def: The two-dimensional extent of any of the components of the auricles or external acoustic meatus.

VT:0010459.name: behavioral response to novel environment trait
VT:0010459.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity of an organism to change, adjust, or alter its actions or reactions as a result of exposure to new surroundings.

VT:0010460.name: behavioral response to novel food trait
VT:0010460.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity of an organism to change, adjust, or alter its actions or reactions as a result of exposure to new food.

VT:0010461.name: excretion behavior trait
VT:0010461.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to actions or reactions of an organism with regard to the elimination of waste products that arise as a result of metabolic activity.

VT:0010462.name: defecation behavior trait
VT:0010462.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to actions or reactions of an organism with regard to the expulsion of feces from the body.

VT:0010463.name: coat/hair pigmentation trait
VT:0010463.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the deposition or aggregation of coloring matter in the fine, keratinized filamentous growths arising from the epidermis of mammals.

VT:0010464.name: fertility trait
VT:0010464.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to produce live offspring.

VT:0010465.name: adipocyte free fatty acid secretion trait
VT:0010465.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of free fatty acids (those not bound to other molecules or moieties) secreted from a fat cell.

VT:0010466.name: prostate mass
VT:0010466.def: The amount of matter in the gland surrounding the beginning of the urethra in males that secretes part of the seminal fluid.

VT:0010467.name: lateral prostate mass
VT:0010467.def: The amount of matter in the lateral lobe of the prostate.

VT:0010468.name: ventral prostate mass
VT:0010468.def: The amount of matter in the ventral lobe of the prostate.

VT:0010469.name: pancreas molecular composition trait
VT:0010469.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the organ that secretes pancreatic juice into the duodenum and secretes glucagon and insulin into the bloodstream.

VT:0010470.name: pancreas insulin amount
VT:0010470.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the pancreas of the polypeptide hormone, secreted by beta cells, that promotes glucose utilization, protein synthesis, and the formation and storage of neutral lipids.

VT:0010471.name: exploratory behavior trait
VT:0010471.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to actions or reactions in tests for exploratory related behaviors.

VT:0010472.name: compulsivity behavior trait
VT:0010472.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to actions or reactions in tests for compulsive behaviors.

VT:0010473.name: impulsivity behavior trait
VT:0010473.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to actions or reactions with regard to the ability of an individual to exert restraint over behavior.

VT:0010474.name: blood non-HDL cholesterol amount
VT:0010474.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the lipoprotein:cholesterol complex that is not in the high density lipoprotein fraction; includes low density lipoproteins (LDL), very low density lipoproteins (VLDL), and intermediate density lipoproteins (IDL).

VT:0010475.name: blood amylase amount
VT:0010475.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a group of amylolytic enzymes that cleave starch, glycogen, and related alpha-1,4-glucans.

VT:0010476.name: blood glutamate dehydrogenase amount
VT:0010476.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this enzyme, which converts glutamate to alpha-ketoglutarate, and vice versa.

VT:0010477.name: blood lactate dehydrogenase amount
VT:0010477.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this enzyme, which catalyzes interconversion of pyruvate and lactate with concomitant interconversion of NADH and NAD+.

VT:0010478.name: blood lipase amount
VT:0010478.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this enzyme, which catalyzes the formation or hydrolysis of lipids.

VT:0010479.name: blood insulin-like growth factor amount
VT:0010479.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this protein hormone, which is similar in molecular structure to insulin and plays a role in childhood growth and anabolic effects in adults.

VT:0010480.name: blood osteocalcin amount
VT:0010480.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this protein found in bone and dentin, which is secreted by osteoblasts.

VT:0010481.name: blood immunoglobulin M amount
VT:0010481.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this immunoglobulin formed during the early part of the immune response that is the most efficient antibody in stimulating complement activity.

VT:0010482.name: body fat mass
VT:0010482.def: The amount of matter in the body of an organism that is fat or adipose tissue.

VT:0010483.name: body lean mass
VT:0010483.def: The amount of matter in the body of an organism that is not fat.

VT:0010484.name: serotonin amount
VT:0010484.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of this monoamine neurotransmitter derived primarily from tryptophan; found primarily in the CNS, gastrointestinal tract, and platelets.

VT:0010485.name: venous return trait
VT:0010485.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the return of blood to the heart through the great veins and coronary sinus.

VT:0010486.name: cardiac output trait
VT:0010486.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ejection of blood from the heart into the aorta.

VT:0010487.name: response to xenobiotic stimulus trait
VT:0010487.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity of an organism to change, adjust, or alter its morphology, physiology, or behavior as a result of exposure to a foreign compound.

VT:0010488.name: response to addictive substance trait
VT:0010488.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity of an organism to change, adjust, or alter its morphology, physiology, or behavior as a result of exposure to a substance with the potential for addiction.

VT:0010489.name: response to alcohol trait
VT:0010489.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity of an organism to change, adjust, or alter its morphology, physiology, or behavior as a result of alcohol exposure.

VT:0010490.name: aorta blood flow trait
VT:0010490.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the movement of blood within the main trunk of the systemic arteries.

VT:0010491.name: heart left ventricle anterior wall thickness
VT:0010491.def: The distance between the surfaces of the wall closest to the front of the left lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0010492.name: heart left ventricle diameter
VT:0010492.def: The distance across the left lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0010493.name: heart left atrium diameter
VT:0010493.def: The distance across the left upper chamber of the heart.

VT:0010494.name: lumbar vertebra morphology trait
VT:0010494.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the bony segments of the spinal column located anterior/superior to the sacral vertebrae and posterior/inferior to the thoracic vertebrae.

VT:0010495.name: inguinal lymph node mass
VT:0010495.def: The amount of matter in the lymph nodes located in the groin area.

VT:0010496.name: pituitary gland mass
VT:0010496.def: The amount of matter in the compound gland suspended from the base of the hypothalamus, which secretes somatotropins, prolactin, TSH (thyroid-stimulating hormone), gonadotropins, adrenal corticotropin, and other related peptides.

VT:0010497.name: liver molecular composition trait
VT:0010497.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the bile-secreting exocrine gland, which is important for detoxification; for fat, carbohydrate, and protein metabolism; and for glycogen storage.

VT:0010498.name: liver cholesterol amount
VT:0010498.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the bile-secreting exocrine gland of the most abundant steroid in animal tissues, precursor to steroid hormones and bile salts; also component of plasma membranes.

VT:0010499.name: calcium amount
VT:0010499.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion, quantity or volume of this metallic bivalent element with atomic symbol Ca and atomic number 20.

VT:0010500.name: platelet calcium amount
VT:0010500.def: The proportion, quantity or volume of this metallic bivalent element in the disc-like fragments of megakaryocytes that are found in the blood and function in clotting.

VT:0010501.name: islet of Langerhans physiology trait
VT:0010501.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the cellular masses in the interstitial tissue of the pancreas that form the endocrine portion of the gland.

VT:0010502.name: urine catecholamine amount
VT:0010502.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of biologically active amines derived from tyrosine, including metanephrine, dopamine, epinephrine, and norepinephrine.

VT:0010503.name: blood IDL cholesterol amount
VT:0010503.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the lipoprotein:cholesterol complex in which the lipoproteins are formed in degradation of very low density lipoproteins.
synonyms: blood intermediate density lipoprotein cholesterol amount

VT:0010504.name: blood HDL phospholipid amount
VT:0010504.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of phospholipid found in the high density lipoprotein fraction of whole blood, serum, or plasma.

VT:0010505.name: blood LDL phospholipid amount
VT:0010505.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of phospholipid found in the low density lipoprotein fraction of whole blood, serum, or plasma.

VT:0010506.name: blood IDL phospholipid amount
VT:0010506.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of phospholipid found in the intermediate density lipoprotein fraction of whole blood, serum, or plasma.

VT:0010507.name: blood VLDL phospholipid amount
VT:0010507.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of phospholipid found in the very low density lipoprotein fraction of whole blood, serum, or plasma.

VT:0010508.name: neurocranium mass
VT:0010508.def: The amount of matter in the bones of the skull enclosing the brain.

VT:0010509.name: neurocranium mineral mass
VT:0010509.def: The amount of matter in the minerals (inorganic elements or compounds that have importance in body functions) in the bones of the skull enclosing the brain.

VT:0010510.name: lumbar vertebra mass
VT:0010510.def: The amount of matter in the bony segments of the spinal column located anterior/superior to the sacral vertebrae and posterior/inferior to the thoracic vertebrae.

VT:0010511.name: lumbar vertebra mineral mass
VT:0010511.def: The amount of matter in the minerals (inorganic elements or compounds that have importance in body functions) in the bony segments of the spinal column located anterior/superior to the sacral vertebrae and posterior/inferior to the thoracic vertebrae.

VT:0010512.name: histocompatibility type
VT:0010512.def: The Major Histocompatibility Complex (MHC) molecules expressed by an organism; these cell surface molecules distinguish self from nonself and mediate interactions of immune cells through antigen processing and presentation.

VT:0010513.name: blood ferritin amount
VT:0010513.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this ubiquitous intracellular protein that stores iron and releases it in a controlled fashion.

VT:0010514.name: blood transferrin amount
VT:0010514.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this iron-binding glycoprotein.

VT:0010515.name: blood fibronectin amount
VT:0010515.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole, blood, serum, or plasma of this glycoprotein that binds to integrins.

VT:0010516.name: blood glutathione amount
VT:0010516.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this tripeptide antioxidant.

VT:0010517.name: neurocranium size trait
VT:0010517.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the bones of the skull enclosing the brain.

VT:0010518.name: lumbar vertebra size trait
VT:0010518.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the bony segments of the spinal column located anterior/superior to the sacral vertebrae and posterior/inferior to the thoracic vertebrae.

VT:0010519.name: liver triglyceride amount
VT:0010519.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the bile-secreting exocrine gland of this molecule, glycerol esterified at each of its three hydroxyl groups by a fatty acid; triglyceride is an important molecule for storage of fatty acids in adipose tissue.

VT:0010520.name: spleen periarteriolar lymphoid sheath cell quantity
VT:0010520.def: The proportion or number of cells in the area of the spleen within the marginal sinus, in which T cells surround the central arteriole.

VT:0010521.name: spleen B cell follicle cell quantity
VT:0010521.def: The proportion or number of cells in the area of the white pulp where the affinity maturation of B cells and the generation of memory B cells and plasma cells occur.

VT:0010522.name: axillary lymph node cell quantity
VT:0010522.def: The proportion or number of cells in the lymph nodes located around the axillary vein that receive lymphatic drainage from the upper or forelimb, scapular region and pectoral region.

VT:0010523.name: cervical lymph node cell quantity
VT:0010523.def: The proportion or number of cells in the lymph nodes found near the neck and shoulders.

VT:0010524.name: seminal gland mass
VT:0010524.def: The amount of matter in the two folded, sac shaped glands that are diverticula of the ductus deferens.

VT:0010525.name: blood vessel smooth muscle cell quantity
VT:0010525.def: The proportion or number of cells in the nonstriated, involuntary muscle tissue of the structures that convey blood throughout the body.

VT:0010526.name: aorta physiology trait
VT:0010526.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the main trunk of the systemic arteries.

VT:0010527.name: associative learning trait
VT:0010527.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of an organism to change the frequency or form of its actions or reactions as a result of the influence of the environment.

VT:0010528.name: avoidance learning behavior trait
VT:0010528.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the actions or reactions of an organism pertaining to the ability to associate a previously neutral stimulus with an unpleasant or punishing stimulus so that the animal learns to avoid the previously neutral stimulus.

VT:0010529.name: contextual fear conditioning behavior trait
VT:0010529.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the actions or reactions of an organism pertaining to the ability to learn and remember an association between an aversive experience (the unconditioned stimulus (US), usually a shock) and the neutral, unchanging environment (the conditioned stimulus (CS), or the environmental context in this case).

VT:0010530.name: cued fear conditioning behavior trait
VT:0010530.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to actions or reactions of an organism pertaining to the ability to learn and remember an association between an aversive experience (the unconditioned stimulus (US), usually a shock) and a neutral stimulus (the conditioned stimulus (CS), usually an auditory cue or light flash).

VT:0010531.name: operant conditioning behavior trait
VT:0010531.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to actions or reactions of an organism pertaining to the ability of a behavior's antecedent and/or its consequence to influence the occurrence and form of behavior.

VT:0010532.name: active avoidance behavior trait
VT:0010532.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to actions or reactions of an organism pertaining to the ability to escape a hostile environment to actively avoid the unpleasant or punishing stimulus (e.g., shock) previously encountered in this environment.

VT:0010533.name: passive avoidance behavior trait
VT:0010533.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to actions or reactions of an organism pertaining to the ability to enter a hostile environment where it receives an unpleasant or punishing stimulus applied previously with prolonged latency.

VT:0010534.name: erythrocyte ion transport trait
VT:0010534.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the movement in red blood cells of atoms carrying an electric charge.

VT:0010535.name: erythrocyte ion amount
VT:0010535.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in red blood cells of atoms carrying an electric charge.

VT:0010536.name: rostral migratory stream morphology trait
VT:0010536.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the transient structure formed by neurons migrating from the subventricular zone into the olfactory bulbs.

VT:0010537.name: lateral septum morphology trait
VT:0010537.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of this portion of the septum which has strong projections to hypothalamic and midbrain regions and receives projections from the hippocampus and amygdala.

VT:0010538.name: lateral septum size trait
VT:0010538.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of this portion of the septum which has strong projections to hypothalamic and midbrain regions and receives projections from the hippocampus and amygdala.

VT:0010539.name: urine potassium amount
VT:0010539.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of the monovalent cation of this alkali metal element.

VT:0010540.name: urine creatinine amount
VT:0010540.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in urine of this product of creatine catabolism.

VT:0010541.name: orosomucoid 1 amount
VT:0010541.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of this subgroup of the alpha-1-globulin fraction of blood.

VT:0010542.name: enamel thickness
VT:0010542.def: The distance between the surfaces of the hard outer coating of the exposed portion of the tooth.

VT:0010543.name: catecholamine amount
VT:0010543.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of organic compounds that act as hormones or neurotransmitters and are derived from the amino acid tyrosine.

VT:0010544.name: kidney glomerulus quantity
VT:0010544.def: The proportion or number of the capillary loops at the beginning of each nephric tubule in the kidney(s).

VT:0010545.name: blood adiponectin amount
VT:0010545.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this protein hormone secreted by adipose tissue and the placenta; involved in glucose regulation and fatty acid oxidation.

VT:0010546.name: kidney glomerulus integrity trait
VT:0010546.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the capillary loops at the beginning of each nephric tubule in the kidney.

VT:0010547.name: liver integrity trait
VT:0010547.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the bile-secreting exocrine gland, which is important for detoxification; for fat, carbohydrate, and protein metabolism; and for glycogen storage.

VT:0010548.name: joint integrity trait
VT:0010548.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the articulation point of two or more rigid skeletal components (bones, cartilage, or parts of a single bone).

VT:0010549.name: cerebrum integrity trait
VT:0010549.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the largest part of the brain, derived from the telencephalon, and is composed of a right and a left hemisphere each which contains an outer cerebral cortex and a subcortical basal ganglia; cerebral functions include sensorimotor, emotional, and intellectual activities.

VT:0010550.name: hypodermis integrity trait
VT:0010550.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the irregular layer of adipose and connective tissue, stroma, or membrane immediately deep to the skin and superficial to the deep fascia; usually consists primarily of either just loose connective tissue, or a fatty layer that may also include a muscle layer, and/or a fibrous layer; may also occur as a membranous layer only, being nearly devoid of fat.

VT:0010551.name: uvea integrity trait
VT:0010551.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the pigmented vascular coat of the eyeball, consisting of the iris, ciliary body, and choroid.

VT:0010552.name: mammary gland integrity trait
VT:0010552.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the milk-producing glands in female mammals, consisting of lobes containing clusters of alveoli with a system of ducts to convey the milk to an external nipple or teat.

VT:0010553.name: tongue integrity trait
VT:0010553.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the mobile mass of muscular tissue and surrounding epithelial tissue occupying the cavity of the mouth and forming part of the floor.

VT:0010554.name: intestine integrity trait
VT:0010554.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the digestive tube passing from the stomach to the anus.

VT:0010555.name: thymus integrity trait
VT:0010555.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the primary lymphoid organ that is required for maturation of T cells.

VT:0010556.name: aorta elastic tissue integrity trait
VT:0010556.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the slender connective tissue fiber in tissue of the main trunk of the systemic arteries which is characterized by great elasticity.

VT:0010557.name: brain electrophysiology trait
VT:0010557.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the functions of or processes in the brain (the center of thought and emotion; controls coordination, bodily activities, and the interpretation of information from the senses) as they relate to electrical phenomena.

VT:0010558.name: kidney molecular composition trait
VT:0010558.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the paired organs responsible for urine excretion and regulation of ion concentrations.

VT:0010559.name: kidney renin amount
VT:0010559.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the kidney of this enzyme which cleaves a bond in angiotensionogen to generate angiotensin I.

VT:0010560.name: pancreas integrity trait
VT:0010560.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the organ that secretes pancreatic juice into the duodenum and secretes glucagon and insulin into the bloodstream.

VT:0010561.name: heart left ventricle molecular composition trait
VT:0010561.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the left lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0010562.name: forelimb integrity trait
VT:0010562.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the anterior/superior jointed appendages used for locomotion or grasping.

VT:0010563.name: hindlimb integrity trait
VT:0010563.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the posterior/inferior jointed appendages used for locomotion or grasping.

VT:0010564.name: heart right ventricle deoxyribonucleic acid amount
VT:0010564.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), the molecule composed of the sugar deoxyribose, phosphate groups and any combination of the bases adenine, guanine, cytosine, and/or thymine, in the right lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0010565.name: heart left ventricle deoxyribonucleic acid amount
VT:0010565.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), the molecule composed of the sugar deoxyribose, phosphate groups and any combination of the bases adenine, guanine, cytosine, and/or thymine, in the left lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0010566.name: nervous system integrity trait
VT:0010566.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the components of the system responsible for receiving and processing information about an organism's environment and controlling behavior.

VT:0010567.name: thoracic aorta morphology trait
VT:0010567.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the part of the descending aorta superior to the aortic hiatus of the diaphragm.

VT:0010568.name: thoracic aorta molecular composition trait
VT:0010568.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the part of the descending aorta superior to the aortic hiatus of the diaphragm.

VT:0010569.name: quadriceps morphology trait
VT:0010569.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the group of four muscles (rectus femoris, vastus intermedius, vastus lteralis, and vastus medialis) which extend down the front of the thigh and are the major extensors of the knee joint.

VT:0010570.name: lumbar vertebra area
VT:0010570.def: The two-dimensional extent (surface or cross-section) of the bony segments of the spinal column located anterior/superior to the sacral vertebrae and posterior/inferior to the thoracic vertebrae.

VT:0010571.name: prostate integrity trait
VT:0010571.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the gland surrounding the beginning of the urethra in males that secretes part of the seminal fluid.

VT:0010572.name: testis integrity trait
VT:0010572.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the male reproductive gland(s) where sperm production occurs.

VT:0010573.name: vertebra strength trait
VT:0010573.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the bony segments of the spinal column to withstand the application of force without yielding or breaking.

VT:0010574.name: lumbar vertebra strength trait
VT:0010574.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the bony segments of the spinal column located anterior/superior to the sacral vertebrae and posterior/inferior to the thoracic vertebrae to withstand the application of force without yielding or breaking.

VT:0010575.name: uterus integrity trait
VT:0010575.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the hollow muscular organ where the embryo/fetus develops.

VT:0010576.name: urine epinephrine amount
VT:0010576.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of this catecholamine hormone that stimulates the adrenergic receptors and that causes systemic vasoconstriction and gastrointestinal relaxation, stimulates the heart, and dilates bronchi and cerebral vessels.

VT:0010577.name: spinal cord molecular composition trait
VT:0010577.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the cylindrical tissue of the vertebral canal that extends from the medulla oblongata to the conus medullaris.

VT:0010578.name: pituitary gland integrity trait
VT:0010578.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the compound gland suspended from the base of the hypothalamus, which secretes somatotropins, prolactin, TSH (thyroid-stimulating hormone), gonadotropins, adrenal corticotropin, and other related peptides.

VT:0010579.name: brain integrity trait
VT:0010579.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the brain, one of the two components of the central nervous system and the center of thought and emotion; controls coordination, bodily activities and the interpretation of information from the senses (sight, hearing, smell, etc.).

VT:0010580.name: kidney integrity trait
VT:0010580.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the paired organs responsible for urine excretion and regulation of ion concentrations.

VT:0010581.name: sterol amount
VT:0010581.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a steroid with one OH group.

VT:0010582.name: blood sterol amount
VT:0010582.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a steroid with one OH group.

VT:0010583.name: brain sterol amount
VT:0010583.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a steroid with one OH group in the brain, one of the two components of the central nervous system and the center of thought and emotion; controls coordination, bodily activities and the interpretation of information from the senses.

VT:0010584.name: liver sterol amount
VT:0010584.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the bile-secreting exocrine gland of a steroid with one OH group.

VT:0010585.name: brain molecular composition trait
VT:0010585.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the brain, one of the two components of the central nervous system and the center of thought and emotion; controls coordination, bodily activities and the interpretation of information from the senses.

VT:0010586.name: brain cholesterol amount
VT:0010586.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the brain (one of the two components of the central nervous system and the center of thought and emotion) of these most abundant steroids in animal tissues.

VT:0010587.name: blood phytosterol amount
VT:0010587.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a plant-derived steroid with one OH group.
synonyms: blood plant sterol and stanol amount

VT:0010588.name: blood campesterol amount
VT:0010588.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a phytosterol with the formula C28H48O.

VT:0010589.name: blood sitosterol amount
VT:0010589.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a plant-derived sterol similar to cholesterol.

VT:0010590.name: brain phytosterol amount
VT:0010590.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the brain (one of the two components of the central nervous system and the center of thought and emotion) of a plant-derived steroid with one OH group.
synonyms: brain plant sterol and stanol amount

VT:0010591.name: brain campesterol amount
VT:0010591.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the brain (one of the two components of the central nervous system and the center of thought and emotion) of a phytosterol with the formula C28H48O.

VT:0010592.name: brain sitosterol amount
VT:0010592.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the brain (one of the two components of the central nervous system and the center of thought and emotion) of a plant-derived sterol similar to cholesterol.

VT:0010593.name: liver phytosterol amount
VT:0010593.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the bile-secreting exocrine gland of a plant-derived steroid with one OH group.
synonyms: liver plant sterol and stanol amount

VT:0010594.name: liver campesterol amount
VT:0010594.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the bile-secreting exocrine gland of a phytosterol with the formula C28H48O.

VT:0010595.name: liver sitosterol amount
VT:0010595.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the bile-secreting exocrine gland of a plant-derived sterol similar to cholesterol.

VT:0010596.name: heart left ventricle natriuretic peptide A amount
VT:0010596.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the left lower chamber of the heart of the peptide hormone NPPA, which is involved in the control of extracellular fluid volume and electrolyte homeostasis.
synonyms: heart left ventricle atrial natriuretic factor amount

VT:0010597.name: blood murinoglobulin 1 amount
VT:0010597.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of Mug1, a serine-type endopeptidase inhibitor.

VT:0010598.name: thoracic aorta cellular protein amount
VT:0010598.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of intracellular proteins in the part of the descending aorta superior to the aortic hiatus of the diaphragm.

VT:0010599.name: maternal behavior trait
VT:0010599.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the behavior of the mother or attending female associated with the ability of young to thrive.

VT:0010600.name: maternal nurturing trait
VT:0010600.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to a female tending to young.

VT:0010601.name: brain ventricle integrity trait
VT:0010601.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the cavities of the brain filled with cerebrospinal fluid.

VT:0010602.name: aorta integrity trait
VT:0010602.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the main trunk of the systemic arteries.

VT:0010603.name: stomach integrity trait
VT:0010603.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the sac-like structure of the digestive canal between the esophagus and the small intestine.

VT:0010604.name: urine chloride amount
VT:0010604.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of the monovalent anion of chlorine.

VT:0010605.name: urine norepinephrine amount
VT:0010605.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of this catecholamine hormone secreted by the adrenal medulla which also acts as a neurotransmitter in the central and sympathetic nervous systems; precursor of epinephrine.

VT:0010606.name: urine vanillylmandelic acid amount
VT:0010606.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the  urine of the major urinary metabolite of adrenal and sympathetic catecholamines such as epinephrine and norepinephrine.

VT:0010607.name: blood gamma-glutamyltransferase amount
VT:0010607.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this enzyme, which catalyzes the transfer of the gamma-glutamyl moiety of glutathione to an acceptor such as amino acid, peptide, or water.

VT:0010608.name: thyroid gland mass
VT:0010608.def: The amount of matter in the two-lobed endocrine gland found in all vertebrates, located in front of and on either side of the trachea in humans, that produces various hormones, such as triiodothyronine and calcitonin.

VT:0010609.name: areola morphology trait
VT:0010609.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the circular, pigmented area of the skin surrounding the mammalian nipple.

VT:0010610.name: areola quantity
VT:0010610.def: The proportion or number of the circular, pigmented areas of the skin surrounding the mammalian nipple.

VT:0010611.name: uterus mass
VT:0010611.def: The amount of matter in the hollow muscular organ where the embryo/fetus develops.

VT:0010612.name: cranium morphology trait
VT:0010612.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the upper portion of the skull that excludes the mandible.

VT:0010613.name: cranium size trait
VT:0010613.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the upper portion of the skull that excludes the mandible.

VT:0010614.name: cranium mass
VT:0010614.def: The amount of matter in the upper portion of the skull that excludes the mandible.

VT:0010615.name: cranium mineral mass
VT:0010615.def: The amount of matter in the minerals (inorganic elements or compounds that have importance in body functions) in the upper portion of the skull that excludes the mandible.

VT:0010616.name: blood lactate amount
VT:0010616.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in blood of the compound produced from pyruvate by lactate dehydrogenase.

VT:0010617.name: blood pyruvate amount
VT:0010617.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume  in  blood of  pyruvate (the carboxylate anion of pyruvic acid), which is the  end product of glycolysis.

VT:0010618.name: urine creatine amount
VT:0010618.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in urine of creatine, a naturally occurring amino acid in vertebrates that helps to supply energy to all cells in the body.

VT:0010619.name: liver glutathione amount
VT:0010619.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the liver of this tripeptide antioxidant.

VT:0010620.name: liver malondialdehyde amount
VT:0010620.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the liver of the dialdehyde of malonic acid.

VT:0010621.name: urine taurine amount
VT:0010621.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of an aminosulfonic acid synthesized from l-cysteine.

VT:0010622.name: blood xenobiotic amount
VT:0010622.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the blood of any pharmacologically, endocrinologically, or toxicologically active substance not endogenously produced and therefore foreign to an organism.

VT:0010623.name: blood acetaminophen amount
VT:0010623.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the blood of this antipyretic and analgesic.

VT:0010624.name: blood superoxide dismutase amount
VT:0010624.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in blood of the oxidoreductase that catalyzes the reaction between superoxide anions and hydrogen to yield molecular oxygen and hydrogen peroxide.

VT:0010625.name: blood malondialdehyde amount
VT:0010625.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the blood of the dialdehyde of malonic acid.

VT:0010626.name: blood vitamin amount
VT:0010626.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of any of the organic substances found in food that are necessary in trace amounts for normal metabolic function.

VT:0010627.name: blood vitamin A amount
VT:0010627.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of any of the vitamin A compounds, retinol, retinal (retinaldehyde), and retinoic acid, all of which are derivatives of beta-carotene.

VT:0010628.name: blood globulin amount
VT:0010628.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the globular proteins that have higher molecular weights and water solubility than the albumins.

VT:0010629.name: bulbourethral gland mass
VT:0010629.def: The amount of matter in the gland in males that lies along the prostate gland and secretes a fluid component of the seminal fluid into the urethra.

VT:0010630.name: blood glutathione peroxidase amount
VT:0010630.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this enzyme, which catalyzes the reaction of two glutathiones with H2O2, forming glutathione disulfide and two water molecules, and is a crucial enzyme in hydrogen peroxide detoxification.

VT:0010631.name: amino acid metabolism trait
VT:0010631.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the chemical reactions and pathways involving the organic compounds, which, when polymerized, form proteins.

VT:0010632.name: carbohydrate metabolism trait
VT:0010632.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the chemical reactions and pathways involving carbohydrates (substances composed of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen according to the general formula Cn(H2O)n).

VT:0010633.name: lipid metabolism trait
VT:0010633.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the chemical reactions and pathways involving molecules composed of carbon and hydrogen that are characteristically insoluble in water.

VT:0010634.name: peptide metabolism trait
VT:0010634.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the chemical reactions and pathways involving peptides (compounds of two or more amino acids in which a carboxyl group of one is united with an amino group of another.

VT:0010635.name: xenobiotic pharmacokinetics trait
VT:0010635.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the absorption, distribution, metabolism or elimination of a foreign compound.

VT:0010636.name: vitamin and cofactor metabolism trait
