VT:0010636.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the chemical reactions and pathways involving a vitamin (organic substance found in food that is necessary in trace amounts for normal metabolic function) or cofactor (atom or molecule essential for the action of the vitamin).

VT:0010637.name: energy metabolism trait
VT:0010637.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the chemical reactions and pathways involved in the production and utilization of various forms of energy.

VT:0010638.name: xenobiotic metabolism trait
VT:0010638.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the chemical reactions and pathways involving a foreign compound.

VT:0010639.name: artery integrity trait
VT:0010639.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the blood vessels that carry blood away from the heart.

VT:0010640.name: thoracic aorta integrity trait
VT:0010640.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the part of the descending aorta superior to the aortic hiatus of the diaphragm.

VT:0010641.name: renal artery morphology trait
VT:0010641.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of either or both of the laterally paired arteries that supply the kidneys.

VT:0010642.name: renal artery integrity trait
VT:0010642.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of either or both of the laterally paired arteries that supply the kidneys.

VT:0010643.name: iliac artery morphology trait
VT:0010643.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the arteries that arise from a bifurcation of the aorta supplying the pelvis or abdomen.

VT:0010644.name: iliac artery integrity trait
VT:0010644.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of any of the arteries that arise from a bifurcation of the aorta supplying the pelvis or abdomen.

VT:0010645.name: biceps brachii muscle mass
VT:0010645.def: The amount of matter in the muscle in the forelimb stylopod which in humans has several functions, the most important being to rotate the forearm and to flex the elbow.

VT:0010646.name: biceps femoris muscle mass
VT:0010646.def: The amount of matter in a muscle of the posterior thigh. It has two parts, one of which (the long head) forms part of the hamstrings muscle group.

VT:0010647.name: forelimb muscle morphology trait
VT:0010647.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the muscle tissue of the anterior/superior jointed appendages used for locomotion or grasping.

VT:0010648.name: muscle glycogen amount
VT:0010648.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in muscle of the polysaccharide which is the storage form for glucose in the liver and muscles; readily converted to glucose when blood glucose level decreases.

VT:0010649.name: adipose beta-carotene amount
VT:0010649.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in fat-storing cells/tissue of a carotenoid that is the most common precursor to vitamin A.

VT:0010650.name: blood haptoglobin amount
VT:0010650.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of any alpha2 globulin that can combine with free oxyhemoglobin to form a stable complex.

VT:0010651.name: tyrosinase activity
VT:0010651.def: The degree of function or response of tyrosinase, the enzyme that acts on tyrosine to produce melanin.

VT:0010652.name: muscle mineral amount
VT:0010652.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of any inorganic element or compound that has importance in body functions in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0010653.name: muscle iron amount
VT:0010653.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in muscle of this metallic element that normally occurs in the heme of hemoglobin, myoglobin, transferrin, ferritin, and iron-containing porphyrins; it is an essential component of enzymes such as catalase, peroxidase, and various cytochromes.

VT:0010654.name: muscle zinc amount
VT:0010654.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in muscle of this essential metallic element that is involved in most metabolic pathways.

VT:0010655.name: feather length
VT:0010655.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the surface covering of birds, made of keratin.

VT:0010656.name: comb morphology trait
VT:0010656.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the vascular, red cutaneous structure attached in a sagittal plane to the dorsum of the skull of domestic fowl.

VT:0010657.name: comb size trait
VT:0010657.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the vascular, red cutaneous structure attached in a sagittal plane to the dorsum of the skull of domestic fowl.

VT:0010658.name: comb shape trait
VT:0010658.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical form or contours of the vascular, red cutaneous structure attached in a sagittal plane to the dorsum of the skull of domestic fowl.

VT:0010659.name: feather tract morphology trait
VT:0010659.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the areas of the skin of a bird in which feathers grow; they are well defined and separated by unfeathered areas called apteria.

VT:0010660.name: feather tract width
VT:0010660.def: The distance from side to side of the area(s) of the skin of a bird in which feathers grow; they are well defined and separated by unfeathered areas called apteria.

VT:0010661.name: hoof pigmentation trait
VT:0010661.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the deposition or aggregation of coloring matter in the tip of a toe of an ungulate mammal, strengthened by a thick horny (keratin) covering. The hoof consists of a hard or rubber sole and a hard wall formed by a thick nail rolled around the tip of the toe.

VT:0010662.name: toll-like receptor 2 protein amount
VT:0010662.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in serum of toll-like receptor 2, a membrane protein which is expressed on the surface of certain cells and plays a role in immune response.

VT:0010663.name: toll-like receptor 9 protein amount
VT:0010663.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in serum of toll-like receptor 9, a membrane protein which is expressed on the surface of certain cells and plays a role in immune response.

VT:0010664.name: semimembranosus mass
VT:0010664.def: The amount of matter in the muscle of the thigh that is the most medial of the three hamstring muscles.

VT:0010665.name: gluteus medius mass
VT:0010665.def: The amount of matter in one of the three gluteal muscles, situated on the outer surface of the pelvis.

VT:0010666.name: milk alpha-casein amount
VT:0010666.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of the alpha fraction of the casein phosphoprotein.

VT:0010667.name: phagocytosis trait
VT:0010667.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the endocytosis process that results in the engulfment of external particulate material by phagocytes. The particles are initially contained within phagocytic vacuoles (phagosomes), which then fuse with primary lysosomes to effect digestion of the particles.

VT:0010668.name: muscle dry matter amount
VT:0010668.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of solids (all constituents excluding water) in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0010669.name: longissimus thoracis width
VT:0010669.def: The distance from side to side of the muscle of the back which is the intermediate and largest of the continuations of the Sacrospinalis.

VT:0010670.name: NADP+-malate dehydrogenase activity
VT:0010670.def: The degree of function or response of the enzyme that catalyzes the dehydrogenation of malate to oxaloacetate.

VT:0010671.name: tarsometatarsus morphology trait
VT:0010671.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the long bone in the lower leg of birds, formed by fusion of tarsal and metatarsal structures.

VT:0010672.name: tarsometatarsus mass
VT:0010672.def: The amount of matter in the long bone in the lower leg of birds, formed by fusion of tarsal and metatarsal structures.

VT:0010673.name: tarsometatarsus length
VT:0010673.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the long bone in the lower leg of birds, formed by fusion of tarsal and metatarsal structures.

VT:0010674.name: tarsometatarsus circumference
VT:0010674.def: The distance around the long bone in the lower leg of birds, formed by fusion of tarsal and metatarsal structures.

VT:0010675.name: semimembranosus size trait
VT:0010675.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the muscle of the thigh that is the most medial of the three hamstring muscles.

VT:0010676.name: semimembranosus width
VT:0010676.def: The distance from side to side of the muscle of the thigh that is the most medial of the three hamstring muscles.

VT:0010677.name: glycated serum protein amount
VT:0010677.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of serum proteins which have undergone glycation (nonenzymic covalent bonding with a sugar molecule).

VT:0010678.name: adipose protein amount
VT:0010678.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in fat-storing cells/tissue of any of the macromolecules consisting of long chains of amino acids in peptide linkage.

VT:0010679.name: tarsometatarsus diameter
VT:0010679.def: The distance across the long bone in the lower leg of birds, formed by fusion of tarsal and metatarsal structures.

VT:0010680.name: glucose-6-phosphatase activity
VT:0010680.def: The degree of function or response of the enzyme that hydrolyzes glucose-6-phosphate to orthophosphate and glucose.

VT:0010681.name: lactate dehydrogenase activity
VT:0010681.def: The degree of function or response of the enzyme that catalyzes the oxidation of lactate to pyruvate.

VT:0010682.name: inguinal canal integrity trait
VT:0010682.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of  the passage in the lower abdominal wall through which the spermatic cord in the male or the round ligament in the female, nerves and vessels pass from the pelvic cavity to the scrotum or labia majora, respectively.

VT:0010683.name: abdominal wall integrity trait
VT:0010683.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the margins that enclose the abdominal cavity; the major part is muscular but also includes skin, subcutaneous fat, fascia and the parietal peritoneum.

VT:0010684.name: peritoneum morphology trait
VT:0010684.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the serous membrane that lines the peritoneal cavity.

VT:0010685.name: peritoneum pigmentation trait
VT:0010685.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the deposition or aggregation of coloring matter in the serous membrane that lines the peritoneal cavity.

VT:0010686.name: blood calcidiol amount
VT:0010686.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the product of the first step in the biologic conversion of vitamin D3 to the more active form, calcitriol.

VT:0010687.name: response to heat trait
VT:0010687.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism as a result of a heat stimulus, a temperature stimulus above the optimal temperature for that organism.

VT:0010688.name: milk osteopontin amount
VT:0010688.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of a secreted phosphoprotein, produced by many epithelial cell types, which is highly negatively charged and frequently associated with mineralization processes.

VT:0010689.name: pericardial fat pad morphology trait
VT:0010689.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the encapsulated adipose tissue found around the heart.

VT:0010690.name: pericardial fat pad mass
VT:0010690.def: The amount of matter in the encapsulated adipose tissue found around the heart.

VT:0010691.name: subscapular fat pad morphology trait
VT:0010691.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the encapsulated adipose tissue located beneath the large, flat bones of the shoulder girdle.

VT:0010692.name: subscapular fat pad mass
VT:0010692.def: The amount of matter in the encapsulated adipose tissue located beneath the large, flat bones of the shoulder girdle.

VT:0010693.name: longissimus muscle morphology trait
VT:0010693.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the longest subdivision of the sacrospinalis that extends forward into the transverse processes of the posterior cervical vertebrae.

VT:0010694.name: blood fructosamine amount
VT:0010694.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the blood of fructosamine, the compound that results from glycation reactions between a sugar and a primary amine, followed by isomerization via the Amadori rearrangement.

VT:0010695.name: blood ghrelin amount
VT:0010695.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the peptide hormone produced mainly by P/D1 cells lining the fundus of the stomach and epsilon cells of the pancreas that stimulates hunger and serves as a potent stimulator of growth hormone from the anterior pituitary gland; in addition to stimulating appetite and growth, ghrelin also plays various roles in energy homeostasis, neuropathy, and in the cardiovascular and immune systems.

VT:0010696.name: preovulatory follicle quantity
VT:0010696.def: The proportion or number of ovarian structures containing an oocyte at the last stage of growth, characterized in mammals by the formation of a cavity (antrum) filled with follicular fluid and in birds by the accumulation of vitellus.

VT:0010697.name: blood chylomicron cholesterol amount
VT:0010697.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the cholesterol associated with lipoprotein complexes that transport exogenous triglycerides and cholesterol from the intestines to other tissues.

VT:0010698.name: blood HDL triglyceride amount
VT:0010698.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the triglyceride in small lipoproteins that transport triglycerides and cholesterol.

VT:0010699.name: blood LDL triglyceride amount
VT:0010699.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the triglyceride in the lipoprotein complex that transports triglyceride and cholesterol out of the arteries and around the body, for use by various tissues in normal bodily functions.

VT:0010700.name: blood VLDL triglyceride amount
VT:0010700.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the triglyceride in lipoprotein complexes formed to transport endogenously derived triglycerides to extra-hepatic tissues.

VT:0010701.name: blood chylomicron triglyceride amount
VT:0010701.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of triglyceride (any of a group of lipids that are esters formed from one molecule of glycerol and three molecules of one or more fatty acids, are widespread in adipose tissue, and commonly circulate in the blood in the form of lipoproteins) carried in chylomicron molecules in a specified volume of blood. Chylomicrons are a class of lipoproteins that transport exogenous triglycerides and cholesterol from the small intestine to other tissues.

VT:0010702.name: blood lipoprotein particle size
VT:0010702.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the lipid-protein complexes involved in the transportation and metabolism of lipids.

VT:0010703.name: blood HDL particle size
VT:0010703.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the high density lipoprotein particles found in whole blood, serum, or plasma.

VT:0010704.name: blood LDL particle size
VT:0010704.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the low density lipoprotein particles found in whole blood, serum, or plasma.

VT:0010705.name: blood VLDL particle size
VT:0010705.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the very low density lipoprotein particles found in whole blood, serum, or plasma.

VT:0010706.name: kidney glutathione amount
VT:0010706.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in kidney of this tripeptide antioxidant.

VT:0010707.name: kidney malondialdehyde amount
VT:0010707.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in kidney of the dialdehyde of malonic acid.

VT:0010708.name: sheltering behavior trait
VT:0010708.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to actions or reactions of an organism with regard to visiting a shelter or nest used for resting/sleeping.

VT:0010709.name: behavioral response to novel object trait
VT:0010709.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity of an organism to change, adjust, or alter its actions or reactions as a result of exposure to an unfamiliar object.

VT:0010710.name: milk copper amount
VT:0010710.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of this metallic bioelement found in a number of proteins.

VT:0010711.name: milk iron amount
VT:0010711.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of this metallic element that is an essential constituent of hemoglobins, cytochromes, and iron-binding proteins.

VT:0010712.name: milk manganese amount
VT:0010712.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of this metallic element that resembles iron.

VT:0010713.name: milk selenium amount
VT:0010713.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of this metallic element chemically similar to sulfur.

VT:0010714.name: milk zinc amount
VT:0010714.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of this metallic element that is a cofactor in many proteins.

VT:0010715.name: fear-related behavior trait
VT:0010715.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to actions or reactions in tests for fear-related behaviors (emotional response related to anticipation of specific pain or danger).

VT:0010716.name: anxiety-related behavior trait
VT:0010716.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to actions or reactions in tests for anxiety-related behaviors (emotional response related to anticipation of non-specific threat).

VT:0010717.name: response to amphetamine trait
VT:0010717.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity of an organism to change, adjust, or alter its morphology, physiology, or behavior as a result of amphetamine exposure.

VT:0010718.name: response to cocaine trait
VT:0010718.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity of an organism to change, adjust, or alter its morphology, physiology, or behavior as a result of cocaine exposure.

VT:0010719.name: response to methamphetamine trait
VT:0010719.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity of an organism to change, adjust, or alter its morphology, physiology, or behavior as a result of methamphetamine exposure.

VT:0010720.name: response to morphine trait
VT:0010720.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity of an organism to change, adjust, or alter its morphology, physiology, or behavior as a result of morphine exposure.

VT:0010721.name: response to nicotine trait
VT:0010721.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity of an organism to change, adjust, or alter its morphology, physiology, or behavior as a result of nicotine exposure.

VT:0010722.name: withdrawal response to addictive substance trait
VT:0010722.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the intensity, duration, or type of morphological, physiological, or behavioral response displayed after discontinuation of an addictive substance.

VT:0010723.name: conditioned place preference behavior trait
VT:0010723.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the actions or reactions of an organism pertaining to the ability to learn and remember an association between a putative rewarding internal state produced by a xenobiotic or drug with a neutral, unchanging environment.

VT:0010724.name: urine ketone body amount
VT:0010724.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of ketone bodies (acetoacetate, 3-hydroxybutyrate and/or acetone). Ketone bodies are produced by fatty acid and carbohydrate metabolism and seen in conditions such as starvation and diabetes mellitus.

VT:0010725.name: startle reflex trait
VT:0010725.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the threshold or reflex response to variable stimuli, often auditory; usually measured by amplitude of whole body flinch.

VT:0010726.name: wildness behavior trait
VT:0010726.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to actions or reactions in tests to determine the ease with which an animal can be captured and/or handled.

VT:0010727.name: spatial reference memory trait
VT:0010727.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to recall spatial location information from previous encounters or training sessions in order to navigate or perform other behavior using such location cues.

VT:0010728.name: discrimination learning trait
VT:0010728.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to exhibit a differential response to different stimuli that is achieved by the reinforcement of the desired response for each particular stimulus.

VT:0010729.name: olfactory discrimination memory trait
VT:0010729.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to exhibit a differential response to olfactory stimuli that is achieved by the reinforcement of the desired response for each particular olfactory stimulus.

VT:0010730.name: locomotor coordination trait
VT:0010730.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of an animal to maintain skillful and effective interaction of movements while engaging in behavioral locomotor activity.

VT:0010731.name: gait trait
VT:0010731.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the pattern of movement of the limbs, characterized by elements of progression, stability, speed and length over the ground.

VT:0010732.name: head movement trait
VT:0010732.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the motion of the portion of the body containing the brain and organs of sight, hearing, taste, and smell.

VT:0010733.name: trigeminal nerve integrity trait
VT:0010733.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the chief sensory nerve of the face and motor nerve of the muscles of mastication.

VT:0010734.name: anorectal integrity trait
VT:0010734.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the rectum and anus.

VT:0010735.name: urination behavior trait
VT:0010735.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to actions or reactions of an organism with regard to the process in which parasympathetic nerves stimulate the bladder wall muscle to contract and expel urine from the body.

VT:0010736.name: wound healing trait
VT:0010736.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of repair of trauma to any tissues of the body, especially that caused by physical means.

VT:0010737.name: skin molecular composition trait
VT:0010737.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the membranous protective covering of the body.

VT:0010738.name: skin mineral amount
VT:0010738.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the skin of any inorganic element or compound that has importance in body functions.

VT:0010739.name: skin chloride amount
VT:0010739.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the skin of the monovalent anion of chlorine.

VT:0010740.name: skin potassium amount
VT:0010740.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the skin of the monovalent cation of this alkali metal element.

VT:0010741.name: skin sodium amount
VT:0010741.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the skin of the monovalent cation of this alkali metal element, the most plentiful extracellular ion in the body.

VT:0010742.name: blood cystatin amount
VT:0010742.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of an inhibitor of cysteine proteases.

VT:0010743.name: blood cystatin C amount
VT:0010743.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of cystatin C.

VT:0010744.name: urine podocalyxin amount
VT:0010744.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of this sialoglycoprotein.

VT:0010745.name: heart left ventricle integrity trait
VT:0010745.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the left lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0010746.name: coronary artery integrity trait
VT:0010746.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of any of the arteries that branch from the aorta to supply blood to the heart.

VT:0010747.name: heart left ventricle interstitial collagen amount
VT:0010747.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of collagen types I and III in the left lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0010748.name: stereotypic behavior trait
VT:0010748.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of behavior related to repetitive, invariant, perseverative motor patterns that do not appear to be purposeful.

VT:0010749.name: heart blood pressure trait
VT:0010749.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to blood pressure in the heart.

VT:0010750.name: heart left ventricular blood pressure trait
VT:0010750.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to blood pressure in the lower left chamber of the heart.

VT:0010751.name: response to methylenedioxymethamphetamine trait
VT:0010751.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity of an organism to change, adjust, or alter its morphology, physiology, or behavior as a result of methylenedioxymethamphetamine exposure (also known as MDMA or Ecstasy).

VT:0010752.name: blood angiotensin II amount
VT:0010752.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this hormone, a vasoconstrictor formed by the action of angiotensin-converting enzyme on angiotensin I.

VT:0010753.name: urine urea amount
VT:0010753.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in urine of this product of protein catabolism.

VT:0010754.name: kidney adrenomedullin amount
VT:0010754.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of adrenomedullin in the kidney.

VT:0010755.name: heart molecular composition trait
VT:0010755.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the heart.

VT:0010756.name: heart lactate dehydrogenase activity
VT:0010756.def: The degree of function or response in the heart of the enzyme that catalyzes the oxidation of lactate to pyruvate.

VT:0010757.name: heart integrity trait
VT:0010757.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the heart.

VT:0010758.name: heart left ventricle end-diastolic diameter
VT:0010758.def: The distance across the left lower chamber of the heart, immediately after mitral valve closure.

VT:0010759.name: heart left ventricle end-systolic diameter
VT:0010759.def: The distance across the left lower chamber of the heart, immediately before mitral valve opening.

VT:0010760.name: nitric oxide amount
VT:0010760.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in a body tissue or fluid of nitric oxide, the free radical oxide of nitrogen which functions in various physiological capacities.

VT:0010761.name: kidney lipid peroxide amount
VT:0010761.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in kidney of the lipid peroxidation end products produced by the oxidative degradation of lipids.

VT:0010762.name: catalase activity
VT:0010762.def: The degree of function or response of this enzyme that converts the reactive oxygen species hydrogen peroxide to water and oxygen.

VT:0010763.name: superoxide dismutase activity
VT:0010763.def: The degree of function or response of this family of enzymes that convert naturally-occurring but harmful superoxide radicals to molecular oxygen and hydrogen peroxide.

VT:0010764.name: liver lipid amount
VT:0010764.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in liver tissue of fat-soluble substances (molecules composed of carbon and hydrogen and are characteristically insoluble in water).

VT:0010765.name: head and neck integrity trait
VT:0010765.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the head and/or neck.

VT:0010766.name: gluthathione peroxidase activity
VT:0010766.def: The degree of function or response of the enzyme that catalyzes the following reaction: 2 glutathione + hydrogen peroxide = oxidized glutathione + 2 H2O.

VT:0010767.name: kidney glutathione peroxidase activity
VT:0010767.def: The degree of function or response in the kidney of the enzyme that catalyzes the following reaction: 2 glutathione + hydrogen peroxide = oxidized glutathione + 2 H2O.

VT:0010768.name: kidney superoxide dismutase activity
VT:0010768.def: The degree of function or response in the kidney of this family of enzymes that convert naturally-occurring but harmful superoxide radicals to molecular oxygen and hydrogen peroxide.

VT:0010769.name: paraoxonase 1 activity
VT:0010769.def: The degree of function or response of the arylesterase that hydrolyzes paroxon, an organophosphorus anticholinesterase compound, to produce p-nitrophenol.

VT:0010770.name: kidney paraoxonase 1 activity
VT:0010770.def: The degree of function or response in the kidney of the arylesterase that hydrolyzes paroxon, an organophosphorus anticholinesterase compound, to produce p-nitrophenol.

VT:0010771.name: retina integrity trait
VT:0010771.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the thin layer of neural tissue lining the back of the eyeball which contains visual receptors.

VT:0010772.name: central nervous system integrity trait
VT:0010772.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the core nervous system that serves an integrating and coordinating function. In vertebrates it consists of the neural tube derivatives: the brain and spinal cord. In invertebrates it includes central ganglia plus nerve cord.

VT:0010773.name: peripheral nervous system integrity trait
VT:0010773.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the major division of the nervous system that contains nerves which connect the central nervous system (CNS) with sensory organs, other organs, muscles, blood vessels and glands.

VT:0010774.name: ornithine decarboxylase activity
VT:0010774.def: The degree of function or response of the enzyme that catalyzes the decarboxylation of ornithine (a product of the urea cycle) to form putrescine, the rate-limiting and first committed step in polyamine synthesis.

VT:0010775.name: liver ornithine decarboxylase activity
VT:0010775.def: The degree of function or response in the liver of the enzyme that catalyzes the decarboxylation of ornithine (a product of the urea cycle) to form putrescine, the rate-limiting and first committed step in polyamine synthesis.

VT:0010776.name: blood alpha-fetoprotein amount
VT:0010776.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the highly abundant plasma protein produced by the yolk sac, liver, and gastrointestinal tract during fetal life and by certain neoplasms in the adult.

VT:0010777.name: serum alpha-fetoprotein amount
VT:0010777.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in serum of the highly abundant plasma protein produced by the yolk sac, liver and gastrointestinal tract during fetal life and by certain neoplasms in the adult.

VT:0010778.name: plasma alpha-fetoprotein amount
VT:0010778.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in plasma of the highly abundant plasma protein produced by the yolk sac, liver and gastrointestinal tract during fetal life and by certain neoplasms in the adult.

VT:0010779.name: blood integrity trait
VT:0010779.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the biochemical soundness of the internal equilibrium in the cell containing fluid that circulates through the body, carrying nourishment, electrolytes, hormones, vitamins, antibodies, heat, and oxygen to the tissues and taking away waste matter and carbon dioxide.

VT:0010780.name: cerebrovascular system morphology trait
VT:0010780.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the network of vessels that convey blood in the brain.

VT:0010781.name: cerebrovascular system integrity trait
VT:0010781.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the network of vessels that convey blood in the brain.

VT:0010782.name: pulmonary arterial blood pressure trait
VT:0010782.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to blood pressure in the pulmonary artery.

VT:0010783.name: urinary system integrity trait
VT:0010783.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of any of the organs involved in the production or excretion of urine.

VT:0010784.name: blood oxygen amount
VT:0010784.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of oxygen in whole blood, serum, or plasma.

VT:0010785.name: blood carbon dioxide amount
VT:0010785.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of carbon dioxide in whole blood, serum, or plasma.

VT:0010786.name: mesenteric artery morphology trait
VT:0010786.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of any of the arteries which arise from the abdominal aorta and distribute to most of the intestines.

VT:0010787.name: eicosanoid amount
VT:0010787.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in a body tissue or fluid of eicosanoids, signaling molecules derived from C20 fatty acids.

VT:0010788.name: blood alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase amount
VT:0010788.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase,  a  lysosomal enzyme involved in the degradation of blood type A epitope.

VT:0010789.name: adrenal gland molecular composition trait
VT:0010789.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the endocrine glands located above the kidney responsible for hormone and epinephrine secretion.

VT:0010790.name: adrenal gland ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0010790.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the adrenal glands. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0010791.name: brain ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0010791.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the brain. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0010792.name: heart ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0010792.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the heart. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0010793.name: kidney ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0010793.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the kidney. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0010794.name: liver ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0010794.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the liver. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0010795.name: lung molecular composition trait
VT:0010795.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the spongy organs of respiration contained within the pleural cavity of the thorax.

VT:0010796.name: lung ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0010796.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the lung. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0010797.name: muscle ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0010797.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in muscle. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0010798.name: spleen molecular composition trait
VT:0010798.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the organ that functions to filter blood and to store red corpuscles and platelets.

VT:0010799.name: spleen ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0010799.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the spleen. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0010800.name: testis molecular composition trait
VT:0010800.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the  male reproductive gland(s) where sperm production occurs.

VT:0010801.name: testis ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0010801.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the testis. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0010802.name: thymus molecular composition trait
VT:0010802.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the primary lymphoid organ that is required for maturation of T cells.

VT:0010803.name: thymus ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0010803.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the thymus. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0010804.name: uterus molecular composition trait
VT:0010804.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the hollow muscular organ where the embryo/fetus develops.

VT:0010805.name: uterus ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0010805.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the uterus. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0010806.name: quadriceps mass
VT:0010806.def: The amount of matter in the group of four muscles (rectus femoris, vastus intermedius, vastus lteralis, and vastus medialis) which extend down the front of the thigh and are the major extensors of the knee joint.

VT:0010807.name: feather pigmentation trait
VT:0010807.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the deposition or aggregation of coloring matter in the surface covering of birds, made of keratin.

VT:0010808.name: milk sulfur amount
VT:0010808.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of this nonmetallic element with atomic symbol S and atomic number 16.

VT:0010809.name: urine sorbital dehydrogenase amount
VT:0010809.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of the enzyme sorbital dehydrogenase, an enzyme that converts sorbitol, the sugar alcohol form of glucose, into fructose.

VT:0010810.name: blood pyrophosphate amount
VT:0010810.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the blood of pyrophosphate, a phosphorus oxyanion containing two phosphorus atoms in a P-O-P linkage.

VT:0010811.name: heart left ventricle interstitial epinephrine amount
VT:0010811.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of interstitial epinephrine in the left lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0010812.name: heart left ventricle interstitial norepinephrine amount
VT:0010812.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of interstitial norepinephrine in the left lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0010813.name: heart left ventricle interstitial bradykinin amount
VT:0010813.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of interstitial bradykinin, a linear nonapeptide messenger belonging to the kinin group of proteins, in the left lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0010814.name: heart left ventricle interstitial angiotensin II amount
VT:0010814.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of interstitial angiotensin II in the left lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0010815.name: urine hormone amount
VT:0010815.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of any of the chemical substances that have specific regulatory effects on the activity of a certain organ or organs; originally applied to substances secreted by various endocrine glands and transported in the bloodstream to the target organs, it is sometimes extended to include substances that are not produced by the endocrine glands but that have similar effects.

VT:0010816.name: urine aldosterone amount
VT:0010816.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of aldosterone, a steroid hormone produced by the adrenal cortex that regulates reabsorption of water and ions in the kidney.

VT:0010817.name: comb length
VT:0010817.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the vascular, red cutaneous structure attached in a sagittal plane to the dorsum of the skull of domestic fowl.

VT:0010818.name: comb height
VT:0010818.def: The vertical dimension of the vascular, red cutaneous structure attached in a sagittal plane to the dorsum of the skull of domestic fowl.

VT:0010819.name: comb pigmentation trait
VT:0010819.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the deposition or aggregation of coloring matter in the vascular, red cutaneous structure attached in a sagittal plane to the dorsum of the skull of domestic fowl.

VT:0010820.name: comb mass
VT:0010820.def: The amount of matter in the vascular, red cutaneous structure attached in a sagittal plane to the dorsum of the skull of domestic fowl.

VT:0010821.name: oviduct mass
VT:0010821.def: The amount of matter in the tube through which the ova pass from the ovary to the uterus (mammals) or to the outside (fish, birds).

VT:0010822.name: blood inhibin amount
VT:0010822.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of either of two glycoproteins (designated A and B), secreted by the gonads, that inhibit pituitary production of follicle-stimulating hormone.

VT:0010823.name: milk lactoperoxidase amount
VT:0010823.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of an enzyme that catalyzes the radioiodination of tyrosine and its derivatives and of peptides containing tyrosine.

VT:0010824.name: milk iodine amount
VT:0010824.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of this nonmetallic element of the halogen group, which is especially important in thyroid hormone synthesis.

VT:0010825.name: tongue size trait
VT:0010825.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the mobile mass of muscular tissue and surrounding epithelial tissue occupying the cavity of the mouth and forming part of the floor.

VT:0010826.name: tongue length
VT:0010826.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the mobile mass of muscular tissue and surrounding epithelial tissue occupying the cavity of the mouth and forming part of the floor.

VT:0010827.name: tongue mass
VT:0010827.def: The amount of matter in the mobile mass of muscular tissue and surrounding epithelial tissue occupying the cavity of the mouth and forming part of the floor.

VT:0010828.name: tissue epinephrine amount
VT:0010828.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in a tissue of a catecholamine secreted by the adrenal gland upon stimulation of the sympathetic nervous system.

VT:0010829.name: cervical spinal cord epinephrine amount
VT:0010829.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in a spinal cord segment adjacent to a cervical region of a catecholamine secreted by the adrenal gland upon stimulation of the sympathetic nervous system.

VT:0010830.name: medulla oblongata epinephrine amount
VT:0010830.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the medulla oblongata (the region of the brainstem that lies directly above the spinal cord and controls vital autonomic functions) of a catecholamine secreted by the adrenal gland upon stimulation of the sympathetic nervous system.

VT:0010831.name: midbrain/pons epinephrine amount
VT:0010831.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the midbrain (the middle of the three cerebral vesicles of the embryo or the corresponding part of the adult brain) and neighboring pons (between the medulla oblongata and the midbrain) of a catecholamine secreted by the adrenal gland upon stimulation of the sympathetic nervous system.

VT:0010832.name: hypothalamus epinephrine amount
VT:0010832.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the hypothalamus (the ventral part of the diencephalon, which forms the floor and lateral wall of the third ventricle) of a catecholamine secreted by the adrenal gland upon stimulation of the sympathetic nervous system.

VT:0010833.name: forebrain epinephrine amount
VT:0010833.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the forebrain (part of the brain developed from the most rostral of the three primary vesicles of the embryonic neural tube from which the diencephalon and telencephalon are derived) of a catecholamine secreted by the adrenal gland upon stimulation of the sympathetic nervous system.

VT:0010834.name: tissue dihydroxyphenylacetic acid (DOPAC) amount
VT:0010834.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in a tissue of the 3-O-methyl ether of (3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)acetic acid, a catecholamine metabolite.

VT:0010835.name: tissue homovanillic acid amount
VT:0010835.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in a tissue of HVA, a catecholamine metabolite.

VT:0010836.name: tissue 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid amount
VT:0010836.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in a tissue of indole-3-acetic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at C-5.

VT:0010837.name: tissue norepinephrine amount
VT:0010837.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in a tissue of a catecholamine hormone that functions as a neurotransmitter and is the precursor to epinephrine.

VT:0010838.name: tissue serotonin amount
VT:0010838.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in a tissue of this monoamine neurotransmitter derived primarily from tryptophan.

VT:0010839.name: tissue dopamine amount
VT:0010839.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in a tissue of this catecholamine neurotransmitter, derived from tyrosine and the precursor to norepinephrine and epinephrine.

VT:0010840.name: cervical spinal cord dihyroxyphenylacetic acid (DOPAC) amount
VT:0010840.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in a spinal cord segment adjacent to a cervical region of the 3-O-methyl ether of (3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)acetic acid, a catecholamine metabolite.

VT:0010841.name: medulla oblongata dihydroxyphenylacetic acid (DOPAC) amount
VT:0010841.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the medulla oblongata (the region of the brainstem that lies directly above the spinal cord and controls vital autonomic functions) of the 3-O-methyl ether of (3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)acetic acid, a catecholamine metabolite.

VT:0010842.name: midbrain/pons dihydroxyphenylacetic acid (DOPAC) amount
VT:0010842.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the midbrain (the middle of the three cerebral vesicles of the embryo or the corresponding part of the adult brain) and neighboring pons (between the medulla oblongata and the midbrain) of the 3-O-methyl ether of (3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)acetic acid, a catecholamine metabolite.

VT:0010843.name: hypothalamus dihydroxyphenylacetic acid (DOPAC) amount
VT:0010843.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the hypothalamus (the ventral part of the diencephalon, which forms the floor and lateral wall of the third ventricle) of the 3-O-methyl ether of (3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)acetic acid, a catecholamine metabolite.

VT:0010844.name: forebrain dihydroxyphenylacetic acid (DOPAC) amount
VT:0010844.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the forebrain (part of the brain developed from the most rostral of the three primary vesicles of the embryonic neural tube from which the diencephalon and telencephalon are derived) of the 3-O-methyl ether of (3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)acetic acid, a catecholamine metabolite.

VT:0010845.name: cervical spinal cord homovanillic acid amount
VT:0010845.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in a spinal cord segment adjacent to a cervical region of HVA, a catecholamine metabolite.

VT:0010846.name: medulla oblongata homovanillic acid amount
VT:0010846.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the medulla oblongata (the region of the brainstem that lies directly above the spinal cord and controls vital autonomic functions) of HVA, a catecholamine metabolite.

VT:0010847.name: midbrain/pons homovanillic acid amount
VT:0010847.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the midbrain (the middle of the three cerebral vesicles of the embryo or the corresponding part of the adult brain) and neighboring pons (between the medulla oblongata and the midbrain) of HVA, a catecholamine metabolite.

VT:0010848.name: hypothalamus homovanillic acid amount
VT:0010848.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the hypothalamus (the ventral part of the diencephalon, which forms the floor and lateral wall of the third ventricle) of HVA, a catecholamine metabolite.

VT:0010849.name: forebrain homovanillic acid amount
VT:0010849.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the forebrain (part of the brain developed from the most rostral of the three primary vesicles of the embryonic neural tube from which the diencephalon and telencephalon are derived) of HVA, a catecholamine metabolite.

VT:0010850.name: cervical spinal cord 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid amount
VT:0010850.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in a spinal cord segment adjacent to a cervical region of indole-3-acetic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at C-5.

VT:0010851.name: medulla oblongata 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid amount
VT:0010851.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the medulla oblongata (the region of the brainstem that lies directly above the spinal cord and controls vital autonomic functions) of indole-3-acetic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at C-5.

VT:0010852.name: midbrain/pons 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid amount
VT:0010852.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the midbrain (the middle of the three cerebral vesicles of the embryo or the corresponding part of the adult brain) and neighboring pons (between the medulla oblongata and the midbrain) of indole-3-acetic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at C-5.

VT:0010853.name: hypothalamus 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid amount
VT:0010853.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the hypothalamus (the ventral part of the diencephalon, which forms the floor and lateral wall of the third ventricle) of indole-3-acetic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at C-5.

VT:0010854.name: forebrain 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid amount
VT:0010854.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the forebrain (part of the brain developed from the most rostral of the three primary vesicles of the embryonic neural tube from which the diencephalon and telencephalon are derived) of indole-3-acetic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at C-5.

VT:0010855.name: cervical spinal cord norepinephrine amount
VT:0010855.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in a spinal cord segment adjacent to a cervical region of a catecholamine hormone that functions as a neurotransmitter and is the precursor to epinephrine.

VT:0010856.name: medulla oblongata norepinephrine amount
VT:0010856.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the medulla oblongata (the region of the brainstem that lies directly above the spinal cord and controls vital autonomic functions) of a catecholamine hormone that functions as a neurotransmitter and is the precursor to epinephrine.

VT:0010857.name: midbrain/pons norepinephrine amount
VT:0010857.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the midbrain (the middle of the three cerebral vesicles of the embryo or the corresponding part of the adult brain) and neighboring pons (between the medulla oblongata and the midbrain) of a catecholamine hormone that functions as a neurotransmitter and is the precursor to epinephrine.

VT:0010858.name: hypothalamus norepinephrine amount
VT:0010858.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the hypothalamus (the ventral part of the diencephalon, which forms the floor and lateral wall of the third ventricle) of a catecholamine hormone that functions as a neurotransmitter and is the precursor to epinephrine.

VT:0010859.name: forebrain norepinephrine amount
VT:0010859.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the forebrain (part of the brain developed from the most rostral of the three primary vesicles of the embryonic neural tube from which the diencephalon and telencephalon are derived) of a catecholamine hormone that functions as a neurotransmitter and is the precursor to epinephrine.

VT:0010860.name: cervical spinal cord serotonin amount
VT:0010860.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in a spinal cord segment adjacent to a cervical region of a monoamine neurotransmitter derived primarily from tryptophan.

VT:0010861.name: medulla oblongata serotonin amount
VT:0010861.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the medulla oblongata (the region of the brainstem that lies directly above the spinal cord and controls vital autonomic functions) of  a monoamine neurotransmitter derived primarily from tryptophan.

VT:0010862.name: midbrain/pons serotonin amount
VT:0010862.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the midbrain (the middle of the three cerebral vesicles of the embryo or the corresponding part of the adult brain) and neighboring pons (between the medulla oblongata and the midbrain) of a monoamine neurotransmitter derived primarily from tryptophan.

VT:0010863.name: hypothalamus serotonin amount
VT:0010863.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the hypothalamus (the ventral part of the diencephalon, which forms the floor and lateral wall of the third ventricle) of a monoamine neurotransmitter derived primarily from tryptophan.

VT:0010864.name: forebrain serotonin amount
VT:0010864.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the forebrain (part of the brain developed from the most rostral of the three primary vesicles of the embryonic neural tube from which the diencephalon and telencephalon are derived) of a monoamine neurotransmitter derived primarily from tryptophan.

VT:0010865.name: cervical spinal cord dopamine amount
VT:0010865.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in a spinal cord segment adjacent to a cervical region of this catecholamine neurotransmitter, derived from tyrosine and the precursor to norepinephrine and epinephrine.

VT:0010866.name: medulla oblongata dopamine amount
VT:0010866.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of dopamine in the most caudal region of the brainstem that lies directly rostral to the spinal cord. Dopamine is a catecholamine neurotransmitter derived from tyrosine and the precursor to norepinephrine and epinephrine.

VT:0010867.name: midbrain/pons dopamine amount
VT:0010867.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the midbrain (the middle of the three cerebral vesicles of the embryo or the corresponding part of the adult brain) and neighboring pons (between the medulla oblongata and the midbrain) of this catecholamine neurotransmitter, derived from tyrosine and the precursor to norepinephrine and epinephrine.

VT:0010868.name: hypothalamus dopamine amount
VT:0010868.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the hypothalamus (the ventral part of the diencephalon, which forms the floor and lateral wall of the third ventricle) of this catecholamine neurotransmitter, derived from tyrosine and the precursor to norepinephrine and epinephrine.

VT:0010869.name: forebrain dopamine amount
VT:0010869.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the forebrain (part of the brain developed from the most rostral of the three primary vesicles of the embryonic neural tube from which the diencephalon and telencephalon are derived) of this catecholamine neurotransmitter, derived from tyrosine and the precursor to norepinephrine and epinephrine.

VT:0010870.name: blood enzyme inhibitor amount
VT:0010870.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the blood of any pharmacologically, endocrinologically, or toxicologically active substance which decreases or interferes with the activity of an enzyme.

VT:0010871.name: brain epinephrine amount
VT:0010871.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the brain of a catecholamine secreted by the adrenal gland upon stimulation of the sympathetic nervous system.

VT:0010872.name: brain dihydroxyphenylacetic acid (DOPAC) amount
VT:0010872.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the brain of the 3-O-methyl ether of (3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)acetic acid, a catecholamine metabolite.

VT:0010873.name: brain homovanillic acid amount
VT:0010873.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the brain of HVA, a catecholamine metabolite.

VT:0010874.name: brain 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid amount
VT:0010874.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the brain of indole-3-acetic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at C-5.

VT:0010875.name: brain norepinephrine amount
VT:0010875.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the brain of a catecholamine hormone that functions as a neurotransmitter and is the precursor to epinephrine.

VT:0010876.name: brain serotonin amount
VT:0010876.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the brain of a monoamine neurotransmitter derived primarily from tryptophan.

VT:0010877.name: brain dopamine amount
VT:0010877.def: The proportion, quantity or volume in the brain of this catecholamine neurotransmitter, derived from tyrosine and the precursor to norepinephrine and epinephrine.

VT:0010878.name: blood bile acid amount
VT:0010878.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of any member of a group of hydroxy-5beta-cholanic acids occurring in bile, where they are present as the sodium salts of their amides with glycine or taurine.

VT:0010879.name: blood reactive oxygen metabolite amount
VT:0010879.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of hydroperoxides measured in whole blood, serum, or plasma as derivatives in a DROM spectrophotometric test.

VT:0010880.name: serum reactive oxygen metabolite amount
VT:0010880.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of hydroperoxides measured in serum as derivatives in a DROM spectrophotometric test.

VT:0010881.name: blood oxidized LDL amount
VT:0010881.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of oxidized LDL in whole blood, serum, or plasma.

VT:0010882.name: serum oxidized LDL amount
VT:0010882.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of oxidized LDL in serum.

VT:0010883.name: muscle triglyceride amount
VT:0010883.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in muscle of this molecule, glycerol esterified at each of its three hydroxyl groups by a fatty acid.

VT:0010884.name: blood flavanone amount
VT:0010884.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a flavan bearing an oxo substituent at position 4.

VT:0010885.name: urine urotensin II amount
VT:0010885.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of urotensin II in a specified volume of urine.

VT:0010886.name: blood urotensin II amount
VT:0010886.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of urotensin II.

VT:0010887.name: blood bradykinin amount
VT:0010887.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of bradykinin, a linear nonapeptide messenger belonging to the kinin group of proteins.

VT:0010888.name: tissue protein amount
VT:0010888.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in a body tissue of macromolecules consisting of long sequences of amino acids in peptide linkage.

VT:0010889.name: tissue enzyme amount
VT:0010889.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in a body tissue of any of the proteins that act as catalysts for biological reactions.

VT:0010890.name: intestine trypsin amount
VT:0010890.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in an intestinal tissue of the digestive enzyme trypsin.

VT:0010891.name: blood sorbital dehydrogenase amount
VT:0010891.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of sorbital dehydrogenase, an enzyme that converts sorbitol, the sugar alcohol form of glucose, into fructose.

VT:0010892.name: heart right ventricular blood pressure trait
VT:0010892.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to blood pressure in the lower right chamber of the heart.

VT:0010893.name: ovary molecular composition trait
VT:0010893.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the female reproductive gland containing the germ cells.

VT:0010894.name: colon molecular composition trait
VT:0010894.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the portion of the large intestine between the cecum and the rectum.

VT:0010895.name: gastrocnemius molecular composition trait
VT:0010895.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the two-headed large muscle of the posterior portion of the lower hindlimb, the most superficial of the calf muscles.

VT:0010896.name: femur area
VT:0010896.def: The two-dimensional extent of the long bone of the thigh.

VT:0010897.name: abdominal adipose mass
VT:0010897.def: The amount of matter in the fat-storing tissue lining the cavity bounded by the abdominal walls, the diaphragm, and the pelvis, and surrounding the internal organs.

VT:0010898.name: leukocyte integrity trait
VT:0010898.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural or biochemical soundness of the nucleated cells of the myeloid or lymphoid lineages, found in blood or other tissue.

VT:0010899.name: bone marrow cell integrity trait
VT:0010899.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural or biochemical soundness of the cells found in the bone marrow.

VT:0010900.name: Leydig cell integrity trait
VT:0010900.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural or biochemical soundness of the testosterone-secreting cells in the interstitial area, between the seminiferous tubules, in the testis.

VT:0010901.name: colorectal integrity trait
VT:0010901.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the portion of the large intestine between the cecum and the anus.

VT:0010902.name: blood eicosanoid amount
VT:0010902.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of eicosanoids, signaling molecules derived from C20 fatty acids.

VT:0010903.name: blood carbohydrate or carbohydrate derivative amount
VT:0010903.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of any organooxygen compound that is a polyhydroxy-aldehyde or -ketone, or a compound derived from one. Carbohydrates contain only carbon, hydrogen and oxygen and usually have an empirical formula Cm(H2O)n; carbohydrate derivatives may contain other elements by substitution or condensation.

VT:0010904.name: tissue oxygen amount
VT:0010904.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of oxygen in some tissue.

VT:0010905.name: brain oxygen amount
VT:0010905.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of oxygen in the brain.

VT:0010906.name: lung integrity trait
VT:0010906.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of either or both of the spongy organs of respiration contained within the pleural cavity of the thorax.

VT:0010907.name: blood copper amount
VT:0010907.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in blood of this metallic element that has formula Cu, and normally occurs as a cofactor for a number of proteins including amine oxidases and chaperone proteins.

VT:0010908.name: urine copper amount
VT:0010908.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in urine of this metallic element that has formula Cu, and normally occurs as a cofactor for a number of proteins including amine oxidases and chaperone proteins.

VT:0010909.name: blood ceruloplasmin amount
VT:0010909.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of ceruloplasmin, a metalloprotein that binds most of the copper in plasma and is involved in the peroxidation of Fe(II)transferrin to Fe(III) transferrin.

VT:0010910.name: skeletal muscle capillary amount
VT:0010910.def: The proportion or number in skeletal muscle of the small branching blood vessels that connect arterioles and venules.

VT:0010911.name: glomerular capillary morphology trait
VT:0010911.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the small branching blood vessels in the kidney glomerulus that receive blood from the kidney afferent arterioles.

VT:0010912.name: urine homeostasis trait
VT:0010912.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the internal equilibrium in the fluid and dissolved substances excreted by the kidneys.

VT:0010913.name: kidney tubule molecule reabsorption trait
VT:0010913.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which the cells of the loops of Henle, proximal and distal convoluted tubules, and collecting ducts in the kidney reabsorb water, electrolytes, or other molecules, thereby removing them from the newly produced urine.

VT:0010914.name: blood glucagon-like peptide amount
VT:0010914.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a peptide hormone derived from proglucagon and mainly produced by intestinal L cells.

VT:0010915.name: peritoneum integrity trait
VT:0010915.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the serous membrane that lines the peritoneal cavity.

VT:0010916.name: blood gastric inhibitory polypeptide amount
VT:0010916.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of gastric inhibitory polypeptide, a 42-amino-acid hormone that is produced by enteroendocrine K-cells and released into the circulation in response to nutrient stimulation.

VT:0010917.name: bile acid amount
VT:0010917.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of any member of a group of hydroxy-5beta-cholanic acids occurring in bile, where they are present as the sodium salts of their amides with glycine or taurine.

VT:0010918.name: liver bile acid amount
VT:0010918.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the liver of any member of a group of hydroxy-5beta-cholanic acids occurring in bile, where they are present as the sodium salts of their amides with glycine or taurine.

VT:0010919.name: feces bile acid amount
VT:0010919.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in feces of any member of a group of hydroxy-5beta-cholanic acids occurring in bile, where they are present as the sodium salts of their amides with glycine or taurine.

VT:0010920.name: cerebral artery morphology trait
VT:0010920.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of any of the arteries which irrigate the cerebrum of the brain.

VT:0010921.name: cerebral artery size trait
VT:0010921.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of any of the arteries which irrigate the cerebrum of the brain.

VT:0010922.name: liver iron amount
VT:0010922.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in liver tissue of this metallic element that normally occurs in the heme of hemoglobin, myoglobin, transferrin, ferritin, and iron-containing porphyrins; it is an essential component of enzymes such as catalase, peroxidase, and various cytochromes.

VT:0010923.name: cerebral cortex integrity trait
VT:0010923.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the grey matter on the surface of the cerebral hemisphere that develops from the telencephalon and folds into gyri; it is responsible for intellectual faculties and higher mental functions.

VT:0010924.name: blood amount
VT:0010924.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the cardiovascular system of the cell-containing fluid that circulates through the body, carrying nourishment, electrolytes, hormones, vitamins, antibodies, heat, and oxygen to the tissues and taking away waste matter and carbon dioxide.

VT:0010925.name: kidney glomerulus size trait
VT:0010925.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the capillary loops at the beginning of each nephric tubule in the kidney.

VT:0010926.name: blood plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 amount
VT:0010926.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of plasminogen activator inhibitor 1,  the principal inhibitor of tissue plasminogen activator (tPA) and urokinase (uPA), and hence an inhibitor of fibrinolysis.

VT:0010927.name: blood complement amount
VT:0010927.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of complement,  the thermolabile group of proteins in normal blood serum and plasma that in combination with antibodies causes the destruction especially of particulate antigens (such as bacteria and foreign blood corpuscles).

VT:0010928.name: bone marrow physiology trait
VT:0010928.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the soft tissue that fills the core cavities of bones.

VT:0010929.name: arteriole morphology trait
VT:0010929.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the blood vessels that are the smallest arterial vessel located between the muscular arteries and the capillaries.

VT:0010930.name: kidney arteriole morphology trait
VT:0010930.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the renal arterioles, the blood vessels that branch from the kidney interlobular arteries and convey blood to the glomerular capillaries and from the glomerulocapillary network to the capillary beds of the proximal convoluted tubules.

VT:0010931.name: blood molecular composition trait
VT:0010931.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the cell-containing fluid that circulates through the body, carrying nourishment, electrolytes, hormones, vitamins, antibodies, heat, and oxygen to the tissues and taking away waste matter and carbon dioxide.

VT:0010932.name: blood arginine amount
VT:0010932.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of arginine, an alpha-amino acid that is glycine in which the alpha-is substituted by a 3-guanidinopropyl group.

VT:0010933.name: nipple size trait
VT:0010933.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the erectile protuberance at the tip of the mammary gland in which the mammary ducts terminate and from which milk can be secreted.

VT:0010934.name: adipocyte size trait
VT:0010934.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of fat cells.

VT:0010935.name: urine pH trait
VT:0010935.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative acidity or alkalinity of the urine, as measured by the concentration of hydrogen ion.

VT:0010936.name: head temperature trait
VT:0010936.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the level of heat maintained in the head of a living being.

VT:0010937.name: fetus trait
VT:0010937.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic or state of the unborn young of a viviparous mammal after it has taken form in the uterus.

VT:0010938.name: fetus integrity trait
VT:0010938.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the unborn young of a viviparous mammal after it has taken form in the uterus.

VT:0010939.name: erythrocyte molecular composition trait
VT:0010939.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the erythrocyte,  the fetal or adult cell in the blood that carries oxygen.

VT:0010940.name: erythrocyte sodium amount
VT:0010940.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in red blood cells of  the monovalent cation of this alkali metal element, the most plentiful extracellular ion in the body.

VT:0010941.name: erythrocyte potassium amount
VT:0010941.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in red blood cells of the monovalent cation of this alkali metal element.

VT:0010942.name: erythrocyte ATP amount
VT:0010942.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in red blood cells of adenosine-5'-triphosphate, a molecule involved in the transportation of chemical energy during metabolic pathways.

VT:0010943.name: glucokinase activity
VT:0010943.def: The degree of function or response of the enzyme that catalyzes the phosphorylation of glucose to glucose-6-phosphate.

VT:0010944.name: liver glucokinase activity
VT:0010944.def: The degree of function or response in the liver of the enzyme that catalyzes the phosphorylation of glucose to glucose-6-phosphate.

VT:0010945.name: cardiac muscle capillary amount
VT:0010945.def: The proportion or number in cardiac muscle of the small branching blood vessels that connect arterioles and venules.

VT:0010946.name: aorta molecular composition trait
VT:0010946.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in any part of the main trunk of the systemic arteries.

VT:0010947.name: liver adipose amount
VT:0010947.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the fat-storing tissue in the liver, the bile-secreting exocrine gland which is important for detoxification; for fat, carbohydrate, and protein metabolism; and for glycogen storage.

VT:0010948.name: tympanic cavity morphology trait
VT:0010948.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the small, air-filled, membrane-lined chamber bound externally by the tympanic membrane and containing three osicles that vibrate in response to sound waves.

VT:0010949.name: tympanic cavity integrity trait
VT:0010949.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the small, air-filled, membrane-lined chamber bound externally by the tympanic membrane and containing three osicles that vibrate in response to sound waves.

VT:0010950.name: blood angiotensin I amount
VT:0010950.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this hormone, a decapeptide that is cleaved from precursor angiotensin by renin. It is converted to angiotensin II by angiotensin converting enzyme.

VT:0010951.name: heart right ventricle molecular composition trait
VT:0010951.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the right lower chamber of the heart.

VT:0010952.name: adrenal gland renin amount
VT:0010952.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the adrenal glands of this enzyme which cleaves a bond in angiotensinogen to generate angiotensin I.

VT:0010953.name: erythrocyte hemoglobin amount
VT:0010953.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in red blood cells of  the oxygen-carrying protein.

VT:0010954.name: gastrointestinal system mass
VT:0010954.def: The amount of matter in the components of the system that converts ingested food to nutrients and energy.

VT:0010955.name: pulmonary arteriole morphology trait
VT:0010955.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the pulmonary arterioles, the smallest vessels which connect the pulmonary arteries to the capillaries that surround the pulmonary alveoli.

VT:0010956.name: quinidine metabolism trait
VT:0010956.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the chemical reactions and pathways involving quinidine,  an alkaloid that dampens the excitability of cardiac and skeletal muscles by blocking sodium and potassium currents across cellular membranes.

VT:0010957.name: verapamil metabolism trait
VT:0010957.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the chemical reactions and pathways involving verapamil,  a calcium channel blocker used (particularly as the hydrochloride salt) in the treatment of hypertension, angina pectoris and cardiac arrhythmia, and as a preventive medication for migraine.

VT:0010958.name: digoxin metabolism trait
VT:0010958.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the chemical reactions and pathways involving digoxin, a cardiac glycoside used to control ventricular rate in atrial fibrillation and in the management of congestive heart failure with atrial fibrillation.

VT:0010959.name: urine integrity trait
VT:0010959.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the biochemical soundness of the internal equilibrium in  the fluid and dissolved substances excreted by the kidneys.

VT:0010960.name: sodium ion homeostasis trait
VT:0010960.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to any process involved in the maintenance of an internal equilibrium of sodium ions within an organism or cell.

VT:0010961.name: potassium ion homeostasis trait
VT:0010961.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to any process involved in the maintenance of an internal equilibrium of potassium ions within an organism or cell.

VT:0010962.name: soleus muscle mass
VT:0010962.def: The amount of matter in either or both of the soleus muscles, a deep muscle of the triceps surae group, in the superficial posterior compartment of the leg.

VT:0010963.name: CD25-positive T cell morphology trait
