VT:0010963.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the regulatory subset of regulatory T lymphocytes that carry the CD25 marker.  CD25 is the IL-2 receptor alpha chain.

VT:0010964.name: CD25-positive T cell quantity
VT:0010964.def: The proportion or number of the subset of regulatory T lymphocytes that carry the CD25 marker.  CD25 is the IL-2 receptor alpha chain.

VT:0010965.name: blood glycine amount
VT:0010965.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the simplest (and the only achiral) proteinogenic amino acid, with a hydrogen atom as its side chain.

VT:0010966.name: blood L-serine amount
VT:0010966.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the L-enantiomer of serine, an alpha-amino acid that is alanine substituted at position 3 by a hydroxy group.

VT:0010967.name: blood L-alanine amount
VT:0010967.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the L-enantiomer of alanine, an alpha-amino acid that consists of propionic acid bearing an amino substituent at position 2.

VT:0010968.name: blood L-cysteine amount
VT:0010968.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of an optically active form of cysteine having L-configuration.

VT:0010969.name: blood L-aspartic acid amount
VT:0010969.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the L-enantiomer of aspartic acid, an alpha-amino acid that consists of succinic acid bearing a single alpha-amino substituent.

VT:0010970.name: blood L-asparagine amount
VT:0010970.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of an optically active form of asparagine (an alpha-amino acid in which one of the hydrogens attached to the alpha-carbon of glycine is substituted by a 2-amino-2-oxoethyl group) having L-configuration.

VT:0010971.name: blood L-glutamic acid amount
VT:0010971.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of an optically active form of glutamic acid (an alpha-amino acid that is glutaric acid bearing a single amino substituent at position 2) having L-configuration.

VT:0010972.name: blood L-glutamine amount
VT:0010972.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of an optically active form of glutamine (an alpha-amino acid that consists of butyric acid bearing an amino substituent at position 2 and a carbamoyl substituent at position 4) having L-configuration.

VT:0010973.name: blood L-proline amount
VT:0010973.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of pyrrolidine in which the pro-S hydrogen at position 2 is substituted by a carboxylic acid group. L-Proline is the only one of the twenty DNA-encoded amino acids which has a secondary amino group alpha to the carboxyl group.

VT:0010974.name: blood L-tyrosine amount
VT:0010974.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of an optically active form of tyrosine (an alpha-amino acid that is phenylalanine bearing a hydroxy substituent at position 4 on the phenyl ring) having L-configuration.

VT:0010975.name: blood L-arginine amount
VT:0010975.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of  the L-isomer of arginine, an alpha-amino acid that is glycine in which the alpha-is substituted by a 3-guanidinopropyl group.

VT:0010976.name: blood L-hisitidine amount
VT:0010976.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the L-enantiomer of the amino acid histidine, an alpha-amino acid that is propanoic acid bearing an amino substituent at position 2 and a 1H-imidazol-4-yl group at position 3.

VT:0010977.name: blood L-isoleucine amount
VT:0010977.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the L-enantiomer of isoleucine, a 2-amino-3-methylpentanoic acid having either (2R,3R)- or (2S,3S)-configuration.

VT:0010978.name: blood L-leucine amount
VT:0010978.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the L-enantiomer of leucine, a branched-chain amino acid that consists of glycine in which one of the hydrogens attached to the alpha-carbon is substituted by an isobutyl group.

VT:0010979.name: blood L-valine amount
VT:0010979.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the L-enantiomer of valine, a branched-chain amino acid that consists of glycine in which one of the hydrogens attached to the alpha-carbon is substituted by an isopropyl group.

VT:0010980.name: blood L-lysine amount
VT:0010980.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the L-isomer of lysine, a diamino acid that is caproic (hexanoic) acid bearing two amino substituents at positions 2 and 6.

VT:0010981.name: blood L-methionine amount
VT:0010981.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the L-enantiomer of methionine, a sulfur-containing amino acid that is butyric acid bearing an amino substituent at position 2 and a methylthio substituent at position 4.

VT:0010982.name: blood L-phenylalanine amount
VT:0010982.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the L-enantiomer of phenylalanine, an aromatic amino acid that is alanine in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a phenyl group.

VT:0010983.name: blood L-threonine amount
VT:0010983.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of an optically active form of threonine (An alpha-amino acid in which one of the hydrogens attached to the alpha-carbon of glycine is substituted by a 1-hydroxyethyl group) having L-configuration.

VT:0010984.name: blood L-tryptophan amount
VT:0010984.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the L-enantiomer of tryptophan an alpha-amino acid that is alanine bearing an indol-3-yl substituent at position 3.

VT:0010985.name: blood L-taurine amount
VT:0010985.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the L-enantiomer of taurine, an amino sulfonic acid that is the 2-amino derivative of ethanesulfonic acid. It is a naturally occurring amino acid derived from methionine and cysteine metabolism.

VT:0010986.name: blood L-citrulline amount
VT:0010986.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the L-enantiomer of citrulline, consisting of ornithine having a carbamoyl group at the N5-position.

VT:0010987.name: blood dipeptide amount
VT:0010987.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of any molecule that contains two amino-acid residues connected by peptide linkages.

VT:0010988.name: blood anserine amount
VT:0010988.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a dipeptide comprising of beta-alanine and 3-methyl-L-histidine units.

VT:0010989.name: blood balenine amount
VT:0010989.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of A dipeptide composed of beta-alanine and 1-methylhistidine.

VT:0010990.name: blood carnosine amount
VT:0010990.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a dipeptide that is the N-(beta-alanyl) derivative of L-histidine.

VT:0010991.name: blood sarcosine amount
VT:0010991.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a N-alkylglycine that is the N-methyl derivative of glycine. It is an intermediate in the metabolic pathway of glycine.

VT:0010992.name: blood 3-methylhistidine amount
VT:0010992.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a methylhistidine in which the methyl group is located at N-3.

VT:0010993.name: blood 1-methylhistidine amount
VT:0010993.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a methylhistidine in which the methyl group is located at N-1.

VT:0010994.name: blood L-ornithine amount
VT:0010994.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of an optically active form of ornithine having L-configuration.

VT:0010995.name: blood 4-hydroxyproline amount
VT:0010995.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a monohydroxyproline where the hydroxy group is located at the 4-position. It is found in fibrillar collagen.

VT:0010996.name: blood 3-hydroxybutyrate amount
VT:0010996.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-hydroxybutyric acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

VT:0010997.name: response to Coronaviridae infection
VT:0010997.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity to change, adjust, or alter immune processes or function as a result of invasion and multiplication of Coronaviridae viruses (enveloped positive-sense single-stranded RNA viruses with a genome of up to 32kb in length) in the tissues, or of exposure to components of or toxins produced by a coronavirus.

VT:0010998.name: blood electrolyte amount
VT:0010998.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of any electrolyte, a substance that dissociates into two or more ions, to some extent, in water. Has importance in body functions.

VT:0010999.name: body water amount
VT:0010999.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of water retained in the body.

VT:0011000.name: choline amount
VT:0011000.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of choline (2-hydroxyethyltrimethylammonium), an amino alcohol that occurs widely in living organisms as a constituent of certain types of phospholipids and in the neurotransmitter acetylcholine.

VT:0011001.name: trimethylamine N-oxide amount
VT:0011001.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a tertiary amine oxide resulting from the oxidation of the amino group of trimethylamine; a metabolite derived from gut bacteria.

VT:0011002.name: betaine amount
VT:0011002.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of this modified amino acid consisting of a glycine with three methyl groups that serves as a methyl donor for various metabolic pathways.

VT:0011003.name: phosphocholine amount
VT:0011003.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the phosphate of choline, and the parent compound of the phosphocholine family; an intermediate in the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine in tissues.

VT:0011004.name: glycerophosphocholine amount
VT:0011004.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the glycerol phosphate ester of a phosphocholine; one of two major forms of choline storage (along with phosphocholine) in the cytosol.

VT:0011005.name: tissue deoxyribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011005.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in a tissue of deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), the molecule composed of the sugar deoxyribose, phosphate groups and any combination of the bases adenine, guanine, cytosine, and/or thymine.

VT:0011006.name: response to oxycodone trait
VT:0011006.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the capacity of an organism to change, adjust, or alter its morphology, physiology, or behavior as a result of oxycodone exposure.

VT:0011007.name: muscle calcium amount
VT:0011007.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in muscle of this metallic bivalent element with atomic symbol Ca and atomic number 20.

VT:0011008.name: muscle magnesium amount
VT:0011008.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in muscle of  this alkaline earth element, atomic number 12, atomic symbol Mg.

VT:0011009.name: muscle manganese amount
VT:0011009.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in muscle of this metallic element that resembles iron.

VT:0011010.name: muscle phosphorus amount
VT:0011010.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in muscle of this nonmetallic essential element which occurs naturally in phosphates and takes part in a broad variety of chemical reactions.

VT:0011011.name: muscle potassium amount
VT:0011011.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in muscle of potassium, an alkaline metallic element.

VT:0011012.name: muscle selenium amount
VT:0011012.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in muscle of this metallic element chemically similar to sulfur.

VT:0011013.name: muscle sodium amount
VT:0011013.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in muscle of the monovalent cation of this alkali metal element.

VT:0011014.name: muscle sulfur amount
VT:0011014.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in muscle of this nonmetallic element with atomic symbol S and atomic number 16.

VT:0011015.name: muscle copper amount
VT:0011015.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in muscle of this metallic bioelement found in a number of proteins.

VT:0011016.name: CD3-positive T cell quantity
VT:0011016.def: The proportion or number of T lymphocytes that are positive for the CD3 T-cell co-receptor complex.

VT:0011017.name: aorta ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011017.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in any part of the aorta, the main trunk of the systemic arteries. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011018.name: stellate ganglion molecular composition trait
VT:0011018.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the postsynaptic neurons formed by the fusion of the inferior cervical and first thoracic ganglia.

VT:0011019.name: stellate ganglion ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011019.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the stellate ganglion, the postsynaptic neurons formed by the fusion of the inferior cervical and first thoracic ganglia. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011020.name: foot pad ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011020.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the metapodial pad. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011021.name: eye molecular composition trait
VT:0011021.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the organs of vision and their supporting structures.

VT:0011022.name: eye ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011022.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the eye. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011023.name: adipose ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011023.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in fat-storing cells/tissue. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011024.name: colon ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011024.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the portion of the large intestine between the cecum and the rectum. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011025.name: skin ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011025.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the membranous protective covering of the body. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011026.name: prostate molecular composition trait
VT:0011026.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the gland surrounding the beginning of the urethra in males that secretes part of the seminal fluid.

VT:0011027.name: prostate ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011027.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the gland surrounding the beginning of the urethra in males that secretes part of the seminal fluid. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011028.name: urethra molecular composition trait
VT:0011028.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the canal leading from the bladder, discharging the urine externally.

VT:0011029.name: urethra ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011029.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the urethra and adjacent tissue. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011030.name: ovary ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011030.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the female reproductive gland containing the germ cells. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011031.name: blood ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011031.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the cell-containing fluid that circulates through the body, carrying nourishment, electrolytes, hormones, vitamins, antibodies, heat, and oxygen to the tissues and taking away waste matter and carbon dioxide. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011032.name: pancreas ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011032.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the organ that secretes pancreatic juice into the duodenum and secretes glucagon and insulin into the bloodstream. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011033.name: spinal cord ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011033.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the cylindrical tissue of the vertebral canal that extends from the medulla oblangata to the conus medullaris. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011034.name: pituitary gland molecular composition trait
VT:0011034.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the compound gland suspended from the base of the hypothalamus, which secretes somatotropins, prolactin, TSH (thyroid-stimulating hormone), gonadotropins, adrenal corticotropin, and other related peptides.

VT:0011035.name: pituitary gland ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011035.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the compound gland suspended from the base of the hypothalamus, which secretes somatotropins, prolactin, TSH (thyroid-stimulating hormone), gonadotropins, adrenal corticotropin, and other related peptides. VT:0011139.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases or other substances in the group of neurons that is the largest of the sympathetic trunk; normally lies at the base of the skull and innervates the head and neck.

VT:0011140.name: superior cervical ganglion ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011140.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the group of neurons that is the largest of the sympathetic trunk; normally lies at the base of the skull and innervates the head and neck. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011141.name: right pulmonary vein molecular composition trait
VT:0011141.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the vein that drains the right lung and returns blood to the heart.

VT:0011142.name: right pulmonary vein ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011142.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the right pulmonary vein, the vein that drains the right lung and returns blood to the heart. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011143.name: lymphatic vessel molecular composition trait
VT:0011143.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or ther substances in the lymphatic vessels, vessels that contain or convey lymph, that originate as an interfibrillar or intercellular cleft or space in a tissue or organ.

VT:0011144.name: lymphatic vessel ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011144.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the lymphatic vessels, vessels that contain or convey lymph, that originate as an interfibrillar or intercellular cleft or space in a tissue or organ. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011145.name: blood interleukin-19 amount
VT:0011145.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a cytokine which is a member of the IL-10 cytokine subfamily and involved in the inflammatory response.

VT:0011146.name: blood interleukin-25 amount
VT:0011146.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a cytokine which is a member of the IL-17 cytokine subfamily and is a pro-inflammatory cytokine favoring the Th2-type immune response.

VT:0011147.name: interleukin-19 secretion trait
VT:0011147.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of interleukin-19 a monocytic cytokine which is a member of the IL-10 cytokine subfamily and involved in the inflammatory response.

VT:0011148.name: interleukin-25 secretion trait
VT:0011148.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the controlled release of interleukin-25, a member of the IL-17 cytokine subfamily and a pro-inflammatory cytokine favoring the Th2-type immune response.

VT:0011149.name: intervertebral disk molecular composition trait
VT:0011149.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the cartilaginous and gelatinous structures found between the bodies of adjacent vertebrae.

VT:0011150.name: intervertebral disk ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011150.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the cartilaginous and gelatinous structures found between the bodies of adjacent vertebrae. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011151.name: hippocampal formation ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011151.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the hippocampal formation of the brain. The hippocampal formation includes the hippocampus (proper) plus dentate gyrus and subiculum. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011152.name: laryngeal muscle molecular composition trait
VT:0011152.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the muscles associated with the larynx.

VT:0011153.name: laryngeal muscle ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011153.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the muscles associated with the larynx. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011154.name: tibia molecular composition trait
VT:0011154.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the tibia, the medial and larger of the two bones of the lower leg, which articulates with the femur, fibula, and talus.

VT:0011155.name: tibia ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011155.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the medial and larger of the two bones of the lower leg, which articulates with the femur, fibula, and talus. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011156.name: cranium molecular composition trait
VT:0011156.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the upper portion of the skull, excluding the mandible.

VT:0011157.name: cranium ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011157.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the upper portion of the skull, excluding the mandible. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011158.name: voluntary immobility trait
VT:0011158.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to intentional lack of movement executed with a purpose based on learning and/or experience.

VT:0011159.name: striatum ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011159.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the striatum of the brain. The striatum region of the forebrain consists of the caudate nucleus, putamen, and fundus striati. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011160.name: extensor digitorum longus muscle mass
VT:0011160.def: The amount of matter in the penniform muscle of the lateral front part of the leg responsible for extension of the toes and dorsiflexion of the ankle.

VT:0011161.name: tibialis anterior muscle mass
VT:0011161.def: The amount of matter in the muscle of the shin that is responsible for dorsiflexion and inversion of the foot.

VT:0011162.name: cerebral artery molecular composition trait
VT:0011162.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of molecules (proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances) within any of the arteries which irrigate the cerebrum of the brain.

VT:0011163.name: cerebral artery ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011163.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in any of the arteries which irrigate the cerebrum of the brain. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011164.name: food intake trait
VT:0011164.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process whereby food (i.e. material, usually of plant or animal origin, that contains essential nutrients such as carbohydrates, fats, proteins, vitamins, and/or minerals and that is ingested and assimilated by an organism to produce energy, stimulate growth, and maintain life) is taken in for utilization by the body.

VT:0011165.name: bone marrow molecular composition trait
VT:0011165.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in bone marrow, the soft tissue that fills the cavities of bones.

VT:0011166.name: bone marrow ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011166.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in bone marrow, the soft tissue that fills the cavities of bones. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011167.name: sperm molecular composition trait
VT:0011167.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the male gamete, which is produced in the testes. Sperm cells play an important role in the process of fertilization, where they fuse with a female gamete or egg cell (ovum) to form a zygote.

VT:0011168.name: sperm ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011168.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the male gamete, which is produced in the testes. Sperm cells play an important role in the process of fertilization, where they fuse with a female gamete or egg cell (ovum) to form a zygote. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011169.name: parathyroid gland molecular composition trait
VT:0011169.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in one of the two small, paired endocrine glands, usually found embedded in the connective tissue capsule on the posterior surface of the thyroid gland.

VT:0011170.name: parathyroid gland ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011170.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in in one of the two small, paired endocrine glands, usually found embedded in the connective tissue capsule on the posterior surface of the thyroid gland. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011171.name: carotid artery morphology trait
VT:0011171.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the bilaterally paired branched artery that originates from the aortic arches and divides into and includes as parts the internal and external carotid arteries.

VT:0011172.name: carotid artery integrity trait
VT:0011172.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the bilaterally paired branched artery that originates from the aortic arches and divides into and includes as parts the internal and external carotid arteries.

VT:0011173.name: monocyte physiology trait
VT:0011173.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the large, phagocytic mononuclear leukocytes produced in the vertebrate bone marrow and released into the blood.

VT:0011174.name: prenatal growth trait
VT:0011174.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the increase in size or mass of an organism before birth.

VT:0011175.name: connective tissue integrity trait
VT:0011175.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the physical or functional supporting tissue of the body, a major constituent of which is an extracellular matrix of ground substance, protein fibers, and structural glycoproteins.

VT:0011176.name: artery ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011176.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in any of the blood vessels that carry blood away from the heart. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011177.name: mesenteric artery ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011177.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in any of the arteries which arise from the abdominal aorta and distribute to most of the intestines. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011178.name: penis molecular composition trait
VT:0011178.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of molecules (proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances) within the organ of copulation and urination in the male.

VT:0011179.name: corpus cavernosum penis ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011179.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in one of the columns of erectile tissue forming the dorsum and sides of the penis. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011180.name: gastric mucosa molecular composition trait
VT:0011180.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the surface epithelium of the stomach, which is made up of several different cell types.

VT:0011181.name: gastric mucosa ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011181.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the surface epithelium of the stomach, which is made up of several different cell types. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011182.name: Circle of Willis molecular composition trait
VT:0011182.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the Circle of Willis, a network of arteries at the base of the brain that connects the two major arterial systems supplying blood to the brain.

VT:0011183.name: Circle of Willis ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011183.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the Circle of Willis, a network of arteries at the base of the brain that connects the two major arterial systems supplying blood to the brain. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011184.name: choroid plexus molecular composition trait
VT:0011184.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the network formed by blood vessels and the tela choroidea which secretes CSF into the ventricular spaces.

VT:0011185.name: choroid plexus ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011185.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the network formed by blood vessels and the tela choroidea which secretes CSF into the ventricular spaces. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011186.name: lumbar vertebra molecular composition trait
VT:0011186.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the bony segments of the spinal column located anterior/superior to the sacral vertebrae and posterior/inferior to the thoracic vertebrae.

VT:0011187.name: lumbar vertebra ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011187.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the bony segments of the spinal column located anterior/superior to the sacral vertebrae and posterior/inferior to the thoracic vertebrae. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011188.name: CA1 stratum radiatum ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011188.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the CA1 stratum radiatum, the part of the hippocampus stratum radiatum lying in area CA1, superficial to the CA1 pyramidal cell layer and deep to the CA1 stratum lucidum-moleculare, continuous with the stratum radiatum of CA2 and bounded by the subiculum. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011189.name: CA1 stratum oriens ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011189.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the CA1 stratum oriens, the part of the hippocampus stratum oriens lying in area CA1, superficial to the alveus of CA1 and deep to the pyramidal cell layer of CA1. It is continuous with the stratum oriens of CA2 and bounded by the subiculum. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011190.name: blood estrone sulfate amount
VT:0011190.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this steroid that is the 3-sulfate of estrone.

VT:0011191.name: milk acidity/alkalinity trait
VT:0011191.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of milk to resist changes in pH (buffering capacity).

VT:0011192.name: milk cyclophilin A amount
VT:0011192.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of cyclophilin A, a peptidylprolyl isomerase involved in immunoregulation.

VT:0011193.name: milk immunoglobulin amount
VT:0011193.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of members of a diverse group of plasma proteins, made up of polypeptide chains, that function as a primary mechanism for protection against disease.

VT:0011194.name: milk immunoglobulin A amount
VT:0011194.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of the principal immunoglobulin in exocrine secretions; prevents pathogens from invading the body through the mucosa of the gastrointestinal, pulmonary, and genitourinary tracts.

VT:0011195.name: milk immunoglobulin G amount
VT:0011195.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of the major antibody for antitoxins, viruses, and bacteria; also activates complement.

VT:0011196.name: milk immunoglobulin G1 amount
VT:0011196.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of immunoglobulin class G1.

VT:0011197.name: milk immunoglobulin G2 amount
VT:0011197.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of immunoglobulin class G2.

VT:0011198.name: milk immunoglobulin M amount
VT:0011198.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of this immunoglobulin formed during the early part of the immune response that is the most efficient antibody in stimulating complement activity.

VT:0011199.name: muscle anserine amount
VT:0011199.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a dipeptide comprising beta-alanine and 3-methyl-L-histidine units detected in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0011200.name: muscle arsenic amount
VT:0011200.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of this element which is toxic in most forms detected in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0011201.name: muscle beta-alanine content
VT:0011201.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of an amino acid formed by the degradation of dihydrouracil and carnosine detected in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0011202.name: muscle carnosine amount
VT:0011202.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a dipeptide molecule made up of beta-alanine and histidine detected in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0011203.name: muscle chromium amount
VT:0011203.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a trace element that plays a role in glucose metabolism detected in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0011204.name: muscle cobalt amount
VT:0011204.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a trace element that is a component of vitamin B12 detected in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0011205.name: muscle creatine amount
VT:0011205.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a glycine derivative with methyl and amidino groups attached to the nitrogen detected in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0011206.name: muscle creatinine content
VT:0011206.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a metabolite of creatine detected in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0011207.name: muscle collagen amount
VT:0011207.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the major protein of the white fibers of connective tissue, cartilage, and bone detected in the contractile tissue that effects movement.

VT:0011208.name: muscle taurine amount
VT:0011208.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of an amino acid derived from methionine and cysteine metabolism detected in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:0011209.name: colostrum albumin amount
VT:0011209.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in colostrum of the major blood protein that is important in maintenance of the colloidal osmotic pressure, fatty acid transport, and transport of large organic molecules.

VT:0011210.name: colostrum molecular composition trait
VT:0011210.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the first secretion of the mammary gland before milk production.

VT:0011211.name: sperm head morphology trait
VT:0011211.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the part of the spermatazoa containing the nucleus and acrosome.

VT:0011212.name: sperm plasma membrane integrity trait
VT:0011212.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the plasma membrane that is part of a sperm cell.

VT:0011213.name: blood androstenone amount
VT:0011213.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the testicular steroid androstenone.

VT:0011214.name: CD3-negative T cell quantity
VT:0011214.def: The proportion or number of T lymphocytes that are negative for the CD3 T-cell co-receptor complex.

VT:0011215.name: blood interleukin-8 amount
VT:0011215.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a cytokine produced by a variety of cell types that plays a role in the regulation of the acute inflammatory response; it induces chemotaxis of neutrophils and other inflammatory cells.

VT:0011216.name: blood lysozyme amount
VT:0011216.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a glycoside hydrolase that is present in saliva, tears, egg white, and many animal fluids and functions as an antibacterial agent.

VT:0011217.name: mononuclear leukocyte quantity
VT:0011217.def: The proportion or number of mature lymphocytes and monocytes transported by the blood to the body's extravascular space. They are morphologically distinguishable from mature granulocytic leukocytes by their large, non-lobed nuclei and lack of coarse, heavily stained cytoplasmic granules.

VT:0011218.name: blood immunoglobulin G2 amount
VT:0011218.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of immunoglobulin class G2.

VT:0011219.name: blood serotonin amount
VT:0011219.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of this monoamine neurotransmitter derived primarily from tryptophan.

VT:0011220.name: large unstained cell quantity
VT:0011220.def: The proportion or number of larger than normal cells which are unstained using routine blood count methodologies; large unstained cells (LUC) are larger than normal lymphocytes, and may be atypical lymphocytes, myeloperoxidase deficient cells or peroxidase negative blasts. Aberrations in the count of large unstained cells may be indicative of viral disease or leukemia.

VT:0011221.name: blood glutamic acid amount
VT:0011221.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of glutamic acid (2-aminopentanedioic acid), a non-essential alpha-amino used in the biosynthesis of proteins; its anion form, glutamate, is the major excitatory neurotransmitter in the mammalian central nervous system and also serves as the metabolic precursor of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA), an inhibitory neurotransmitter.

VT:0011222.name: blood cholinesterase amount
VT:0011222.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of any of the enzymes that catalyze the hydrolysis of the neurotransmitter acetylcholine into choline and acetic acid.

VT:0011223.name: hoof morphology trait
VT:0011223.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the tip of a toe of an ungulate mammal, strengthened by a thick horny (keratin) covering. The hoof consists of a hard or rubbery sole, and a hard wall formed by a thick nail rolled around the tip of the toe.

VT:0011224.name: paw/hand/foot/hoof integrity trait
VT:0011224.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the pedal or prehensile extremity of vertebrates.

VT:0011225.name: hoof integrity trait
VT:0011225.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the structural soundness of the tip of a toe of an ungulate mammal, strengthened by a thick horny (keratin) covering. The hoof consists of a hard or rubbery sole, and a hard wall formed by a thick nail rolled around the tip of the toe.

VT:0011226.name: adipose skatole amount
VT:0011226.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of skatole, a tryptophan degradation product, detected in fat-storing cells/tissue.

VT:0011227.name: cathepsin B activity
VT:0011227.def: The degree of function or response of a lysosomal cysteine proteinase present in a variety of tissues and important in many physiological and pathological processes.

VT:0011228.name: emotional memory trait
VT:0011228.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability to recall experiences linked with strong emotions better than neutral experiences. This type of memory is influenced by brain regions like the amygdala and hippocampus and is less likely to be forgotten over time.

VT:0011229.name: substantia nigra molecular composition trait
VT:0011229.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the substantia nigra of the brain, the layer of grey substance that separates the posterior parts of the cerebral peduncles (tegmentum mesencephali) from the anterior parts; it normally includes a posterior compact part with many pigmented cells (pars compacta) and an anterior reticular part whose cells contain little pigment (pars reticularis).

VT:0011230.name: substantia nigra ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011230.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the substantia nigra of the brain, the layer of grey substance that separates the posterior parts of the cerebral peduncles (tegmentum mesencephali) from the anterior parts; it normally includes a posterior compact part with many pigmented cells (pars compacta) and an anterior reticular part whose cells contain little pigment (pars reticularis). Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011231.name: primary motor cortex morphology trait
VT:0011231.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the part of the cerebral cortex that receives projections from the motor thalamus and which projects to motor neurons in the brainstem and spinal cord; the primary motor cortex, or M1, is located on the precentral gyrus and on the anterior paracentral lobule on the medial surface of the brain.

VT:0011232.name: primary motor cortex ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011232.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the part of the cerebral cortex that receives projections from the motor thalamus and which projects to motor neurons in the brainstem and spinal cord; the primary motor cortex, or M1, is located on the precentral gyrus and on the anterior paracentral lobule on the medial surface of the brain. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011233.name: cartilage molecular composition trait
VT:0011233.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the nonvascular, resilient, flexible connective tissue found primarily in joints, walls of the thorax, and tubular structures, but which also comprises most of the skeleton in early fetal life; some species have skeletons that are completely composed of cartilage which is never ossified.

VT:0011234.name: cartilage ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011234.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in nonvascular, \nresilient, flexible connective tissue found primarily in joints, walls of the thorax, and tubular structures, but which also comprises most of the skeleton in early fetal life; some species have skeletons that are completely composed of cartilage which is never ossified. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011235.name: carotid artery molecular composition trait
VT:0011235.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the bilaterally paired branched artery that originates from the aortic arches and divides into and includes as parts the internal and external carotid arteries.

VT:0011236.name: left common carotid artery ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011236.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the leftmost of the two common carotid arteries, originating from the aortic arch in the thorax. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.
synonyms: left common carotid artery RNA amount

VT:0011237.name: right common carotid artery ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011237.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the rightmost of the two common carotid arteries, originating from in the neck from the brachiocephalic trunk. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.
synonyms: right common carotid artery RNA amount

VT:0011238.name: tibialis anterior ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011238.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the muscle of the shin that is responsible for dorsiflexion and inversion of the foot. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011239.name: skeletal muscle molecular composition trait
VT:0011239.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in any of the striated muscles connected at either or both extremities with the bony framework of the body.

VT:0011240.name: islet of Langerhans ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011240.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the cellular masses consisting of several to several hundred cells in the interstitial tissue of the pancreas; they are composed of five different cell types that make up the endocrine portion of the pancreas. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011241.name: leukocyte molecular composition trait
VT:0011241.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the nucleated cells of the myeloid or lymphoid lineages, found in blood or other tissue.
synonyms: white blood cell molecular composition trait

VT:0011242.name: leukocyte ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011242.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the nucleated cells of the myeloid or lymphoid lineages, found in blood or other tissue. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.
synonyms: whte blood cell ribonucleic acid amount

VT:0011243.name: basilar artery ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011243.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in a major artery that supplies the hindbrain and runs along the ventral keel of the hindbrain. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011244.name: white adipose ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011244.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid \nin the connective tissue consisting of fat-storing cells and arranged in lobular groups or along minor blood vessels. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011245.name: proximal tubule ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011245.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative\n amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a nephron tubule that connects the glomerular capsule to the loop of Henle. It has a brush border epithelial morphology.

VT:0011246.name: large intestine molecular composition trait
VT:0011246.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the distal portion of the digestive tube that extends from the ileocecal valve to the anus.

VT:0011247.name: large intestine ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011247.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the distal portion of the digestive tube that extends from the ileocecal valve to the anus. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011248.name: gastrocnemius ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011248.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the two-headed large muscle of the posterior portion of the lower hindlimb, the most superficial of the calf muscles. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011249.name: cerebrum molecular composition trait
VT:0011249.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the largest part of the brain, derived from the telencephalon, which is composed of a right and a left hemisphere, each of which contains an outer cerebral cortex and a subcortical basal ganglia; cerebral functions include sensorimotor, emotional, and intellectual activities.

VT:0011250.name: cerebrum ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011250.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the largest part of the brain, derived from the telencephalon, which is composed of a right and a left hemisphere, each of which contains an outer cerebral cortex and a subcortical basal ganglia; cerebral functions include sensorimotor, emotional, and intellectual activities. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011251.name: amygdala ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011251.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the almond-shaped body of basal nuclei anterior to the inferior horn of the lateral ventricle of the brain, within the temporal lobe; this area is involved in aggression and fear responses. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011252.name: medulla oblongata molecular composition trait
VT:0011252.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the most caudal region of the brainstem that lies directly rostral to the spinal cord; includes regions responsible for autonomic functions such as digestion, breathing and control of heart rate.

VT:0011253.name: medulla oblongata ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011253.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the most caudal region of the brainstem that lies directly rostral to the spinal cord; includes regions responsible for autonomic functions such as digestion, breathing and control of heart rate. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011254.name: cerebral cortex molecular composition trait
VT:0011254.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the surface of the cerebral hemisphere that develops from the telencephalon and folds into gyri; it is responsible for intellectual faculties and higher mental functions.

VT:0011255.name: cerebral cortex ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011255.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the surface of the cerebral hemisphere that develops from the telencephalon and folds into gyri; it is responsible for intellectual faculties and higher mental functions. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011256.name: telencephalon molecular composition trait
VT:0011256.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the paired anteriolateral division of the prosencephalon plus the lamina terminalis from which the olfactory lobes, cerebral cortex, and subcortical nuclei are derived.

VT:0011257.name: telencephalon ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011257.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the paired anteriolateral division of the prosencephalon plus the lamina terminalis from which the olfactory lobes, cerebral cortex, and subcortical nuclei are derived. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011258.name: forebrain molecular composition trait
VT:0011258.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the part of the brain developed from the most rostral of the three primary vesicles of the embryonic neural tube from which the diencephalon and telencephalon are derived.

VT:0011259.name: forebrain ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011259.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the part of the brain developed from the most rostral of the three primary vesicles of the embryonic neural tube from which the diencephalon and telencephalon are derived. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011260.name: cerebellum molecular composition trait
VT:0011260.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the part of the metencephalon that lies in the posterior cranial fossa dorsal to the pons and medulla that is concerned with the coordination of movement and learning of motor skills.

VT:0011261.name: cerebellum ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011261.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the part of the metencephalon that lies in the posterior cranial fossa dorsal to the pons and medulla that is concerned with the coordination of movement and learning of motor skills. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011262.name: inner ear molecular composition trait
VT:0011262.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the labyrinth, including the semicircular canals, vestibule and cochlea.

VT:0011263.name: vestibular epithelium ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011263.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in an\n epithelium that is part of a vestibular labyrinth. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011264.name: blood plasma ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011264.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in blood plasma, the liquid component of blood which has blood cells and platelets removed from it. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011265.name: uterine cervix molecular composition trait
VT:0011265.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the opening of the uterus to the vagina.

VT:0011266.name: uterine cervix ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011266.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the opening of the uterus to the vagina. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011267.name: diaphragm molecular composition trait
VT:0011267.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the thin musculomebranous barrier that separates the abdominal and thoracic cavities; often used for breathing control.

VT:0011268.name: diaphragm ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011268.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the thin musculomebranous barrier that separates the abdominal and thoracic cavities; often used for breathing control. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011269.name: prefrontal cortex ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011269.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the anterior part of the frontal lobes of the brain, lying in front of the motor and premotor areas. This brain region has been implicated in planning complex cognitive behaviors, personality expression, decision making and moderating correct social behavior. The basic activity of this brain region is considered to be orchestration of thoughts and actions in accordance with internal goals. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011270.name: oocyte molecular composition trait
VT:0011270.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the female germ cell that has entered meiosis.

VT:0011271.name: oocyte ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011271.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the female germ cell that has entered meiosis. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011272.name: epididymis molecular composition trait
VT:0011272.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the elongated structure connected to the posterior surface of the testes that transports, stores, and matures spermatozoa between testes and vas deferens.

VT:0011273.name: epididymis ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011273.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the elongated structure connected to the posterior surface of the testes that transports, stores, and matures spermatozoa between testes and vas deferens. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011277.name: soleus molecular composition trait
VT:0011277.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the superficial flat broad muscle of the calf that is responsible for plantar flexion of the foot.

VT:0011278.name: soleus ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011278.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the superficial flat broad muscle of the calf that is responsible for plantar flexion of the foot. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011279.name: psoas muscle ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011279.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in a powerful flexor of the thigh at the hip joint (psoas major) and a weak flexor of the trunk and lumbar spinal column (psoas minor). Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011280.name: retroperitoneal fat pad ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011280.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the encapsulated adipose tissue found on the dorsal/posterior side of the serous membrane lining the abdominal cavity and covering most of the viscera. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0011281.name: retroperitoneal fat pad molecular composition trait
VT:0011281.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the encapsulated adipose tissue found on the dorsal/posterior side of the serous membrane lining the abdominal cavity and covering most of the viscera.

VT:0011282.name: connective tissue molecular composition trait
VT:0011282.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the physical or functional supporting tissue of the body, a major constituent of which is an extracellular matrix of ground substance, protein fibers, and structural glycoproteins.

VT:0011283.name: joint molecular composition trait
VT:0011283.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in the articulation point of two or more rigid skeletal components (bones, cartilage, or parts of a single bone).

VT:0011284.name: connective tissue ribonucleic acid amount
VT:0011284.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the physical or functional supporting tissue of the body, a major constituent of which is an extracellular matrix of ground substance, protein fibers, and structural glycoproteins. Ribonucleic acid is a high molecular weight, linear polymer composed of nucleotides containing ribose and linked by phosphodiester bonds.

VT:0015000.name: epididymal fat pad morphology trait
VT:0015000.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the elongated structure connected to the posterior surface of the testes that transports, stores, and matures spermatozoa between testes and vas deferens.

VT:0015001.name: femoral fat pad morphology trait
VT:0015001.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the long bone of the thigh.

VT:0015002.name: interscapular fat pad morphology trait
VT:0015002.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the encapsulated adipose tissue located between the large, flat bones of the shoulder girdle.

VT:0015003.name: mammary fat pad morphology trait
VT:0015003.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the milk-secreting gland that lies within the breast.

VT:0015004.name: mesenteric fat pad morphology trait
VT:0015004.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the peritoneal fold that encloses the small intestine and connects it to the abdominal wall.

VT:0015005.name: parametrial fat pad morphology trait
VT:0015005.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the extension of the subserous coat of the uterus laterally between the layers of the broad ligament.

VT:0015006.name: renal fat pad morphology trait
VT:0015006.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the kidney.

VT:0015007.name: uterine fat pad morphology trait
VT:0015007.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the hollow muscular organ where the embryo/fetus develops.

VT:0015008.name: total fat pad mass
VT:0015008.def: The total amount of matter in all of the encapsulated adipose tissue in the body.

VT:0015009.name: white adipocyte morphology trait
VT:0015009.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the fat cells with light coloration and few mitochondria; these contain a scant ring of cytoplasm surrounding a single large lipid droplet or vacuole.

VT:0015010.name: white adipocyte lipid droplet size trait
VT:0015010.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the single large lipid droplet or vacuole of the fat cells with light coloration and few mitochondria.
synonyms: white fat cell lipid droplet size trait
white lipocyte lipid droplet size trait

VT:0015011.name: white adipocyte size trait
VT:0015011.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of fat cells with light coloration and few mitochondria.

VT:0015014.name: aggression-related behavior trait
VT:0015014.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to domineering, assaultive or forceful physical action.

VT:0015015.name: depression-related behavior trait
VT:0015015.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to responses to a stressful or pleasurable situation or stimulus.

VT:0015024.name: allogrooming behavior trait
VT:0015024.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the cleaning, parasite removal, surface covering adjustment, addition of conditioners to body surface, or other hygienic activities by one animal on another of the same species.

VT:0015026.name: neuron quantity
VT:0015026.def: The proportion or number of the functional cells of the nervous system that receive, conduct, and transmit impulses.

VT:0015027.name: craniofacial physiology trait
VT:0015027.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the region of the body that includes the front part of the head from the chin to the top of the forehead, where the mouth, eyes, nose, and other features are and the part of the skull enclosing the brain.

VT:0015028.name: organ of Corti supporting cell differentiation trait
VT:0015028.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process whereby relatively unspecialized cells acquire the specialized structural and/or functional features characteristic of the highly differentiated epithelial cells with distinctive morphological features that surround the hair cells in the organ of Corti.

VT:0015029.name: outer ear development trait
VT:0015029.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of any of the components of the auricles or external acoustic meatus during their formation and differentiation.

VT:0015031.name: obsolete behavioral response to xenobiotic stimulus trait
VT:0015031.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to behavior or change in behavior in response to exposure to a foreign compound.

VT:0015032.name: obsolete behavioral response to alcohol trait
VT:0015032.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to a change in behavior elicited by alcohol consumption.

VT:0015035.name: auditory cortex morphology trait
VT:0015035.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the region of the cerebral cortex that receives the auditory radiation from the medial geniculate body, a thalamic cell group receiving auditory input from the cochlear nuclei in the rhombencephalon and is responsible for processing of auditory (sound) information.

VT:0015036.name: reproductive life span
VT:0015036.def: The period of time in which an organism can produce offspring.

VT:0015037.name: gland development trait
VT:0015037.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of an organized aggregation of cells functioning as a secretory or excretory organ.

VT:0015038.name: coat/hair development trait
VT:0015038.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation or differentiation of the fine, keratinized filamentous growths arising from the epidermis of mammals.

VT:0015039.name: body width
VT:0015039.def: The distance from side to side of the body of an organism, perpendicular to the axis along which height is measured.

VT:0015042.name: egg production trait
VT:0015042.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the generation of eggs by an organism; after development of the ovum is complete.

VT:0015043.name: milk amount
VT:0015043.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of milk produced by the mammary gland.

VT:0015044.name: beak morphology trait
VT:0015044.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the horny projection of the face containing the jaws, mouth and nares and lacking teeth.

VT:0015045.name: thoracic cavity morphology trait
VT:0015045.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the cavity in the vertebrate body enclosed by the ribcage between the diaphragm and the neck, and contains the lungs, heart, thoracic aorta, pulmonary artery and its branches, thymus gland, and the respiratory airway.

VT:0015046.name: hippocampus neuron morphology trait
VT:0015046.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the neurons located in the hippocampus, the deep-lying structure of the cerebrum involved with memory storage and spatial navigation.

VT:0015047.name: head development trait
VT:0015047.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the portion of the body containing the brain and organs of sight, hearing, taste, and smell during its formation and differentiation.

VT:0015048.name: limb regeneration trait
VT:0015048.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which a limb or portion of a limb is regrown after damage or amputation.

VT:0015049.name: tail regeneration trait
VT:0015049.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which the tail or portion of the tail is regrown after damage or amputation.

VT:0015050.name: paravertebral ganglion morphology trait
VT:0015050.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the groups of postsynaptic neurons located at intervals along the sympatheic trunk, including the superior cervical, middle cervical and stellate (cervicothoracic) ganglia as well as the thoracic, lumbar and sacral ganglia.

VT:0015051.name: prevertebral ganglion morphology trait
VT:0015051.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the sympathetic ganglia located in front of the vertebral column and associated with the major branches of the abdominal aorta; these include the celiac, aorticorenal, superior and inferior mesenteric ganglia.

VT:0015052.name: surface structure trait
VT:0015052.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of the organism subdivision which is the collection of anatomical structures on the body surface.

VT:0015053.name: opercular flap morphology trait
VT:0015053.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the structure that covers the gills.

VT:0015054.name: lumbar dorsal root ganglion morphology trait
VT:0015054.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the group of nerve cell bodies located on the dorsal spinal roots within the vertebral column at the level of the lumbar vertebrae.

VT:0015055.name: cloaca morphology trait
VT:0015055.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the posterior opening that serves as the only such opening for the intestinal, reproductive and urinary tracts.

VT:0015056.name: cloaca respiration trait
VT:0015056.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the movement of gases into and out of the posterior opening that serves as the only such opening for the intestinal, reproductive and urinary tracts.

VT:0015057.name: head physiology trait
VT:0015057.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the portion of the body containing the brain and organs of sight, hearing, taste, and smell.

VT:0015058.name: brain physiology trait
VT:0015058.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the functions of or processes in the brain, one of the two components of the central nervous system and the center of thought and emotion; controls coordination, bodily activities and the interpretation of information from the senses (sight, hearing, smell, etc.).

VT:0015059.name: thorax trait
VT:0015059.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the portion of the body between the head and the abdomen; in mammals this region is formed by the sternum, thoracic vertebrae and ribs and does not include the upper limbs.

VT:0015060.name: rump trait
VT:0015060.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the hindquarters.

VT:0015061.name: thorax development trait
VT:0015061.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the portion of the body between the head and the abdomen during its formation and differentiation.

VT:0015063.name: parasympathetic postganglionic fiber morphology trait
VT:0015063.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any or all of the cholinergic axonal fibers projecting from a parasympathetic ganglion to an effector organ.

VT:0015064.name: parasympathetic preganglionic fiber morphology trait
