VT:0015064.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any or all of the cholinergic axonal fibers projecting from the CNS to a parasympathetic ganglion.

VT:0015065.name: gustatory system trait
VT:0015065.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the series of events required for an organism to receive a gustatory stimulus, convert it to a molecular signal, and recognize and characterize the signal, or the morphology of the structures involved in any of these events.

VT:0015066.name: surface structure morphology trait
VT:0015066.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the organism subdivision which is the collection of anatomical structures on the body surface.

VT:0015067.name: surface structure development trait
VT:0015067.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation or differentiation of the organism subdivision which is the collection of anatomical structures on the body surface.

VT:0015068.name: surface structure physiology trait
VT:0015068.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the organism subdivision which is the collection of anatomical structures on the body surface.

VT:0015069.name: appendage development trait
VT:0015069.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation or differentiation of an external body part that projects from the body.

VT:0015070.name: appendage physiology trait
VT:0015070.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in an external body part that projects from the body.

VT:0015071.name: appendage morphology trait
VT:0015071.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of an external body part that projects from the body.

VT:0015072.name: fin morphology trait
VT:0015072.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the appendages primarily used to maintain position, move, steer or stop in a liquid medium.

VT:0015073.name: fin regeneration trait
VT:0015073.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process by which a fin or portion of a fin is regrown after damage or amputation.

VT:0015074.name: organ system trait
VT:0015074.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of an anatomical group that has as its parts distinct anatomical structures interconnected by anatomical structures at a lower level of granularity.

VT:0015075.name: styloid process of temporal bone morphology trait
VT:0015075.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the slender needle-like pointed projection that runs downward and slightly forward from the base of the inferior surface of the petrous portion of the temporal bone where it joins the tympanic portion; it gives attachment to the styloglossus, stylohyoid, and stylopharyngeus muscles and the stylohyoid and stylomandibular ligaments.

VT:0015076.name: subarcuate fossa morphology trait
VT:0015076.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the irregular depression found on the posterior inner surface of the petrous portion of the temporal bone just below its crest and above and lateral to the internal acoustic meatus.

VT:0015077.name: molecule homeostasis trait
VT:0015077.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the an internal equilibrium of proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances.

VT:0015078.name: blood homeostasis trait
VT:0015078.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the internal equilibrium in the cell-containing fluid that circulates through the body, carrying nourishment, electrolytes, hormones, vitamins, antibodies, heat, and oxygen to the tissues and taking away waste matter and carbon dioxide.

VT:0015079.name: sterol homeostasis trait
VT:0015079.def: Any measurable characteristic related to any process involved in the maintenance of an internal equilibrium of sterol (a steroid with one OH group) within an organism or cell.

VT:0015085.name: cerebellum vermis lobule morphology trait
VT:0015085.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the region of a cerebellar lobule that resides in the central section of the cerebellum between the two hemispheres; in humans, vermis lobule regions may be nearly continuous with the cerebellar hemisphere lobules dorsally but are separated by deeper longitudinal fissures in the ventral regions; in mammals, the vermis portion of the cerebellum has a foliation pattern along the AP axis that is distinct from the lateral cerebellar hemispheres.

VT:0015086.name: urine mineral amount
VT:0015086.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of any inorganic element or compound that has importance in body functions.

VT:0015087.name: vitamin metabolism trait
VT:0015087.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to any process that causes a chemical change in any of the organic substances found in food that are necessary in trace amounts for normal metabolic function.

VT:0015088.name: glucose metabolism trait
VT:0015088.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the chemical reactions and pathways involving glucose, the aldohexose gluco-hexose. D-glucose is dextrorotatory and is sometimes known as dextrose; it is an important source of energy for living organisms and is found free as well as combined in homo- and hetero-oligosaccharides and polysaccharides.

VT:0015089.name: alcohol metabolism trait
VT:0015089.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the chemical reactions and pathways involving alcohols, any of a class of compounds containing one or more hydroxyl groups attached to a saturated carbon atom.

VT:0015090.name: artery molecular composition trait
VT:0015090.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportions of molecules (proteins, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances) within the blood vessels that carry blood away from the heart.

VT:0015093.name: hearing system trait
VT:0015093.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the series of events required for an organism to receive an auditory stimulus, convert it to a molecular signal, and recognize and characterize the signal, or to the morphology of the structures involved in any of these events.

VT:0015094.name: equilibrioception system trait
VT:0015094.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the series of events required for an organism to receive an orientational stimulus, convert it to a molecular signal, and recognize and characterize the signal, or the morphology of the structures involved in any of these events.

VT:0015095.name: sensory trait
VT:0015095.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the series of events required for an organism to receive a sensory stimulus, convert it to a molecular signal, and recognize and characterize the signal, or the morphology of the structures involved in any of these events.

VT:0015096.name: equilibrioception system morphology trait
VT:0015096.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the structures involved in the processes by which an organism can perceive its orientation with respect to gravity.

VT:0015097.name: equilibrioception system physiology trait
VT:0015097.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the structures involved in the combination of processes by which an organism can perceive its orientation with respect to gravity as well as the overall process by which an organism can perceive its orientation with respect to gravity.

VT:0015098.name: nociception system morphology trait
VT:0015098.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the structures involved in the series of events required for an organism to sense pain.

VT:0015099.name: touch perception trait
VT:0015099.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the series of events required for an organism to receive a touch stimulus, convert it to a molecular signal, and recognize and characterize the signal.

VT:0015100.name: nociception system physiology trait
VT:0015100.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the structures required for an organism to sense pain.

VT:0015101.name: proprioception system trait
VT:0015101.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the series of events by which an organism senses the position, location, orientation, and movement of the body and its parts, or to the morphology of the structures involved in any of these events.

VT:0015102.name: parasympathetic cholinergic neuron morphology trait
VT:0015102.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the neurons that utilize acetylcholine as a neurotransmitter, innervate smooth muscle, cardiac muscle and glands and regulate homeostasis.

VT:0015103.name: sympathetic cholinergic neuron morphology trait
VT:0015103.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the neurons that utilize acetylcholine as a neurotransmitter, innervate smooth muscle, cardiac muscle and glands and mediate the body's response to stressful situations.

VT:0015104.name: hippocampus pyramidal cell layer morphology trait
VT:0015104.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the hippocampal layer containing neurons with pyramidal shaped cell bodies.

VT:0015105.name: cerebrum morphology trait
VT:0015105.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the largest part of the brain, derived from the telencephalon, which is composed of a right and a left hemisphere, each of which contains an outer cerebral cortex and a subcortical basal ganglia; cerebral functions include sensorimotor, emotional, and intellectual activities.

VT:0015106.name: neocortex morphology trait
VT:0015106.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the larger part of the mammalian cerebral cortex, distinguished from the allocortex by being composed of a larger number of nerve cells arranged in six layers.

VT:0015107.name: obsolete sympathetic neuron innervation pattern trait
VT:0015107.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement, distribution or supply of nerve fibers to sympathetic termini.\nconsider: VT:0010296, VT:0010297

VT:0015108.name: neurite morphology trait
VT:0015108.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the neuronal process, either a dendrite or an axon in vivo, or a filamentous projection from a neuron such as is seen in tissue culture.

VT:0015109.name: dendrite morphology trait
VT:0015109.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the highly branched tree-like process of a neuron that serves as a receptive field and conducts impulses toward the cell body.

VT:0015110.name: synapse morphology trait
VT:0015110.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the membrane junction site of a nerve cell to a target cell, such as another nerve cell, an effector cell, or a sensory receptor cell; transmission of nerve impulses may be mediated by chemical or by electrical means.

VT:0015111.name: inner ear development trait
VT:0015111.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of any of the components the labyrinth, including the semicircular canals, vestibule, and cochlea.

VT:0100000.name: humerus size trait
VT:0100000.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the bone of the forelimb that articulates with the scapula above and the radius and ulna below.

VT:0100001.name: tibia size trait
VT:0100001.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the medial and larger of the two bones of the lower leg, which articulates with the femur, fibula, and talus.

VT:0100002.name: connective tissue trait
VT:0100002.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical or functional supporting tissue of the body, a major constituent of which is an extracellular matrix of ground substance, protein fibers, and structural glycoproteins.

VT:0100003.name: organism subdivision trait
VT:0100003.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of an anatomical structure which is a subpart of the whole organism; the mereological sum of these is the whole organism.

VT:0100005.name: body size trait
VT:0100005.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the overall physical magnitude of an organism.

VT:0100006.name: anatomical relation trait
VT:0100006.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the location of a part of the body in relation to the body as a whole or to other parts.

VT:0100007.name: growth trait
VT:0100007.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the increase in size of an organism.

VT:0100011.name: urine enzyme amount
VT:0100011.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in the urine of proteins that act as catalysts for biological reactions.

VT:0100012.name: kidney blood vessel physiology trait
VT:0100012.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the network of vessels that convey blood in the paired organs responsible for urine excretion and regulation of ion concentrations.

VT:0100015.name: circulatory system development trait
VT:0100015.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology of the system that moves extracellular fluids to and from tissues during its formation and differentiation.

VT:0100016.name: circulatory system morphology trait
VT:0100016.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic pertaining to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the system that moves extracellular fluids to and from tissues.

VT:0100017.name: circulatory system physiology trait
VT:0100017.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic pertaining to the function of or processes in the system that moves extracellular fluids to and from tissues.

VT:0100018.name: integumentary system development trait
VT:0100018.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation or differentiation of the system consisting of the skin and its derivatives.

VT:0100019.name: integumentary system physiology trait
VT:0100019.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the system consisting of the skin and its derivatives.

VT:0100020.name: integumentary system morphology trait
VT:0100020.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the system consisting of the skin and its derivatives.

VT:0100021.name: mammary alveoli size trait
VT:0100021.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the sac-like structure of the mammary gland that synthesizes and secretes milk after pregnancy.

VT:0100022.name: mammary alveoli diameter
VT:0100022.def: The distance across the sac-like structure of the mammary gland that synthesizes and secretes milk after pregnancy.

VT:0100023.name: mammary alveoli epithelial cell quantity
VT:0100023.def: The proportion or number of epithelial cells surrounding the mammary alveoli.

VT:0100024.name: mammary gland fetal development trait
VT:0100024.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation during the fetal period of the milk-secreting gland in female mammals.

VT:0100025.name: mammary gland cistern morphology trait
VT:0100025.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the largest area for milk accumulation in the ductal system of the mammary gland in some species.

VT:0100026.name: mammary gland cistern capacity
VT:0100026.def: The volume of or amount contained in the largest area for milk accumulation in the ductal system of the mammary gland in some species.

VT:0100027.name: nipple shape trait
VT:0100027.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical form or contours of the projection near the center of the mammary gland, on the surface of which the lactiferous ducts open.

VT:0100028.name: nipple diameter
VT:0100028.def: The distance across the erectile protuberance at the tip of the mammary gland in which the mammary ducts terminate and from which milk can be secreted.

VT:0100030.name: nipple angle
VT:0100030.def: The angle between the vertical and the teat axis.

VT:0100031.name: mammary blood flow trait
VT:0100031.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the volume of blood that flows through the vascular system of the mammary gland.

VT:0100033.name: mammary gland circumference
VT:0100033.def: The distance around the milk-producing glands in female mammals, consisting of lobes containing clusters of alveoli with a system of ducts to convey the milk to an external nipple or teat.

VT:0100034.name: mammary gland mass
VT:0100034.def: The amount of matter in the milk-producing glands in female mammals, consisting of lobes containing clusters of alveoli with a system of ducts to convey the milk to an external nipple or teat.

VT:0100035.name: udder size trait
VT:0100035.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the organ in certain species containing two or more mammary glands, each with its own nipple.

VT:0100036.name: mammary alveoli capacity
VT:0100036.def: The volume of or amount contained in the sac-like structure of the mammary gland that synthesizes and secretes milk after pregnancy.

VT:1000000.name: body conformation trait
VT:1000000.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the symmetry, size and shape of the various body regions relative to each other or general appearance of an organism.

VT:1000023.name: food conversion trait
VT:1000023.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the organism's ability to convert food into body mass.

VT:1000047.name: blood creatine kinase amount
VT:1000047.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of the enzyme creatine kinase, which uses ATP to convert creatine to phosphocreatine and ADP; elevated levels are indicative of muscle damage.

VT:1000059.name: obsolete total heart ventricle morphology trait
VT:1000059.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of both of the lower chambers of the heart.

VT:1000060.name: troponin T amount
VT:1000060.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in a body tissue or fluid of one of a complex of three regulatory proteins required for skeletal and cardiac muscle contraction; used as an indicator for myocardial damage.

VT:1000062.name: chest circumference
VT:1000062.def: The distance around an organism's thorax measured just posterior to the forelimbs.

VT:1000066.name: hip width
VT:1000066.def: The distance from side to side between the points of both hips.

VT:1000067.name: udder morphology trait
VT:1000067.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the organ in certain species containing two or more mammary glands, each with its own nipple.

VT:1000072.name: milk somatic cell quantity
VT:1000072.def: The proportion or number of somatic cells (leukocytes and epithelial cells) in milk; a high number is an indicator of mastitis.

VT:1000111.name: bone mass
VT:1000111.def: The amount of matter in osseous tissue forming a part of the skeleton; consists of a dense outer layer surrounded by the periosteum, and an inner spongy substance.

VT:1000120.name: intercostal muscle thickness
VT:1000120.def: The distance between the surfaces of the respiratory muscles that arise from the lower border of one rib and insert into the upper border of the adjoining rib.

VT:1000121.name: lumbar vertebra quantity
VT:1000121.def: The proportion or number of bony segments of the spinal column located anterior/superior to the sacral vertebrae and posterior/inferior to the thoracic vertebrae.

VT:1000122.name: thoracic vertebra quantity
VT:1000122.def: The proportion or number of bony segments of the vertebral column located anterior to the lumbar vertebrae and posterior to the cervical vertebrae, which articulate with the ribs.

VT:1000126.name: adipose thickness
VT:1000126.def: The distance between the surfaces of a layer of fat-storing tissue.

VT:1000130.name: internal adipose amount
VT:1000130.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of fat-storing tissue in the body cavity, specifically in the areas of the kidneys, pelvis, and heart.
synonyms: kidney, pelvic, and heart fat weight

VT:1000135.name: subcutaneous adipose thickness
VT:1000135.def: The distance between the surfaces of the fat-storing layer directly beneath the skin.

VT:1000146.name: longissimus thoracis mass
VT:1000146.def: The amount of matter in the muscle of the back which is the intermediate and largest of the continuations of the Sacrospinalis.

VT:1000149.name: intercostal muscle mass
VT:1000149.def: The amount of matter in the respiratory muscles that arise from the lower border of one rib and insert into the upper border of the adjoining rib.

VT:1000152.name: wellness/fitness trait
VT:1000152.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the healthfulness of an organism.

VT:1000161.name: milk total fat amount
VT:1000161.def: The total proportion, quantity, or volume of fat in milk.

VT:1000165.name: milk protein amount
VT:1000165.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in milk of macromolecules consisting of long sequences of amino acids in peptide linkage.

VT:1000181.name: viable offspring quantity
VT:1000181.def: The proportion or number of offspring born alive.

VT:1000189.name: offspring quantity
VT:1000189.def: The proportion or number of offspring born in single or multiple births.

VT:1000190.name: estrus intensity
VT:1000190.def: The degree to which the female displays the state of sexual excitement during which she is most receptive to mating.

VT:1000197.name: stillborn offspring quantity
VT:1000197.def: The proportion or number of offspring that have died before birth process is completed.

VT:1000205.name: nipple length
VT:1000205.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the nipple.

VT:1000206.name: nipple quantity
VT:1000206.def: The proportion or number of mammary gland projections containing the outlets of the milk ducts through which milk is excreted.

VT:1000210.name: scrotum circumference
VT:1000210.def: The distance around the external sac of skin that encloses the testes.

VT:1000220.name: abdominal adipose amount
VT:1000220.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the fat-storing tissue lining the cavity bounded by the abdominal walls, the diaphragm, and the pelvis, and surrounding the internal organs.

VT:1000223.name: pectoralis muscle mass
VT:1000223.def: The amount of matter in either or both of the muscles that make up the upper and fore part of the chest that adduct and rotate the arm and lift the ribs.

VT:1000226.name: gizzard mass
VT:1000226.def: The amount of matter in the secondary, muscular stomach in some vertebrates used for grinding up food.

VT:1000238.name: feather development trait
VT:1000238.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the morphology or physiology during formation and differentiation of the surface covering of birds, made of keratin.

VT:1000241.name: fear/anxiety-related behavior trait
VT:1000241.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to actions or reactions in tests for fear or anxiety related behaviors.

VT:1000242.name: feather pecking trait
VT:1000242.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the pecking of the other birds.

VT:1000243.name: receiving feather pecking trait
VT:1000243.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the receipt of pecking by the other birds.

VT:1000244.name: obsolete social tendency trait
VT:1000244.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the tendency to choose between freely available food or food in combination with social stimuli in a maze test with several options.\nconsider: VT:0010455

VT:1000276.name: humerus area
VT:1000276.def: The two-dimensional extent of the bone of the forelimb that articulates with the scapula above and the radius and ulna below.

VT:1000278.name: humerus mineral mass
VT:1000278.def: The amount of matter in the minerals (inorganic elements or compounds that have importance in body functions) in the bone of the forelimb that articulates with the scapula above and the radius and ulna below.

VT:1000280.name: humerus width
VT:1000280.def: The distance from side to side of the bone of the forelimb that articulates with the scapula above and the radius and ulna below.

VT:1000281.name: tibia area
VT:1000281.def: The two-dimensional extent of the medial and larger of the two bones of the lower leg, which articulates with the femur, fibula, and talus.

VT:1000283.name: tibia mineral mass
VT:1000283.def: The amount of matter in the minerals (inorganic elements or compounds that have importance in body functions) in the medial and larger of the two bones of the lower leg, which articulates with the femur, fibula, and talus.

VT:1000284.name: tibia strength trait
VT:1000284.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the medial and larger of the two bones of the lower leg to withstand the application of force without yielding or breaking.

VT:1000286.name: tibia elasticity trait
VT:1000286.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the medial and larger of the two bones of the lower leg to recover size and shape after deformation in any way.

VT:1000289.name: tibia width
VT:1000289.def: The distance from side to side of the medial and larger of the two bones of the lower leg, which articulates with the femur, fibula, and talus.

VT:1000294.name: egg quantity
VT:1000294.def: The proportion or number of eggs produced.

VT:1000361.name: cannon bone circumference
VT:1000361.def: The distance around the metacarpal or metatarsal bone(s) in some hoofed mammals, extending between the knee or hock and the fetlock.

VT:1000369.name: femur size trait
VT:1000369.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the long bone of the thigh.

VT:1000385.name: total vertebra quantity
VT:1000385.def: The total number of bony segments constituting the vertebral column.

VT:1000401.name: muscle androstenone amount
VT:1000401.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the testicular steroid androstenone detected in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:1000414.name: diaphragm mass
VT:1000414.def: The amount of matter in the thin musculomebranous barrier that separates the abdominal and thoracic cavities.

VT:1000415.name: obsolete glycolytic potential
VT:1000415.def: OBSOLETE. The measure of the available glycogen stores in a body tissue or fluid; available glycogen is dependent on glycogen, glucose, glucose-6-phosphate, and lactate levels.

VT:1000419.name: total foot mass
VT:1000419.def: The total amount of matter in all of the pedal extremities of an organism.

VT:1000420.name: head mass
VT:1000420.def: The amount of matter in the portion of the body containing the brain and organs of sight, hearing, taste, and smell.

VT:1000421.name: small intestine length
VT:1000421.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the upper portion of the digestive tract, between the stomach and the large intestine.

VT:1000425.name: skin mass
VT:1000425.def: The amount of matter in the membranous protective covering of the body.

VT:1000429.name: muscle lactate amount
VT:1000429.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the compound produced from pyruvate by lactate dehydrogenase in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:1000430.name: muscle cholesterol amount
VT:1000430.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the most abundant steroid in animal tissues present in the total lipid extracted from the contractile tissue that effects movement.

VT:1000431.name: muscle indole amount
VT:1000431.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of indole, a tryptophan degradation product, detected in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:1000432.name: muscle water amount
VT:1000432.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of this clear, odorless, tasteless liquid in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:1000433.name: muscle protein amount
VT:1000433.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of macromolecules consisting of long chains of amino acids in peptide linkage in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:1000434.name: muscle skatole amount
VT:1000434.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of skatole, a tryptophan degradation product, detected in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:1000435.name: muscle conductivity trait
VT:1000435.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the contractile tissue that effects movement of an organ or part of the body to conduct electrical current.

VT:1000436.name: skeletal muscle conductivity trait
VT:1000436.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the striated muscles connected at either or both extremities with the bony framework of the body to conduct electrical current.

VT:1000444.name: adipose androstenone amount
VT:1000444.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the testicular steroid androstenone present in fat tissue.

VT:1000465.name: intermuscular adipose amount
VT:1000465.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of fat-storing tissue present between the muscles.

VT:1000468.name: intestinal adipose mass
VT:1000468.def: The amount of matter in the fat-storing tissue associated with the digestive tube passing from the stomach to the anus.

VT:1000472.name: subcutaneous adipose mass
VT:1000472.def: The amount of matter in the fat-storing layer directly beneath the skin.

VT:1000479.name: muscle lipid amount
VT:1000479.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of fat-soluble substances (molecules composed of carbon and hydrogen and are characteristically insoluble in water) in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:1000480.name: intramuscular adipose mass
VT:1000480.def: The amount of matter in the fat-storing cells/tissue present within skeletal muscle.

VT:1000518.name: adipose fatty acid trans-11-C18:1 amount
VT:1000518.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a monounsaturated fatty acid (C18H34O2), with a carbon-carbon double bond at C-11, present in a sample of fat.

VT:1000519.name: adipose fatty acid C20:2 amount
VT:1000519.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of an unsaturated fatty acid (C20H36O2), with two carbon-carbon double bonds, present in a sample of fat.

VT:1000520.name: adipose fatty acid cis-11-C20:1 amount
VT:1000520.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a monounsaturated fatty acid (C20H38O2), with a carbon-carbon double bond at C-11, present in a sample of fat.

VT:1000521.name: adipose fatty acid C17:0 amount
VT:1000521.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a saturated fatty acid (C17H34O2) present in a sample of fat.

VT:1000522.name: adipose fatty acid cis-9,cis-12-C18:2 amount
VT:1000522.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of an omega-6 unsaturated fatty acid (C18H32O2), with two carbon-carbon double bonds, present in a sample of fat.

VT:1000523.name: adipose fatty acid C18:3 n-3 amount
VT:1000523.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of an omega-3, polyunsaturated fatty acid (C18H30O2), with three carbon-carbon double bonds, present in a sample of fat.
synonyms: adipose fatty acid C18:3 n-3 content
adipose fatty acid C18:3 n-3 percentage

VT:1000524.name: adipose fatty acid C14:0 amount
VT:1000524.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a saturated fatty acid (C14H28O2) present in a sample of fat.

VT:1000525.name: adipose fatty acid cis-9-C18:1 amount
VT:1000525.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a monounsaturated, omega-9 fatty acid (C18H34O2), present in a sample of fat.

VT:1000526.name: adipose fatty acid C16:0 amount
VT:1000526.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a saturated fatty acid (C16H32O2) present in a sample of fat.

VT:1000527.name: adipose fatty acid cis-9-C16:1 amount
VT:1000527.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of an omega-7, monounsaturated fatty acid (C16H30O2) present in a sample of fat.

VT:1000528.name: adipose fatty acid C18:0 amount
VT:1000528.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of a saturated fatty acid (C18H36O2) present in a sample of fat.

VT:1000574.name: longissimus thoracis muscle area
VT:1000574.def: The two-dimensional extent of the muscle of the back which is the intermediate and largest of the continuations of the Sacrospinalis.

VT:1000575.name: longissimus thoracis muscle thickness
VT:1000575.def: The distance between the surfaces of the muscle of the back which is the intermediate and largest of the continuations of the Sacrospinalis.

VT:1000578.name: longissimus thoracis length
VT:1000578.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the muscle of the back which is the intermediate and largest of the continuations of the Sacrospinalis.

VT:1000606.name: skeletal muscle myosin heavy chain type I amount
VT:1000606.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the type I isoform, predominant in slow-twitch fibers, of the most abundant protein in skeletal muscle.

VT:1000607.name: skeletal muscle myosin heavy chain type IIa amount
VT:1000607.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the type IIa isoform, found in greater amounts in fast fibers, of the most abundant protein in skeletal muscle.

VT:1000612.name: type IIb muscle fiber quantity
VT:1000612.def: The proportion or number of type IIb, fast glycolytic fibers in skeletal muscle; these white fibers are greater in diameter than red fibers, have less myoglobin, sarcoplasm, and mitochondria, and contract more quickly.

VT:1000637.name: functional nipple quantity
VT:1000637.def: The proportion or number of nipples capable of secreting milk.

VT:1000639.name: uterine horn length
VT:1000639.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the upper right or left portion of the uterus to which the uterine tube is connected.

VT:1000640.name: uterine horn mass
VT:1000640.def: The matter of the upper right or left portion of the hollow muscular organ where the embryo/fetus develops to which the uterine tube is connected.

VT:1000641.name: ovary mass
VT:1000641.def: The amount of matter in the female reproductive gland containing the germ cells.

VT:1000642.name: uterus length
VT:1000642.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the hollow muscular organ where the embryo/fetus develops.

VT:1000643.name: sperm production trait
VT:1000643.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the production of mature male germ cells.

VT:1000644.name: testis mass
VT:1000644.def: The amount of matter in the male reproductive gland(s) where sperm production occurs.

VT:1000653.name: lactation duration
VT:1000653.def: The period of time over which milk is produced from the mammary gland.

VT:1000664.name: feather morphology trait
VT:1000664.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the surface covering of birds, made of keratin.

VT:1000666.name: femur width
VT:1000666.def: The distance from side to side of the long bone of the thigh.

VT:1000667.name: gizzard morphology trait
VT:1000667.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the secondary, muscular stomach in some vertebrates used for grinding up food.

VT:1000670.name: blood cortisol amount
VT:1000670.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume in whole blood, serum, or plasma of a steroid hormone secreted by the adrenal cortex which acts as an anti-inflammatory agent.

VT:1000683.name: obsolete total heart ventricle size trait
VT:1000683.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of both of the lower chambers of the heart.

VT:1000684.name: total heart ventricle mass
VT:1000684.def: The total amount of matter in both of the lower chambers of the heart.

VT:1000685.name: muscle pH regulation trait
VT:1000685.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative acidity or alkalinity in the muscle, as measured by the concentration of hydrogen ion.

VT:1000686.name: paw/hand/foot/hoof mass
VT:1000686.def: The amount of matter in the pedal or prehensile extremity of vertebrates.

VT:1000687.name: forelimb mass
VT:1000687.def: The amount of matter in the anterior/superior jointed appendages used for locomotion or grasping.

VT:1000688.name: metatarsus mass
VT:1000688.def: The amount of matter in any of the bones of the lower/hindlimbs that articulate proximally with the tarsus and distally with the phalanges.

VT:1000689.name: hindlimb mass
VT:1000689.def: The amount of matter in the posterior/inferior jointed appendages used for locomotion or grasping.

VT:1000694.name: muscle glycogen homeostasis trait
VT:1000694.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the state of equilibrium in muscle with respect to this readily converted carbohydrate reserve, found in most tissues, especially liver and muscle.

VT:1000702.name: udder cleft morphology trait
VT:1000702.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the upward extension of the suspensory ligament separating the two halves of the udder.

VT:1000703.name: udder height, floor to tarsal joint
VT:1000703.def: The vertical dimension between the udder floor and tarsal joint (point of the hock), viewed from the side.

VT:1000704.name: mammary gland length
VT:1000704.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the milk-producing glands in female mammals, consisting of lobes containing clusters of alveoli with a system of ducts to convey the milk to an external nipple or teat.

VT:1000705.name: mammary gland width
VT:1000705.def: The distance from side to side of the milk-producing glands in female mammals, consisting of lobes containing clusters of alveoli with a system of ducts to convey the milk to an external nipple or teat.

VT:1000706.name: longissimus thoracis morphology trait
VT:1000706.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the muscle of the back which is the intermediate and largest of the continuations of the Sacrospinalis.

VT:1000711.name: abdominal fat pad mass
VT:1000711.def: The amount of matter in the encapsulated adipose tissue in the cavity bounded by the abdominal walls, the diaphragm, and the pelvis.

VT:1000712.name: skeletal muscle mass
VT:1000712.def: The amount of matter in one or more of the striated muscles connected at either or both extremities with the bony framework of the body.

VT:1000713.name: skeletal muscle myosin heavy chain type IIb amount
VT:1000713.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the type IIb isoform, found in the fastest fibers, of the most abundant protein in skeletal muscle.

VT:1000720.name: nonfunctional nipple quantity
VT:1000720.def: The proportion or number of nipples incapable of secreting milk.

VT:1000726.name: back conformation trait
VT:1000726.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the arrangement of an organism's back, neck, and area between the shoulder blades, known as the withers in some animals.

VT:1000731.name: chest width
VT:1000731.def: The distance from side to side of the chest, viewed from the front; typically measured at the widest point above the forelimbs.

VT:1000732.name: chest depth
VT:1000732.def: The dorsal-ventral dimension of the chest, measured directly behind the forelimbs.

VT:1000733.name: heel depth
VT:1000733.def: The vertical distance from the ground to the hairline at the back of the hoof.

VT:1000734.name: hoof diagonal
VT:1000734.def: The distance from the tip of the hoof to the hairline at the back of the hoof.

VT:1000735.name: hoof angle
VT:1000735.def: The angle at which the hoof wall meets the ground.

VT:1000736.name: obsolete temperament trait
VT:1000736.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the general attitude or characteristic reactions of an organism exhibited toward another organism.\nconsider: VT:0010452

VT:1000737.name: hind leg set
VT:1000737.def: The squareness of the hind legs in relation to the body; may be assessed from the side or from behind.

VT:1000738.name: limb conformation trait
VT:1000738.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the assessment of the overall structure and proportions of the jointed appendages of an animal, used for locomotion or grasping.

VT:1000739.name: rump morphology trait
VT:1000739.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the hindquarters.

VT:1000740.name: rump width
VT:1000740.def: The distance from side to side between the caudal protrusions of the pelvis, viewed from behind.

VT:1000741.name: rump angle
VT:1000741.def: The slope of the topline of the rump, between the cranial and caudal protrusions of the pelvic bone, viewed from the side.

VT:1000742.name: sarcomere length
VT:1000742.def: The distance from point to point along the longest axis of the segment of a myofibril between two Z lines.

VT:1000743.name: skeletal muscle fiber quantity
VT:1000743.def: The proportion or number of skeletal muscle fibers, the large multinucleated cells that make up the striated muscles connected at either or both extremities with the bony framework of the body.

VT:1000746.name: skeletal muscle myosin isoform amount
VT:1000746.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of any of several forms of the thick filament protein in any of the striated muscles connected at either or both extremities with the bony framework of the body.

VT:1000747.name: type I muscle fiber quantity
VT:1000747.def: The proportion or number of type I, slow oxidative fibers in skeletal muscle; these red fibers are rich in sarcoplasm, myoglobin, and mitochondria and contract more slowly than white fibers.

VT:1000748.name: type IIa muscle fiber quantity
VT:1000748.def: The proportion or number of type IIa, fast oxidative fibers in skeletal muscle; have an admixture of glycolytic and oxidative enzymes and an intermediate twitch time.

VT:1000761.name: muscle nitrogen amount
VT:1000761.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of this element present in the tissue composed of contractile cells or fibers that effects movement.

VT:1000764.name: muscle myoglobin amount
VT:1000764.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of the heme-containing, oxygen-carrying and storage protein in the contractile tissue that effects movement.

VT:1000775.name: integumentary system trait
VT:1000775.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of the system consisting of the skin and its derivatives.

VT:1000776.name: alimentary system trait
VT:1000776.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of the system dedicated to the mechanical, chemical, and enzymatic processing of food.

VT:1000777.name: urinary system trait
VT:1000777.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of the organs involved in the production or excretion of urine or the urine produced.

VT:1000781.name: nervous/sensory system trait
VT:1000781.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of the system responsible for receiving and processing information about an organism's environment and controlling behavior.

VT:1000782.name: endocrine/exocrine system trait
VT:1000782.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of the system of glands that secrete hormones and other substances.

VT:1000783.name: immune system trait
VT:1000783.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of the organs or cells associated with the body's defense against foreign organisms or substances and aberrant native cells.

VT:1000784.name: circulatory system trait
VT:1000784.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of the system that moves extracellular fluids to and from tissues.

VT:2000000.name: arterial blood pressure trait
VT:2000000.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to blood pressure in the arteries.

VT:2000001.name: capillary blood pressure trait
VT:2000001.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to blood pressure in the capillaries.

VT:2000002.name: venous blood pressure trait
VT:2000002.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the blood pressure in the veins.

VT:2000003.name: regional blood pressure trait
VT:2000003.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the blood pressure in a specific region of the body, tissue, or organ.

VT:2000004.name: coronary blood flow trait
VT:2000004.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to blood flow in the heart.

VT:2000005.name: cerebral blood flow trait
VT:2000005.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to blood flow in the brain.

VT:2000006.name: renal blood flow trait
VT:2000006.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to blood flow in the kidneys.

VT:2000007.name: obsolete pulmonary blood flow trait
VT:2000007.def: OBSOLETE. Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the blood flow in the lungs.\nconsider: VT:0002295

VT:2000008.name: lymph flow trait
VT:2000008.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the movement of lymph through the lymph vessels.

VT:2000009.name: heart pumping trait
VT:2000009.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of the heart to pump blood through its various chambers and out into the circulatory system.

VT:2000016.name: obsolete venous return amount
VT:2000016.def: OBSOLETE. The proportion, quantity, or volume of blood that enters the right heart from the vena cava.

VT:2000017.name: heart electrical impulse conduction trait
VT:2000017.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the conduction of an electrical impulse through the heart.

VT:2000018.name: heart muscle contractility trait
VT:2000018.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of cardiac muscle fibers to shorten.

VT:2000020.name: heart muscle relaxation trait
VT:2000020.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of striated, involuntary muscle comprising the myocardium to lengthen following contraction.

VT:2000021.name: heart muscle contractile force
VT:2000021.def: The force generated by contraction of the striated, involuntary muscle comprising the myocardium.

VT:3000000.name: platelet adhesion trait
VT:3000000.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of platelets sticking to exposed extracellular matrix proteins.

VT:3000001.name: platelet activation trait
VT:3000001.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of stimulating platelets to release substances that promote platelet adhesion and blood clotting.

VT:3000002.name: platelet aggregation trait
VT:3000002.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process of platelets sticking to each other.

VT:3000003.name: fibrin formation trait
VT:3000003.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the process whereby prothrombin is activated to thrombin which acts to convert fibrinogen to fibrin, allowing for formation of a fibrin clot.

VT:3000004.name: blood viscosity trait
VT:3000004.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the resistance of two layers of blood to sliding against each other.

VT:4000007.name: coat/hair physiology trait
VT:4000007.def: Any measurable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the fine, keratinized filamentous growths arising from the epidermis of mammals.

VT:4000009.name: skin layer morphology trait
VT:4000009.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the individual layers of the membranous protective covering of the body.

VT:4000011.name: endocrine pancreas morphology trait
VT:4000011.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the Islets of Langerhans of the pancreas which secrete insulin and glucagon into the bloodstream.

VT:4000012.name: mucous gland morphology trait
VT:4000012.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of any of the glands that secret mucous.

part_of.name: part_of
part_of.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the function of or processes in the organized aggregations of cells that release hormones in response to neural stimuli.
